verses.text: As dooyrt Yeesey rish y centurion, Immee royd, as 'naght myr t'ou er chredjal, myr shen dy jig oo jeh. As va e er-mooinjerey er ny lheihys ayns yn oor cheddin.

verses.name: Matthew 8:14
verses.text: As tra va Yeesey er jeet stiagh ayns thie Pheddyr, honnick eh moir e ven ny lhie, as ching ayns y chiassaghey.

verses.name: Matthew 8:15
verses.text: As venn eh rish y laue eck, as daag yn chiassaghey ee: as ren ee girree, as shirveish orroo.

verses.name: Matthew 8:16
verses.text: Tra va'n fastyr er jeet, hug ad lhien huggey ymmodee va drogh-spyrrydyn ayndoo: as deiyr eh magh ny spyrrydyn lesh fockle, as laanee eh ooilley ny va ching.

verses.name: Matthew 8:17
verses.text: Myr shoh va cooilleenit shen ny loayr Esaias y phadeyr, gra, Ghow eh-hene er ny aslayntyn ainyn, as dymmyrk eh nyn ghoghanyn.

verses.name: Matthew 8:18
verses.text: Nish tra honnick Yeesey earrooyn mooarey dy leih mygeayrt y mysh, hug eh sarey dy gholl gys y cheu elley.

verses.name: Matthew 8:19
verses.text: As haink scrudeyr dy row huggey, as dooyrt eh rish, Vainshter, eiyr-yms ort raad erbee dy jed oo.

verses.name: Matthew 8:20
verses.text: As dooyrt Yeesey rish, Ta tuill ec ny shynnee, as idd ec eeanlee yn aer, agh cha vel ec mac y dooinney wheesh boayl aaght son e chione.

verses.name: Matthew 8:21
verses.text: As dooyrt fer elley jeh e ynseydee rish, Hiarn, lhig dou hoshiaght goll thie dy oanluckey my ayr.

verses.name: Matthew 8:22
verses.text: Agh dooyrt Yeesey rish, Eiyr orrym's, as lhig da ny merriu nyn merriu y oanluckey.

verses.name: Matthew 8:23
verses.text: As tra v'eh er ghoaill lhuingys, hie e ynseydee marish.

verses.name: Matthew 8:24
verses.text: As cur-my-ner hrog sterrym mooar ayns yn aarkey, myr shen dy row ny tonnyn brishey harrish y lhong: agh v'eshyn ny chadley.

verses.name: Matthew 8:25
verses.text: As haink e ynseydee huggey, as ghooisht ad eh, gra, Hiarn, saue shin: bee mayd caillit.

verses.name: Matthew 8:26
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Cre'n-fa ta shiu agglagh, shiuish dy chredjue moal? Eisht dirree eh, as hug eh yn gheay, as yn aarkey fo-harey as va kiuney vooar ayn.

verses.name: Matthew 8:27
verses.text: Agh ghow ny deiney yindys, gra, Cre'n dooinney eh shoh, dy vel ny eer geayghyn as y faarkey ayns biallys da!

verses.name: Matthew 8:28
verses.text: As tra v'eh er jeet gys y cheu elley, gys cheer ny Gergesenee haink daa ghooinney va drogh-spyrrydyn ayndoo magh ny whail, veih mastey ny hoiaghyn, as cha keoi shen v'ad, nagh by-lhoys da dooinney erbee goaill yn raad shen.

verses.name: Matthew 8:29
verses.text: As cur-my-ner deie ad, gra, Cre'n eie t'ayd orrin, Yeesey Vac Yee? vel oo er jeet dy nyn dorchaghey roish y traa?

verses.name: Matthew 8:30
verses.text: As tammylt voue va beiyhaghey griagh mooar dy vuckyn.

verses.name: Matthew 8:31
verses.text: As ghuee ny drogh-spyrrydyn er, gra, My eiyrys oo magh shin, lhig dooin goll stiagh ayns ny muckyn.

verses.name: Matthew 8:32
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Gow-jee reue. As tra v'ad er jeet ass ny deiney, hie ad stiagh ayns y ghriagh dy vuckyn: as cur-my-ner roie yn slane griagh gour nyn mullee lesh yn eaynee gys y cheayn, as v'ad baiht ayns ny ushtaghyn.

verses.name: Matthew 8:33
verses.text: As roie ny bochillyn roue, as haink ad gys yn ard-valley, as dinsh ad dy chooilley nhee: as mychione ny deiney va seaghnit lesh ny drogh-spyrrydyn.

verses.name: Matthew 8:34
verses.text: As cur-my-ner, haink y slane ard-valley magh quail Yeesey, as tra honnick ad eh, ghuee ad er, eh dy gholl roish ass ny ardjyn oc.

verses.name: Matthew 9:1
verses.text: As ghow eh lhuingys, as hioill eh harrish, as haink eh gys e ard-valley hene.

verses.name: Matthew 9:2
verses.text: As cur-my-ner, hug ad lhieu huggey dooinney doghanit lesh y chingys craaee, ny lhie er lhiabbee: as Yeesey goaill tastey jeh'n chredjue oc, dooyrt eh rish y varter, Vac, bee dy yien mie, ta dty pheccaghyn er ny leih dhyt.

verses.name: Matthew 9:3
verses.text: Er shoh, dooyrt shiartanse jeh ny scrudeyryn roo hene, T'eh shoh loayrt goan mollaghtagh.

verses.name: Matthew 9:4
verses.text: As Yeesey toiggal ny smooinaghtyn oc, dooyrt, Cre'n-fa ta drogh smooinaghtyn troggal ayns ny creeaghyn eu?

verses.name: Matthew 9:5
verses.text: Son cre sassey dy ghra, Ta dty pheccaghyn er ny leih dhyt? ny dy ghra, Irree seose as shooill?

verses.name: Matthew 9:6
verses.text: Agh dy vod fys y ve eu, dy vel pooar ec Mac y dooinney er y thalloo dy leih peccaghyn: (eisht dooyrt eh rish y varter) Irree, trog lhiat dty lhiabbee, as immee royd gys dty hie.

verses.name: Matthew 9:7
verses.text: As dirree eh seose as jimmee eh gys e hie.

verses.name: Matthew 9:8
verses.text: Agh tra honnick y pobble shoh, ghow ad yindys, as hug ad moylley da Jee, v'er choyrt lheid y phooar da deiney.

verses.name: Matthew 9:9
verses.text: As tra yn Yeesey er n'gholl veih shen, honnick eh dooinney va enmyssit Mian, ny hoie ec boayrd y cheesh: as dooyrt eh rish, Eiyr orrym's. As dirree eh seose, as deiyr eh er.

verses.name: Matthew 9:10
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione, myr va Yeesey ny hoie ec bee ayns y thie, cur-my-ner haink ymmodee publicanee as peccee, as hoie ad sheese marishyn as marish e ynseydee.

verses.name: Matthew 9:11
verses.text: Tra honnick ny Phariseeyn shoh, dooyrt ad rish e ynseydee, Cre'n-fa ta'n mainshter eu gee marish publicanee as peccee?

verses.name: Matthew 9:12
verses.text: Agh cheayll Yeesey ad, as dooyrt eh roo, Cha vel feme ocsyn ta slane er yn er-lhee, agh ec sleih chingey.

verses.name: Matthew 9:13
verses.text: Agh immee-jee shiuish, as ynsee-jee cre ta dy ve toiggit liorish y raa shoh, S'bare lhiam myghin na oural: son cha daink mish dy eamagh er y vooinjer chairagh, agh er peccee gys arrys.

verses.name: Matthew 9:14
verses.text: Eisht haink huggey ynseydee Ean, as dooyrt ad, Cre'n-fa ta shinyn as ny Phariseeyn trostey dy mennick, agh cha vel y vooinjer ayd's trostey?

verses.name: Matthew 9:15
verses.text: As dooyrt Yeesey roo, Vod caarjyn y dooinney-poosee dobberan, choud as ta dooinney yn phoosee maroo? agh hig ny laghyn, tra vees dooinney yn phoosee er ny ghoaill ersooyl voue, as shen y traa nee ad trostey.

verses.name: Matthew 9:16
verses.text: Cha vel dooinney erbee cur peesh dy eaddagh noa er shenn gharmad: son ta'n pheesh goaill e laane ass y gharmad, as ta'n assee wheesh shen smessey,

verses.name: Matthew 9:17
verses.text: Chamoo ta sleih coyrt feeyn noa ayns shenn voteilyn: er-nonney ta ny boteilyn scoltey, as ta'n feeyn er ny gheayrtey, as ta ny boteilyn dy choayl orroo; agh t'ad cur feeyn noa ayns boteilyn noa, as t'ad ny neesht sauchey.

verses.name: Matthew 9:18
verses.text: Choud as v'eh loayrt ny goan shoh roo, cur-my-ner haink fer-reill, as hug eh ooashley da, gra, Ta m'inneen eer nish paartail: agh tar, as cur dty laue urree, as bee ee bio.

verses.name: Matthew 9:19
verses.text: As hrog Yeesey, as deiyr eh er, as myr shen ren e ynseydee.

verses.name: Matthew 9:20
verses.text: (As cur-my-ner haink ben cheu-e-chooylloo, va doghanit lesh roie-folley rish daa vlein jeig, as venn ee rish oirr e gharmad.

verses.name: Matthew 9:21
verses.text: Son dooyrt ee r'ee hene, My oddym agh bentyn rish e gharmad bee-ym er my lheihys.

verses.name: Matthew 9:22
verses.text: Agh hyndaa Yeesey mygeayrt, as tra honnick eh ee, dooyrt eh, Inneen bee dy yien mie; ta dty chredjue er dty laanaghey. As va'n ven er ny lheihys veih yn oor shen magh.)

verses.name: Matthew 9:23
verses.text: As tra va Yeesey er jeet stiagh ayns thie yn er-reill, as tra honnick eh ny bardoonee, as y cheshaght ooilley 'syn un chiaull.

verses.name: Matthew 9:24
verses.text: Dooyrt eh roo, Scugh-jee, son cha vel y ven-aeg marroo, agh ny cadley. As hie ad son craidey mysh.

verses.name: Matthew 9:25
verses.text: As tra va'n sleih er skeayley, hie eh stiagh, as ghow eh ee er laue, as dirree yn ven-aeg.

verses.name: Matthew 9:26
verses.text: As hie goo magh jeh shoh trooid ooilley yn cheer.

verses.name: Matthew 9:27
verses.text: As tra va Yeesey er n'immeeaght veih shen, deiyr daa ghooinney doal er gyllagh as gra, Jean myghin orrin, Vac

verses.name: Matthew 9:28
verses.text: As tra v'eh er jeet stiagh ayns y thie, haink ny deiney doal huggey: as dooyrt Yeesey roo, Vel shiu credjal dy voddym shoh y yannoo? Dooyrt adsyn rish, Ta Hiarn.

verses.name: Matthew 9:29
verses.text: Eisht venn eh rish ny sooillyn oc, gra Cordail rish nyn gredjue dy row nyn aghin eu.

verses.name: Matthew 9:30
verses.text: As va ny sooillyn oc er nyn vosley, as hug Yeesey currym gyere orroo, gra, Jeeagh Jee nagh vow dooinney erbee fys er.

verses.name: Matthew 9:31
verses.text: Agh tra v'adsyn er n'gholl roue, hug ad goo jeh magh trooid ooilley yn cheer shen.

verses.name: Matthew 9:32
verses.text: Erreish daue shoh v'er n'gholl ersooyl, cur-my-ner, hug ad lhieu huggey dooinney balloo va drogh-spyrryd ayn.

verses.name: Matthew 9:33
verses.text: As tra va'n drogh-spyrryd er ny chastey, ren y balloo loayrt: as ghow yn pobble yindys, gra, Cha row rieau lheid shoh er ny akin ayns Israel.

verses.name: Matthew 9:34
verses.text: Agh dooyrt ny Phariseeyn, Liorish yn ard ghrogh-spyrryd t'eshyn castey drogh-spyrrydyn.

verses.name: Matthew 9:35
verses.text: As hie Yeesey mygeayrt ooilley ny ard-valjyn as ny baljyn-cheerey oc, gynsaghey ayns ny kialteenyn oc, as preacheil sushtal yn reeriaght, as lheihys dy chooilley hingys, as dy chooilley ghoghan mastey'n pobble.

verses.name: Matthew 9:36
verses.text: Agh tra honnick eh yn chaglym mooar dy leih, v'eh er ny veiyghey lesh chymmey orroo, er-yn-oyr dy row ad tooillit, as er nyn skeayley noon as noal, myr kirree fegooish bochilley.

verses.name: Matthew 9:37
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt eh rish e ynseydee, Ta'n fouyr dy jarroo palchey, agh s'coan ta ny beayneeyn.

verses.name: Matthew 9:38
verses.text: Guee-jee shiuish, er-y-fa shen, er Chiarn y fouyr, eh dy chur magh labreeyn gys y fouyr echey.

verses.name: Matthew 10:1
verses.text: As tra v'eh er n-eamagh er e ghaa ostyl jeig huggey, hug eh daue pooar harrish spyrrydyn neu-ghlen dy chastey ad, as dy lheihys dy chooilley vonney dy hingys, as dy chooilley ghoghan.

verses.name: Matthew 10:2
verses.text: As shoh va enmyn yn daa ostyl yeig; Yn chied-er, Simon, ta enmyssit Peddyr, as Andreays e vraar, Jamys mac Zebedee, as Ean y braar echeysyn

verses.name: Matthew 10:3
verses.text: Philip as Parlane, Thomase, as Mian yn publican, Jamys mac Alpheus, as Lebbeus va slennooit Thaddeus.

verses.name: Matthew 10:4
verses.text: Simon yn Canaanite, as Yuaase Iscariot, ren myrgeddin eh y vrah.

verses.name: Matthew 10:5
verses.text: Yn ghaa-yeig shoh hug Yeesey magh, as doardee eh daue, gra, Ny immee-jee raad ny Hashoonee, ny gys ard-valjyn ny Samaritanee.

verses.name: Matthew 10:6
verses.text: Agh immee-jee hoshiaght gys kirree cailjey thie Israel.

verses.name: Matthew 10:7
verses.text: As myr vees shiu goll, jean-jee preacheil, gra, Ta reeriaght niau er-gerrey.

verses.name: Matthew 10:8
verses.text: Slaanee-jee sleih chingey, glen-jee ny louranee, jean-jee ny merriu y aa-vioghey, as drogh-spyrrydyn y chastey: nastee ta shiu er gheddyn, as dy nastee cur-jee veue.

verses.name: Matthew 10:9
verses.text: Ny kiare-jee son airh, ny argid, ny prash y ve eu ayns nyn sporranyn:

verses.name: Matthew 10:10
verses.text: Ny spagey son y raad, ny daa chooat, ny braagyn, ny lorg: (son ta'n obbree toilliu e veaghey).

verses.name: Matthew 10:11
verses.text: As ard-valley ny balley erbee dy jed shiu stiagh ayn, Jean-jee briaght quoi ayn ta feeu, as marishyn gow-jee aaght derrey hed shiu reue.

verses.name: Matthew 10:12
verses.text: As tra hed shiu stiagh ayns thie, bannee-jee daue.

verses.name: Matthew 10:13
verses.text: As my vees y thie feeu, lhig da'n shee eu cheet er: agh mannagh bee eh feeu, lhig da'n shee eu chyndaa hiu hene reesht.

verses.name: Matthew 10:14
verses.text: As quoi-erbee nagh der oltaghey bea diu, as nash der geill da ny goan eu: tra aagys shiu yn thie ny'n ard-valley shen, crie-jee veue joan nyn goshey.

verses.name: Matthew 10:15
verses.text: Dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, Dy bee eh ny sassey da cheer Sodom as Gomorrah, ec laa ny briwnys, na da'n ard-valley shen.

verses.name: Matthew 10:16
verses.text: Cur-my-ner ta mish dy choyrt shiu magh myr kirree mastey moddee oaldey: Bee-jee er-y-fa shen tastagh myr ard-nieughyn, as oney myr calmaneyn.

verses.name: Matthew 10:17
verses.text: Agh bee-jee er nyn dwoaie roish deiney, son livrey-ee ad shiu seose gys ny coonceilyn, as scuitchee ad shiu ayns nyn quaiylyn oc.

verses.name: Matthew 10:18
verses.text: As bee shiu er nyn goyrt fenish kiannoortyn as reeaghyn er y choontey aym's, myr shoh gymmyrkey feanish dauesyn, as da ny Ashoonee.

verses.name: Matthew 10:19
verses.text: Agh tra ver ad stiagh shiu, ny bee-jee imneagh cre'n aght, ny cre nee shiu gra, son bee eh er ny choyrt diu ayns yn oor cheddin cre nee shiu y ghra.

verses.name: Matthew 10:20
verses.text: Son cha nee shiuish ta loayrt, agh spyrryd yn Ayr eu ta loayrt ayndiu.

verses.name: Matthew 10:21
verses.text: As livreyee braar seose e vraar gys baase, as yn ayr e lhiannoo: as nee cloan girree magh noi nyn ayr as nyn moir, as bee ad feanishyn baaish orroo.

verses.name: Matthew 10:22
verses.text: As ver yn ymmodee feoh diu er coontey yn ennym aym's: agh eshyn nee shassoo magh gys y jerrey, bee eh er ny hauail.

verses.name: Matthew 10:23
verses.text: Agh tra nee ad tranlaase erriu ayns un ard-valley, cosne-jee reue gys ard-valley elley: son ta mee shickyrys diu, nagh bee shiu er n'gholl harrish ard-valjyn Israel derrey vees Mac y dooinney er jeet.

verses.name: Matthew 10:24
verses.text: Cha vel y scoillar erskyn e vainshter ny'n charvaant erskyn e hiarn.

verses.name: Matthew 10:25
verses.text: S'lioar da'n scoillar dy ve myr e vainshter, as y charvaant myr e hiarn: my t'ad er cheau Beelzebub er mainshter y thie, cre woad smoo nee ad e vooinjer y oltooaney.

verses.name: Matthew 10:26
verses.text: Ny gow-jee er-y-fa shen aggle roue: son cha vel nhee erbee follit nagh jir gys soilshey: ny nhee erbee keillit, nagh jig er-ash.

verses.name: Matthew 10:27
verses.text: Shen ta mish dy insh diu ayns folliaght fockle-jee shiuish magh eh dy foshlit: as shen ta shiu er chlashtyn myr hannish voym's, jean-jee y phreacheil er mullagh ny dhieyn.

verses.name: Matthew 10:28
verses.text: As ny bee aggle erriu rouesyn varrys y corp, agh nagh jarg er yn annym y varroo: agh bee-jee ayns aggle smoo roishyn oddys annym as callin neesht y stroie ayns niurin.

verses.name: Matthew 10:29
verses.text: Nagh vel daa sparroo er nyn greck son farling? as cha duitt unnane oc marroo er y thalloo fegooish oardagh yn Ayr eu.

verses.name: Matthew 10:30
verses.text: Agh ta eer renaigyn nyn ghing ooilley er nyn earroo.

verses.name: Matthew 10:31
verses.text: Ny bee-jee shiuish er-y-fa shen ayns aggle, ta ny smoo dy ve soit jiuish na jeh ymmodee sperriu.

verses.name: Matthew 10:32
verses.text: Quoi-erbee er-y-fa shen ghoys rhym's kiongoyrt rish deiney, goym's rishyn myrgeddin kiongoyrt rish my Ayr t'ayns niau.

verses.name: Matthew 10:33
verses.text: Agh quoie-erbee obbys mish kiongoyrt rish deiney, eshyn neem's myrgeddin y obbal kiongoyrt rish my Ayr t'ayns niau.

verses.name: Matthew 10:34
verses.text: Ny smooinee-jee dy daink mish dy chur lhiam shee er y thalloo: cha daink mee dy chur lhiam shee, agh cliwe.

verses.name: Matthew 10:35
verses.text: Son ta mish er jeet dy scarrey dooinney veih e ayr, as yn inneen veih e moir, as y ven-chleuin veih e moir-'sy-leigh

verses.name: Matthew 10:36
verses.text: As noidyn dooinney vees adsyn jeh'n lught-thie echey hene.

verses.name: Matthew 10:37
verses.text: Eshyn ta ny s'graihee er ayr ny moir na orrym's, cha vel eh feeu jee'm: as eshyn ta ny s'graihee er mac ny inneen na orrym's cha vel eh feeu jee'm.

verses.name: Matthew 10:38
verses.text: As eshyn nagh jean e chrosh y ymmyrkey, as geiyrt orrym's, cha vel eh feeu jee'm.

verses.name: Matthew 10:39
verses.text: Eshyn ta aggindagh e vioys y hauail, caillee eh eh: agh eshyn chaillys e vioys er my ghraih's, nee eh eh y hauail.

verses.name: Matthew 10:40
verses.text: Eshyn ta soiaghey jiuish, t'eh soiaghey jeem's: as eshyn ta soiaghey jeem's, t'eh soiaghey jehsyn t'er my choyrt.

verses.name: Matthew 10:41
verses.text: Eshyn ta cur oltaghey-bea da phadeyr ayns ennym phadeyr, yiow eh leah phadeyr as eshyn ta cur oltaghey-bea da dooinney cairagh ayns ennym dooinney cairagh, yiow eh leagh dooinney cairagh.

verses.name: Matthew 10:42
verses.text: As quoi-erbee ver agh cappan dy ushtey feayr da unnane jeh'n vooinjer veggey shoh dy iu, son dy vel eh credjal aynym's, dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, nagh jean eh er aght erbee e leagh y choayl.

verses.name: Matthew 11:1
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione, erreish da Yeesey v'er choyrt ny curmyn shoh da e ghaa ostyl jeig dy jagh eh veih shen dy ynsaghey, as dy phreacheil ayns ny ard-valjyn mygeayrt.

verses.name: Matthew 11:2
verses.text: Nish tra va Ean er chlashtyn ayns y phryssoon jeh obbraghyn Chreest, hug eh jees jeh e ynseydee hene er chaghteraght huggey,

verses.name: Matthew 11:3
verses.text: Dy ghra rish, Nee uss eh va dy heet ny vel shin dy yeeaghyn son fer elley?

verses.name: Matthew 11:4
verses.text: Dreggyr Yeesey as dooyrt eh roo, Immee-jee, as soilshee-jee da Ean ny reddyn ta shiu dy chlashtyn as dy akin:

verses.name: Matthew 11:5
verses.text: Ta ny doail geddyn nyn soilshey, as ny croobee shooyll, ny louraanee er nyn ghlenney, ny beuyr clashtyn, ny merriu er nyn mioghey, as yn sushtal er ny phreacheil da ny boghtyn.

verses.name: Matthew 11:6
verses.text: As bannit ta eshyn nagh jean beg y hoiaghey jeem's.

verses.name: Matthew 11:7
verses.text: As myr v'ad goll roue, ren Yeesey toshiaght dy ghra rish y pobble mychione Ean, Cre hie shiu magh gys yn aasagh dy akin? Nee cuirtlagh criht lesh y gheay?

verses.name: Matthew 11:8
verses.text: Agh cre hie shiu magh dy akin? Dooinney coamrit ayns garmad moyrnagh? Cur-my-ner, t'adsyn ta ceau coamrey moyrnagh ayns cooyrtyn reeoil.

verses.name: Matthew 11:9
verses.text: Agh cre hie shiu magh dy akin? Nee phadeyr? dy jarroo ta mee gra riu, as fer syrjey na phadeyr.

verses.name: Matthew 11:10
verses.text: Son shoh eh, my-e-chione te scruit, Cur-my-ner ta mee cur my haghter magh royd, dy chiartaghey'n raad kiongoyrt rhyt.

verses.name: Matthew 11:11
verses.text: Dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, ny mast' ocsyn t'er ve ruggit jeh mraane, cha vel fer syrjey na Ean Bashtey er droggal: ny-yeih ta'n fer sloo t'ayns reeriaght niau ny syrjey na eshyn.

verses.name: Matthew 11:12
verses.text: As er-dy laghyn Ean Bashtey derrey nish, ta sleih chionney stiagh gys reeriaght niau, as t'adsyn ta cheet lesh jeeanid cosney stiagh ayn.

verses.name: Matthew 11:13
verses.text: Son ren ooilley ny phadeyryn as y leigh phadeyrys derrey Ean.

verses.name: Matthew 11:14
verses.text: As my ta shiu booiagh goaill-rish, shoh Elias va ry-hoi cheet.

verses.name: Matthew 11:15
verses.text: Eshyn ta cleayshyn echey dy chlashtyn lhig da clashtyn.

verses.name: Matthew 11:16
verses.text: Agh cre gys nee'm yn cheeloghe shoh y hoylaghey? T'ad goll-rish cloan ta nyn soie ayns ny margaghyn, as geamagh da ny sheshaghyn oc.

verses.name: Matthew 11:17
verses.text: As gra, Ta shin er n'yannoo bingys diu, as cha vel shiu er ghaunsin: ta shin er hroggal bardoon diu, as cha vel shiu er ghobberan.

verses.name: Matthew 11:18
verses.text: Son cha daink Ean gee ny giu, as t'ad gra, Ta drogh-spyrryd ayn.

verses.name: Matthew 11:19
verses.text: Haink Mac yn dooinney gee as giu, as t'ad gra, Cur-my-ner dooinney jollyssagh, as iuder feeyney, carrey dy publicanee as dy pheccee: agh ta creenaght er ny heyrey liorish e cloan hene.

verses.name: Matthew 11:20
verses.text: Eisht ren eh toshiaght dy phlaiynt er ny ard-valjyn, ayndoo va'n chooid smoo jeh e obbraghyn yindyssagh er nyn yannoo, er-yn-oyr nagh ghow ad arrys.

verses.name: Matthew 11:21
verses.text: Smerg dhyt's Chorazin, smerg dhyt's Vethsaida: son dy beagh ny obbraghyn yindyssagh er ny ve jeant ayns Tyre as Sidon t'er ny ve jeant ayndiuish, veagh ad er ghoaill arrys foddey er-dy-henney ayns aanrit-sack as leoie

verses.name: Matthew 11:22
verses.text: Agh ta mee gra riu, Dy bee kerraghey s'eddrym er ny choyrt er Tyre as Sidon ec laa ny briwnys, na vees er ny choyrt erriuish.

verses.name: Matthew 11:23
verses.text: As uss, Chapernaum, ta dty ooashley roshtyn gys niau, bee oo er dty hilgey sheese gys niurin: son dy beagh ny obbraghyn yindyssagh er ve jeant ayns Sodom, t'er ve jeant aynyd's, veagh eh er ve er-mayrn gys y laa t'ayn jiu.

verses.name: Matthew 11:24
verses.text: Agh ta mee gra riu, dy bee kerraghey sassey er ny choyrt er thalloo Sodom ec laa ny briwnys, na vees ort's.

verses.name: Matthew 11:25
verses.text: Ec y traa shen dreggyr Yeesey as dooyrt eh, Ta mee cur booise dhyt, O Ayr, Hiarn niau as thalloo, er-yn-oyr dy vel oo er cheiltyn ny reddyn shoh vouesyn ta creeney as tushtagh, as dy vel oo er hoilshaghey ad da oikanyn.

verses.name: Matthew 11:26
verses.text: Shen dy jarroo myr te, Ayr, son shen myr ve mie ayns dty hilley's.

verses.name: Matthew 11:27
verses.text: Ta dy chooilley nhee er ny livrey dooys liorish my Ayr: as cha nhione da dooinney erbee yn Mac, agh yn Ayr: chamoo shione da dooinney erbee yn Ayr, agh y Mac, as eshyn da s'gooidsave lesh yn Mac eh y hoilshaghey.

verses.name: Matthew 11:28
verses.text: Tar-jee hym's ooilley shiuish ta deinagh as trome laadit, as neem's shiu y ooraghey.

verses.name: Matthew 11:29
verses.text: Gow-jee my whing erriu, as ynsee-jee voym's, son ta mee meen as imlee ayns cree: as yiow shiu fea da nyn amneenyn.

verses.name: Matthew 11:30
verses.text: Son ta my whing aashagh, as my errey eddrym.

verses.name: Matthew 12:1
verses.text: Ec y traa shen hie Yeesey trooid magher arroo-er y doonaght, as va e ostyllyn accryssagh, as ghow ad toshiaght dy phluckey ny jeeassyn arroo, as dy ee.

verses.name: Matthew 12:2
verses.text: Agh tra honnick ny Phariseeyn ad, dooyrt ad rish, Cur-my-ner ta dty vooinjer's jannoo shen nagh vel lowal dy ve jeant er y doonaght.

verses.name: Matthew 12:3
verses.text: Agh dooyrt eshyn roo, Nagh vel shiuish er lhaih cre ren David, tra v'eh hene as e heshaght accryssagh.

verses.name: Matthew 12:4
verses.text: Kys hie eh stiagh ayns thie Yee, as d'ee eh yn arran casherick, nagh row lowit dasyn dy ee, agh da ny saggyrtyn ny-lomarcan?

verses.name: Matthew 12:5
verses.text: Er-nonney, nagh vel shiu er lhaih ayns y leigh, kys er laghyn y doonaght ta ny saggyrtyn ayns y chiamble brishey yn doonaght, as foast cha vel peccah er ny choyrt ass nyn lieh?

verses.name: Matthew 12:6
verses.text: Agh ta mish gra riuish, dy vel ayns shoh fer syrjey na'n chiamble.

verses.name: Matthew 12:7
verses.text: Agh dy beagh fys er ve euish, cre ta er ny hoiggal liorish y raa shoh, Share lhiam myghin na oural, cha beagh shiu er gheyrey yn vooinjer neu-chyndagh.

verses.name: Matthew 12:8
verses.text: Son ta Mac y dooinney ny Hiarn er y doonaght hene.

verses.name: Matthew 12:9
verses.text: As tra v'eh er n'gholl veih shen, hie eh stiagh ayns nyn synagogue.

verses.name: Matthew 12:10
verses.text: As cur-my-ner, va dooinney ayns shen va'n laue echey er shyrgaghey: as, dy vod dagh oyr plaiynt y ve oc noi Yeesey, denee ad jeh, gra, Vel eh lowal dy lheihys er laghyn y doonaght?

verses.name: Matthew 12:11
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Quoi yn dooinney ny mast' eu, vees un cheyrrey echey, as my huittys ee ayns jeeg er y doonaght, nagh daare eh greme urree, as nagh drog eh ass ee?

verses.name: Matthew 12:12
verses.text: Nagh vel dooinney eisht foddey share na keyrrey? Shen-y-fa te lowal dy yannoo mie er y doonaght.

verses.name: Matthew 12:13
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt eh rish y dooinney, Sheeyn magh dty laue: as heeyn eh magh ee; as va'n laue echey er ny lheihys myr y laue elley.

verses.name: Matthew 12:14
verses.text: Eisht hie ny Phariseeyn magh, as hug ad nyn goyrle dy-cheilley n'oi, kys oddagh ad eh y stroie.

verses.name: Matthew 12:15
verses.text: Agh tra va fys ec Yeesey er, jimmee eh veih shen: as deiyr earrooyn mooarey dy leih er, as ren eh ad ooilley y lheihys.

verses.name: Matthew 12:16
verses.text: As hug eh currym daue, gyn ad dy vrah eh:

verses.name: Matthew 12:17
verses.text: As shoh myr va cooilleenit shen ny loayr Esaias y phadeyr, gra,

verses.name: Matthew 12:18
verses.text: Cur-my-ner, my hirveishagh hene ta mee er reih, my er-graihagh hene, eer taitnys my anmey: ver-yms yn spyrryd aym's ersyn, as soilshee eh briwnys da ny Ashoonee.

verses.name: Matthew 12:19
verses.text: Cha bee eh streeuagh ny anveaagh, chamoo chluinnys fer erbee e choraa ayns ny straidyn.

verses.name: Matthew 12:20
verses.text: Cuirtlagh vroojit cha jean eh y vrishey, as y bite giare-cheaut cha der eh ass, derrey ver eh magh briwnys ayns barriaght.

verses.name: Matthew 12:21
verses.text: As ayns yn ennym echeysyn nee ny Ashoonee treishteil.

verses.name: Matthew 12:22
verses.text: Eisht hug ad lhieu huggey dooinney seaghoit lesh drogh-spyrryd, doal as balloo: as ren eh eh y lheihys, myr shen dy ren eshyn va doal as balloo chammah loayrt as fakin.

verses.name: Matthew 12:23
verses.text: As ghow ooilley yn pobble yindys, as dooyrt ad, Nagh nee shoh mac Ghavid?

verses.name: Matthew 12:24
verses.text: Agh tra cheayll ny Phariseeyn shoh, dooyrt ad, Cha vel eh shoh castey drogh spyrrydyn, agh liorish Beelzebub prince ny drogh-spyrrydyn.

verses.name: Matthew 12:25
verses.text: As Yeesey toiggal ny smooinaghtyn oc, dooyrt roo, Ta dy chooilley reeriaght ta girree magh n'oi hene goll naardey: as ard-valley ny thie erbee ta girree-magh fo-my-cheilley, cha vod ad shassoo.

verses.name: Matthew 12:26
verses.text: As my ta Satan castey Satan, t'eh girree-magh n'oi hene: kys eisht oddys y reeriaght echey shassoo?

verses.name: Matthew 12:27
verses.text: As my ta mish liorish Beelzebub castey drogh-spyrrydyn, quoi liorish ta nyn mooinjer hene dy chastey ad? adsyn er-y-fa shen vees ny briwnyn eu.

verses.name: Matthew 12:28
verses.text: Agh my ta mish liorish spyrryd Yee castey drogh-spyrrydyn, eisht ta reeriaght Yee er jeet hiuish.

verses.name: Matthew 12:29
verses.text: Er-nonney, kys oddys fer goll stiagh ayns thie yn treanagh, as e chooid y ghoaill er-niart, mannagh geulee eh hoshiaght yn treanagh, as eisht nee eh e hie y roostey?

verses.name: Matthew 12:30
verses.text: Eshyn nagh vel lhiam, t'eh m'oi: as eshyn nagh vel chymsaghey marym, t'eh skeayley.

verses.name: Matthew 12:31
verses.text: Shen-y-fa ta mee gra riu, Bee dy chooilley pheccah as raa mollaghtagh er ny leih da deiney: agh goan mollaghtagh noi yn Spyrryd Noo cha bee er nyn leih da deiney.

verses.name: Matthew 12:32
verses.text: As quoi-erbee loayrys fockle noi Mac y dooinney, bee eh er ny leih da: agh quoi erbee loayrys noi yn Spyrryd Noo, cha bee eh er ny leih da, edyr 'sy theihll shoh, ny 'sy theihll ta ry-heet.

verses.name: Matthew 12:33
verses.text: Edyr jean-jee yn billey mie, as e vess mie; er-nonney jean-jee yn billey olk, as e vess olk: son liorish e vess, ta enney er ny choyrt er y villey.

verses.name: Matthew 12:34
verses.text: O shiuish heeloghe dy ard-nieughyn, kys oddys shiuish ta olk shiu hene, reddyn mie y loayrt? son ass laanid y chree ta'n beeal loayrt.

verses.name: Matthew 12:35
verses.text: Ta dooinney mie ass stoyr mie yn chree echey, cur magh reddyn mie: as drogh ghooinney ass y drogh-stoyr cur magh drogh reddyn.

verses.name: Matthew 12:36
verses.text: Agh ta mee gra riu, Dy chooilley ghrogh-ockle nee deiney y loayrt, dy der ad coontey er y hon ec laa ny briwnys.

verses.name: Matthew 12:37
verses.text: Son liorish dty ghoan bee oo er dty heyrey, as liorish dty ghoan bee oo er dty gheyrey.

verses.name: Matthew 12:38
verses.text: Eisht dreggyr shiartanse jeh ny scrudeyryn as jeh ny Phariseeyn, gra, Vainshter, baillhien cowrey y akin void.

verses.name: Matthew 12:39
verses.text: Agh dreggyr eshyn, as dooyrt eh roo, Ta drogh-heeloghe as neu-ghooghyssagh shirrey cowrey, agh cha bee cowrey erbee er ny chur daue, agh cowrey yn adeyr Jonas.

verses.name: Matthew 12:40
verses.text: Son myr va Jonas three laghyn as three oieghyn ayns bolg y whale: myr shen bee Mac y dooinney three laghyn as three oieghyn ayns cree yn thallooin.

verses.name: Matthew 12:41
verses.text: Nee deiney Nineveh girree seose ayns briwnys, as y cheeloghe shoh y gheyrey, er-yn-oyr dy ghow ad arrys ec preacheil Yonas, as cur-my-ner, ta fer syrjey na Jonas ayns shoh.

verses.name: Matthew 12:42
verses.text: Nee ben-rein y jiass girree seose ayns briwnys noi yn cheeloghe shoh, as ad y gheyrey: son haink ish veih ardjyn sodjey magh y thallooin, dy chlashtyn creenaght Solomon, as cur-my-ner ta fer s'ooasle na Solomon ayns shoh.

verses.name: Matthew 12:43
verses.text: Tra ta'n spyrryd neu-ghlen er n'gholl ass dooinney, t'eh shooyll trooid faasaghyn fadane, chee aash, agh ayns fardail.

verses.name: Matthew 12:44
verses.text: Eisht t'eh gra, Chyndaa-ym gys my hie, ass haink mee; as tra t'eh cheet, t'eh dy gheddyn eh follym, sceabit, as soit magh dy stooamey.

verses.name: Matthew 12:45
verses.text: Eisht t'eh goll, as cur lesh marish shiaght spyrrydyn elley ta ny smessey na eh hene, as t'ad goll shagh as cummal ayns shen: as ta stayd yerrinagh yn dooinney shen ny s'doogh na'n toshiaght. Eer myr shoh hig eh dy ve er y cheeloghe vee chrauee shoh.

verses.name: Matthew 12:46
verses.text: Choud as v'eh foast loayrt rish y pobble, cur-my-ner va e voir as e vraaraghyn nyn shassoo mooie, shirrey loayrt rish.

verses.name: Matthew 12:47
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt fer rish, Cur-my-ner, ta dty voir as dty vraaraghyn nyn shassoo mooie, shirrey loayrt rhyt.

verses.name: Matthew 12:48
verses.text: Agh dreggyr eshyn yn fer dinsh shoh da, gra, Quoi my voir? as quoi my vraaraghyn?

verses.name: Matthew 12:49
verses.text: As heeyn eh magh e laue lhieusyn va sheer geiyrt er, as dooyrt eh, Cur-my-ner my voir, as my vraaraghyn.

verses.name: Matthew 12:50
verses.text: Son quoi-erbee nee aigney my Ayrey t'ayns niau, eh shen my vraar, as my huyr as my voir.

verses.name: Matthew 13:1
verses.text: Yn laa cheddin hie Yeesey magh ass y thie, as hoie eh sheese rish oirr ny marrey.

verses.name: Matthew 13:2
verses.text: As va earrooyn mooarey dy leih er nyn jaglym cooidjagh huggey, myr shen dy jagh eh er board lhong, as hoie eh sheese, as va ooilley yn pobble nyn shassoo er y traie.

verses.name: Matthew 13:3
verses.text: As loayr eh mooarane reddyn roo ayns coraaghyn-dorraghey, gra, Cur-jee my-ner, hie correyder magh dy chuirr.

verses.name: Matthew 13:4
verses.text: As myr v'eh cuirr, huitt paart jeh'n rass rish oirr y raad, as haink ny eeanlee, as d'ee ad seose eh.

verses.name: Matthew 13:5
verses.text: Huitt paart er thalloo cloaie, raad nagh row mooarane ooir as daase eh er-y-chooyl, er-yn-oyr nagh row diunid hallooin echey:

verses.name: Matthew 13:6
verses.text: As tra ghow yn ghrian niart, ve fiojit; as er-yn-oyr nagh row eh er n'ghoaill fraue, ren eh shymley ersooyl.

verses.name: Matthew 13:7
verses.text: As huitt paart mastey drineyn: as daase ny drineyn seose as phloogh ad eh.

verses.name: Matthew 13:8
verses.text: Agh huitt cooid elley jeh ayns thalloo mie, as dymmyrk eh mess, paart keead-filley paart three-feed-filley, as paart jeih fillaghyn as feed.

verses.name: Matthew 13:9
verses.text: Eshyn ta cleayshyn echey dy chlashtyn, lhig da clashtyn.

verses.name: Matthew 13:10
verses.text: As haink e ostyllyn huggey, as dooyrt ad rish, Cre'n-fa t'ou loayrt roo ayns coraaghyn-dorraghey?

verses.name: Matthew 13:11
verses.text: Dreggyr eshyn, as dooyrt eh roo, Er-yn-oyr dy vel eh er ny choyrt diuish folliaghtyn reeriaght niau y hoiggal, agh dauesyn cha vel eh er ny choyrt.

verses.name: Matthew 13:12
verses.text: Son quoi-erbee ta echey, dasyn vees er ny choyrt, as bee towse s'feoiltey er ny choyrt da: agh quoi-erbee nagh vel echey, veihsyn vees shen ny ta echey, er ny ghoaill ersooyl.

verses.name: Matthew 13:13
verses.text: Shen-y-fa ta mee loayrt roo ayns coraaghyn-dorraghey: er-yn-oyr, ga dy vel ad fakin, cha vel ad cur-my-ner: as clashtyn cha vel ad cur geill, chamoo t'ad toiggal.

verses.name: Matthew 13:14
verses.text: As ayndoosyn ta cooilleenit phadeyrys Esaias, ta gra, Ayns clashtyn, cluinnee shiu, agh cha jean shiu toiggal: as ayns fakin, hee shiu, agh cha der shiu my-ner

verses.name: Matthew 13:15
verses.text: Son ta cree yn phobble shoh er n'aase roauyr, as ta ny cleayshyn oc moal dy chlashtyn, as ny sooillyn oc t'ad er n'yeigh; er-aggle dy vaikagh ad lesh nyn sooillyn, as dy gluinnagh ad lesh nyn gleayshyn, as dy doiggagh ad lesh nyn gree, as dy beagh ad er nyn jyndaa, as dy jinnin ad y lheihys

verses.name: Matthew 13:16
verses.text: Agh bannit ta ny sooillyn euish, son t'ad fakin, as ny cleayshyn eu, son t'ad clashtyn.

verses.name: Matthew 13:17
verses.text: Son dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, dy vel ymmodee phadeyryn as deiney cairagh er ve aignagh dy akin ny reddyn ta shiuish dy akin, agh cha vel ad er vakin ad: as dy chlashtyn ny reddyn ta shiuish dy chlashtyn, agh cha vel ad er chlashtyn ad.

verses.name: Matthew 13:18
verses.text: Clasht-jee er-y-fa shen coraa-dorraghey yn chorreyder.

verses.name: Matthew 13:19
verses.text: Quoi-erbee ta clashtyn goo yn reeriaght, as nagh vel dy hoiggal eh, ta'n drogh er cheet, as tayrtyn lesh shen ny va cuirt ayns e chree: shoh eh ghow yn rass rish oirr y raad.

verses.name: Matthew 13:20
verses.text: Agh eshyn ghow yn rass ayns ynnydyn claghagh, shen eh ta clashtyn y goo, as jeeragh lesh boggey dy ghoaill eh:

verses.name: Matthew 13:21
verses.text: Foast cha vel fraue echey ayn hene agh t'eh cummal rish son tammylt: agh tra ta seaghyn as tranlaase cheet er, er coontey yn ghoo chelleeragh ta e chredjue failleil.

verses.name: Matthew 13:22
verses.text: Eshyn myrgeddin ghow yn rass mastey ny drineyn, yn fer ta clashtyn y goo: as ta kiarail y theihll shoh, as molteyrys berchys plooghey yn goo, as te cheet dy ve ne vessoil.

verses.name: Matthew 13:23
verses.text: Agh eshyn ghow yn rass ayns thalloo mie, shen eh ta clashtyn y goo as dy hoigg eh, as t'eh tilgey mess, as gymmyrkey, paart keead-filley, paart three feed, as paart jeih fillaghyn as feed.

verses.name: Matthew 13:24
verses.text: Coraa-dorraghey elley loayr eh roo gra, Ta reeriaght niau er ny hoylaghey gys dooinney chuirr rass mie ayns e vagher:

verses.name: Matthew 13:25
verses.text: Agh choud as va sleih nyn gadley haink e noid, as chuirr eh coggyl mastey y churnaght, as jimmee eh roish.

verses.name: Matthew 13:26
verses.text: Agh tra va'n chass er n'aase, as e n'gholl my-yeish, eisht haink y coggyl rish myrgeddin.

verses.name: Matthew 13:27
verses.text: Er shen haink fir-vooinjerey yn er-thie, as dooyrt ad rish, Vainshter, nagh chuirr uss rass mie ayns dty vagher? cre voish eisht ta'n coggyl t'ayn?

verses.name: Matthew 13:28
verses.text: Dooyrt eshyn roo, Noid t'er n'yannoo shoh. Dooyrt ny fir-vooinjerey rish, Nailt eisht shin dy gholl as dy ghaartlian ass eh?

verses.name: Matthew 13:29
verses.text: As dooyrt eshyn, Cha naill-ym; er aggle ayns gaartlian yn coggyl, dy n'astyrt shiu yn churnaght myrgeddin ass ny fraueyn marish.

verses.name: Matthew 13:30
verses.text: Lhig-jee daue ny-neesht gaase cooidjagh derrey'n fouyr: as ayns earish yn ouyr jir-yms rish ny beayneeyn, Chymsee-jee cooidjagh hoshiaght yn coggyl ayns bunneeyn ry-hoi lostey; agh tayrn-jee yn churnaght stiagh ayns my hoalt.

verses.name: Matthew 13:31
verses.text: Coraa-dorraghey elley loayr eh roo, gra, Ta reeriaght niau goll-rish grine dy rass mustard ghow dooinney, as chuirr eh ayns e vagher eh.

verses.name: Matthew 13:32
verses.text: As ga dy nee eh sloo jeh dy chooilley rass: foast tra te er n'aase, eh smoo ta mastey lossreeyn, as te cheet dy ve ny villey: myr shen dy vel eeanlee yn aer cheet as goaill fastee ayns ny banglaneyn echey.

verses.name: Matthew 13:33
verses.text: Coraa-dorraghey elley loayr eh roo, Ta reeriaght niau goll-rish soorid ren ben y ghoaill as coodaghey seose ayns three towseyn dy veinn, derrey va'n clane soorit.

verses.name: Matthew 13:34
verses.text: Ooilley ny goan shoh loayr Yeesey rish y pobble ayns coraaghyn-dorraghey, as fegooish coraa-dorraghey, cha loayr eh roo:

verses.name: Matthew 13:35
verses.text: As shoh myr va cooilleenit shen loayr y phadeyr, gra, Foshlym my veeal dy loayrt coraaghyn-dorraghey, soilshee-ym magh reddyn t'er ve follit er-dy hoshiaght y theihll.

verses.name: Matthew 13:36
verses.text: Eisht hug Yeesey yn cheshaght ersooyl, as hie eh stiagh ayns y thie: as haink huggey adsyn va sheer marish, gra, Soilshee dooin coraa dorraghey coggyl yn vagheragh.

verses.name: Matthew 13:37
verses.text: Dreggyr eshyn as dooyrt eh roo Eshyn chuirr yn rass mie, Mac yn dooinney:

verses.name: Matthew 13:38
verses.text: Yn magher yn seihll: yn rass mie cloan y reeriaght: agh y coggyl cloan y drogh-er:

verses.name: Matthew 13:39
verses.text: Yn noid chuirr ad yn Jouyl: yn fouyr jerrey yn theihll: as ny beayneeyn ny ainleyn.

verses.name: Matthew 13:40
verses.text: Myr, er-y-fa shen, ta'n coggyl er ny haglym, as er ny lostey ayns yn aile; shen myr vees eh ec jerrey'n theihll.

verses.name: Matthew 13:41
verses.text: Ver yn Mac dooinney magh e ainleyn, as teiyee ad ass e reeriaght dy chooilley nhee ta tayrn sleih gys peccah, as adsyn ta cur rish yn olk;

verses.name: Matthew 13:42
verses.text: As tilgee ad ad ayns coirrey aileagh: ayns shen vees keayney as snaggeraght feeacklyn.

verses.name: Matthew 13:43
verses.text: Eisht nee yn chloan chairagh soilshean magh myr y ghrian, ayns reeriaght nyn Ayrey. Eshyn ta cleayshyn echey dy chlashtyn, lhig da clashtyn.

verses.name: Matthew 13:44
verses.text: Reesht ta reeriaght niau goll-rish berchys follit ayns magher: yn verchys cheddin tra ta dooinney dy gheddyn magh t'eh dy choodaghey eh, as ayns boggey jeh t'eh goll as creck ooilley ny t'echey, as kionnaghey yn magher cheddin.

verses.name: Matthew 13:45
verses.text: Reesht ta reeriaght niau dy ve soylit rish marchan va shirrey pearlyn costal:

verses.name: Matthew 13:46
verses.text: As tra v'eh er gheddyn un phearl dy phrice vooar, hie eh, as chreck eh ooilley ny v'echey, as chionnee eh eh.

verses.name: Matthew 13:47
verses.text: Reesht ta reeriaght niau goll-rish lieen va cuirt 'sy cheayn as haare jeh dy chooilley horch dy eeast.

verses.name: Matthew 13:48
verses.text: As tra ve lane, hayrn ad eh gys thalloo, as hoie ad sheese, as haggil ad yn eeast mie ayns siyn, agh cheau ad yn drogh eeast ersooyl.

verses.name: Matthew 13:49
verses.text: Shen myr vees eh ec jerrey yn theihll: hig ny ainleyn magh, as scarree ad yn vee chrauee veih mastey yn chloan chairal;

verses.name: Matthew 13:50
verses.text: As tilgee ad ad ayns coirrey dy aile: ayns shen vees keayney as snaggeraght feeacklyn.

verses.name: Matthew 13:51
verses.text: Dooyrt Yeesey roo, Vel shiu er hoiggal ooilley ny reddyn shoh? Dooyrt adsyn rish, Ta shin, Hiarn.

verses.name: Matthew 13:52
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt eh roo, Shen-y-fa ta dy chooilley scrudeyr, ta ynsit gys reeriaght niau, goll-rish dooinney ta ny er-thie (mie) ta cur magh ass e hashtaghyn reddyn noa as shenn.

verses.name: Matthew 13:53
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione, tra va Yeesey erreish ny coraaghyn-dorraghey shoh y loayrt, dy jimmee eh veih shen.

verses.name: Matthew 13:54
verses.text: As tra v'eh er jeet gys e heer hene, dynsee eh ad ayns ny synagogueyn oc, ayns wheesh as dy row ad atchimagh, as dy dooyrt ad, Cre voish ta creenaght as mirrillyn y dooinney shoh?

verses.name: Matthew 13:55
verses.text: Nagh nee shoh mac y teyr? Nagh vel e voir enmyssit Moirrey, as e vraaraghyn Jamys as Joses, as Simon, as Judas?

verses.name: Matthew 13:56
verses.text: As nagh vel ny shayraghyn echey ooilley marin? cre voish eisht ta ooilley ny reddyn t'ec y dooinney shoh?

verses.name: Matthew 13:57
verses.text: As v'ad jymmoosagh rish. Agh dooyrt Yeesey roo, Cha vel phadeyr gyn ooashley, agh ayns e heer hene, as ayns e hie hene.

verses.name: Matthew 13:58
verses.text: As cha nhimmey mirril dobbree eh ayns shen, kyndagh rish y vee-chredjue oc.

verses.name: Matthew 14:1
verses.text: Ec y traa shen cheayll Herod yn Tetrarch jeh goo Yeesey,

verses.name: Matthew 14:2
verses.text: As dooyrt eh rish e ir-oik, Shoh Ean Bashtey, t'eh er n'irree veih ny merriu, as er-yn-oyr shen ta mirrillyn er nyn obbraghey

verses.name: Matthew 14:3
verses.text: Son va Herod er ghoaill Ean, as er choyrt eh ayns geulaghyn 'sy phryssoon, er coontey Herodias ben e vraar Philip.

verses.name: Matthew 14:4
verses.text: Son va Ean er ghra rish, Te noi yn leigh, ee dy ve ayd son ben.

verses.name: Matthew 14:5
verses.text: As tra baillish v'er choyrt eh gy-baase v'eh ayns aggle roish y pobble, er-yn-oyr dy row ad dy ghoaill eh son phadeyr.

verses.name: Matthew 14:6
verses.text: Agh er y laa v'er ny reayll corrym rish y laa ruggyr Herod, ghaunse inneen Herodias ayns yn enish oc, as ghow Herod lane boggey j'ee.

verses.name: Matthew 14:7
verses.text: Er shen ghiall eh lesh breearrey, dy choyrt-jee cre erbee hirragh ee.

verses.name: Matthew 14:8
verses.text: As dooyrt ish, myr va e moir er chur roee, Cur dou ayns shoh kione Ean Bashtey er claare.

verses.name: Matthew 14:9
verses.text: As by-hrimshey lesh y ree: ny-yeih e coontey yn vreearrey, as y vooinjer v'ec gien marish, doardee eh (yn kione) dy v'er ny livrey huic.

verses.name: Matthew 14:10
verses.text: As hug eh fys yn kione dy ve giarit jeh Ean ayns y phryssoon.

verses.name: Matthew 14:11
verses.text: As va'n kione er ny choyrt er claare as livreit gys y ven-aeg, as hug ish lh'ee eh gys e moir.

verses.name: Matthew 14:12
verses.text: As haink e ynseydee, as hrog ad y corp, as doanluck ad eh, as hie ad, as dinsh ad da Yeesey.

verses.name: Matthew 14:13
verses.text: Tra cheayll Yeesey jeh, ghow eh lhuingys, as jimmee eh veih shen gys ynnyd faasagh er-lheh: as tra cheayll y pobble jeh, deiyr ad er ry nyn gosh ass ny ard-valjyn.

verses.name: Matthew 14:14
verses.text: As hie Yeesey magh, as honnick eh chaglym mooar dy leih, as v'eh er ny veiyghey lesh chymmey orroo, as laanee eh adsyn va ching.

verses.name: Matthew 14:15
verses.text: As tra va'n fastyr er, haink e ostyllyn huggey, gra, She boayl faasagh shoh, as te nish lesh yn anmys; lhig y raad da'n cheshaght, dy vod ad goll roue gys ny baljyn cheerey, as beaghey y chionnaghey daue hene.

verses.name: Matthew 14:16
verses.text: Agh dooyrt Yeesey roo, Cha lhiass daue goll roue cur-jee shiuish beaghey daue

verses.name: Matthew 14:17
verses.text: As dooyrt ad rish, Cha vel ain ayns shoh agh queig bwilleenyn, as daa eeast.

verses.name: Matthew 14:18
verses.text: Dooyrt eshyn, Cur-jee lhieu ad ayns shoh hym's.

verses.name: Matthew 14:19
verses.text: As doardee eh yn pobble dy hoie sheese er y faiyr, as ghow eh ny queig bwilleenyn as y daa eeast, as yeeagh eh seose gys niau, as vannee eh, as vrish eh, as hug eh ny bwilleenyn da ny ostyllyn, as hirveish adsyn ad er y pobble.

verses.name: Matthew 14:20
verses.text: As ren ad ooilley gee, as v'ad jeant magh: as hrog ad jeh'n fooilliagh daag ad, lane daa vaskad jeig.

verses.name: Matthew 14:21
verses.text: As adsyn v'er n'ee v'ad queig thousane dooinney, cheu-mooie jeh mraane as cloan.

verses.name: Matthew 14:22
verses.text: As chelleeragh hug Yeesey er e ostyllyn goaill lhuingys, as goll harrish gys y cheu elley roish, choud as v'eshyn lhiggey yn raad da'n pobble.

verses.name: Matthew 14:23
verses.text: As tra v'eh er chur y pobble ersooyl, hie eh-hene er-lheh seose er slieau, dy ghoaill padjer: as tra va'n fastyr er jeet, v'eh ayns shen ny-lomarcan.

verses.name: Matthew 14:24
verses.text: Agh va'n lhong nish ayns mean ny marrey, eiyrit noon as noal lesh ny tonnyn: son va'n gheay nyn 'oi.

verses.name: Matthew 14:25
verses.text: As ayns y chiarroo arrey jeh'n oie, haink Yeesey huc, shooyll er y cheayn.

verses.name: Matthew 14:26
verses.text: As tra honnick ny ostyllyn eh shooyll er y cheayn, v'ad atchimagh, gra, She scaan t'ayn; as deie ad magh ayns aggle.

verses.name: Matthew 14:27
verses.text: Agh chelleeragh loayr Yeesey roo, gra, Bee-jee dy yien mie, she mish t'ayn, ny gow-jee aggle.

verses.name: Matthew 14:28
verses.text: As dreggyr Peddyr eh, gra, Hiarn, my she oo t'ayn, abbyr rhym cheet hood er yn ushtey.

verses.name: Matthew 14:29
verses.text: As dooyrt eh, Tar royd. As tra va Peddyr er jeet neose ass y lhong, huill eh er yn ushtey, dy gholl gys Yeesey.

verses.name: Matthew 14:30
verses.text: Agh gennaghtyn yn gheay rastagh, v'eh agglit: as aarloo dy gholl fo, dyllee eh, gra, Hiarn, saue mee.

verses.name: Matthew 14:31
verses.text: As ayns y tullogh, heeyn Yeesey magh e laue, as haare eh eh, as dooyrt eh rish, O ghooinney faase-chredjuagh, cre'n-fa v'ou mee-ouryssagh?

verses.name: Matthew 14:32
verses.text: As tra v'ad er n'gholl er-board y lhong, huitt yn gheay.

verses.name: Matthew 14:33
verses.text: Eisht haink yn cheshaght-lhuingey, as hug ad ooashley da, gra, Ayns firrinys oo Mac Yee.

verses.name: Matthew 14:34
verses.text: As tra v'ad er jeet harrish, haink ad gys cheer Ghennesaret.

verses.name: Matthew 14:35
verses.text: As tra hoig cummaltee yn voayl shen quoi v'eh, hug ad fys magh gys ooilley yn cheer mygeayrt, as hug ad lhieu huggey ooilley adsyn va doghanit.

verses.name: Matthew 14:36
verses.text: As ghuee ad er, ynrycan dy ventyn rish oirr e gharmad: as whilleen as venn rish, v'ad er nyn lheihys.

verses.name: Matthew 15:1
verses.text: Eisht haink gys Yeesey scrudeyryn as Phariseeyn veih Jerusalem, gra,

verses.name: Matthew 15:2
verses.text: Cre'n-fa ta dty ostyllyn brishey oardaghyn y chanstyr? son cha vel ad niee nyn laueyn ec goaill beaghey.

verses.name: Matthew 15:3
verses.text: Agh dreggyr eshyn, as dooyrt eh roo, Cre'n-oyr ta shiuish brishey sarey Yee liorish nyn oardaghyn?

verses.name: Matthew 15:4
verses.text: Son hug Jee sarey, gra, Cur arrym da dty ayr as da dty voir: as, Eshyn ta gwee mollaght er ayr ny moir, lhig da ve currit dy baase.

verses.name: Matthew 15:5
verses.text: Agh ta shiuish gra, Quoi-erbee jir rish ayr ny moir, Yn chooid-choonee shen oddagh uss jerkal rish voym's, te gioot er ny chasherickey gys Jee.

verses.name: Matthew 15:6
verses.text: As nagh lhiass da cooney sodjey 'choyrt da e ayr ny e voir. Ta shiu myr shoh jannoo sarey Yee gyn vree liorish ny oardaghyn eu.

verses.name: Matthew 15:7
verses.text: Chrauee-oalsey, s'mie ren Esaias phadeyrys jiuish, gra,

verses.name: Matthew 15:8
verses.text: Ta'n pobble shoh tayrn er-gerrey dou lesh nyn meeal, as cur ooashley dou lesh nyn meillyn, agh ta'n cree oc foddey voym.

verses.name: Matthew 15:9
verses.text: Agh ayns fardail t'ad cur ooashley dou, gynsaghey son y goo aym's oardaghyn deiney.

verses.name: Matthew 15:10
verses.text: As deie eh er y pobble, as dooyrt eh roo, Eaisht-jee as toig-jee.

verses.name: Matthew 15:11
verses.text: Cha nee shen ta goll stiagh ayns veeal ta jannoo dooinney neu-ghlen: agh ny ta cheet magh ass y veeal, shen ta jannoo neu-ghlen jeh.

verses.name: Matthew 15:12
verses.text: Eisht haink e ostyllyn huggey, as dooyrt ad rish, Vel fys ayd dy rowl ny Phariseeyn jymmoosagh, tra cheayll ad raa shoh?

verses.name: Matthew 15:13
verses.text: Agh dreggyr eshyn, as dooyrt eh, Bee dy chooilley villey, nagh vel my Ayr flaunyssagh er hoiaghey, er ny astyrt ass ny fraueyn.

verses.name: Matthew 15:14
verses.text: Lhig-jee daue: she leeideilee doal ad ta kione y vooinjer ghoal. As my ta'n doal shooyll kione y doal, tuittee ad ny-neesht ayns y jeeg.

verses.name: Matthew 15:15
verses.text: Eisht dreggyr Peddyr, as dooyrt eh rish, Soilshee dooinyn yn coraa-dorraghey shoh.

verses.name: Matthew 15:16
verses.text: Dooyrt Yeesey rish, Vel shiuish neesht foast fegooish tushtey?

verses.name: Matthew 15:17
verses.text: Nagh vel shiu foast toiggal, cre-erbee ta goit stiagh ayns y veeal, dy vel eh goll sheese ayns y volg, as goll magh trooid y chorp?

verses.name: Matthew 15:18
verses.text: Agh ta ny reddyn ta cheet magh ass y veeal, cheet veih'n chree, as t'ad shen jannoo dooinney neu-ghlen.

verses.name: Matthew 15:19
verses.text: Son magh veih'n chree ta cheet drogh smooinaghtyn, dunverys, brishey-poosey, maarderys, maarlys, feanish foalsey, goan mollaghtagh.

verses.name: Matthew 15:20
verses.text: Ad shoh ny reddyn ta jannoo dooinney neu-ghlen: agh dy ee lesh laueyn nagh ve nieet, cha vel shen jannoo dooinney neu-ghlen.

verses.name: Matthew 15:21
verses.text: Eisht hie Yeesey veih shen, as jimmee eh gys ardjyn Tyre as Sidon.

verses.name: Matthew 15:22
verses.text: As cur-my-ner va ben va ny Canaanite, haink magh ass ny ardjyn shen, geamagh as gra, Jean myghin orrym, O Hiarn, vac Ghavid; s'mooar ta my inneen er ny torchaghey lesh drogh-spyrryd.

verses.name: Matthew 15:23
verses.text: Agh cha dug eh fockle dy ansoor jee. As haink e ostyllyn, as ghuee ad er, gra, Lhig y raad j'ee, son t'ee gyllagh nyn yei.

verses.name: Matthew 15:24
verses.text: Agh dreggyr eshyn, as dooyrt eh, Cha vel mish er my choyrt, agh gys kirree-cailjey thie Israel.

verses.name: Matthew 15:25
verses.text: Eisht haink ee, as hug, ee ooashley da, gra, Hiarn, cooin lhiam.

verses.name: Matthew 15:26
verses.text: Agh dreggyr eh, as dooyrt eh, Cha vel eh cooie arran ny clienney y ghoaill, as y hilgey eh gys ny moddee.

verses.name: Matthew 15:27
verses.text: S'feer shen, Hiarn, dooyrt ish: foast ta ny moddee gee jeh'n vrooillagh ta tuittym jeh boayrd nyn mainshter.

verses.name: Matthew 15:28
verses.text: Er shen dansoor Yeesey, as dooyrt eh r'ee, O ven, s'mooar ta dty chredjue: yn aghin t'ou dy yeearree dy row ayd. As va'n inneen eck er ny lheihys veih'n oor cheddin.

verses.name: Matthew 15:29
verses.text: As jimmee Yeesey veih shen, as haink eh er-gerrey da faarkey Ghalilee, as hie eh seose er slieau, as hoie eh ayns shen.

verses.name: Matthew 15:30
verses.text: As haink earrooyn mooarey dy leih huggey, as nyn mast' oc va croobee, doail, balloo, baccee, as ymmodee elley, as hug ad ad nyn lhie ec cassyn Yeesey, as ren eh ad y lheihys.

verses.name: Matthew 15:31
verses.text: Ayns wheesh as dy ghow ooilley'n pobble yindys, tra honnick ad ny balloo loayrt, ny baccee slane, ny croobee shooyll as ny doail fakin, as ren ad Jee Israel y ghloyraghey.

verses.name: Matthew 15:32
verses.text: Eisht deie Yeesey er e ostyllyn, as dooyrt eh, Ta chymmey aym er y pobble, er-yn-oyr dy vel ad er ve marym nish three laa, as cha vel monney beaghey oc dy ghoaill: as cha der-ym ad ersooyl nyn drostey, er aggle dy gannooinee ad er y raad.

verses.name: Matthew 15:33
verses.text: Dooyrt e ostyllyn rish, Cre raad yiow mayd wheesh shen dy arran 'syn aasagh, as magh lheid yn earroo mooar dy leih?

verses.name: Matthew 15:34
verses.text: Dooyrt Yeesey roo, Cre-woad bwilleen t'eu? Dooyrt adsyn, Shiaght, as kuse fardalagh dy eeastyn beggey.

verses.name: Matthew 15:35
verses.text: As doardee eh da'n pobble dy hoie er y thalloo.

verses.name: Matthew 15:36
verses.text: As ghow eh ny shiaght bwilleenyn, as ny eeastyn, as hug e booise, as vrish eh, as hug eh ad da e ostyllyn, as hirveish adsyn er y pobble ad.

verses.name: Matthew 15:37
verses.text: As ren ad ooilley gee, as v'ad er nyn yannoo magh: as hrog ad jeh'n fooilliagh va er-mayrn lane shiaght baskadyn.

verses.name: Matthew 15:38
verses.text: As v'adsyn ren gee, kiare thousane dooinney, marish mraane as cloan.

verses.name: Matthew 15:39
verses.text: As hug eh ersooyl yn pobble, as ghow eh lhuingys, as haink eh gys ardjyn Vagdala.

verses.name: Matthew 16:1
verses.text: As haink ny Phariseeyn as ny Sadduceeyn dy phrowal eh, as hir ad er, eh dy yeeaghyn cowrey ennagh daue veih niau.

verses.name: Matthew 16:2
verses.text: Dreggyr eshyn, as dooyrt eh roo, Tra ta'n fastyr er, jir shiuish, Bee emshyr aalin ayn: son dy vel jirgid 'syn aer.

verses.name: Matthew 16:3
verses.text: As ayns y voghrey, Bee emshyr vroghe ayn jiu; son ta'n aer jiarg as dullyr. O shiuish chrauee-oalsey, ta toiggal eu kys dy ghoaill baght jeh neeal yn aer, as nagh vod shiu baght y ghoaill jeh cowraghyn ny hearishyn?

verses.name: Matthew 16:4
verses.text: She drogh-heeloghe as neu-ghooghyssagh ta shirrey cowrey, as cha bee cowrey er ny chur daue, agh cowrey yn adeyr Jonas. As daag eh ad, as jimmee eh roish.

verses.name: Matthew 16:5
verses.text: Nish tra va e ostyllyn er n'aagail y cheu elley, v'ad er yarrood arran y chur

verses.name: Matthew 16:6
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt Yeesey roo, Gow-jee twoaie, as bee-jee er nyn arrey noi soorid ny Phariseeyn as ny Sadduceeyn.

verses.name: Matthew 16:7
verses.text: As loayr ad re-cheilley, gra, Ta shoh er yn oyr nagh dug shin lhien arran.

verses.name: Matthew 16:8
verses.text: Tra hoig Yeesey shoh, dooyrt eh roo, Gheiney faase-chredjuagh, cre'n-fa ta shiu resooney riu hene son nagh dug shiu lhieu arran?

verses.name: Matthew 16:9
verses.text: Nagh vel shiu foast toiggal, as nagh vel cooinaghtyn eu er ny queig bwilleenyn ren magh ny queig thousaneyn, as cre whilleen baskad d'ooilliagh v'eu?

verses.name: Matthew 16:10
verses.text: Ny er ny shiaght bwilleenyn ren magh ny kiare thousaneyn, as cre-woad baskad hrog shiu?

verses.name: Matthew 16:11
verses.text: Kys te nagh vel shiu goaill eu hene nagh nee er arran va mee cheet, agh shiu dy ghoaill twoaie jeh soorid ny Phariseeyn as ny Sadduceeyn?

verses.name: Matthew 16:12
verses.text: Eisht hoig ad nagh dug eh raaue daue noi soorid arran, agh noi ynsagh ny Phariseeyn as ny Sadduceeyn.

verses.name: Matthew 16:13
verses.text: Tra va Yeesey er jeet gys ardjyn Cesarea Philippi, denee eh jeh e ostyllyn, gra, Cre ta deiney dy ghra my-mychione's, Mac y dooinney, quoi mee hene?

verses.name: Matthew 16:14
verses.text: Dooyrt adsyn, Ta paart gra dy nee Ean Bashtey oo, as paart Elias, as ta feallagh elley gra dy nee Jeremias oo, ny fer jeh ny phadeyryn.

verses.name: Matthew 16:15
verses.text: Dooyrt eshyn roo, Agh quoi ta shiuish gra, dy vel mee?

verses.name: Matthew 16:16
verses.text: Dreggyr Simon Peddyr, as dooyrt eh, Uss yn Creest, Mac y Jee bio.

verses.name: Matthew 16:17
verses.text: Dansoor Yeesey, as dooyrt eh rish, Bannit t'ou uss Simon mac Jona: son cha nee feill as fuill t'er hoilshaghey shoh dhyt's agh my Ayr t'ayns niau.

verses.name: Matthew 16:18
verses.text: As ta mee myrgeddin gra rhyt, Dy nee uss Peddyr, as dy nee er y chreg shoh trog-ym's my agglish: as cha vow giattyn niurin yn varriaght urree.

verses.name: Matthew 16:19
verses.text: As ver-yms dhyt's ogheryn reeriaght niau: as cre-erbee chianglys oo er y thalloo, bee eh kianlt ayns niau: as cre-erbee eayslys oo er y thalloo, bee eh er ny eaysley ayns niau.

verses.name: Matthew 16:20
verses.text: Eisht hug eh currym er e ostyllyn gyn ad dy insh da dooinney erbee, dy nee eshyn va Yeesey yn Creest.

verses.name: Matthew 16:21
verses.text: Veih yn traa shen magh ren Yeesey toshiaght dy hoilshaghey da e ostyllyn, kys dy beign da goll seose gys Jerusalem, as goll fo mooarane surranse veih'n chanstyr, as ny ard-saggyrtyn, as ny scrudeyryn, as dy beagh eh er ny choyrt gy baase, agh dy n'irragh eh reesht er y trass laa.

verses.name: Matthew 16:22
verses.text: Eisht ghow Peddyr eh er-lheh, as ghow eh toshiaght dy choyrlaghey eh, gra, Foddey dy row eh void, Hiarn, lheid shoh dy haghyrt dhyt.

verses.name: Matthew 16:23
verses.text: Agh hyndaa eshyn, as dooyrt eh rish Peddyr, Ass my enish, y violeyder, t'ou cur ribbey ayns my raad: son cha vel ennaghtyn ayd jeh ny reddyn ta bentyn rish Jee, agh jeh ny reddyn ta bentyn rish deiney.

verses.name: Matthew 16:24
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt Yeesey rish e ostyllyn My ta dooinney erbee aggindagh geiyrt orrym's, lhig da eh-hene y obbal, as e chrosh y hroggal, as geiyrt orrym.

verses.name: Matthew 16:25
verses.text: Son quoi-erbee baillish e vioys y hauail, caillee eh eh: as quoi-erbee chaillys e vioys er my ghraih's, sauee eh eh.

verses.name: Matthew 16:26
verses.text: Son cre'n vondeish t'ec dooinney, my chosnys eh yn seihll ooilley, as e annym hene y choayl? ny cre nee dooinney y choyrt ayns coonrey son e annym?

verses.name: Matthew 16:27
verses.text: Son hig Mac y dooinney ayns gloyr e Ayrey, as e ainleyn casherick marish: as ec y traa shen cooilleenee eh da dy chooilley ghooinney cordail rish e obbraghyn.

verses.name: Matthew 16:28
verses.text: Dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, Dy vel paart nyn shassoo ayns shoh, nagh jean blashtyn er y baase, derrey hee ad Mac y dooinney cheet ayns e reeriaght.

verses.name: Matthew 17:1
verses.text: As ec kione shey laa, ghow Yeesey Peddyr, as Jamys, as Ean e vraar, as hug eh lesh ad er-lheh seose er slieau ard,

verses.name: Matthew 17:2
verses.text: As va'n cummey echey er ny chaghlaa kiongoyrt roo, as ren yn eddin echey soilshean myr y ghrian, as va'n coamrey echey gial myr y soilshey.

verses.name: Matthew 17:3
verses.text: As cur-my-ner, honnick ad Moses as Elias taggloo rish.

verses.name: Matthew 17:4
verses.text: Eisht dreggyr Peddyr as dooyrt eh rish Yeesey, Hiarn, s'maynrey dooin dy hannaghtyn ayns shoh: my she dty aigney's eh, lhig dooin ayns shoh troggal three cabbaneyn: cabbane er dty hon's, as cabbane son Moses, as cabbane son Elias.

verses.name: Matthew 17:5
verses.text: Choud as v'eh foast loayrt, ren bodjal sollys skeayley harrystoo: as cur-my-ner haink coraa ass y vodjal, gra, Shoh my vac ennoil, ayn ta mee goaill slane taitnys, eaisht-jee rishyn.

verses.name: Matthew 17:6
verses.text: As tra cheayll ny ostyllyn eh, huitt ad sheese er nyn eddin gys y thalloo, son s'mooar yn aggle v'orroo.

verses.name: Matthew 17:7
verses.text: As haink Yeesey as venn eh roo, as dooyrt eh, Trog-jee erriu, as ny gow-jee aggle.

verses.name: Matthew 17:8
verses.text: As tra hrog ad seose nyn sooillyn, cha vaik ad fer erbee, agh Yeesey ny-lomarcan.

verses.name: Matthew 17:9
verses.text: As myr v'ad cheet neose jeh'n clieau hug Yeesey currym orroo, gra, Ny insh-jee yn ashlish da unnane erbee, derrey vees Mac yn dooinney er n'irree veih ny merriu.

verses.name: Matthew 17:10
verses.text: As denee e ostyllyn jeh, gra, Cre'n-oyr jir ny scrudeyryn dy vel Elias dy heet hoshiaght?

verses.name: Matthew 17:11
verses.text: Dansoor Yeesey as dooyrt eh roo, Hig Elias dy jarroo hoshiaght, as lhiassee eh dy chooilley nhee:

verses.name: Matthew 17:12
verses.text: Agh ta mish gra riu, dy vel Elias er jeet hannah, as cha dug ad geill da, agh t'ad er ghellal rish lurg nyn aigney hene as er yn aght cheddin nee Mac y dooinney neesht surranse lioroo.

verses.name: Matthew 17:13
verses.text: Eisht hoig e Ostyllyn dy nee er Ean Bashtey v'eh cheet.

verses.name: Matthew 17:14
verses.text: As tra v'ad er jeet gys y cheshaght, haink huggey dooinney dy row, gliooney sheese as gra,

verses.name: Matthew 17:15
verses.text: Hiarn, jean chymmey er my vac, son t'eh ass e cheeayl, as dy mooar seaghnit: son t'eh dy mennick tuittym ayns yn aile, as dy mennick ayns yn ushtey.

verses.name: Matthew 17:16
verses.text: As hug mee lhiam eh gys dty ostyllyn, as cha yarg ad eh y lheihys.

verses.name: Matthew 17:17
verses.text: Dansoor Yeesey as dooyrt eh, O heeloghe vee-chredjuagh as roonagh, caid ta mish dy ve meriu? caid ta mee dy hurranse diu? cur lhiat eh hym's ayns shoh.

verses.name: Matthew 17:18
verses.text: As vaggyr Yeesey er y drogh-spyrryd, as hie eh magh ass: as va'n lhiannoo er ny lheihys veih'n oor shen.

verses.name: Matthew 17:19
verses.text: Eisht haink e ostyllyn gys Yeesey er-lheh, as dooyrt ad, Cre liorish nagh voddagh shinyn eh y lheihys?

verses.name: Matthew 17:20
verses.text: Dooyrt Yeesey roo, Kyndagh rish nyn gredjue moal: son dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, Dy beagh nyn gredjue wheesh grine dy rass mustard, jirragh shiu rish y slieau shoh, Scugh veih shoh noon gys shid, as nee eh scughey: as cha bee nhee erbee ro-ghoillee diu.

verses.name: Matthew 17:21
verses.text: Ny-yeih cha vel y dooghys shoh dy ghrogh-spyrrydyn dy ve castit, agh liorish padjer as trostey.

verses.name: Matthew 17:22
verses.text: As choud as v'ad ayns Galilee, dooyrt Yeesey roo, Bee Mac y dooinney er ny vrah gys laueyn deiney:

verses.name: Matthew 17:23
verses.text: As ver ad eh gy-baase, as y trass laa nee eh girree reesht: as v'ad feer trimshagh.

verses.name: Matthew 17:24
verses.text: As tra v'ad er jeet gys Capernaum, haink y vooinjer va troggal argid y cheesh gys Peddyr, gra, Nagh vel y mainshter euish geeck y cheesh?

verses.name: Matthew 17:25
verses.text: Dooyrt eshyn, Dy row. As tra v'eh er jeet stiagh ayns y thie, va Yeesey ro-laue rish, gra, Cre t'ou smooinaghtyn, Simon, quoi jeh ta reeaghyn y thallooin troggal custom ny keesh? jeh nyn gloan hene, ny jeh joarreeyn?

verses.name: Matthew 17:26
verses.text: Dooyrt Peddyr rish, Jeh joarreeyn. Dooyrt Yeesey rishyn, Eisht ta'n chloan seyr.

verses.name: Matthew 17:27
verses.text: Ny-yeih, son nagh bee cumys er ny chur hooin, immee uss gys y cheayn, as lhig sheese dooan, as trog y chied eeast hig hood: as tra vees oo er vosley e veeal, yiow peesh dy argid ayn; shen gow, as eeck eh er my hon's as er dty hon hene.

verses.name: Matthew 18:1
verses.text: Ec y traa cheddin haink e ostyllyn gys Yeesey, gra, Quoi syrjey ta ayns reeriaght niau?

verses.name: Matthew 18:2
verses.text: As deie Yeesey er lhiannoo beg, as hoie eh eh kiongoyrt roo

verses.name: Matthew 18:3
verses.text: As dooyrt eh, Dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, Mannagh jean shiu chyndaa, as cheet dy ve myr cloan veggey, cha jed shiu stiagh ayns reeriaght niau.

verses.name: Matthew 18:4
verses.text: Quoi-erbee er-y-fa shen, nee eh-hene y injillaghey myr y lhiannoo beg shoh, eh syrjey vees ayns reeriaght niau.

verses.name: Matthew 18:5
verses.text: As quoi-erbee nee soiaghey jeh lheid y lhiannoo beg shoh ayns yn ennym aym's, t'eh jannoo soiaghey jeem's.

verses.name: Matthew 18:6
verses.text: Agh quoi-erbee ver oyr da unnane jeh'n vooinjer veggey shoh ta credjal aynym's dy huittym (veih'n chredjue) veagh eh ny baare da dy beagh clagh-wyllin er ve croghit mysh e wannal, as eh dy ve baiht ayns diunid ny marrey.

verses.name: Matthew 18:7
verses.text: Smerg da'n theihll kyndagh rish oyryn peccah: son shegin da nyn lheid 've ayn; agh smerg da'n dooinney, liorish ta'n loght cheet.

verses.name: Matthew 18:8
verses.text: Shen-y-fa my ta dty laue ny dty chass hene dy dty hayrn gys yn olk, giare jeed, as tilg void ad; te ny share dhyt goll stiagh ayns bea croobagh ny baccagh, na daa laue ny daa chass y ve ayd, as oo dy ve tilgit ayns yn aile dy bragh farraghtyn.

verses.name: Matthew 18:9
verses.text: As my ta dty hooill dy dty hayrn gys peccah, pluck assyd, as tilg void ee: te ny share dhyt goll stiagh ayns bea lesh un hooill, na daa hooill y ve ayd, as oo dy ve tilgit ayns aile niurin.

verses.name: Matthew 18:10
verses.text: Cur-jee twoaie nagh soie shiu beg jeh unnane jeh'n vooinjer veggey shoh: son ta mee gra riu, dy vel ny ainleyn ocsyn ayns niau, kinjagh cur-my-ner eddin my Ayr flaunyssagh.

verses.name: Matthew 18:11
verses.text: Son ta Mac y dooinney er jeet dy hauail shen ny va caillit.

verses.name: Matthew 18:12
verses.text: Cre ta shiu smooinaghtyn? My ta keead keyrrey ec dooinney, as unnane jeu v'er n'gholl er-shaghryn, nagh vel eh faagail yn chiare-feed as yn nuy-jeig, as goll gys ny sleityn, as shirrey yn cheyrrey chailjey?

verses.name: Matthew 18:13
verses.text: As my she shen dy vel eh dy gheddyn ee, dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, dy vel eh goaill ny smoo dy voggey jeh'n cheyrrey shen, ny jeh'n chiare-feed as yn nuy-jeig, nagh jagh er-shaghryn.

verses.name: Matthew 18:14
verses.text: Er yn aght cheddin, cha nee aigney nyn Ayr t'ayns niau eh, unnane jeh'n vooinjer veggey shoh dy herraghtyn.

verses.name: Matthew 18:15
verses.text: Myrgeddin my nee dty vraar aggair dhyt, immee as insh da e oill eddyr shiu hene nyn-lomarcan: my eaishtys eh rhyt, t'ou er chosney dty vraar.

verses.name: Matthew 18:16
verses.text: Agh mannagh n'eaisht eh rhyt, eisht gow mayrt fer ny jees elley, ayns beeal ghaa ny three dy eanishyn dy vod dy chooilley ockle ve jeant mie.

verses.name: Matthew 18:17
verses.text: As mannagh der eh geill dauesyn, insh eh da'n agglish: agh mannagh der eh geill da'n agglish, jeeagh er myr an-chreestee as myr publican.

verses.name: Matthew 18:18
verses.text: Dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, Cre erbee nee shiuish y chiangley er y thalloo, bee eh kianlt ayns niau: as cre-erbee nee shiu y eaysley er y thalloo, bee eh er ny eaysley ayns niau.

verses.name: Matthew 18:19
verses.text: Reesht ta mee gra riu, my nee jees jiuish coardail er y thalloo 'syn un aghin bee nyn aghin er ny chooilleeney liorish my Ayr t'ayns niau.

verses.name: Matthew 18:20
verses.text: Son raad ta ghaa ny three er nyn jaglym cooidjagh ayns m'ennym's, shen y raad ta mish nyn mastey.

verses.name: Matthew 18:21
verses.text: Eisht haink Peddyr huggey, as dooyrt eh, Hiarn, cre cha mennick as ta orrym's leih da my vraar, tra yioym aggair liorish? nee choud as shiaght keayrtyn?

verses.name: Matthew 18:22
verses.text: Dooyrt Yeesey rish, Cha vel mish gra rhyt, Choud as shiaght keayrtyn: agh choud as three-feed as jeih keayrtyn shiaght.

verses.name: Matthew 18:23
verses.text: Shen-y-fa ta reeriaght niau er ny hoylaghey gys ree dy row, baillish coontey rish e harvaantyn.

verses.name: Matthew 18:24
verses.text: As tra v'eh er n'yannoo toshiaght dy choontey, haink fer huggey va lhiastyn da jeih thousane talent.

verses.name: Matthew 18:25
verses.text: Agh son wheesh as nagh row echey dy eeck, doardee e hiarn eh dy ve creckit as e ven, as e chloan, as ooilley ny v'echey, as e eeaghyn dy ve eeckit.

verses.name: Matthew 18:26
verses.text: Huitt y charvaant er-y-fa shen sheese, as ghuee eh er, gra, Cur daill dou, Hiarn, as nee'm ooilley y eeck dhyt.

verses.name: Matthew 18:27
verses.text: Eisht va chiarn y charvaant shen er ny veiyghey lesh chymmey, as ren eh feaysley er, as leih eh da ny v'eh dy lhiastyn.

verses.name: Matthew 18:28
verses.text: Agh hie yn charvaant cheddin magh, as hooar eh fer jeh e heshaghyn-sharvaant va lhiastyn keead ping da: as haare eh greme er, as ghow eh eh er y scoarnagh, gra, Eeck shen ny t'ou dy lhiastyn.

verses.name: Matthew 18:29
verses.text: As huitt e heshey-harvaant sheese ec e chassyn, as ghuee eh er, gra, Cur daill dou as nee'm ooilley y eeck dhyt.

verses.name: Matthew 18:30
verses.text: Agh cha lhiggagh eh lesh: agh hie eh, as hilg eh eh ayns pryssoon, derrey eeckagh eh ny v'eh dy lhiastyn.

verses.name: Matthew 18:31
verses.text: Myr shen tra honnick e heshaghyn-sharvaant kys hie eh er, ghow ad dy feer olk rish, as haink ad, as dinsh ad da nyn jiarn ooilley ny va er daghyrt.

verses.name: Matthew 18:32
verses.text: Eisht deie e hiarn er, as dooyrt eh rish, O ghrogh harvaant, leih mish dhyt's yn slane lhiastynys shen, er-yn-oyr dy ren oo lheid yn aghin hym:

verses.name: Matthew 18:33
verses.text: Nagh lhisagh uss myrgeddin as chymmey er ve ayd er dty heshey-harvaant, eer myr va chymmey aym's ort's?

verses.name: Matthew 18:34
verses.text: As va e hiarn jymmoosagh, as livrey eh seose eh gys laue y tidoor ny phryssoonagh, derrey eeckagh eh ooilley ny v'eh dy lhiastyn.

verses.name: Matthew 18:35
verses.text: Er yn aght shoh myrgeddin nee my Ayr flaunyssagh riuish, mannagh leihee shiu veih nyn greeaghyn dy chooilley ghooinney da e vraar e loghtyn.

verses.name: Matthew 19:1
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione, erreish da Yeesey v'er loayrt ny goan shoh, dy jimmee eh veih Galilee, as dy daink eh gys ardjyn Yudea, er cheu elley dy Yordan:

verses.name: Matthew 19:2
verses.text: As deiyr earrooyn mooarey dy leih er, ren eh ad y lheihys ayns shen.

verses.name: Matthew 19:3
verses.text: Haink ny Phariseeyn huggey myrgeddin dy phrowal eh, as dooyrt ad rish, Vel eh lowal da dooinney e ven y chur er sooyl son dy chooilley oyr?

verses.name: Matthew 19:4
verses.text: Dreggyr eshyn, as dooyrt eh roo, Nagh vel shiu er lhaih, eshyn chroo ad ec y toshiaght, dy chroo eh ad fyrrynagh as bwoirrynagh?

verses.name: Matthew 19:5
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Er-yn-oyr shoh nee dooinney faagail e ayr as e voir, as lhiannee eh gys e ven: as bee ad ny-neesht un eill.

verses.name: Matthew 19:6
verses.text: Shen-y-fa cha vel ad ny sodjey jees, agh yn un eill. Cre-erbee er-y-fa shen ta Jee er chur cooidjagh, ny lhig da dooinney erbee y scarrey veih-my-cheilley.

verses.name: Matthew 19:7
verses.text: Dooyrt adsyn rish, Cre'n-oyr eisht doardee Moses screeuyn-scarree y choyrt, as y ven y chur ersooyl?

verses.name: Matthew 19:8
verses.text: Dooyrt eshyn roo, kyndagh rish creoghys nyn greeaghyn, lhow Moses diu nyn mraane y chur ersooyl: agh ec y toshiaght cha row eh myr shen.

verses.name: Matthew 19:9
verses.text: As ta mish gra riu, Quoi-erbee scarrys rish e ven, cheu-mooie jeh son maarderys, as phoosys ben elley, t'eh brishey-poosey: as quoi-erbee phoosys ish ta scarrit, t'eh brishey poosey:

verses.name: Matthew 19:10
verses.text: Dooyrt e ostyllyn rish, My she shoh yn chooish eddyr dooinney as e ven, cha vel eh mie dy phoosey.

verses.name: Matthew 19:11
verses.text: Agh dooyrt eshyn roo, Cha nee dy chooilley ghooinney oddys shen y ghoaill er, agh adsyn ny-lomarcan daue te er ny choyrt.

verses.name: Matthew 19:12
verses.text: Son ta deiney gennish ayn, rug myr shen veih brein nyn mayrey: as ta deiney gennish ayn, v'er nyn yannoo gennish liorish deiney: as ta deiney gennish ayn, t'er n'yannoo ad-hene gennish er graih reeriaght niau. Eshyn oddys shoh y ghoaill er, lhig da 'ghoaill eh.

verses.name: Matthew 19:13
verses.text: Eisht hug ad lhieu huggey cloan veggey, dy chur e laueyn orroo, as dy vannaghey ad: as hug e ostyllyn oghsan daue.

verses.name: Matthew 19:14
verses.text: Agh dooyrt Yeesey, Sur-jee cloan aegey, as ny jean-jee ad y lhiettal dy heet hym's: son jeh nyn lheid ta reeriaght niau.

verses.name: Matthew 19:15
verses.text: As hug eh e laueyn orroo, as jimmee eh veih shen.

verses.name: Matthew 19:16
verses.text: As cur-my-ner, haink fer huggey, as dooyrt eh rish, Vainshter vie, cre'n obbyr ne lhisins y yannoo dy chosney yn vea veayn?

verses.name: Matthew 19:17
verses.text: As dooyrt eshyn rish, Cre'n-fa t'ou genmys mish mie? cha vel ayn ny ta mie, agh unnane, ynrycan Jee: agh my sailts goll stiagh ayns bea, freill ny annaghyn.

verses.name: Matthew 19:18
verses.text: Dooyrt eshyn rish, Cre ny annaghyn? Dooyrt Yeesey, Cha jean oo dunverys, Cha brish oo poosey, Cha jean oo geid, Cha n'ymmyrk oo feanish foalsey,

verses.name: Matthew 19:19
verses.text: Cur arrym da dty ayr as da dty voir: as, Ver oo graih da dty naboo myr dhyt hene.

verses.name: Matthew 19:20
verses.text: Dooyrt y dooinney aeg rish, Ooilley ny annaghyn shoh ta mee er vreayll veih my aegid: cre sodjey t'orrym dy vannoo?

verses.name: Matthew 19:21
verses.text: Dooyrt Yeesey rish, My sailt ve dy firrinagh mie, immee, as creck, as cur ny t'ayd da ny boghtyn, as bee berchys ayd ayns niau; as tar as eiyr orrym's.

verses.name: Matthew 19:22
verses.text: Agh tra cheayll yn dooinney aeg yn raa shen, hie eh ersooyl dy trimshagh: son va state mooar hallooin echey.

verses.name: Matthew 19:23
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt Yeesey rish e ostyllyn, Dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, S'doillee hed dooinney berchagh stiagh ayns reeriaght niau.

verses.name: Matthew 19:24
verses.text: As reesht ta mee gra riu, Te ny sassey da camel goll trooid croae snaidey, na da dooinney berchagh dy gholl stiagh ayns reeriaght Yee.

verses.name: Matthew 19:25
verses.text: Tra cheayll e ostyllyn shoh, ghow ad yindys erskyn-towse, gra, Quoi eisht oddys ve er ny hauail?

verses.name: Matthew 19:26
verses.text: Agh yeeagh Yeesey orroo, as dooyrt eh roo, Gys deiney ta shoh neu-phossible, agh da Jee ta dy chooilley nhee possible.

verses.name: Matthew 19:27
verses.text: Eisht dreggyr Peddyr, as dooyrt eh rish, Cur-my-ner, ta shinyn er dreigeil ooilley, as er n'eiyrt ort's; cre yiow mainyn er-y-fa shen.

verses.name: Matthew 19:28
verses.text: Dooyrt Yeesey roo, Dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, 'Sy stayd noa, tra nee Mac y dooinney soie er stoyl-reeoil e ghloyr, dy jean shiuish myrgeddin t'er n'eiyrt orrym's soie er daa stoyl-reeoil yeig, briwnys daa heeloghe yeig Israel.

verses.name: Matthew 19:29
verses.text: As dy chooilley unnane t'er hreigeil thieyn, ny braaraghyn, ny shayraghyn, ny ayr, ny moir, ny ben, ny cloan, ny thalloo, er graih m'ennym's, yiow ad keead filley, as eiraght ayns y vea veayn.

verses.name: Matthew 19:30
verses.text: Agh bee ymmodee jeusyn ta hoshiaght, er-jerrey; as jeusyn ta er-jerrey hoshiaght.

verses.name: Matthew 20:1
verses.text: Son ta reeriaght niau casley rish dooinney va ny er-thie, hie magh dy moghey dy ailley labreeyn son e gharey-feeyney.

verses.name: Matthew 20:2
verses.text: As tra v'eh er choardail rish ny labreeyn son ping 'sy laa, hug eh ad stiagh ayns e gharey-feeyney.

verses.name: Matthew 20:3
verses.text: As hie eh magh mysh y trass oor, as honnick eh feallagh elley shassoo nyn daaue 'syn ynnyd-margee,

verses.name: Matthew 20:4
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Immee-jee shiuish myrgeddin gys y gharey-feeyney, as cre erbee ta cair, shen yiow shiu. As hie ad rhymboo.

verses.name: Matthew 20:5
verses.text: Reesht hie eh magh mysh y cheyoo as yn nuyoo oor, as ren eh er yn aght cheddin.

verses.name: Matthew 20:6
verses.text: As mysh yn un oor jeig, hie eh magh, as hooar eh feallagh elley shassoo nyn daaue, as dooyrt eh roo, Cre'n-fa ta shiu nyn shassoo ayns shoh fey ny laa nyn daaue?

verses.name: Matthew 20:7
verses.text: Dooyrt adsyn rish, Er-yn-oyr nagh vel dooinney erbee er vailley shin. Dooyrt eshyn roo, Immee-jee shiuish myrgeddin gys y gharey-feeyney, as yiow shiu cre-erbee ta cair.

verses.name: Matthew 20:8
verses.text: Myr shen tra va'n fastyr er jeet, dooyrt chiarn y gharey-feeyney rish y stiurt echey, Eie er ny labreeyn, as cur daue nyn vaill, goaill toshiaght veih yn vooinjer s'jerree gys y chied eallagh.

verses.name: Matthew 20:9
verses.text: As tra haink feallagh yn un oor jeig hooar ad dagh dooinney jeu ping y pheesh.

verses.name: Matthew 20:10
verses.text: Agh tra haink y chied eallagh, heill ad dy voghe ad ny smoo, as hooar adsyn myrgeddin dagh dooinney e phing.

verses.name: Matthew 20:11
verses.text: As tra v'ad er ghoaill eh, ren ad tallagh noi yn er-thie.

verses.name: Matthew 20:12
verses.text: Gra, Cha vel yn vooinjer s'jerree shoh er n'obbraghey agh un oor, as t'ou er n'yannoo ad corrym rooinyn ta er n'ymmyrkey yn errey as chiass y laa.

verses.name: Matthew 20:13
verses.text: Agh dreggyr eshyn fer jeu, gra, Heshey vie, cha vel mish jannoo aggair dhyt: nagh choard uss rhym's son ping?

verses.name: Matthew 20:14
verses.text: Trog shen ny ta lhiat, as immee royd: m'aigney's eh dy choyrt da'n fer s'jerree shoh, myr ta mee er chur dhyt's.

verses.name: Matthew 20:15
verses.text: Nagh vel eh lowal dou dy yannoo cre saillym rish my chooid hene? vel dty hooill's olk, er-yn-oyr dy vel mish mie?

verses.name: Matthew 20:16
verses.text: Myr shen bee adsyn ta er-jerrey hoshiaght, as adsyn ta hoshiaght er-jerrey: son shimmey t'er nyn eam, agh s'tiark t'er nyn reih.

verses.name: Matthew 20:17
verses.text: As myr va Yeesey goll seose gys Jerusalem, ghow eh yn daa ostyl yeig dy lhiattee er y raad, as dooyrt eh roo,

verses.name: Matthew 20:18
verses.text: Cur-my-ner ta shin goll seose gys Jerusalem, as bee Mac y dooinney er ny vrah gys ny ard-saggyrtyn, as gys ny scrudeyryn, as deyree ad eh gy-baase.

verses.name: Matthew 20:19
verses.text: As livreyee ad seose eh gys ny Ashoonee, as nee ad faghid er, as eh y scuitchal, as y chrossey: as er y trass laa nee eh girree reesht (veih ny merriu).

verses.name: Matthew 20:20
verses.text: Eisht haink huggey moir cloan Zebedee, as e mec maree, cur ooashley da, as shirrey aghin er.

verses.name: Matthew 20:21
verses.text: As dooyrt eh r'ee, Cre ta dty yeearree? Dooyrt ish rish, Giall daue shoh my ghaa vac dy hoie, yn derrey yeh er dty laue yesh, as y jeh elley er dty laue hoshtal ayns dty reeriaght.

verses.name: Matthew 20:22
verses.text: Agh dreggyr Yeesey as dooyrt eh, Cha vel fys eu hene cre ta shiu dy yeearree. Vod shiu giu jeh'n cappan ta mish giu jeh, as v'er nyn mashtey lesh y bashtey ta mish dy ve bashtit lesh? Dooyrt adsyn rish, Foddee mayd.

verses.name: Matthew 20:23
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Iuee shiu dy jarroo jeh my chappan, as bee shiu er nyn mashtey lesh y bashtey ta mish dy ve bashtit lesh: agh dy hoie er my laue yesh, as er my laue hoshtal, cha vel shen lhiam's dy-choyrt, agh ny-lomarcan dauesyn er nyn son te kiarit liorish my Ayr.

verses.name: Matthew 20:24
verses.text: As tra cheayll yn jeih shoh, v'ad feer jymmoosagh rish y daa vraar.

verses.name: Matthew 20:25
verses.text: Agh deie Yeesey orroo huggey, as dooyrt eh, Ta fys eu dy vel princeyn ny Hashoonee gymmyrkey chiarnys harrystoo, as ta ny ard-gheiney gymmyrkey reill orroo.

verses.name: Matthew 20:26
verses.text: Agh cha bee shillish myr shen: agh quoi-erbee jiuish baillish ve ooasle, lhig da ve nyn shirveishagh.

verses.name: Matthew 20:27
verses.text: As quoi-erbee baillish ve yn ard-ghooinney nyn mast' eu, lhig da ve yn charvaant eu.

verses.name: Matthew 20:28
verses.text: Myr nagh daink yn Mac dooinney dy ve shirveishit er, agh dy hirveish, as dy chur e vioys ny lhiassaghey son ymmodee.

verses.name: Matthew 20:29
verses.text: As tra v'ad er n'immeeaght veih Jericho deiyr earrooyn mooarey dy leih er.

verses.name: Matthew 20:30
verses.text: As cur-my-ner, va daa ghooinney doal nyn soie rish oirr yn raad, as tra cheayll ad dy row Yeesey goll shaghey, deie ad, gra, Jean myghin orrin, O Hiarn, vac Ghavid.

verses.name: Matthew 20:31
verses.text: As hooar yn pobble foill daue, ad dy ve nyn-dhost: agh deie adsyn wheesh shen smoo, gra, Jean myghin orrin, O Hiarn, vac Ghavid.

verses.name: Matthew 20:32
verses.text: As hass Yeesey, as deie eh orroo, as dooyrt eh, Cre bailliu mee dy yannoo er ny son eu?

verses.name: Matthew 20:33
verses.text: Dooyrt adsyn rish, Hiarn, dy vod ny sooillyn ain v'er nyn vosley.

verses.name: Matthew 20:34
verses.text: Myr shen va chymmey ec Yeesey orroo, as venn eh rish ny sooillyn oc: as chelleeragh hooar ny sooillyn oc nyn soilshey, as deiyr ad er.

verses.name: Matthew 21:1
verses.text: As tra v'ad tayrn er-gerrey da Jerusalem, as dy row ad er jeet gys Bethphage, gys cronk ny Oliveyn, hug Yeesey jees jeh e ostyllyn er chaghteraght,

verses.name: Matthew 21:2
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Immee-jee gys y balley-cheerey ta shiu dy akin, as chelleeragh yiow shiu assyl kianlt as lhiy maree: feayshil-jee as cur-jee lhieu ad hym's.

verses.name: Matthew 21:3
verses.text: As my loayrys dooinney erbee veg riu, abbyr-jee shiuish, Ta feme ec y Chiarn orroo; as chelleeragh lhiggee eh yn raad daue.

verses.name: Matthew 21:4
verses.text: Va ooilley shoh jeant, dy voddagh shen ve cooilleenit va loayrit liorish y phadeyr gra,

verses.name: Matthew 21:5
verses.text: Insh-jee da inneen Sion, Cur-my-ner, ta dty ree cheet hood dy imlee, as ny hoie er assyl, as er lhiy sharragh assyl.

verses.name: Matthew 21:6
verses.text: As hie adsyn rhymboo, as ren ad myr va Yeesey er n'oardaghey daue.

verses.name: Matthew 21:7
verses.text: As hug ad lhieu yn assyl as y lhiy, as hug ad orroo nyn eaddeeyn, as hug ad eshyn ny hoie orroo.

verses.name: Matthew 21:8
verses.text: As ren earrooyn mooarey dy leih skeayley nyn gharmadyn er y raad; yiare feallagh elley banglaneyn jeh ny biljyn, as skeayl ad ad er y raad.

verses.name: Matthew 21:9
verses.text: As deie yn pobble hie roish, as adsyn haink ny yei, gra, Hosanna gys mac Ghavid: bannit t'eshyn ta cheet ayns ennym y Chiarn, Hosanna ayns yn yrjid.

verses.name: Matthew 21:10
verses.text: As tra v'eh er jeet gys Jerusalem, va ooilley yn ard-valley ayns anvea, gra, Quoi eh shoh?

verses.name: Matthew 21:11
verses.text: Dooyrt y pobble, Shoh Yeesey yn phadeyr, ta veih Nazareth ayns Galilee.

verses.name: Matthew 21:12
verses.text: As hie Yeesey stiagh ayns chiamble Yee, as deiyr eh magh ooilley adsyn va creck as kionnaghey ayns y chiamble, as hilg eh harrish ny buird ocsyn va caghlaa argid, as ny stuill ocsyn va creck calmaneyn.

verses.name: Matthew 21:13
