verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Te scruit, Bee my hie's enmyssit thie yn phadjer, agh ta shiuish er n'yannoo eh ny ooig dy vaarlee.

verses.name: Matthew 21:14
verses.text: As haink ny doail as ny croobee huggey gys y chiamble, as ren eh ad y lheihys.

verses.name: Matthew 21:15
verses.text: As tra honnick ny ard-saggyrtyn as ny scruderyn ny reddyn yindyssagh v'eh dy yannoo, as ny paitchyn geamagh ayns y chiamble, as gra, Hosanna gys mac Ghavid, v'ad feer chorree.

verses.name: Matthew 21:16
verses.text: As dooyrt ad rish, Vel oo clashtyn cre t'ad shoh dy ghra? Dooyrt Yeesey roo, Ta mee; nagh lhaih shiuish rieau, Magh ass beill oikanyn as cloan er y cheeagh t'ou er gheddyn moylley firrinagh?

verses.name: Matthew 21:17
verses.text: As daag eh ad, as hie eh magh ass yn ard-valley gys Bethany, as ghow eh aaght ayns shen.

verses.name: Matthew 21:18
verses.text: Nish ayns y voghrey, myr v'eh goll reesht gys yn ard-valley, v'eh accryssagh.

verses.name: Matthew 21:19
verses.text: As tra honnick eh billey-figgagh er y raad, haink eh huggey, as cha dooar eh monney er, agh ynrycan duillagyn, as dooyrt eh rish, Nar aase mess erbee ort's veih shoh magh er son dy bragh. As chelleeragh ren y billey-figgagh fioghey ersooyl.

verses.name: Matthew 21:20
verses.text: As tra honnick e ostyllyn shoh, ghow ad yindys, gra, Cre cha leah as ta'n billey figgagh er chreenagh roish?

verses.name: Matthew 21:21
verses.text: Dreggyr Yeesey, as dooyrt eh roo, Dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, My vees shiu credjuagh, as gyn ve fo mee-ourys erbee, nee shiu cha nee ynrycan shoh ta jeant rish y villey-figggagh, agh my jir shiu rish y slieau shoh, Bee er dty scughey, as er dty hilgey ayns y cheayn; bee eh er ny yannoo.

verses.name: Matthew 21:22
verses.text: As cre-erbee nee shiu geearree ayns padjer, lesh credjue, yiow shiu eh.

verses.name: Matthew 21:23
verses.text: As tra v'eh er jeet stiagh ayns y chiamble, haink ny ard-saggyrtyn as shanstyr yn phobble huggey myr v'eh gynsaghey, gra, Cre'n phooar t'ayd's dy yannoo ny reddyn shoh? as quoi hug yn phooar shoh dhyt?

verses.name: Matthew 21:24
verses.text: As dreggyr Yeesey as dooyrt eh roo, Fenym's jiuish un red; as my inshys shiu dou eh, inshym's myrgeddin diuish, cre'n phooar t'aym dy yannoo ny reddyn shoh.

verses.name: Matthew 21:25
verses.text: Bashtey Ean, cre voish ve? veih niau, ny veih deiney? As loayr ad nyn mast' oc hene, gra, My jir mayd, Veih niau; jir eshyn rooin, Cre'n-fa eisht nagh chred shiu eh?

verses.name: Matthew 21:26
verses.text: Agh my jir mayd, Veih deiney; ta aggle orrin roish y pobble; son ta dy chooilley ghooinney goaill Ean son phadeyr.

verses.name: Matthew 21:27
verses.text: As dreggyr ad Yeesey, as dooyrt ad, Cha vod mayd ginsh. As dooyrt eh roo, Chamoo ta mish ginsh diuish, cre'n phooar t'aym, dy yannoo ny reddyn shoh.

verses.name: Matthew 21:28
verses.text: Agh cre ta shiu dy smooinaghtyn? Va dooinney dy row as daa vac echey, as haink eh gys yn er-shinney, as dooyrt eh, Vac, Immee as obbree jiu ayns my gharey-feeyney.

verses.name: Matthew 21:29
verses.text: Dreggyr eshyn as dooyrt eh, Cha jem: agh ny lurg shen ghow eh arrys, as hie eh.

verses.name: Matthew 21:30
verses.text: As haink eh gys e vac saa, as loayr eh rish myrgeddin. As dreggyr eshyn, as dooyrt eh, Hem, vainshter; as cha jagh eh.

verses.name: Matthew 21:31
verses.text: Quoi jeu shoh ny-neesht ren aigney e ayrey? Dooyrt adsyn rish, Yn mac shinney. Dooyrt Yeesey roo, Dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, dy jed ny publicanee as ny drogh. vraane stiagh ayns reeriaght Yee reue-ish.

verses.name: Matthew 21:32
verses.text: Son haink Ean hiuish ayns raad y chairys, as cha chred shiu eh: agh chred ny publicanee as ny drogh-vraane eh. As ga dy vaik shiu shoh, cha ghow shiu arrys ny lurg shen, dy chredjal ayn.

verses.name: Matthew 21:33
verses.text: Eaisht-jee rish coraa-dorraghey elley: Va fer-thie dy row ren garey-feeyney y hoiaghey, as ren eh cleigh y yannoo mysh, as chleiy eh press-feeyney ayn, as hrog eh toor, as hoie eh eh rish tannys, as hie eh gys cheer foddey.

verses.name: Matthew 21:34
verses.text: As tra va earish ny mess tayrn er-gerrey, hug eh e ir-vooinjerey gys y tannys, dy gheddyn jeh'n mess echey.

verses.name: Matthew 21:35
verses.text: As ghow yn tannys e ir-vooinjerey, as woaill ad fer, as varr ad fer elley, as chlagh ad fer elley.

verses.name: Matthew 21:36
verses.text: Reesht hug eh magh sharvaantyn elley ny s'lhee na'n chied eallagh: as ghell ad roosyn er yn aght cheddin.

verses.name: Matthew 21:37
verses.text: Agh er-jerrey ooilley hug eh huc e vac, gra, Bee ad arrymagh da my vac.

verses.name: Matthew 21:38
verses.text: Agh tra honnick y tannys yn mac dooyrt ad nyn mast' oc hene, Shoh'n eirey, tar-jee, lhig dooin eh y varroo, as bee'n eiraght echey lhien hene.

verses.name: Matthew 21:39
verses.text: As ghow ad eh, as hilg ad eh magh ass y gharey-feeyney, as varr ad eh.

verses.name: Matthew 21:40
verses.text: Tra hig er-y-fa shen Chiarn y gharey-feeyney, Cre nee eh rish yn tannys shen?

verses.name: Matthew 21:41
verses.text: Dooyrt adsyn rish, Stroie-ee eh fegooish myghin ny drogh-gheiney shen, as nee eh soiaghey yn garey-feeyney rish tannys elley, livrey-ys ny messyn da ayns nyn imbagh cooie.

verses.name: Matthew 21:42
verses.text: Dooyrt Yeesey roo, Nagh lhaih shiu rieau ayns goo Yee, Yn chlagh ren ny masoonee y vee-lowal, ta'n chlagh cheddin er jeet dy ve yn ard-chlagh chorneilagh: shoh jannoo yn Chiarn, as te yindyssagh ayns ny sooillyn ainyn?

verses.name: Matthew 21:43
verses.text: Shen-y-fa ta mish gra riu, Dy bee reeriaght Yee er ny ghoaill veue-ish, as er ny choyrt da ashoon ymmyrkys magh yn mess echey.

verses.name: Matthew 21:44
verses.text: As quoi-erbee huittys er y chlagh shen bee eh er ny vroo: agh er quoi-erbee huittys y chlagh shen, nee ee cha meen as joan jeh.

verses.name: Matthew 21:45
verses.text: As tra va ny ard-saggyrtyn as ny Phariseeyn erreish ny coraaghyn-dorraghey echey y chlashtyn, dennee ad dy nee jeusyn v'eh loayrt.

verses.name: Matthew 21:46
verses.text: Agh tra v'ad shleeuit er goaill eh v'ad ayns aggle roish y pobble, er-yn-oyr dy row ad jeeaghyn er dy ve ny adeyr.

verses.name: Matthew 22:1
verses.text: As dreggyr Yeesey, as loayr eh roo reesht liorish coraaghyn-dorraghey, gra,

verses.name: Matthew 22:2
verses.text: Ta reeriaght Yee er ny hoylaghey gys ree dy row, ren bannish son e vac

verses.name: Matthew 22:3
verses.text: As hug eh magh e harvaantyn dy eamagh orroosyn va cuirt gys y vannish: as cha balliu cheet.

verses.name: Matthew 22:4
verses.text: Reesht hug eh magh sharvaantyn elley, gra, Abbyr-jee roosyn ta cuirt, Cur-my-ner ta mee er n'aarlaghey my yinnair: ta my ghew as my veiyn beiyht marroo, as dy chooilley nhee ullee; tar-jee gys y vannish.

verses.name: Matthew 22:5
verses.text: Agh hoie adsyn beg jeh as hie ad rhymboo, fer gys e state-hallooin, as fer elley gys e varchantys

verses.name: Matthew 22:6
verses.text: As ghow yn chooid elley ny sharvaantyn echey, as ghell ad dy elgyssagh roo, as varr ad ad.

verses.name: Matthew 22:7
verses.text: Agh tra cheayll y ree jeh v'eh feer chorree: as hug eh magh e heshaghtyn caggee, as stroie eh ny dunveryn shen, as losht eh yn ard-valley oc.

verses.name: Matthew 22:8
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt eh rish e harvaantyn, Ta'n vannish aarloo, agh y vooinjer va cuirt cha row ad feeu.

verses.name: Matthew 22:9
verses.text: Gow-jee magh er-y-fa shen gys ny raaidyn mooarey, as whilleen as yiow shiu, cuir-jee gys y vannish.

verses.name: Matthew 22:10
verses.text: As hie ny sharvaantyn shen magh gys ny raaidyn-mooarey, as ren ad whilleen as haink nyn raad y haglym cooidjagh, chammah sie as mie: as va thie ny banshey er ny lhieeney lesh goaldee.

verses.name: Matthew 22:11
verses.text: As tra haink y ree stiagh dy akin ny goaldee, honnick eh dooinney ayns shen nagh row garmad-banshey er:

verses.name: Matthew 22:12
verses.text: As dooyrt eh rish, Heshey vie, kys haink uss stiagh ayns shoh, fegooish garmad-banshey? As cha row fockle echey dy ghra.

verses.name: Matthew 22:13
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt y ree rish ny sharvaantyn, Kiangle-jee eh laue as cass, as gow-jee eh ersooyl, as tilg-jee eh ayns y dorraghys sodjey-mooie: shen-y-raad vees keayney as snaggeraght feeacklyn.

verses.name: Matthew 22:14
verses.text: Son shimmey t'er nyn eam, agh s'tiark t'er nyn reih.

verses.name: Matthew 22:15
verses.text: Eisht hie ny Phariseeyn, as hug ad nyn goyrle dy cheilley, kys dy ghoaill vondeish er ayns e ghoan.

verses.name: Matthew 22:16
verses.text: As hug ad magh huggey shiartanse jeusyn v'ad hene er n'ynsaghey marish ny Herodianee, gra, Vainshter, ta fys ain dy vel oo firrinagh, as dy vel oo gynsaghey raad Yee syn ynrickys, chamoo t'ou ayns aggle roish dooinney erbee: son cha vel oo soiaghey jeh persoon deiney.

verses.name: Matthew 22:17
verses.text: Insh dooin er-y-fa shen, Cre t'ou uss smooinaghtyn, Vel eh lowal keesh y eeck da Cesar mannagh vel?

verses.name: Matthew 22:18
verses.text: Agh dennee Yeesey yn foalsaght oc, as dooyrt eh, Cre'n-fa ta shiu shirrey vondeish y ghoaill orrym, shiuish chrauee-oalsey?

verses.name: Matthew 22:19
verses.text: Jeeagh-jee dou argid y cheesh: as yeeagh ad ping da.

verses.name: Matthew 22:20
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Quoi ta'n jalloo as y screeu shoh cowraghey?

verses.name: Matthew 22:21
verses.text: Dooyrt adsyn rish, Cesar. Eisht dooyrt eh roo, Eeck-jee er-y-fa shen da Cesar shen ny ta lesh Cesar: as da Jee, shen ny ta lesh Jee.

verses.name: Matthew 22:22
verses.text: Tra cheayll ad shoh ghow ad yindys as daag ad eh, as hie ad rhymboo.

verses.name: Matthew 22:23
verses.text: Yn laa cheddin haink huggey ny Sadduceeyn, ta gra, Nagh vel irree-seose reesht veih ny merriu dy ve ayn, as denee ad jeh

verses.name: Matthew 22:24
verses.text: Gra, Vainshter, ta Moses er ghra, My ta dooinney geddyn baase gyn cloan, dy vel e vraar dy phoosey yn ven echey, as dy hroggal seose sluight gys e vraar.

verses.name: Matthew 22:25
verses.text: Nish va ny mast' ain shiaght braaraghyn, as phoose y braar shinney, as geddyn baase gyn cloan, daag eh e ven da e nah vraar.

verses.name: Matthew 22:26
verses.text: As hooar y nah vraar myrgeddin baase as y trass, gys y chiaghtoo.

verses.name: Matthew 22:27
verses.text: As er-jerrey ooilley hooar y ven baase myrgeddin.

verses.name: Matthew 22:28
verses.text: Shen-y-fa ec yn irree-reesht, quoi jeh'n chiaght vees ee echey son ben, son v'ee poost roo ooilley.

verses.name: Matthew 22:29
verses.text: Dreggyr Yeesey as dooyrt eh roo, Ta shiu fo marranys, as cha vel toiggal eu jeh goo ny jeh pooar Yee.

verses.name: Matthew 22:30
verses.text: Son ec yn irree-reesht, cha vel ad poosey, ny er nyn goyrt ayns poosey; agh t'ad myr ainleyn Yee t'ayns niau.

verses.name: Matthew 22:31
verses.text: Agh mychione irree-reesht ny merriu, nagh vel shiu er lhaih shen va loayrit riu liorish Jee, gra,

verses.name: Matthew 22:32
verses.text: Mish Jee Abraham, as Jee Isaac, as Jee Yacob? cha vel Jee Jee ny merriu, agh Jee ny bioee.

verses.name: Matthew 22:33
verses.text: As tra cheayll y pobble shoh, ghow ad yindys jeh'n ynsaghey echey.

verses.name: Matthew 22:34
verses.text: Agh tra va ny Phariseeyn er chlashtyn dy row eh er chur ny Sadduceeyn nyn dhost, v'ad er nyn jaglym cooidjagh.

verses.name: Matthew 22:35
verses.text: As denee fer jeu ard-ynsit 'sy leigh, question jeh, dy phrowal eh, gra,

verses.name: Matthew 22:36
verses.text: Vainshter, cre yn ard-anney ayns y leigh?

verses.name: Matthew 22:37
verses.text: Dooyrt Yeesey rish, Ver oo graih da'n Chiarn dty Yee lesh ooilley dty chree as lesh ooilley dty annym, as lesh ooilley dt'aigney.

verses.name: Matthew 22:38
verses.text: Shoh yn chied as yn ard-anney.

verses.name: Matthew 22:39
verses.text: As ta'n nah anney casley rish, Ver oo graih da dty nahoo myr dhyt hene.

verses.name: Matthew 22:40
verses.text: Yn daa anney shoh bun y leigh as ny phadeyryn.

verses.name: Matthew 22:41
verses.text: Choud as va ny Phariseeyn er nyn jaglym cooidjagh, denee Yeesey jeu,

verses.name: Matthew 22:42
verses.text: Gra, Cre ta nyn smooinaghtyn my chione Creest? quoi da mac eh? Dooyrt adsyn rish, Mac Ghavid.

verses.name: Matthew 22:43
verses.text: Dooyrt eshyn roo, Kys eisht dy vel David liorish yn spyrryd genmys eh ny Hiarn, gra,

verses.name: Matthew 22:44
verses.text: Dooyrt y Chiarn rish my Hiarn's, Soie uss er my laue yesh, derrey neem's dty noidyn stoyl dty choshey?

verses.name: Matthew 22:45
verses.text: My ta David eisht genmys eh ny Hiarn, kys t'eh yn mac echey?

verses.name: Matthew 22:46
verses.text: As cha row dooinney ny vod oc son ansoor y chur da, chamoo by-lhoys da fer erbee jeu (veih'n laa shen magh) question erbee sodjey y chur huggey.

verses.name: Matthew 23:1
verses.text: Eisht loayr Yeesey rish y pobble, as rish e ostyllyn,

verses.name: Matthew 23:2
verses.text: Gra, Ta ny scrudeyryn as ny Phariseeyn nyn soie ayns stoyl Voses.

verses.name: Matthew 23:3
verses.text: Ooilley er-y-fa shen cre-er-bee nee ad y oardaghey diu dy reayll, freill-jee, as jean-jee eh; agh ny jean-jee lurg ny obbraghyn oc: son t'ad gra, agh cha vel ad jannoo.

verses.name: Matthew 23:4
verses.text: Son t'ad kiangley erraghyn tromey as doillee dy ve er nyn ymmyrkey, as dyn goyrt ad er geayltyn deiney, agh cha lhie ad hene wheesh mair roo dy hroggal ad.

verses.name: Matthew 23:5
verses.text: Agh ooilley nyn obbraghyn t'ad dy yannoo dy ve cronnit liorish deiney: t'ad jannoo lhean ny phylactereeyn oc, as ceau chemmallyn mooarey er nyn gharmadyn,

verses.name: Matthew 23:6
verses.text: As shynney lhieu ny ard ynnydyn-soie ec cuirraghyn, as ny ard-stuill ayns ny synagogueyn,

verses.name: Matthew 23:7
verses.text: As sleih dy vannaghey daue ayns ny margaghyn, as dy ve enmyssit liorish deiney, Rabbi, Rabbi.

verses.name: Matthew 23:8
verses.text: Agh ny bee-jee shiuish enmyssit Rabbi: son ta un vainshter eu, ta shen dy ghra, Creest, as ta shiuish ooilley nyn mraaraghyn.

verses.name: Matthew 23:9
verses.text: As ny enmys-jee dooinney erbee ny mast' eu, Yn ayr: son ta un er ynrycan nyn Ayr, eer eh t'ayns niau.

verses.name: Matthew 23:10
verses.text: Chamoo gow-jee erriu dy ve mainshteryn, son ta un er nyn Mainshter, eer Creest.

verses.name: Matthew 23:11
verses.text: Agh eshyn syrjey ta nyn mast' eu, bee eh nyn shirveishagh.

verses.name: Matthew 23:12
verses.text: Son quoi-erbee ta dy mooaralagh soiaghey seose eh-hene, bee eh er ny injillaghey, agh eshyn ta dy injillaghey eh-hene, bee eh er ny hoiaghey seose.

verses.name: Matthew 23:13
verses.text: Agh smerg diuish scrudeyryn as Phariseeyn, chrauee oalsey; son ta shiu dooney seose reeriaght niau noi deiney: cha vel shiu goll stiagh shiu hene, as ta shiu dyn lhiettal adsyn ta aggindagh er goll stiagh.

verses.name: Matthew 23:14
verses.text: Smerg diu scrudeyryn as Phariseeyn, chrauee-oalsey; son ta shiu cleiy fo thieyn mraane-treoghe, as son scaa dy chraueeaght lhiggey erriu dy ve kinjagh ayns padjer: shen-y-fa ta kerraghey strimmey nyn gour.

verses.name: Matthew 23:15
verses.text: Smerg diu scrudeyryn as Phariseeyn, chrauee-oalsey; son ta shiu goll mygeayrt keayn as thalloo, dy hayrn agh un yoarree gys y chredjue eu hene, as tra t'eh er jyndaa hiu, ta shiu dy yannoo eh ny lhiannoo dy niurin ghaa wheesh smessey na shiu hene.

verses.name: Matthew 23:16
verses.text: Smerg diu leeideilee doal, ta gra, Quoi-erbee looys liorish y chiamble, nagh vel eh veg: agh quoi-erbee looys liorish airh y chiamble, t'eh kianlt gys e vreearrey.

verses.name: Matthew 23:17
verses.text: O shiuish vee-cheeayllee as doail: son quoi s'ooasle ta, yn airh, ny'n chiamble ta casherickey yn airh.

verses.name: Matthew 23:18
verses.text: As quoi-erbee looys liorish yn altar, nagh vel eh veg: agh quoi-erbee looys liorish y gioot t'er yn altar, t'eh kianlt gys e vreearrey.

verses.name: Matthew 23:19
verses.text: O shiuish vee-cheayllee as doail: son quoi s'ooasle ta yn gioot, ny'n altar ta casherickey'n gioot?

verses.name: Matthew 23:20
verses.text: Quoi-erbee er-y-fa shen looys liorish yn altar, t'eh loo liorish yn altar hene, as liorish dy chooilley nhee ta chebbit er.

verses.name: Matthew 23:21
verses.text: As quoi-erbee looys liorish y chiamble, t'eh loo liorish y chiamble, as liorishyn ta cummal ayn.

verses.name: Matthew 23:22
verses.text: As eshyn looys liorish niau, t'eh loo liorish stoyl-reeoil Yee, as liorishyn ta ny hoie er.

verses.name: Matthew 23:23
verses.text: Smerg diu scrudeyryn as Phariseeyn, chrauee-oalsey; son ta shiu geeck jaghee jeh mynthey, anise as cummin, agh cha vel shiu er chooilleeney currymyn s'ymmyrchee yn leigh, cairys, myghin as firrinys: ad shoh lhisagh shiu v'er n'yannoo, fegooish y chooid elley y aagail gyn jannoo.

verses.name: Matthew 23:24
verses.text: Shiuish leeideilee doal, ta sheeley veue yn char-chuilag, agh sluggee shiu camel.

verses.name: Matthew 23:25
verses.text: Smerg diu scrudeyryn as Phariseeyn, chrauee-oalsey: son ta shiu glenney yn cappan as y claare er cheu-mooie, agh cheu sthie t'ad lane dy hranlaase as dy neu-heeltys.

verses.name: Matthew 23:26
verses.text: Pharisee ghoal, glen hoshiaght cheu-sthie yn chappan as y chlaare, dy vod y cheu-mooie ve glen myrgeddin

verses.name: Matthew 23:27
verses.text: Smerg diu scrudeyryn as Phariseeyn, chrauee-oalsey; son ta shiu goll-rish oaiagh yn t'er nyn ghiallaghey, ta dy jarroo jeeaghyn aalin er cheu-mooie, agh cheu-sthie t'ad lane dy chraueyn ny merriu, as jeh dy chooilley eajeeys.

verses.name: Matthew 23:28
verses.text: Shen myr ta shiuish neesht er cheu-mooie cairagh ayns shilley deiney, agh cheu-sthie ta shiu lane dy chraueeaght-oalsey as dy vee-chairys.

verses.name: Matthew 23:29
verses.text: Smerg diu scrudeyryn as Phariseeyn, chrauee oalsey, son dy vel shiu troggal oaiaghyn ny phadeyryn, as soiaghey magh lhiaghtyn ny deiney cairagh.

verses.name: Matthew 23:30
verses.text: As gra, Dy beagh shinyn er ve ayns laghyn nyn ayraghyn, cha beagh shin er ve nyn baarteeasyn maroosyn ayns fuill ny phadeyryn.

verses.name: Matthew 23:31
verses.text: Shen-y-fa ta shiu nyn veanishyn noi eu hene, ny nee shiuish yn sluight ocsyn hug ny phadeyryn dy baase.

verses.name: Matthew 23:32
verses.text: Lhieen-jee seose eisht towse nyn ayraghyn.

verses.name: Matthew 23:33
verses.text: Shiuish ard-nieughyn, sheeloghe dy ard-nieughyn, kys oddys shiu kerraghey niurin y scapail?

verses.name: Matthew 23:34
verses.text: Shen-y-fa, cur-my-ner, ta mish coyrt hiu phadeyryn, as deiney creeney, as scrudeyryn; as paart jeu nee shiu y varroo, as y chrossey, as paart jeu nee shiu y scuitchal ayns nyn guaiylyn, as geiyrt ad veih ard-valley gys ard-valley:

verses.name: Matthew 23:35
verses.text: Dy vod ooilley yn uill chairagh hie er deayrtey er y thalloo tuittym erriu, veih fuilt Abel cairagh, gys fuill Zecharias, mac Varachias, eh ren shiu y varroo eddyr y chiamble as yn altar.

verses.name: Matthew 23:36
verses.text: Dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, Dy jig dy-chooilley nhee jeu shoh er y cheeloghe shoh.

verses.name: Matthew 23:37
verses.text: O Yerusalem, Yerusalem, uss ta cur dy baase ny phadeyryn, as claghey adsyn t'er nyn goyrt er chaghteraght hood, cre cha mennick as va mish aggindagh v'er haglym dty chloan cooidjagh, myr ta kiark goaill stiagh e hein, fo my skianyn, as cha jinnagh shiu!

verses.name: Matthew 23:38
verses.text: Cur-my-ner, ta'n thie eu faagit diu follym-faase.

verses.name: Matthew 23:39
verses.text: Son ta mee gra riu, Nagh vaik shiu mish maghey shoh, derrey jirrys shiu, Bannit ta eshyn ta cheet ayns ennym y Chiarn.

verses.name: Matthew 24:1
verses.text: As hie Yeesey magh as jimmee eh veih'n chiamble; as haink e ostyllyn huggey dy ghoaill baght marish jeh aalid y chiamble.

verses.name: Matthew 24:2
verses.text: As dooyrt Yeesey roo, Nagh vaik shiu ooilley ny reddyn shoh? dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, Nagh bee faagit un chlagh er clagh elley, nagh bee er ny lhieggal.

verses.name: Matthew 24:3
verses.text: As myr v'eh ny hoie er cronk ny Oliveyn, haink e ostyllyn huggey er-lheh, gra, Insh dooin, cuin vees ny reddyn shoh? as cre'n cowrey vees jeh'n cheet ayd, as jeh jerrey yn theihll?

verses.name: Matthew 24:4
verses.text: As dreggyr Yeesey as dooyrt eh roo, Cur-jee twoaie nagh moll dooinney erbee shiu.

verses.name: Matthew 24:5
verses.text: Son hig ymmodee ayns my ennym's, gra, Mish yn Creest: as nee ad ymmodee y volley.

verses.name: Matthew 24:6
verses.text: As cluinnee shiu jeh caggaghyn, as jeh imraaghyn dy chaggaghyn: jeeagh nagh bee shiu seaghnit: son shegin da dy chooilley nhee jeu shoh cheet gys kione, agh cha bee yn jerrey foast.

verses.name: Matthew 24:7
verses.text: Son nee ashoon girree-magh noi ashoon, as reeriaght noi reeriaght: as bee gennaghyn as crampyn, as craaghyn-thallooin ayns ymmodee ynnydyn.

verses.name: Matthew 24:8
verses.text: Bee ooilley shoh toshiaght seaghyn diu.

verses.name: Matthew 24:9
verses.text: Eisht livreyee ad shiu seose dy ve seaghnit, as marree ad shiu: as bee dy chooilley ashoon dwoaiagh erriu er coontey yn ennym aym's.

verses.name: Matthew 24:10
verses.text: As eisht nee ymmodee scarrey rish nyn gredjue, as brahee ad, as ver ad feoh yn derrey yeh da'n jeh elley.

verses.name: Matthew 24:11
verses.text: As nee ymmodee phadeyryn-foalsey girree seose, as mooarane y volley.

verses.name: Matthew 24:12
verses.text: As er-yn-oyr dy jean olkys bishaghey, nee graih-ghiastyllagh ymmodee feayraghey.

verses.name: Matthew 24:13
verses.text: Agh bee eshyn, nee tannaghtyn firrinagh gys y jerrey, er ny hauail.

verses.name: Matthew 24:14
verses.text: As bee sushtal yn reeriaght er ny phreacheil ayns ooilley yn seihll, son feanish da dy chooilley ashoon, as eisht nee yn jerrey cheet.

verses.name: Matthew 24:15
verses.text: Tra hee shiu er-y-fa shen eajeeys yn traartys, ta loayrit jeh liorish Daniel y phadeyr, ny hassoo ayns yn ynnyd casherick, (eshyn ta lhaih, lhig da tastey 'ghoaill).

verses.name: Matthew 24:16
verses.text: Eisht lhig dauesyn t'ayns Judea chea gys ny sleityn.

verses.name: Matthew 24:17
verses.text: Eshyn t'er mullagh y thie, ny lhig da cheet neose dy ghoaill marish nhee erbee ass e hie:

verses.name: Matthew 24:18
verses.text: As ny lhig dasyn t'ayns y vagher chyndaa back, dy chur lesh e eaddagh.

verses.name: Matthew 24:19
verses.text: As smerg dauesyn ta torragh, as dauesyn ta cur keeagh ayns ny laghyn shen.

verses.name: Matthew 24:20
verses.text: Agh guee-jee shiuish nagh bee shiu eginit dy hea ayns y gheurey, ny er y doonaght.

verses.name: Matthew 24:21
verses.text: Son bee seaghyn mooar ec y traa shen, lheid as nagh row er-dy hoshiaght y theihll gys y traa t'ayn nish, as lheid as nagh bee dy bragh arragh.

verses.name: Matthew 24:22
verses.text: As mannagh beagh ny laghyn shen dy leah harrish, cha beagh dooinney bio er ny hauail: agh er graih yn chloan reiht, bee ny laghyn shen dy leah harrish.

verses.name: Matthew 24:23
verses.text: Eisht my jir dooinney erbee riu, Cur my-ner, ta Creest ayns shoh, ny ayns shid; ny cred-jee eh.

verses.name: Matthew 24:24
verses.text: Son nee Creestyn foalsey, as phadeyryn foalsey girree, as cowraghyn mooarey as yindyssyn y hoilshaghey, ayns wheesh (my oddagh eh ve) dy jinnagh ad molley yn eer chloan reiht.

verses.name: Matthew 24:25
verses.text: Cur-my-ner, ta mish er n'insh diu ro laue.

verses.name: Matthew 24:26
verses.text: Shen-y-fa my jir ad riu, T'eh ayns yn aasagh, ny gow-jee magh: cur-my-ner, t'eh ayns ny shamyryn follit, ny cred-jee eh.

verses.name: Matthew 24:27
verses.text: Son myr ta'n tendreil cheet ass y shiar, as cur soilshey choud as gys y sheear: myr shen neesht vees cheet Mac y dooinney.

verses.name: Matthew 24:28
verses.text: Son cre-erbee yn raad vees yn convayrt, shen y raad bee ny urlee er nyn jaglym cooidjagh.

verses.name: Matthew 24:29
verses.text: Chelleeragh lurg seaghyn ny laghyn shen, hig dorraghys er y ghrian, as cha der yn eayst e soilshey, as tuittee rollageyn yn aer, as bee pooaraghyn yn aer er nyn graa.

verses.name: Matthew 24:30
verses.text: As eisht bee cowrey Mac y dooinney er ny akin ayns yn aer as ec y traa shen nee ooilley sheelogheyn y thallooin dobberan, as hee ad yn Mac dooinney cheet ayns bodjallyn yn aer, lesh pooar as gloyr vooar.

verses.name: Matthew 24:31
verses.text: As ver eh magh e ainleyn lesh yn trumpet dy ard-choraa, as nee ad e chloan reiht y haglym cooidjagh veih ny kiare geayghyn, veih'n derrey ard fo'n aer gys yn ard elley.

verses.name: Matthew 24:32
verses.text: Ynsee-jee eisht coraa-dorraghey veih'n villey-figgagh: tra ta'n banglane echey foast oor, as cur magh duillagyn, ta fys eu dy vel y sourey er-gerrey.

verses.name: Matthew 24:33
verses.text: Er yn aght cheddin shiuish, tra hee shiu ooilley ny reddyn shoh, toig-jee dy vel eh er-gerrey, dy jarroo ec ny dorryssyn.

verses.name: Matthew 24:34
verses.text: Dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, Cha bee yn cheeloghe shoh harrish, derrey vees dy chooilley nhee jeu shoh cooilleenit.

verses.name: Matthew 24:35
verses.text: Nee yn aer as yn ooir cherraghtyn, agh my ghoan's cha jean cherraghtyn.

verses.name: Matthew 24:36
verses.text: Agh er y laa as yn oor shen, cha vel fys ec dooinney erbee, cha vel ec ainleyn niau, agh ec my Ayr ny-lomarcan.

verses.name: Matthew 24:37
verses.text: Agh myr va laghyn Noe, myr shen myrgeddin vees cheet Mac y dooinney.

verses.name: Matthew 24:38
verses.text: Son myr ayns ny laghyn va roish y thooilley, v'ad gee as giu, poosey as coyrt ayns poosey, derrey yn laa hie Noe stiagh ayns yn arg,

verses.name: Matthew 24:39
verses.text: As cha dug ad tastey, derrey haink y thooilley as ghow eh ad ooilley ersooyl; myr shen myrgeddin vees cheet Mac y dooinney.

verses.name: Matthew 24:40
verses.text: Shen y traa vees daa ghooinney ayns y vagher, bee fer goit as fer faagit.

verses.name: Matthew 24:41
verses.text: Bee daa ven blieh ec y wyllin, yn derrey yeh goit, as y jeh elley faagit.

verses.name: Matthew 24:42
verses.text: Shen-y-fa bee-jee er nyn arrey, son cha vel fys eu er yn oor tra hig nyn Jiarn.

verses.name: Matthew 24:43
verses.text: Agh shoh toig-jee, dy beagh fys er ve ec mainshter y thie cre'n oor veagh y maarliagh er jeet, veagh eh er e arrey, as cha beagh eh er lhiggey da brishey stiagh er hie.

verses.name: Matthew 24:44
verses.text: Shen-y-fa bee-jee shiuish myrgeddin ullee: son ec lheid yn oor as nagh vel shiu smooinaghtyn er, hig yn Mac dooinney.

verses.name: Matthew 24:45
verses.text: Quoi eisht yn charvaant firrinagh as creeney shen, ta e Hiarn er n'yannoo ny er reill er e vooinjer, dy chur daue nyn meaghey ayns traa cooie?

verses.name: Matthew 24:46
verses.text: Bannit ta'n charvaant cheddin. yiow e Hiarn, tra hig eh, jannoo myr shen.

verses.name: Matthew 24:47
verses.text: Dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, dy livreyee eh gys y churrym echeysyn ooilley e chooid.

verses.name: Matthew 24:48
verses.text: Agh my jir y drogh-harvaant shen ayns e chree, Ta my Hiarn lhiggey shaghey yn cheet echey,

verses.name: Matthew 24:49
verses.text: As toshiaght y yannoo dy woalley e heshaghyn-sharvaant, as dy ee as dy iu marish ny meshtallee.

verses.name: Matthew 24:50
verses.text: Hig Chiarn y charvaant shen ec laa nagh bee eh jeeaghyn er e hon, as ayns oor nagh bee eh twoaiagh jeh;

verses.name: Matthew 24:51
verses.text: As giaree eh eh veih-my-cheilley, as pointee eh e chronney marish ny crauee oalsey: ayns shen vees keayney as snaggeraght feeacklyn.

verses.name: Matthew 25:1
verses.text: Eisht bee reeriaght niau er ny hoylaghey gys jeih moidynyn, ghow ny lampyn oc, as hie magh quail y dooinney poosee.

verses.name: Matthew 25:2
verses.text: As va queig jeu creeney, as queig ommijagh.

verses.name: Matthew 25:3
verses.text: Hug adsyn va ommijagh lhieu ny lampyn oc, agh cha dug ad lhieu ooil maroo:

verses.name: Matthew 25:4
verses.text: Agh hug y vooinjer chreeney lhieu ooil ayns ny siyn oc marish nyn lampyn.

verses.name: Matthew 25:5
verses.text: Choud as v'ad fieau er y dooinney poosee, huitt ad ooilley er saveenagh as cadley.

verses.name: Matthew 25:6
verses.text: As ec main-oie va eam er ny choyrt, Cur-my-ner ta'n dooinney-poosee cheet, gow-jee magh ny whail.

verses.name: Matthew 25:7
verses.text: Eisht dirree ooilley ny moidynyn shen, as hooar ad aarloo nyn lampyn.

verses.name: Matthew 25:8
verses.text: As dooyrt y vooinjer ommijagh rish y vooinjer chreeney, Cur-jee dooinyn jeh'n ooil euish, son ta ny lampyn ain goll ass.

verses.name: Matthew 25:9
verses.text: Agh dreggyr y vooinjer chreeney, gra, Cha der; er-aggle nagh bee dy liooar ain dooin hene as diuish neesht: share diu roie hucsyn ta creck, as kionnaghey diu hene.

verses.name: Matthew 25:10
verses.text: As choud as v'ad goll dy chionnaghey haink y dooinney-poosee, as hie yn vooinjer va aarloo stiagh marish gys y vannish, as va'n dorrys jeight.

verses.name: Matthew 25:11
verses.text: Ny lurg shen haink ny moidynyn elley gra, Hiarn, Hiarn, foshil dooin.

verses.name: Matthew 25:12
verses.text: Agh dreggyr eshyn as dooyrt eh, Dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, nagh voddym goaill riu.

verses.name: Matthew 25:13
verses.text: Bee-jee er nyn dwoaie er-y-fa shen son cha vel fys eu er y laa ny'n oor, nee Mac y dooinney cheet.

verses.name: Matthew 25:14
verses.text: Son ta reeriaght niau myr dooinney va mysh goaill jurnah gys cheer foddey, deie er e harvaantyn hene, as livrey eh daue e chooid:

verses.name: Matthew 25:15
verses.text: As da fer hug eh queig talentyn, da fer elley jees, as da fer elley unnane, da dy chooilley ghooinney rere roshtyn e hushtey, as chelleeragh ghow eh e yurnah.

verses.name: Matthew 25:16
verses.text: Eisht hie yn fer v'er gheddyn ny queig talentyn, as ren eh dellal lhieu, as chossyn eh queig talentyn elley.

verses.name: Matthew 25:17
verses.text: As myrgeddin eshyn v'er gheddyn jees, chossyn eh neesht jees elley.

verses.name: Matthew 25:18
verses.text: Agh eshyn va lesh yn un talent, hie eh as chleiy eh ayns y thalloo, as dollee eh argid e hiarn.

verses.name: Matthew 25:19
verses.text: Agh lurg foddey dy hraa haink chiarn ny sharvaantyn shen, as ren eh coontey roo.

verses.name: Matthew 25:20
verses.text: As haink eshyn v'er gheddyn ny queig talentyn, as hug eh lesh queig talentyn elley, gra, Hiarn, livrey uss dooys queig talentyn: cur-my-ner, ta mee er chosney queig talentyn elley lhieu.

verses.name: Matthew 25:21
verses.text: Dooyrt e hiarn rish, S'mie t'ou er n'yannoo, harvaant vie as firrinagh; t'ou er ny ve firrinagh ayns y veggan, livrey-yms mooarane gys dty churrym: immee uss stiagh gys boggey dty hiarn.

verses.name: Matthew 25:22
verses.text: Haink eshyn myrgeddin v'er gheddyn yn daa halent, as dooyrt eh, Hiarn, livrey uss dooys daa halent: cur-my-ner, ta mee er chosney daa halent elley lhieu.

verses.name: Matthew 25:23
verses.text: Dooyrt e hiarn rish, S'mie t'ou er n'yannoo, harvaant vie as firrinagh: t'ou er ny ve firrinagh ayns y veggan, livrey-yms mooarane gys dty churrym: immee uss stiagh gys boggey dty hiarn.

verses.name: Matthew 25:24
verses.text: Agh y fer v'er gheddyn yn un talent haink eh, as dooyrt eh, Hiarn, va fys aym's dy nee dooinney creoi oo; buinn raad nagh ren oo cuirr, as chaglym raad nagh ren oo skeayley.

verses.name: Matthew 25:25
verses.text: As ghow mee aggle, as hie mee as dollee mee dty halent ayns y thalloo: jeeagh, shoh dhyt dty chooid hene.

verses.name: Matthew 25:26
verses.text: Dreggyr e hiarn, as dooyrt eh rish, Harvaant vee-chairagh as neu-harroogh, va fys ayd's dy row mish buinn raad nagh ren mee cuirr, as chaglym raad nagh ren mee skeayley.

verses.name: Matthew 25:27
verses.text: Lhisagh oo er-y-fa shen v'er chur my argid magh er-use, as eisht tra harrin, oddin v'er gheddyn my chooid hene lesh bishaghey.

verses.name: Matthew 25:28
verses.text: Gow-jee er-y-fa shen yn talent veihsyn, as cur-jee eh dasyn ta jeih talentyn echey.

verses.name: Matthew 25:29
verses.text: Son da dy chooilley ghooinney ta kuse echey vees er ny choyrt, as yiow eh ny smoo: agh veihsyn nagh vel echey vees er ny ghoaill ersooyl eer shen ny ta echey.

verses.name: Matthew 25:30
verses.text: As tilg-jee yn charvaant neu-harroogh ayns y dorraghys sodjey-mooie: ayns shen vees keayney as snaggeraght feeacklyn.

verses.name: Matthew 25:31
verses.text: Tra hig Mac y dooinney ayns e ghloyr, as ooilley e ainleyn casherick marish, shen y traa hoie-ys eh er stoyl-reeoil e ghloyr.

verses.name: Matthew 25:32
verses.text: As kiongoyrt rish vees dy chooilley ashoon er nyn jaglym; as scarree eh ad veih-my-cheilley, myr ta bochilley scarrey eddyr e chirree as ny goair:

verses.name: Matthew 25:33
verses.text: As soie-ee eh ny kirree er e laue-yesh, agh ny goair er e laue-chiare.

verses.name: Matthew 25:34
verses.text: Eisht jir y ree roosyn er e laue-yesh, Tar-jee chloan vannit my Ayrey, gow-jee eiraght 'sy reeriaght ta kiarit diu er-dy hoshiaght y theihll.

verses.name: Matthew 25:35
verses.text: Son va mee accryssagh, as hug shiu beaghey dou: va mee paagh, as hug shiu jough dou: va mee my yoarree, as ghow shiu stiagh mee:

verses.name: Matthew 25:36
verses.text: Rooisht, as ren shiu m'y choamrey: va mee ching, as haink shiu dy my yeeaghyn: va mee ayns pryssoon, as haink shiu hym.

verses.name: Matthew 25:37
verses.text: Eisht nee'n chloan chairagh eh y reggyrt, gra, Hiarn, cuin honnick shin oo accryssagh, as dy dug shin beaghey dhyt? ny paagh, as dy dug shin jough dhyt?

verses.name: Matthew 25:38
verses.text: Cuin honnick shin oo dty yoarree, as dy-ghow shin stiagh oo? ny rooisht, as dy ren shin dty choamrey?

verses.name: Matthew 25:39
verses.text: Ny cuin honnick shin oo ching, ny ayns pryssoon, as dy daink shin dy dty yeeaghyn?

verses.name: Matthew 25:40
verses.text: As freggyree yn Ree, as jir eh roo, Dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, Ayns wheesh as dy vel shiu er n'yannoo eh son y fer sloo jeu shoh my vraaraghyn, ta shiu er n'yannoo eh er my hon's.

verses.name: Matthew 25:41
verses.text: Eisht jir eh roosyn myrgeddin er y laue-chiare, Immee-jee voym, chloan churstey gys yn aile dy bragh farraghtyn, kiarit son y drogh-spyrryd as e ainleyn.

verses.name: Matthew 25:42
verses.text: Son va mee accryssagh, as cha dug shiu beaghey dou: va mee paagh, as cha dug shiu jough dou:

verses.name: Matthew 25:43
verses.text: Va mee my yoarree, as cha ghow shiu stiagh mee: rooisht, as cha ren shiu m'y choamrey: ching, as ayns pryssoon, as cha daink shiu dy my yeeaghyn.

verses.name: Matthew 25:44
verses.text: Eisht nee adsyn myrgeddin eh y reggyrt, gra, Hiarn, cuin honnick shin oo accryssagh, ny paagh, ny dty yoarree, ny rooisht, ny ching, ny ayns pryssoon, as nagh chooin shin lhiat?

verses.name: Matthew 25:45
verses.text: Eisht nee eh nyn reggyrt, gra, Dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, Ayns wheesh as nagh ren shiu eh son unnane jeh'n vooinjer sloo jeu shoh, cha ren shiu eh er my hon's.

verses.name: Matthew 25:46
verses.text: As hed ad shoh ersooyl gys y kerraghey dy bragh farraghtyn: agh y chloan chairagh gys y vea veayn.

verses.name: Matthew 26:1
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione erreish da Yeesey ve er loayrt ooilley ny goan shoh, dy dooyrt eh rish e ostyllyn,

verses.name: Matthew 26:2
verses.text: Ta fys eu lurg daa laa dy bee feailley ny caisht, as dy bee yn Mac dooinney er ny vrah dy ve er ny chrossey.

verses.name: Matthew 26:3
verses.text: Eisht va ny ard-saggyrtyn as ny scrudeyryn as shanstyr y phobble er nyn jaglym cooidjagh gys thie yn ard-saggyrt va enmyssit Caiaphas.

verses.name: Matthew 26:4
verses.text: As hug ad nyn goyrle dy cheilley, my chione Yeesey y ghoaill dy follit, as dy choyrt eh gy-baase.

verses.name: Matthew 26:5
verses.text: Agh dooyrt ad, Cha nee er laa ny feailley, er-aggle dy bee irree-magh ayn mastey'n pobble.

verses.name: Matthew 26:6
verses.text: Nish tra va Yeesey ayns Bethany, ayns thie Simon yn lourane,

verses.name: Matthew 26:7
verses.text: Haink huggey ben lesh box alabaster dy ooil feer chostal, as gheayrt ee eh er e chione, myr v'eh ny hoie ec bee.

verses.name: Matthew 26:8
verses.text: Agh tra honnick e ostyllyn shoh, v'ad jymmoosagh, gra, Cre'n-fa va'n jummal shoh jeant?

verses.name: Matthew 26:9
verses.text: Son oddagh yn ooil shoh v'er ny ve creckit son mooarane, as er ny choyrt da ny boghtyn.

verses.name: Matthew 26:10
verses.text: Tra hoig Yeesey shoh, dooyrt eh roo, Kys dy vel shiu boirey yn ven? son t'ee er n'yannoo obbyr vie orrym's.

verses.name: Matthew 26:11
verses.text: Son ta ny boghtyn eu kinjagh meriu, agh mish cha vel eu kinjagh.

verses.name: Matthew 26:12
verses.text: Son liorish dy vel ee er gheayrtey yn ooil shoh er n y chorp, t'ee er n'yannoo eh cour my oanluckey.

verses.name: Matthew 26:13
verses.text: Dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, Cre theihll y raad vees yn sushtal shoh er ny phreacheil, dy bee shoh myrgeddin ta'n ven shoh er n'yannoo, er ny imraa ayns cooinaghtyn j'ee.

verses.name: Matthew 26:14
verses.text: Eisht hie fer jeh'n daa ostyl yeig, va enmyssit Yuaase Iscariot, gys ny ard-saggyrtyn.

verses.name: Matthew 26:15
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Cre ver shiu dooys, as livrey-ym diuish eh? As choard ad rish son jeih peeshyn as feed dy argid.

verses.name: Matthew 26:16
verses.text: As veih'n traa shen v'eh shirrey caa dy vrah eh.

verses.name: Matthew 26:17
verses.text: Nish er y chied laa jeh feailley yn arran-caisht, haink e ostyllyn gys Yeesey as dooyrt ad rish, Cre'n raad sailt shin dy yannoo aarloo er dty hon dy ee yn eayn caisht?

verses.name: Matthew 26:18
verses.text: As dooyrt eh, Gow-jee gys yn ard-valley gys lheid y dooinney shen, as abbyr-jee rish, Ta'n mainshter gra, Ta my hraa er gerrey, freill-ym y chaisht ec dty hie's marish my ostyllyn.

verses.name: Matthew 26:19
verses.text: As ren adsyn myr va Yeesey er n'oardaghey daue, as daarlee ad yn eayn-caisht.

verses.name: Matthew 26:20
verses.text: Nish tra va'n fastyr er-jeet, hoie eh sheese marish yn daa ostyl yeig.

verses.name: Matthew 26:21
verses.text: As myr v'ad gee, dooyrt eh, Dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, dy jean fer jiuish mish y vrah.

verses.name: Matthew 26:22
verses.text: As v'ad dy mooar seaghnit, as ren ad toshiaght dagh fer jeu dy ghra rish, Hiarn, nee orrym's t'ou cheet?

verses.name: Matthew 26:23
verses.text: As dansoor eshyn, gra, eshyn ta thummey e laue marym ayns y chlaare, eh shen nee mish y vrah.

verses.name: Matthew 26:24
verses.text: Ta Mac y dooinney goll, myr te scruit jeh: agh smerg da'n dooinney shen liorish vees Mac y dooinney er ny vrah: s'mie veagh eh son y dooinney shen mannagh row eh rieau er jeet er y theihll.

verses.name: Matthew 26:25
verses.text: Eisht dansoor Yuaase, ren y vrah eh, as dooyrt eh, Vainshter, nee mish eh? Dooyrt eshyn rish, T'ou er ghra eh.

verses.name: Matthew 26:26
verses.text: As myr v'ad gee, ghow Yeesey arran as vannee eh as vrish eh eh, as hug eh eh da ny ostyllyn, gra, Gow-jee, ee-jee, shoh my chorp's.

verses.name: Matthew 26:27
verses.text: As ghow eh yn cappan, as hug eh booise, as hug eh eh daue, gra, iu-jee ooilley jeh shoh.

verses.name: Matthew 26:28
verses.text: Son shoh my uill's jeh'n conaant noa, t'er ny gheayrtey son ymmodee son leih peccaghyn.

verses.name: Matthew 26:29
verses.text: Agh ta mee gra riu, Nagh n'iu-ym maghey shoh jeh mess y villey-feeyney, derrey'n laa iu-ym eh ass-y-noa meriu ayns reeriaght my Ayrey.

verses.name: Matthew 26:30
verses.text: As tra v'ad er ghoaill arrane-moyllee hie ad magh gys cronk ny Oliveyn.

verses.name: Matthew 26:31
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt Yeesey roo, Failee yn credjue euish ooilley noght kyndagh rhym's: son te scruit, Bwoaill-ym's yn bochilley, as bee kirree yn chioltane er nyn skeayley.

verses.name: Matthew 26:32
verses.text: Agh erreish dou v'er n'irree reesht, hem reu gys Galilee.

verses.name: Matthew 26:33
verses.text: Dansoor Peddyr as dooyrt eh rish, Ga dy vaill credjue dy chooilley ghooinney kyndagh rhyt's, cha vaill my chredjue's dy bragh.

verses.name: Matthew 26:34
verses.text: Dooyrt Yeesey rish, Dy firrinagh ta mee gra rhyt, Noght hene roish gerrym chellee, dy nob uss mish three keayrtyn.

verses.name: Matthew 26:35
verses.text: Dooyrt Peddyr rish, Dy beign dou goll dy baase mayrt, cha nobbin oo. As er yn aght cheddin loayr ooilley ny ostyllyn.

verses.name: Matthew 26:36
verses.text: Eisht haink Yeesey maroo gys ynnyd va enmyssit Gethsemane, as dooyrt eh rish ny ostyllyn, Soie-jee shiuish ayns shoh, choud as hem's gys padjer 'sy voayl shid.

verses.name: Matthew 26:37
verses.text: As ghow eh marish Peddyr, as daa vac Zebedee, as ren eh toshiaght dy ve trimshagh as trome-chreeagh.

verses.name: Matthew 26:38
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt eh roo, Ta my annym feer trimshagh, dy jarroo gys y baase: fuirree-jee ayns shoh as freill-jee arrey marym.

verses.name: Matthew 26:39
verses.text: As hie eh red beg sodjey, as huitt eh sheese er e eddin, as ghow eh padjer, as dooyrt eh, O my Ayr, my oddys eh 've, lhig da'n cappan shoh goll shagh-ym: ny-yeih cha nee m'aigney's, agh dty aigney's dy row jeant.

verses.name: Matthew 26:40
verses.text: As haink eh gys ny ostyllyn, as hooar eh ad nyn gadley, as dooyrt eh rish Peddyr, Kys ta shoh, nagh voddagh shiu arrey y reayll marym un oor?

verses.name: Matthew 26:41
verses.text: Bee-jee er nyn dwoaie as gow-jee padjer, nagh duitt shiu ayns miolagh: ta'n spyrryd dy jarroo arryltagh, agh ta'n eill annoon.

verses.name: Matthew 26:42
verses.text: Hie eh roish reesht yn nah cheayrt, as ghow eh padjer, gra, O my Ayr, mannagh vod yn cappan shoh goll shagh-ym, fegooish mee dy iu eh, dty aigney's dy row jeant.

verses.name: Matthew 26:43
verses.text: As haink eh as hooar eh ad nyn gadley reesht: son va ny sooillyn oc trome.

verses.name: Matthew 26:44
verses.text: As daag eh ad, as hie eh roish reesht as ghow eh padjer yn trass cheayrt, gra ny goan cheddin.

verses.name: Matthew 26:45
verses.text: Eisht haink eh gys e ostyllyn, as dooyrt eh roo, Caddil-jee nish, as gow-jee nyn vea; cur-my-ner ta'n oor tayrn er-gerrey, as ta'n Mac dooinney er ny vrah gys laueyn peccee.

verses.name: Matthew 26:46
verses.text: Irree-jee, as lhig dooin goll: cur-my-ner t'eshyn er-gerrey dooin ta dy my vrah.

verses.name: Matthew 26:47
verses.text: As choud as v'eh foast loayrt, cur my-ner, haink Yuaase, fer jeh'n daa ostyl yeig, as va sheshaght vooar marish lesh cliwenyn as luirg veih ny ard-saggyrtyn as shanstyr y phobble

verses.name: Matthew 26:48
verses.text: Nish hug eshyn v'er vrah eh, cowrey daue, gra, Quoi-erbee ver-yms paag da, shen eh, cum-jee eh dy shickyr.

verses.name: Matthew 26:49
verses.text: As chelleeragh haink eh gys Yeesey, as dooyrt eh, Dy vannee dhyt, Vainshter; as phaag eh eh.

verses.name: Matthew 26:50
verses.text: As dooyrt Yeesey rish, My heshey, cre'n-fa t'ou er jeet? Eisht haink ad, as ghreimm ad er Yeesey, as ghow ad eh.

verses.name: Matthew 26:51
verses.text: As cur-my-ner heeyn fer jeusyn va marish Yeesey magh e laue, as hayrn eh e chliwe, as woaill eh fer-mooinjerey yn ard saggyrt, as ghiare eh yn chleaysh jeh.

verses.name: Matthew 26:52
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt Yeesey rish, Cur seose dty chliwe reesht 'sy fine: son nee adsyn ooilley ta goaill y cliwe, cherraghtyn liorish y chliwe.

verses.name: Matthew 26:53
verses.text: Vel uss smooinaghtyn nagh voddym's nish guee gys my Ayr, as yinnagh eh chelleeragh hym erskyn daa legion jeig dy ainleyn?

verses.name: Matthew 26:54
verses.text: Agh kys eisht vees ny scriptyryn er nyn gooilleeney, dy nee shoh myr te dy ve?

verses.name: Matthew 26:55
verses.text: Ayns yn oor cheddin dooyrt Yeesey rish y pobble, Vel shiu er jeet magh myr noi maarliagh, lesh cliwenyn as luirg dy my ghoaill? hoie mee meriu gagh-laa gynsaghey ayns y chiamble, as cha ren shiu my ghoaill.

verses.name: Matthew 26:56
verses.text: Agh va ooilley shoh jeant, dy voddagh scriptyryn ny phadeyryn ve cooilleenit. Eisht ren ooilley ny ostyllyn treigeil eh, as cosney roue.

verses.name: Matthew 26:57
verses.text: As leeid y vooinjer v'er ghoaill Yeesey eh ersooyl gys Caiaphas yn ard saggyrt, raad va ny scrudeyryn as y chanstyr er nyn jaglym cooidjagh.

verses.name: Matthew 26:58
verses.text: Agh deiyr Peddyr er foddey ny yei, gys thie yn ard-saggyrt, as hie eh stiagh, as hoie eh marish y vooinjer dy yeeaghyn cre'n erree harragh er.

verses.name: Matthew 26:59
verses.text: Nish yn ny ard-saggyrtyn as y chanstyr as ooilley yn choonceil, shirrey feanishyn foalsey noi Yeesey dy choyrt eh gy-baase.

verses.name: Matthew 26:60
verses.text: Agh cha dooar ad veg: ga dy daink ymmodee feanishyn foalsey, foast cha dooar ad veg. Ec y jerrey haink daa eanish foalsey,

verses.name: Matthew 26:61
verses.text: As dooyrt ad, T'eh shoh er ghra, Ta'n phooar aym's dy lhieggal chiamble Yee, as dy hroggal eh reesht ayns three laa.

verses.name: Matthew 26:62
verses.text: As hass yn ard-saggyrt seose, as dooyrt eh rish, Nagh vel oo cur ansoor? cre shoh t'ad dy lhiassaghey dt'oi?

verses.name: Matthew 26:63
verses.text: Agh va Yeesey ny-host. As dreggyr yn ard-saggyrt as dooyrt eh rish, Ta mee cur currym ort liorish y Jee bio, oo dy insh dooin, nee oo yn Creest mac Yee?

verses.name: Matthew 26:64
verses.text: Dooyrt Yeesey rish, T'ou uss er ghra eh: ny-yeih ta mish gra riu, Ny lurg shoh hee shiu Mac y dooinney ny hoie er laue yesh yn phooar, as cheet ayns bodjallyn yn aer.

verses.name: Matthew 26:65
verses.text: Eisht raip yn ard-saggyrt e choamrey, gra, ren er loayrt goan mollaghtagh, cre'n feme sodjey t'ain er feanishyn? cur-my-ner, nish ta shiu er chlashtyn e ghoan mollaghtagh.

verses.name: Matthew 26:66
verses.text: Cre ta shiu smooinaghtyn jeh? Dansoor ad, as dooyrt ad, T'eh toilchin dy ve er ny choyrt gy-baase.

verses.name: Matthew 26:67
verses.text: Eisht cheau ad shellaghyn ayns e eddin, as woaill ad eh, as woaill feallagh elley eh lesh bassyn nyn laueyn.

verses.name: Matthew 26:68
verses.text: Gra, Jean phadeyrys dooin, uss yn Creest, quoi ta dy dty woalley?

verses.name: Matthew 26:69
verses.text: Nish va Peddyr ny hoie cheu-mooie jeh'n cheshaght ayns y halley: as haink ben aeg huggey, gra, V'ou uss myrgeddin marish Yeesey dy Ghalilee.

verses.name: Matthew 26:70
verses.text: Agh dob eh kiongoyrt roo ooilley, gra, Cha s'aym cre t'ou dy ghra.

verses.name: Matthew 26:71
verses.text: As tra v'eh er gholl magh ayns y phorch, honnick ben-aeg elley eh, as dooyrt ee roosyn v'ayns shen, V'eh shoh myrgeddin marish Yeesey dy Nazareth.

verses.name: Matthew 26:72
verses.text: As reesht dob eh lesh loo, Cha nione dou yn dooinney.

verses.name: Matthew 26:73
verses.text: As tammylt ny lurg shen haink huggey paart jeh'n cheshaght, as dooyrt ad rish Peddyr, Shickyr she fer jeu oo, son ta dty ghlare dy dty vrah.

verses.name: Matthew 26:74
verses.text: Eisht ren eh toshiaght dy ghweeaghyn as dy loo, gra, Cha nione dou yn dooinney. As chelleeragh ren y kellagh gerrym.

verses.name: Matthew 26:75
verses.text: As chooinee Peddyr er ny goan va Yeesey er ghra rish, Roish gerrym y chellee, obbee uss mish three keayrtyn. As hie eh magh as cheayn eh dy sharroo.

verses.name: Matthew 27:1
verses.text: Tra va'n moghrey er jeet rish, hug ooilley ny ard-saggyrtyn as shanstyr yn phobble nyn goyrle dy cheilley, dy choyrt eh gy-baase.

verses.name: Matthew 27:2
verses.text: As erreish daue v'er chiangley eh, leeid ad eh ersooyl, as livrey ad eh gys Pontius Pilate yn kiannoort,

verses.name: Matthew 27:3
verses.text: Tra honnick eisht Yuaase ren y vrah eh, dy row eh er ny gheyrey, ghow eh arrys, as hug eh lesh reesht ny jeih peeshyn as feed dy argid gys ny ard-saggyrtyn as y chanstyr,

verses.name: Matthew 27:4
verses.text: Gra, Ta mee er n'yannoo peccah, ayns dy vel mee er vrah yn uill neu-chyndagh. As dooyrt adsyn, Cre ta shen dooinyn? jeeagh uss da shen.

verses.name: Matthew 27:5
verses.text: As hilg eh sheese ny peeshyn argid ayns y chiamble, as jimmee eh roish, as hie eh as ren eh eh-hene y chroghey.

verses.name: Matthew 27:6
verses.text: As ghow ny ard-Saggyrtyn ny peeshyn argid, as dooyrt ad, Cha vel eh lowal dy choyrt ad mastey tashtaghyn y chiamble er-yn-oyr dy nee leagh foalley t'ayn.

verses.name: Matthew 27:7
verses.text: As ghow ad coyrle, as chionnee ad lhieu magher yn phasheyder, dy oanluckey joarreeyn ayn.

verses.name: Matthew 27:8
verses.text: Shen-y-fa va'n magher shen enmyssit, Yn magher-foalley, gys y laa t'ayn jiu.

verses.name: Matthew 27:9
verses.text: (Shen y traa va cooilleenit ny va loayrit liorish Jeremy yn phadeyr, gra, As ghow ad ny jeih peeshyn as feed dy argid, yn phrice echeysyn v'er ny phriceil, eshyn hug cloan Isra price er:

verses.name: Matthew 27:10
verses.text: As hug ad ad son magher yn phasheyder, myr va'n Chiarn er n'oardaghey dou).

verses.name: Matthew 27:11
verses.text: As hass Yeesey fenish y chiannoort, as denee yn kiannoort jeh, gra, Nee uss ree ny Hewnyn? As dooyrt Yeesey rish, T'ou uss dy ghra eh.

verses.name: Matthew 27:12
verses.text: As tra v'eh er ny chassid liorish ny ard-saggyrtyn as y chanstyr, cha dug eh ansoor erbee daue.

verses.name: Matthew 27:13
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt Pilate rish, Nagh vel oo clashtyn cre whilleen red t'ad shoh cur stiagh

verses.name: Matthew 27:14
verses.text: As cha dug eh un ockle dy ansoor da, ayns wheesh as dy ghow yn kiannoort yindys mooar.

verses.name: Matthew 27:15
verses.text: Nish ec y feailley shen va'n kiannoort cliaghtey feaysley daue pryssoonagh erbee dy bailloo.

verses.name: Matthew 27:16
verses.text: As va oc ec y traa shen ard-phryssoon agh va enmyssit Barabbas.

verses.name: Matthew 27:17
verses.text: Shen-y-fa tra v'ad er nyn jaglym cooidjagh, dooyrt Pilate roo, Quoi sailliu mee dy eaysley diu? Barabbas, ny Yeesey, ta enmyssit Creest?

verses.name: Matthew 27:18
verses.text: Son va fys echey dy nee ayns goanlys v'ad er chur stiagh eh.

verses.name: Matthew 27:19
verses.text: Erreish da soie er stoyl y vriwnys, hug e ven fys huggey, gra, Ny bee veg ayd's dy yannoo rish y dooinney cairagh shen: son s'mooar ta mee er hurranse jiu ayns my chadley, er y choontey echeysyn.

verses.name: Matthew 27:20
verses.text: Agh choyrlee ny ard-saggyrtyn as shanstyr y phobble ad dy yannoo aghin son Barabbas, as Yeesey y choyrt gy-baase.

verses.name: Matthew 27:21
verses.text: Dansoor y kiannoort as dooyrt eh roo, Quoi jeh'n jees sailliu mee dy eaysley diu? Dooyrt adsyn, Barabbas.

verses.name: Matthew 27:22
verses.text: Dooyrt Pilate roo, Cre nee'm eisht rish Yeesey, ta enmyssit Creest? Dooyrt ad ooilley rish, Lhig da v'er ny chrossey.

verses.name: Matthew 27:23
verses.text: As dooyrt y kiannoort, Cre'n-oyr, cre'n olk t'eh er n'yannoo? Agh deie adsyn ny smoo, gra, Lhig da v'er ny chrossey.

verses.name: Matthew 27:24
verses.text: Tra honnick Pilate nagh dug ad geill da e choyrle, agh dy row ad aarloo dy irree-magh, ghow eh ushtey, as niee eh e laueyn kiongoyrt rish y pobble, gra, Ta mish neu-chyndagh jeh fuill yn phersoon cairagh shen, jeeagh-jee shiuish da.

verses.name: Matthew 27:25
verses.text: Eisht dansoor ooilley yn pobble, gra, Yn uill echey dy row orrinyn, as er nyn gloan.

verses.name: Matthew 27:26
verses.text: Eisht deayshil eh Barabbas daue; as erreish da Yeesey ve scuitchit, hug eh briwnys er dy v'er ny chrossey.

verses.name: Matthew 27:27
verses.text: Eisht hug sidooryn y chiannoort lhieu Yeesey gys halley ny briwnys, as deie ad er slane sheshaght ny sidooryn.

verses.name: Matthew 27:28
verses.text: As rooisht ad eh, as hug ad er coamrey scarleod.

verses.name: Matthew 27:29
verses.text: As fee attey dy ghrineyn hug ad eh mysh e chione, as cuirtlagh ayns e laue-yesh: as gliooney kiongoyrt rish dooyrt ad ayns craid, Dy vannee dhyt, Ree ny Hewnyn.

verses.name: Matthew 27:30
verses.text: As cheau ad shellaghyn er, as ghow ad y chuirtlagh, as woaill ad eh er y chione

verses.name: Matthew 27:31
verses.text: As erreish daue v'er n'yannoo (nyn saie) craid er, ghow ad yn coamrey reeoil jeh as hug ad e gharmad hene er, as leeid ad eh ersooyl dy chrossey eh.

verses.name: Matthew 27:32
verses.text: As myr haink ad magh, hooar ad dooinney jeh Cyrene, enmyssit Simon: eshyn ren ad y eaginaghey dy ymmyrkey e chrosh.

verses.name: Matthew 27:33
verses.text: As tra v'ad er jeet gys ynnyd ta enmyssit Golgotha, ta shen dy ghra, Ynnyd bollag.

verses.name: Matthew 27:34
verses.text: Hug ad da vinegar dy iu, as gall ny-chione: as tra v'eh er vlashtyn eh, cha baillish giu.

verses.name: Matthew 27:35
verses.text: As ren ad eh y chrossey, as rheynn ad e gharmadyn, tilgey lottyn: as shoh myr va cooilleenit shen loayr y phadeyr, Rheynn ad my gharmadyn nyn mast' oc, as er my chooat ren ad lottyn y hilgey.

verses.name: Matthew 27:36
verses.text: As hoie ad sheese as dreill ad arrey er ayns shen.

verses.name: Matthew 27:37
verses.text: As hoie ad erskyn e chione oyr e vaaish scruit, SHOH YEESEY REE NY HEWNYN.

verses.name: Matthew 27:38
verses.text: Eisht va daa vaarliagh er ny chrossey marish: yn derrey yeh er y laue-yesh, as y jeh elley er y laue-chiare.

verses.name: Matthew 27:39
verses.text: As doltooan y vooinjer va goll shaghey eh, craa nyn ghing.

verses.name: Matthew 27:40
verses.text: As gra, Uss ta lhieggal y chiamble, as dy hroggal eh reesht ayns three laa, saue oo hene: my she mac Yee oo, tar neose jeh'n chrosh.

verses.name: Matthew 27:41
verses.text: Myr shen neesht ren ny ard saggyrtyn craidey mysh, marish ny scrudeyryn as y chanstyr, as dooyrt ad,

verses.name: Matthew 27:42
verses.text: Haue eh feallagh elley, eh-hene cha vod eh sauail: my she ree Israel eh, lhig da cheet neose jeh'n chrosh, as nee mayd credjal ayn.

verses.name: Matthew 27:43
verses.text: Hreisht eh ayns Jee; lhig da eh y livrey nish my saillish eh: son dooyrt eh, She mac Yee mee.

verses.name: Matthew 27:44
verses.text: Hilg ny maarlee myrgeddin v'er nyn grossey marish yn lheid cheddin er.

verses.name: Matthew 27:45
verses.text: Nish veih yn cheyoo oor, va dorraghys harrish ooilley yn cheer, gys yn nuyoo oor.

verses.name: Matthew 27:46
verses.text: As mygeayrt yn nuyoo oor, deie Yeesey lesh ard-choraa, gra, ELI, ELI, LAMA SABACTHANI? ta shen dy ghra, My Yee, My Yee, cre'n-fa t'ou er my hreigeil?

verses.name: Matthew 27:47
verses.text: Dooyrt paart jeusyn va nyn shassoo ayns shen, tra cheayll ad shen, Ta'n dooinney shoh geamagh er Elias.

verses.name: Matthew 27:48
verses.text: As chelleeragh roie fer jeu, as ghow eh sponge as lhieen eh eh lesh vinegar, as hug eh eh er cuirtlagh, as heeyn eh eh huggey dy iu.

verses.name: Matthew 27:49
verses.text: Dooyrt y vooinjer elley, Faag-jee veue eh, hee mayd jig Elias dy hauail eh.

verses.name: Matthew 27:50
verses.text: Tra va Yeesey er n'eamagh reesht lesh ard-choraa, phaart eh..

verses.name: Matthew 27:51
verses.text: As cur-my-ner, va'n coodaghey va eddyr, y chiamble as yn ynnyd casherick raipit veih-my-cheilley, veih'n vullagh gys y laare; as ren y thalloo craa, as ny creggyn scoltey.

verses.name: Matthew 27:52
verses.text: As va ny oaiaghyn er nyn vosley, as ren ymmodee jeh kirp ny nooghyn va nyn gadley, girree seose,

verses.name: Matthew 27:53
verses.text: As cheet ass ny oaiaghyn oc lurg yn irree-seose-reesht echey, hie ad stiagh ayns yn ard-valley casherick, as hoilshee ad ad hene da ymmodee.

verses.name: Matthew 27:54
verses.text: Nish tra honnick yn captan, as adsyn va marish freayll arrey er Yeesey, yn craa thallooin, as ny reddyn v'er jeet gy-kione, ghow ad aggle mooar, gra, Dy firrinagh shoh va Mac Yee.

verses.name: Matthew 27:55
verses.text: As va ymmodee mraane ayns shen (va jeeaghyn er tammylt voue) va er n'eiyrt er Yeesey veih Galilee dy hirveish er.

verses.name: Matthew 27:56
verses.text: Nyn mast' oc va Moirrey Malaine, as Moirrey moir Yamys as Voses, as moir cloan Zebedee.

verses.name: Matthew 27:57
verses.text: Tra va'n fastyr er jeet, haink dooinney berchagh ass Arimathea, va enmyssit Joseph va myrgeddin eh-hene credjal ayns Yeesey.

verses.name: Matthew 27:58
verses.text: Hie eh shoh gys Pilate, as ren eh aghin son corp Yeesey: eisht doardee Pilate yn corp dy ve er ny livrey.

verses.name: Matthew 27:59
verses.text: As tra va Joseph er n'ghoaill y corp hoill eh eh ayns aanrit glen,

verses.name: Matthew 27:60
verses.text: As doanluck eh eh ayns yn oaie noa echey hene, v'eh er chleiy ass y chreg: as rowl eh clagh vooar er beeal yn oaie, as jimmee eh roish.

verses.name: Matthew 27:61
verses.text: As va Moirrey Malaine, as Moirrey elley, nyn soie jeeragh er yn oaie.

verses.name: Matthew 27:62
verses.text: Nish yn nah laa lurg laa yn aarlaghey haink ny ard-saggyrtyn as ny Phariseeyn cooidjagh gys Pilate,

verses.name: Matthew 27:63
verses.text: Gra, Vainshter, ta cooinaghtyn ain dy dooyrt yn molteyr shen, choud as v'eh foast bio, Lurg three laa neem's girree reesht.

verses.name: Matthew 27:64
verses.text: Cur sarey er-y-fa shen yn oaie dy ve jeant shickyr, derrey yn trass laa, er-aggle dy jig e ostyllyn ayns yn oie, as dy geid ad eh ersooyl, as dy jir ad rish yn pobble, T'eh er n'irree veih ny merriu: myr shen bee yn molteyrys s'jerree ny smessey na'n chied volteyrys.

verses.name: Matthew 27:65
verses.text: Dooyrt Pilate roo, Ta watch eu immee-jee reue, jean-jee cha shickyr jeh as oddys shiu.

verses.name: Matthew 27:66
verses.text: Myr shen hie ad, as ren ad yn oaie shickyr, sealal y chlagh, as soiaghey watch.

verses.name: Matthew 28:1
verses.text: Tra va'n doonaght harrish, as y vadran cheet rish er y chied laa jeh'n chiaghtin, haink Moirrey Malaine, as Moirrey elley dy voddagh ad yn oaie y akin.

verses.name: Matthew 28:2
verses.text: As cur-my-ner va craa thallooin mooar ayn; son va ainle y Chiarn er jeet neose veih niau, as er jeet as er rowlal back yn chlagh jeh beeal yn oaie, as er hoie urree.

verses.name: Matthew 28:3
verses.text: Va'n eddin echey goll-rish y tendreil, as e choamrey gial myr y sniaghtey.

verses.name: Matthew 28:4
verses.text: As ayns aggle roish va ny arreyderyn er creau, as haink ad dy ve myr deiney marroo.

verses.name: Matthew 28:5
verses.text: As dreggyr yn ainle, as dooyrt eh rish ny mraane, Ny gow-jee aggle: son ta fys aym's dy vel shiu shirrey Yeesey, v'er ny chrossey.

verses.name: Matthew 28:6
verses.text: Cha vel eh ayns shoh, son t'eh er n'irree myr dooyrt eh-hene: tar-jee, jeeagh-jee er yn ynnyd raad va'n Chiarn oanluckit.

verses.name: Matthew 28:7
verses.text: As immee-jee dy tappee, as insh-jee da e ostyllyn, dy vel eh er n'irree veih ny merriu; as cur-my-ner, t'eh goll reue gys Galilee, ayns shen hee shiu eh, cur-my-ner, ta mish er n'insh diu.

verses.name: Matthew 28:8
verses.text: As jimmee ad dy tappee veih'n oaie lesh aggle as boggey mooar, as roie ad dy chur lhieu yn naight gys e ostyllyn.

verses.name: Matthew 28:9
verses.text: As myr v'ad goll dy insh eh da e ostyllyn, cur-my-ner haink Yeesey nyn guail, gra, Dy vannee diu. As haink ad, as huitt ad sheese ec e chassyn, lesh nyn laueyn orroo, cur ooashley da.

verses.name: Matthew 28:10
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt Yeesey roo, Ny gow-jee aggle: immee-jee, as abbyr-jee rish my vraaraghyn ad dy gholl gys Galilee, as ayns shen hee ad mee.

verses.name: Matthew 28:11
verses.text: Nish myr v'ad goll, cur-my-ner, haink shiartanse jeh'n arrey gys yn ard-valley, as dinsh ad da ny ard-saggyrtyn ooilley ny va er daghyrt.

verses.name: Matthew 28:12
verses.text: As tra v'adsyn as y chanstyr er nyn jaglym cooidjagh, as er chur nyn goyrle dy cheilley hug ad sym mooar dy argid da ny sidooryn,

verses.name: Matthew 28:13
verses.text: Gra, Abbyr-jee shiuish, Haink e ostyllyn ayns yn oie, as gheid ad eh ersooyl choud as va shin nyn gadley.

verses.name: Matthew 28:14
verses.text: As my chlinnys y kiannoort jeh, nee mayd eshyn y vreagey as shiuish y heyrey.

verses.name: Matthew 28:15
verses.text: Myr shen ghow ad yn argid, as ren ad myr va currit roue: as ta'n raa shoh dy cadjin er ny insh magh mastey ny Hewnyn gys y laa t'ayn jiu.

verses.name: Matthew 28:16
verses.text: Eisht hie yn un ostyl yeig roue gys Galilee, gys slieau raad va Yeesey er n'oardaghey daue.

verses.name: Matthew 28:17
verses.text: As tra honnick ad eh, hug ad ooashley da: agh va paart jeu fo mee-ourys.

verses.name: Matthew 28:18
verses.text: As haink Yeesey, as loayr eh roo, gra, Ta dy chooilley phooar er ny chur dou ayns niau as er y thalloo.

verses.name: Matthew 28:19
verses.text: Immee-jee er-y-fa shen, as ynsee-jee dy chooilley ashoon, as bashtee-jee ad ayns ennym yn Ayr, as y Vac, as y spyrryd Noo:

verses.name: Matthew 28:20
verses.text: Gynsaghey daue dy reayll dy chooilley nhee cre-erbee ta mish er chur ayns sarey diu: as cur-my-ner, ta mish meriu kinjagh, eer gys jerrey yn theihll.

verses.name: Luke 1:1
verses.text: Son wheesh as dy vel ymmodee er ghoaill ayns laue dy chur coontey cairagh jeh ny reddyn ta dy firrinagh er nyn gredjal nyn mast'ain.

verses.name: Luke 1:2
verses.text: Eer myr hoilshee ad dooinyn ad, va er-dyn toshiaght nyn veanishyn sooilley as nyn shirveishee jeh'n ghoo.

verses.name: Luke 1:3
verses.text: Ta mish myrgeddin er vakin eh mie, myr ta slane toiggal aym jeh dy chooilley nhee er-dyn eer toshiaght, dy scrieu hoods ayns order, Theophilus smoo ooasle,

verses.name: Luke 1:4
verses.text: Dy vod tushtey share y ve ayd jeh firrinys ny reddyn shen, t'ou er ny ve ynsit ayndoo.

verses.name: Luke 1:5
verses.text: Rish lhing Heron ree Yudea, va saggyrt dy row enmyssit Zacharias, jeh coorse Abia; as va'n ven echey jeh inneenyn Aaron, as yn ennym eck Elizabeth.

verses.name: Luke 1:6
verses.text: As v'ad ny-neesht cairagh kiongoyrt rish Jee, gimmeeaght ayns ooilley annaghyn as oardaghyn y Chiarn gyn loght.

verses.name: Luke 1:7
verses.text: As cha row sluight oc, er-yn-oyr dy row Elizabeth gennish, as v'ad ny-neesht er roie dy mie ayns eash.

verses.name: Luke 1:8
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione, choud as v'eh cooilleeney oik y taggyrt kiongoyrt rish Jee, myr va e choorse er jeet magh,

verses.name: Luke 1:9
verses.text: Cordail rish cliaghtey oik y taggyrt, dy haghyr eh dy ve yn currym echey dy lostey oural-millish, tra v'eh goll stiagh ayns chiamble y Chiarn.

verses.name: Luke 1:10
verses.text: As va'n slane chaglym jeh'n pobble cheu-mooie ec padjer rish traa yn oural-millish.

verses.name: Luke 1:11
verses.text: As haink ainle y Chiarn, as hass eh er cheu yesh altar yn oural-millish.

verses.name: Luke 1:12
verses.text: As tra honnick Zacharias eh, v'eh seaghnit, as huitt aggle er.

verses.name: Luke 1:13
verses.text: Agh dooyrt yn ainle rish, Ny gow aggle Zacharias: son ta dty phadjer er ny chlashtyn, as nee yn ven ayd Elizabeth mac y ymmyrkey dhyt, as nee oo genmys eh Ean.

verses.name: Luke 1:14
verses.text: As bee boggey as gerjagh ayd, as nee ymmodee boggey y ghoaill tra hig eh er y theihll.

verses.name: Luke 1:15
verses.text: Son bee eh ooasle ayns shilley yn Chiarn, as cha n'iu eh feeyn ny jough lajer, as bee eh er ny lhieeney lesh y Spyrryd Noo, veih eer brein e vayrey.

verses.name: Luke 1:16
verses.text: As ymmodee jeh cloan Israel nee eh y hyndaa gys y Chiarn y Jee oc.

verses.name: Luke 1:17
verses.text: As hed eh roishyn ayns spyrryd as pooar Elias, dy hyndaa creeaghyn ny ayragh yn gys y chloan, as ny mee-viallee gys creenaght yn vooinjer chairal, dy yannoo aarloo pobble kiarit son y Chiarn.

verses.name: Luke 1:18
verses.text: As dooyrt Zacharias rish yn ainle, Cre liorish vees fys aym's er shoh son ta mee shenn, as ta'n ven er roie dy mie ayns eash.

verses.name: Luke 1:19
verses.text: As dreggyr yn aile as dooyrt e rish, Mish Gabriel ta shirveish fenish Yee: as ta mee-er my choyrt dy loayrt rhyt, as dy hoilshaghey dhyt ny naightyn mie shoh.

verses.name: Luke 1:20
verses.text: As cur-my-ner bee oo balloo, as cha jig dty ghlare lhiat, derrey yn laa vees ny reddyn shoh cooilleenit, er-y-fa nagh vel oo er chredjal my ghoan's vees er nyn gooilleeney ayns nyn imbagh cooie.

verses.name: Luke 1:21
verses.text: As va'n pobble fieau son Zacharias, as yindys orroo dy row eh cumrail choud ayns y chiamble.

verses.name: Luke 1:22
verses.text: As tra haink eh magh, cha voddagh eh loayrt roo; as hoig ad dy row eh er vakin ashlish ayns y chiamble: son v'eh jannoo signyn daue, as hannee eh balloo.

verses.name: Luke 1:23
verses.text: As shen myr ve, tra v'eh er chooilleeney laghyn e hirveish, dy jimmee eh gys e hie hene.

verses.name: Luke 1:24
verses.text: As lurg ny laghyn shen ren e ven Elizabeth giennaghtyn, as dollee ee ee-hene queig meeghyn, gra,

verses.name: Luke 1:25
verses.text: Shoh myr ta'n Chiarn er n'yannoo er my hon tra yeeagh eh orrym, dy ghoaill ersooyl my oltooan mastey deiney.

verses.name: Luke 1:26
verses.text: As ayns y cheyoo vee, va'n ainle Gabriel er ny choyrt veih Jee, gys ard-valley dy Ghalilee, va enmyssit Nazareth,

verses.name: Luke 1:27
verses.text: Gys moidyn nasht rish dooinney enmyssit Joseph, jeh thie Ghavid; as va ennym y voidyn Moirrey.

verses.name: Luke 1:28
verses.text: As haink yn ainle stiagh as dooyrt eh r'ee, Dy vannee dhyt's ta ayns ard-foayr ta'n Chiarn mayrt; bannit t'ou uss mastey mraane.

verses.name: Luke 1:29
verses.text: As tra honnick ee eh, v'ee seaghnit ec y raa echey, as smooinee ee r'ee hene cre'n monney dy vannaghey va shoh.

verses.name: Luke 1:30
verses.text: As dooyrt yn ainle r'ee, Ny bee aggle ort, O Voirrey; son t'ou er gheddyn foayr veih Jee.

verses.name: Luke 1:31
verses.text: As cur-my-ner, nee oo giennaghtyn, as mac y ymmyrkey, as enmyssee oo yn ennym echey Yeesey.

verses.name: Luke 1:32
verses.text: Bee eshyn cronnal, as enmyssit Mac yn Er-syrjey; as ver y Chiarn Jee dasyn stoyl-reeoil e ayr David.

verses.name: Luke 1:33
verses.text: As nee eh reill harrish thie Yacob gys earishyn foddey beayn, as er e reeriaght cha bee jerrey erbee.

verses.name: Luke 1:34
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt Moirrey rish yn ainle, Kys oddys shoh y ve, fakin nagh nione dou dooinney?

verses.name: Luke 1:35
verses.text: As dreggyr yn ainle as dooyrt eh r'ee, Hig yn Spyrryd Noo neose ort, as bee pooar yn Er-syrjey er ny skeayley harryd: shen-y-fa bee yn sluight chasherick shen ver oo son y theihll, enmyssit Mac Yee.

verses.name: Luke 1:36
verses.text: As cur-my-ner, dty ven-vooinjerey Elizabeth, t'eeish myrgeddin er ghiennaght yn mac ayns ny shenn laghyn eck: as shoh yn cheyoo vee jeeish va raait dy ve gennish.

verses.name: Luke 1:37
verses.text: Son da Jee cha bee nhee erbee neu-phossible.

verses.name: Luke 1:38
verses.text: As dooyrt Moirrey, Cur-my-ner sharvaant y Chiarn, dy jig eh lhiam cordail rish dty ghoo. As jimmee yn ainle voee.

verses.name: Luke 1:39
verses.text: As mysh ny laghyn shen hrog Moirrey urree lesh siyr dy gholl gys cheer ny liargagh, gys ard-valley dy Yudah,

verses.name: Luke 1:40
verses.text: As hie ee stiagh ayns thie Zacharias as vannee ee da Elizabeth.

verses.name: Luke 1:41
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione, tra cheayll Elizabeth bannaghey Moirrey, dy lheim yn oikan ayns e brein, as va Elizabeth lhieent lesh y Spyrryd Noo.

verses.name: Luke 1:42
verses.text: As loayr ee lesh ard-choraa as dooyrt ee, Bannit t'ou uss mastey mraane, as bannit ta sluight dty vreïn.

verses.name: Luke 1:43
verses.text: As kys ta'n (ooashley) aym, dy vel moir my Hiarn er jeet dy my yeeaghyn?

verses.name: Luke 1:44
verses.text: Son cur-my-ner, cha leah as ren coraa dty vannaghey bingys ayns my chleayshyn, lheim yn oikan ayns my vrein son boggey.

verses.name: Luke 1:45
verses.text: As bannit t'eeish ta er chredjal: son bee slane cooilleeney ny reddyn shen v'er ny hoilshaghey jee liorish y Chiarn.

verses.name: Luke 1:46
verses.text: As dooyrt Moirrey, Ta m'annym cur ard-voylley da'n Chiarn.

verses.name: Luke 1:47
verses.text: As ta my spyrryd er ghoaill boggey ayns Jee my Haualtagh.

verses.name: Luke 1:48
verses.text: Son t'eh er chur tastey da stayd injil e harvaant: son cur-my-ner, maghey shoh nee dy chooilley heeloghe mish y enmys bannit.

verses.name: Luke 1:49
verses.text: Son s'mooar ta'n Ooilley-niartal er n'yannoo er my hon, as s'casherick ta e ennym.

verses.name: Luke 1:50
verses.text: As ta e vyghin orroosyn ta goaill aggle roish, veih sheeloghe gys sheeloghe.

verses.name: Luke 1:51
verses.text: T'eh er hoilshaghey niart lesh e roih t'eh er skeayley ny moyrnee ayns mooaralys nyn greeaghyn.

verses.name: Luke 1:52
verses.text: T'eh er lhieggal sheese ny treanee veih nyn stuill-reeoil, as er hoiaghey seose ny imlee.

verses.name: Luke 1:53
verses.text: T'eh er lhieeney ny accryssee lesh reddyn mie, as ny berchee t'eh er chur follym ersooyl.

verses.name: Luke 1:54
verses.text: T'eh er chooney lesh e harvaant Israel ayns cooinaghtyn jeh e vyghin.

verses.name: Luke 1:55
verses.text: (Myr loayr eh rish nyn shenn-ayryn, rish Abraham as e luight) er son dy bragh.

verses.name: Luke 1:56
verses.text: As duirree Moirrey mâree mysh three meeghyn, as haink ee reesht gys e thie hene.

verses.name: Luke 1:57
verses.text: Nish va slane traa Elizabeth er jeet dy ve livreit, as hug ee mac son y theihll.

verses.name: Luke 1:58
verses.text: As cheayll ny naboonyn as y sleih mooinjerey eck, kys va'n Chiarn er hoilshaghey ard-vyghin jee; as ghow ad boggey mâree.

verses.name: Luke 1:59
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione er yn hoghtoo laa dy daink ad dy ghiarey-chymmylt yn lhiannoo; as denmys ad eh Zacharias, lurg ennym e ayrey.

verses.name: Luke 1:60
verses.text: As dreggyr e voir, as dooyrt ee, Cha nee; agh bee eh enmyssit Ean.

verses.name: Luke 1:61
verses.text: As dooyrt ad r'ee, Cha vel veg jeh dty chynney jeh'n ennym shen.

verses.name: Luke 1:62
verses.text: As ren ad signyn gys e ayr, cre'n ennym bailIishyn y ve er.

verses.name: Luke 1:63
verses.text: As hir eh boayrd-screeuee, as scrieu eh, gra, Ta'n ennym echey Ean. As ghow ad ooilley yindys.

verses.name: Luke 1:64
verses.text: As er-y-chooyl va e veeal er ny osley, as e hengey er ny eaysley, as loayr eh, as hug eh moylley da Jee.

verses.name: Luke 1:65
verses.text: As huitt aggle (arrymagh) er ooilley nyn naboonyn: as hie goo jeh ooilley ny reddyn shoh magh trooid ooilley cheer sleitagh Yudea.

verses.name: Luke 1:66
verses.text: As adsyn ooilley cheayll shoh, hasht ad ayns nyn greeaghyn ad, gra, Cren monney dy ghooinney vees eh shoh? as va laue yn Chiarn mârish.

verses.name: Luke 1:67
verses.text: As va'n ayr echey Zacharias lhieent lesh y Spyrryd Noo, as ren eh phadeyrys, gra,

verses.name: Luke 1:68
verses.text: Bannit dy row yn Chiarn Jee Israel, son t'eh er yeeaghyn er, as er livrey e phobble,

verses.name: Luke 1:69
verses.text: As t'eh er hroggal seose saualtys niartal er nyn son, ayns thie e harvaant David;

verses.name: Luke 1:70
verses.text: Myr loayr eh liorish beeal e adeyryn crauee, t'er ny ve er-dy hoshiaght y theihll;

verses.name: Luke 1:71
verses.text: Dy hauail shin veih nyn noidyn, as veih'n lane ocsyn ooilley ta dwoaie oc orrin.

verses.name: Luke 1:72
verses.text: Dy chooilleeney yn vyghin va giallit da ny ayraghyn ain, as dy chooinaghtyn er e chonaant casherick:

verses.name: Luke 1:73
verses.text: Eer yn breearrey ren eh gys yn ayr ain Abraham,

verses.name: Luke 1:74
verses.text: Dy giallagh eh dooinyn, dy beagh shin er nyn livrey veih laueyn nyn noidyn, as shirveish eh fegooish aggle.

verses.name: Luke 1:75
verses.text: Ayns craueeaght as cairys kiongoyrt rish, ooilley laghyn nyn mea.

verses.name: Luke 1:76
verses.text: As bee uss lhiannoo enmyssit phadeyr yn Er-syrjey; son hed oo roish eddin y Chiarn, dy yannoo aarloo e raaidyn;

verses.name: Luke 1:77
verses.text: Dy chur tushtey dy haualtys da e phobble, liorish leih nyn beccaghyn,

verses.name: Luke 1:78
verses.text: Trooid myghin meiygh yn Jee ain; liorish ta irree-ny-greiney veih yn yrjid er hoilshean orrin

verses.name: Luke 1:79
verses.text: Dy chur soilshey dauesyn ta nyn soie ayns dorraghys as ayns scadoo yn vaaish, dy leeideil ny cassyn ain ayns raad y chee.

verses.name: Luke 1:80
verses.text: As daase y lhiannoo, as v'eh er ny niartaghey 'sy spyrryd, as v'eh ayns ny faasaghyn, derrey'n laa v'eh er ny hoilshaghey da Israel.

verses.name: Luke 2:1
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione ayns ny laghyn shen, dy jagh sarey magh veih Cesar Augustus, dy beagh coontey er ny ghoaill jeh'n slane rheam.

verses.name: Luke 2:2
verses.text: (As va'n recortys shoh jeant magh roish my va Cyremus ny chiannoort er Syria.)

verses.name: Luke 2:3
verses.text: As hie ad ooilley dy chur stiagh nyn enmyn, dagh unnane gys e ard-valley hene.

verses.name: Luke 2:4
verses.text: As hie Joseph myrgeddin seose veih Galilee, veih ard-valley Nazareth, gys Judea, gys ard-valley Ghavid, ta enmyssit Bethlehem (son dy row eh jeh thie as kynney Ghavid.)

verses.name: Luke 2:5
verses.text: Dy chur stiagh e ennym hene as ennym Moirrey yn ven va nasht rish, va trome torragh.

verses.name: Luke 2:6
verses.text: As shen myr ve, choud as v'ad ayns shen, dy row yn traa er jeet jeeish dy ve livreit.

verses.name: Luke 2:7
verses.text: As hug ee son y theihll yn chied mac rug jee, as hoill ee eh ayns aanrityn soïllee, as hug ee eh ny lhie ayns manjoor, er-y-fa nagh row room er nyn son ayns y thie-oast.

verses.name: Luke 2:8
verses.text: Nish v'ayns y cheer cheddin bochilley mooie er y vagher freayll arrey er nyn shioltaneyn 'syn oie.

verses.name: Luke 2:9
verses.text: As cur-my-ner haink ainle y Chiarn neose orroo, as ren gloyr y Chiarn soilshean mygeayrt-y-moo; as v'ad fo aggle feer atchimagh.

verses.name: Luke 2:10
verses.text: As dooyrt yn ainle roo, Ny bee aggle erriu: son cur-my-ner, ta mish coyrt lhiam hiu naightyn mie dy voggey mooar vees gys dy chooilley phobble.

verses.name: Luke 2:11
verses.text: Son diuish t'er ny ruggey jiu ayns ard valley Ghavid, Saualtagh, ta shen Creest yn Chiarn.

verses.name: Luke 2:12
verses.text: As bee shoh son cowrey diu; Yiow shiu yn oikan ayns aanrityn soillee, as ny lhie ayns manjoor.

verses.name: Luke 2:13
verses.text: As ayns y tullogh va marish yn ainle ymmodee jeh'n cheshaght flaunyssagh cur moylley da Jee, as gra,

verses.name: Luke 2:14
verses.text: Gloyr dy row gys Jee ayns yn yrjid, as er y thalloo shee, aigney-mie gys deiney.

verses.name: Luke 2:15
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione, cha leah as va ny ainleyn er n'gholl ersooyl voue gys niau, dy dooyrt ny bochillyn yn derrey yeh rish y jeh elley, Lhig dooin goll nish derrey Bethlehem, dy akin yn red shoh t'er jeet gy-kione, ta'n Chiarn er hoilshaghey dooin.

verses.name: Luke 2:16
verses.text: As haink ad lesh siyr, as hooar ad Moirrey as Joseph, as yn oikan ny lhie ayns manjoor.

verses.name: Luke 2:17
verses.text: As tra honnick ad eh, hoilshee ad magh yn raa va er ny insh daue mychione y lhiannoo shoh.

verses.name: Luke 2:18
verses.text: As ghow dy chooilley unnane cheayll eh, yindys jeh ny reddyn va inshit daue liorish ny bochillyn.

verses.name: Luke 2:19
verses.text: Agh hasht Moirrey ooilley ny raaghyn shoh (ayns e haigney) as smooinee ee orroo dy dowin ayns e cree.

verses.name: Luke 2:20
verses.text: As haink ny bochillyn roue, cur gloyr as moylley da Jee son dy chooilley nhee v'ad er chlashtyn as er vakin, myr ve inshit daue.

verses.name: Luke 2:21
verses.text: As tra va hoght laa ec kione son giarey-chymmylt y lhiannoo, v'eh enmyssit YEESEY, son shen yn ennym hug yn ainle er, roish my row eh er ny ghiennaghtyn 'sy vrein.

verses.name: Luke 2:22
verses.text: As tra va laghyn nyn ghlenney, cordail rish leigh Voses, er jeet, hug ad lhieu eh gys Jerusalem, dy hebbal eh gys y Chiarn,

verses.name: Luke 2:23
verses.text: (Myr te scruit ayns leih yn Chiarn, Bee dy chooilley chied-ruggit yrrynagh er ny chasherickey gys y Chiarn.)

verses.name: Luke 2:24
verses.text: As dy hebbal yn oural t'er ny harey ayns leigh yn Chiarn, Piyr dy chalmaneyn turtle, ny daa chalmane aegey.

verses.name: Luke 2:25
verses.text: As cur-my-ner va dooinney ayns Jerusalem va enmyssit Simeon; as va'n dooinney cheddin cairagh as crauee, farkiaght son gerjagh Israel: as va'n Spyrryd Noo ersyn.

verses.name: Luke 2:26
verses.text: As ve er ny hoilshaghey da liorish y Spyrryd Noo, nagh noghe eh baase, roish da v'er vakin Creest yn Chiarn.

verses.name: Luke 2:27
verses.text: As haink eh liorish y Spyrryd stiagh ayns y chiamble: as tra va'n ayr as y voir er chur lhieu yn lhiannoo Yeesey stiagh, dy yannoo er e hon, lurg cliaghtey yn leigh;

verses.name: Luke 2:28
verses.text: Eisht ghow eh seose eh ayns e roihaghyn, as hug eh moylley da Jee, as dooyrt eh,

verses.name: Luke 2:29
verses.text: Hiarn nish t'ou cur kied da dty harvaant paartail ayns she, cordail rish dty ghoo.

verses.name: Luke 2:30
verses.text: Son ta my hooillyn er vakin dty haualtys;

verses.name: Luke 2:31
verses.text: T'ou er chiarail dy ve er ny hoilshaghey fenish dy chooilley phobble;

verses.name: Luke 2:32
verses.text: Soilshey dy hoilshean er ny Ashoonee as gloyr dty phobble Israel.

verses.name: Luke 2:33
verses.text: As ghow Joseph as e voir yindys jeh ny reddyn va loayrit my-e-chione,

verses.name: Luke 2:34
verses.text: As vannee Simeon ad, as dooyrt eh rish Moirrey e voir, Cur-my-ner ta'n lhiannoo shoh soit dy chur sheese as dy hoiaghey seose ymmodee ayns Israel; as son cowrey dy oltooan.

verses.name: Luke 2:35
verses.text: (As dy jarroo hed cliwe trooid dty annym hene neesht) dy vod smooinaghtyn ymmodee creeaghyn v'er ny chronnaghey.

verses.name: Luke 2:36
verses.text: As va myrgeddin phadeyrben enmyssit Anna, inneen Phanuel, jeh kynney Aser: v'ee dy eash vooar, as v'ee er veaghey marish e sheshey shiaght bleeaney neayr as v'ee ny moidyn.

verses.name: Luke 2:37
verses.text: As v'ee ny ben-treoghe mysh kiare feed as kiare bleeaney dy eash, as v'ee dy kinjagh taaghey yn chiamble, shirveish Jee lesh trostey as padjeryn oie as laa.

verses.name: Luke 2:38
verses.text: As haink ish stiagh ec y traa cheddin, as hug ee booise myrgeddin da'n Chiarn, as loayr ee jeh roosyn ooilley va jeeaghyn son livrey-ys ayns Jerusalem.

verses.name: Luke 2:39
verses.text: As tra v'ad er chooilleeney dy chooilley nhee cordail rish leigh yn Chiarn, haink ad reesht gys Galilee, gys yn ard-valley oc hene Nazareth.

verses.name: Luke 2:40
verses.text: As daase y lhiannoo, as v'eh er ny niartaghey 'sy spyrryd, as lhieent lesh creenaght, as va grayse Yee mârish.

verses.name: Luke 2:41
verses.text: Nish va e ayr as e voir goll seose gys Jerusalem dy chooilley vlein ec feailley ny caisht.

verses.name: Luke 2:42
verses.text: As tra v'eh daa vlein jeig dy eash, hie ad seose gys Jerusalem lurg cliaghtey ny feailley.

verses.name: Luke 2:43
verses.text: As tra va ny laghyn harrish, as ad goll thie reesht, duirree yn lhiannoo Yeesey nyn yei ayns Jerusalem, gyn-yss da Joseph as e voir.

verses.name: Luke 2:44
verses.text: Agh smooinaghtgn dy row eh ayns y cheshaght, hie ad jurnah laa; as v'ad briaght er e hon mastey nyn gheiney mooinjerey as nyn ainjys.

verses.name: Luke 2:45
verses.text: As tra nagh dooar ad eh, hie ad reesht gys Jerusalem shirrey er e hon.

verses.name: Luke 2:46
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione, lurg three laa dy dooar ad eh ayns y chiamble, ny hoie mastey ny fir-ynsee, chammah geaishtagh roo, as cur feyshtyn orroo.

verses.name: Luke 2:47
verses.text: As ghow ooilley ny va geaishtagh rish yindys jeh'n toiggal as jeh ny ansooryn echey.

verses.name: Luke 2:48
verses.text: As tra honnick ad eh, v'ad fo mooarane atchim; as dooyrt e voir rish, Vac, cre'n-fa t'ou er n'yannoo myr shoh rooin? cur-my-ner, ta dty ayr as mish er ve briaght dy trimshagh er dty hon.

verses.name: Luke 2:49
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Kys dy row shiu briaght er my hon's? nagh row fys eu dy beign dou ve mysh obbyr my Ayrey?

verses.name: Luke 2:50
verses.text: As cha row toiggyl oc jeh'n raa loayr eh roo.

verses.name: Luke 2:51
verses.text: As hie eh sheese mâroo, as haink eh gys Nazareth, as v'eh biallagh daue: as hasht e voir ooilley ny raaghyn shoh ayns e cree.

verses.name: Luke 2:52
verses.text: As ren Yeesey bishaghey ayns creenaght as aase, as ayns foayr rish Jee as dooinney.

verses.name: Luke 3:1
verses.text: NISH ayns y wheiggoo vlein jeig jeh reill, Tiberius Cesar, tra va Pontius Pilate ny chiannoort er Judea, as Herod ny hetrarch er Galilee, as e vraar Philip reill ayns Iturea as cheer Trachonitis, as Lysanias reill ayns Abilene.

verses.name: Luke 3:2
verses.text: Tra va Annas as Caiaphas nyn ard-saggyrtyn, haink goo Yee gys Ean mac Zacharias ayns yn aasagh.

verses.name: Luke 3:3
verses.text: As haink eh gys ooilley yn cheer my geayrt Jordan, preacheil bashtey arrys son leih peccaghyn.

verses.name: Luke 3:4
