verses.text: Myr te scruit ayns lioar goan Esaias yn phadeyr, gra, Coraa fer geamagh ayns yn aasagh, Kiartee-jee raad y Chiarn, jean-jee ny cassanyn echey jeeragh.

verses.name: Luke 3:5
verses.text: Bee dy chooilley choan er ny lhieeney as dy chooilley slieau as cronk er nyn injillaghey, as ny ynnydyn cammey er nyn yannoo jeeragh, as ny raaidyn garroo er nyn yannoo rea.

verses.name: Luke 3:6
verses.text: As hee dy chooilley eill saualtys Yee.

verses.name: Luke 3:7
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt eh rish y pobble v'er jeet magh huggey dy ve er nyn mashtey, O shiuish heeloghe dy ard-nieughyn, quoi t'er chur raaue diu dy hea veih yn jymmoose ta ry-heet?

verses.name: Luke 3:8
verses.text: Cur-jee magh nish er-y-fa shen messyn cooie dy arrys, as ny jean-jee toshiaght dy ghra riu hene, Ta Abraham ain son nyn ayr: son ta mee gra riu, dy vel pooar ec Jee eer jeh ny claghyn shoh cloan y hroggal seose da Abraham.

verses.name: Luke 3:9
verses.text: As nish hannah ta'n teigh er ny choyrt gys fraue ny biljyn: shen-y-fa ta dy chooilley villey nagh vel gymmyrkey mess mie, dy ve giarit sheese as tilgit ayns yn aile.

verses.name: Luke 3:10
verses.text: As denee yn pobble jeh, gra, Cre ta orrinyn dy yannoo?

verses.name: Luke 3:11
verses.text: Dreggyr eh as dooyrt eh roo, Eshyn ta daa chooat echey, lhig da y choyrt dasyn nagh vel cooat eddyr echey as eshyn ta beaghey echey, lhig da jannoo er yn aght cheddin.

verses.name: Luke 3:12
verses.text: Eisht haink myrgeddin ny publicanee dy ve er nyn mashtey, as dooyrt ad rish, Vainshter, cre ta orrinyn dy yannoo?

verses.name: Luke 3:13
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Ny trog-jee ny smoo na ta er nyn gurrym.

verses.name: Luke 3:14
verses.text: As dênee ny sidooryn myrgeddin, jeh, gra, As cre ta orrinyn dy yannoo? As dooyrt eh roo, Ny jean-jee tranlaase er dooinney erbee, ny jean-jee cassid vreagagh er dooinney erbee, as bee-jee booiagh lesh nyn vaill.

verses.name: Luke 3:15
verses.text: As myr va'n pobble ayns imnea, as dy chooilley ghooinney smooinaghtyn ayns nyn greeaghyn mychione Ean, nee eh va'n Creest mannagh nee;

verses.name: Luke 3:16
verses.text: Dreggyr Ean as dooyrt eh roo ooilley, Ta mish dy jarroo bashtey shiu lesh ushtey; agh ta fer s'pooaral na mish cheet kiangley ny braagyn echey cha vel mee feeu dy eaysley: nee eshyn shiu y vashtey lesh y Spyrryd Noo, as lesh aile.

verses.name: Luke 3:17
verses.text: Ta'n cleayst echey ayns e laue, as fasnee eh dy bollagh e laare-vooie, as gowee eh yn churnaght stiagh ayns e hie tashtee; agh yn coau nee eh y lostey lesh aile nagh bee er ny vooghey.

verses.name: Luke 3:18
verses.text: As ymmodee dy reddyn elley ren eh y choyrlaghey as y phreacheil gys y pobble.

verses.name: Luke 3:19
verses.text: Agh tra v'eh er choyrt oghsan da Herod yn Tetrarch kyndagh rish Herodias ben e vraar Philip, as ooilley ny huilk va Herod er n'yannoo,

verses.name: Luke 3:20
verses.text: Ren eh shoh marish y chooid elley, dy dug eh Ean ayns pryssoon.

verses.name: Luke 3:21
verses.text: Nish tra va ooilley'n pobble er nyn mashtey, haink eh gy-kione dy row Yeesey myrgeddin er ny vashtey, as ghow eh padjer, as va niau er ny osley;

verses.name: Luke 3:22
verses.text: As haink y Spyrryd Noo neose er, myr ayns cummey dooghyssagh calmane, as haink coraa veih niau, gra, Oo my vac ennoil, jeed ta mee dy mooar soiaghey.

verses.name: Luke 3:23
verses.text: As ghow Yeesey eh-hene toshiaght dy ve mysh jeih bleeaney as feed dy eash, as (goit dy ve) mac Yoseph, mac Heli,

verses.name: Luke 3:24
verses.text: Mac Matthat, mac Leyi, mac Melchi, mac Janna, mac Joseph,

verses.name: Luke 3:25
verses.text: Mac Mattathias, mac Amos,mac Naum, mac Esli, mac Nagge,

verses.name: Luke 3:26
verses.text: Mac Maath, mac Mattathias, mac Semei, mac Joseph, mac Juda,

verses.name: Luke 3:27
verses.text: Mac Joanna, mac Rhesa, mac Zorobabel, mac Salathiel, mac Neri,

verses.name: Luke 3:28
verses.text: Mac Melchi, mac Addi, mac Cosam, mac Elmodam, mac Er,

verses.name: Luke 3:29
verses.text: Mac Jose, mac Eliezer, mac Jorim, mac Matthat, mac Levi,

verses.name: Luke 3:30
verses.text: Mac Simeon, mac Juda, mac Joseph, mac Jonan, mac Eliakim,

verses.name: Luke 3:31
verses.text: Mac Melea, mac Menan, mac Mattatha, mac Nathan, mac David,

verses.name: Luke 3:32
verses.text: Mac Jesse, mac Obed, mac Booz, mac Salmon, mac Naasson,

verses.name: Luke 3:33
verses.text: Mac Aminadab, mac Aram, mac Esrom, mac Phares, mac Juda

verses.name: Luke 3:34
verses.text: Mac Jacob, mac Isaac, mac Abraham, mac Thara, mac Nachor,

verses.name: Luke 3:35
verses.text: Mac Saruch, mac Ragan, mac Phalec, mac Heber, mac Sala.

verses.name: Luke 3:36
verses.text: Mac Cainan, mac Arphaxad, mac Sem, mac Noe, mac Lamech,

verses.name: Luke 3:37
verses.text: Mac Mathusala. mac Enoch, mac Ja red, mac Maleleel, mac Cainan,

verses.name: Luke 3:38
verses.text: Mac Enos, mac Seth, mac Adam, mac Yee.

verses.name: Luke 4:1
verses.text: As va Yeesey lane jeh'n Spyrryd Noo, as hyndaa eh veih Jordan, as v'eh er ny leeideil liorish y Spyrryd gys yn aasagh,

verses.name: Luke 4:2
verses.text: As v'eh da-eed laa er ny violaghey liorish y drogh-spyrryd, as ayns ny laghyn shen cha d'ee eh veg; as tra v'ad harrish, v'eh ny lurg shen accryssagh.

verses.name: Luke 4:3
verses.text: As dooyrt y drogh-spyrryd rish, My she Mac Yee oo, abbyr rish yn chlagh shoh dy ve jeant ny arran.

verses.name: Luke 4:4
verses.text: As dreggyr Yeesey eh, gra, Te scruit, Nagh nee er arran ny-lomarcan nee dooinney beaghey, agh liorish ooilley goan Yee.

verses.name: Luke 4:5
verses.text: As hug y drogh-spyrryd lesh seose eh gys mullagh slieau ard, as ayns y tullogh hug eh shilley da jeh ooilley reeriaghtyn y theihll.

verses.name: Luke 4:6
verses.text: As dooyrt y drogh-spyrryd rish, Ooilley yn phooar shoh ver-ym dhyt's, as y ghloyr oc; son ta shen er ny livrey dou, as da quoi-erbee saillym, ta mee dy choyrt eh.

verses.name: Luke 4:7
verses.text: My ver oo er-y-fa shen ooashley dou bee ooilley lhiat hene.

verses.name: Luke 4:8
verses.text: As dreggyr Yeesey as dooyrt eh rish, Ass my enish oo, Noid-ny-hanmey: son te scruit, Ver oo ooashley da'n Chiarn dty Yee, as eshyn ynrycan nee oo y hirveish.

verses.name: Luke 4:9
verses.text: As hug eh lesh eh gys Jerusalem, as hoie eh eh er beinn toor syrjey yn chiamble, as dooyrt eh rish, My she Mac Yee oo, tilg oo hene sheese veih shoh.

verses.name: Luke 4:10
verses.text: Son te scruit, Ver eh currym da e ainleyn harryd, dy dty reayll:

verses.name: Luke 4:11
verses.text: As ayns nyn laueyn nee ad oo y ymmyrkey, er-aggle ec traa erbee dy bwoaill oo dty chass noi clagh.

verses.name: Luke 4:12
verses.text: As dreggyr Yeesey as dooyrt eh rish, Te er ny ghra, Cha jean oo daanys er y Chiarn dty Yee.

verses.name: Luke 4:13
verses.text: As erreish da'n drogh-spyrryd v'er n'yannoo jerrey er ooilley yn violagh, daag eh eh son earish.

verses.name: Luke 4:14
verses.text: As haink Yeesey reesht ayns pooar y spyrryd gys Galilee: as hie goo magh jeh trooid ooilley yn cheer mygeayrt.

verses.name: Luke 4:15
verses.text: As dynsee eh ayns ny kialteenyn oc, as v'eh ayns ard-voylley rish y theay.

verses.name: Luke 4:16
verses.text: As haink eh gys Nazareth, raad v'eh er ny ve troggit: as hie eh, myr v'eh cliaghtey, stiagh ayns y synagogue er laa yn doonaght, as hass eh seose dy lhaih.

verses.name: Luke 4:17
verses.text: As va lioar y phadeyr Esaias er ny livrey da, as tra v'eh er vosley yn lioar, hooar eh yn ynnyd raad v'eh scruit,

verses.name: Luke 4:18
verses.text: Ta spyrryd y Chiarn orrym's, er-y-fa dy vel eh er my ooillaghey dy phreacheil y sushtal gys ny boghtyn, t'eh er my choyrt dy laanaghey yn vooinjer hrome-chreeagh, dy phreacheil livrey-ys gys ny cappeeyn, dy chur soilshey da ny doail, as reamys dauesyn ta broojit,

verses.name: Luke 4:19
verses.text: Dy phreacheil blein eunyssagh y Chiarn.

verses.name: Luke 4:20
verses.text: As yeigh eh yn lioar, as hug eh ee reesht da'n chirveishagh, as hoie eh sheese: as va sooillyn dy chooilley unnane v'ayns y synagogue dy jeean soit er.

verses.name: Luke 4:21
verses.text: As ren eh toshiaght dy ghra roo, Jiu ta'n scriptyr shoh cooilleenit ayns y chlashtyn euish.

verses.name: Luke 4:22
verses.text: As dymmyrk ad ooilley feanish lesh, as ghow ad yindys jeh ny goan graysoil haink ass y veeal echey. As dooyrt ad, Nagh nee shoh mac Yoseph?

verses.name: Luke 4:23
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Jir shiu ayns shickyrys yn chenn raa shoh rhym, Er-lhee, jean oo hene y lheihys: cre-erbee ta shin er chlashtyn va jeant ayns Capernaum, jean myrgeddin ayns shoh ayns dty heer hene.

verses.name: Luke 4:24
verses.text: As dooyrt eh, Dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, Nagh vel soiagh jeant jeh phadeyr erbee ayns e heer hene.

verses.name: Luke 4:25
verses.text: Agh ta mee ginsh diu ayns firrinys, dy row ymmodee mraane treoghe ayns Israel rish hing Elias, tra va'n aer jeight seose three bleeaney as shey meeghyn, tra va genney vooar trooid ooilley yn cheer:

verses.name: Luke 4:26
verses.text: Agh gys unnane oc cha row Elias er ny choyrt, cheu mooie jeh gys Sarepta ard-valley dy Sidon, gys ben-treoghe v'ayns shen.

verses.name: Luke 4:27
verses.text: As va ymmodee louranee ayns Israel rish traa Eliseus yn phadeyr, as cha row fer jeu er ny ghlenney, cheu-mooie jeh Naaman yn Syrian.

verses.name: Luke 4:28
verses.text: As va ooilley ny v'ayns y synagogue tra cheayll ad ny goan shoh, lhieent lesh jymmoose,

verses.name: Luke 4:29
verses.text: As dirree ad, as deiyr ad eh magh ass yn ard-valley, as hug ad lhieu eh gys broogh yn chronk (er va'n ard-valley oc troggit) ry-hoi tilgey sheese eh gour e vullee.

verses.name: Luke 4:30
verses.text: Agh hie eh magh trooid mean y cheshaght, as jimmee eh roish:

verses.name: Luke 4:31
verses.text: As haink eh neose gys Capernaum, ard-valley dy Ghalilee, as dynsee eh ad er laghyn y doonaght.

verses.name: Luke 4:32
verses.text: As ghow ad yindys mooar jeh'n ynsaghey echey: son va e ghoo lesh pooar.

verses.name: Luke 4:33
verses.text: As ayns y synagogue va dooinney seaghnit lesh spyrryd neu-ghlen, as dyllee eh lesh ard-choraa.

verses.name: Luke 4:34
verses.text: Gra, Faag shin; cre'n eie t'ayd orrin uss Yeesey dy Nazareth? vel oo er jeet dy nyn stroie? ta fys aym quoi oo hene; Fer-casherick Yee.

verses.name: Luke 4:35
verses.text: As hug Yeesey oghsan da, gra Bee dty-host, as tar magh ass. As tra va'n drogh spyrryd er hilgey neeal eh, haink eh magh ass, gyn assee da.

verses.name: Luke 4:36
verses.text: As v'ad ooilley fo atchim, as loayr ad ny mast' oc hene, gra, Cre'n fockle (vreeoil) shoh? son lesh pooar as niart t'eh cur ny spyrrydyn neu ghlen fo harey, as t'ad cheet magh.

verses.name: Luke 4:37
verses.text: As hie goo magh jeh trooid dy chooilley ard jeh'n cheer mygeayrt.

verses.name: Luke 4:38
verses.text: As hrog eh magh ass y synagogoe, as hie eh stiagh ayns thie Simon: as va moir ben Simon feer ching ayns y chiassaghey; as ren ad aghin huggey er e son.

verses.name: Luke 4:39
verses.text: As hass eh er-e-skyn, as hug eh oghsan da'n chiassaghey, as daag eh ee. As chelleeragh dirree ee seose, as ren ee shirveish orroo.

verses.name: Luke 4:40
verses.text: Nish ec lhie ny greiney, whilleen as va sleih chingey oc fo mooarane doghanyn hug ad lhieu ad huggey; as hug eh e laueyn er dy chooilley unnane oc, as ren eh ad y lheihys.

verses.name: Luke 4:41
verses.text: As haink drogh-spyrrydyn myrgeddin magh ass ymmodee, gyllagh as gra, Oo yn Creest Mac Yee. As hug eh oghsan daue, as cha lhig eh daue loayrt; son va fys oc dy nee eh va'n Creest.

verses.name: Luke 4:42
verses.text: As 'sy vadran, jimmee eh roish, as hie eh gys boayl er-lheh: as va'n pobble briaght er e hon, as cheet huggey, as chionney er, eh dy uirriaght mâroo.

verses.name: Luke 4:43
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Shegin dooys reeriaght Yee y phreacheil gys ard-valjyn elley myrgeddin: son er yn oyr shen ta mee er my choyrt.

verses.name: Luke 4:44
verses.text: As ren eh preacheil ayns kialteenyn Ghalilee.

verses.name: Luke 5:1
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione myr va'n pobble chionney stiagh er dy chlashtyn goo Yee, as eh ny hassoo liorish faarkey Ghennesareth,

verses.name: Luke 5:2
verses.text: As honnick eh daa lhong rish oirr y traie: agh va ny eeasteyryn er n'gholl assdoo, as v'ad niee yn lieen.

verses.name: Luke 5:3
verses.text: As hie eh er-board unnane jeh ny lhongyn va lesh Simon, as ghuee eh er, eh dy heiy magh tammylt veih yn thalloo: as hoie eh sheese, as dynsee eh yn pobble ass y lhong.

verses.name: Luke 5:4
verses.text: Nish tra v'eh erreish loayrt, dooyrt eh rish Simon, Ymmyrt-jee magh gys y diunid, as cuir-jee yn lieen son tayrn.

verses.name: Luke 5:5
verses.text: As dreggyr Simon as dooyrt eh rish, Vainshter, ta shin er hooilleil fud ny hoie, as cha vel shin er ghoaill monney: ny-yeih er dty ockle's cuir-yms yn lieen.

verses.name: Luke 5:6
verses.text: As tra v'ad er n'yannoo shoh chruinnee ad dy cheilley lheid yn earroo mooar dy eeastyn; dy row yn lieen oc brishey.

verses.name: Luke 5:7
verses.text: As chrie ad er ny parteeassyn oc v'ayns y lhong elley, ad dy heet dy chooney lhieu. As haink ad, as lhieen ad y daa lhong, myr shen dy row ad ayns gaue goll fo.

verses.name: Luke 5:8
verses.text: Tra honnick Simon Peddyr shoh, huitt eh sheese ec glioonyn Yeesey, gra, Immee voym, son ta mee my ghooinney peccoil, O Hiarn.

verses.name: Luke 5:9
verses.text: Son ghow eshyn, as ooilley ny va mârish, yindys mooar jeh'n lught dy eeastyn v'ad er ghoaill:

verses.name: Luke 5:10
verses.text: Myr ren neesht Jamys as Ean mec Zebedee, va nyn barteeassyn marish Simon. As dooyrt Yeesey rish Simon, Ny bee aggle ort, veih shoh magh nee oo goaill deiney.

verses.name: Luke 5:11
verses.text: As tra v'ad er chur lhieu nyn lhongyn gys thalloo, hreig ad ooilley, as deiyr ad er.

verses.name: Luke 5:12
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione, tra v'eh ayns ard-valley dy row, cur-my-ner, dooinney lane jeh'n louraneys: as tra honnick eh Yeesey, huitt eh sheese er e eddin, jannoo aghin huggey as gra, Hiarn, my she dty aigney eh, foddee oo mish y yannoo glen.

verses.name: Luke 5:13
verses.text: As heeyn eh magh e laue, as venn eh rish, gra, M'aigney's eh; bee er dty ghlenney. As chelleeragh daag y louraneys eh.

verses.name: Luke 5:14
verses.text: As hug eh currym er gyn eh dy insh shoh da dooinney erbee: agh immee, as jeeagh oo hene da'n taggyrt, as cheb son dty ghlenney, myr ta Moses er harey, dy ve son feanish daue.

verses.name: Luke 5:15
verses.text: Agh wheesh shen smoo hie goo magh jeh: as haink earrooyn mooarey dy leih cooidjagh dy chlashtyn, as dy ve er nyn lheihys liorish jeh nyn aslayntyn.

verses.name: Luke 5:16
verses.text: Agh hie eshyn eh-hene roish gys yn aasagh, dy ghoaill padjer.

verses.name: Luke 5:17
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione laa dy row, myr v'eh gynsaghey, dy row Phariseeyn as fir-ynsee yn leigh nyn soie liorish, v'er jeet magh ass ooilley baljyn Ghalilee, as Judea as Jerusalem: as va pooar y Chiarn feer vreeoil mârish ayns lheihys doghanyn.

verses.name: Luke 5:18
verses.text: As cur-my-ner, hug sleih lhieu ayns lhiabbee dooinney va ching jeh'n palsee: as v'ad shirrey y chur lhieu stiagh eh, dy hoiaghey eh kiongoyrt rish

verses.name: Luke 5:19
verses.text: As tra nagh row saase erbee oc dy chur lhieu stiagh eh kyndagh rish chennid y phobble, hie ad seose er mullagh y thie, as lhig ad sheese ny hrooid, eh-hene as e lhaibbee, er y laare kiongoyrt rish Yeesey.

verses.name: Luke 5:20
verses.text: As tra hug eh tastey da'n chredjue oc, dooyrt eh rish, Ghooinney, ta dty pheccaghyn er nyn leih dhyt.

verses.name: Luke 5:21
verses.text: As ren ny scrudeyryn as ny Phariseeyn toshiaght dy phleadeil ry-cheilley, gra, Quoi eh shoh ta loayrt goan mollaghtagh? Quoi oddys peccaghyn y leih, agh Jee ny lomarcan?

verses.name: Luke 5:22
verses.text: Agh va fys ec Yeesey er ny smooinaghtyn oc, as dreggyr eh, as dooyrt eh roo, Cre er ta shiu resooney ayns nyn greeaghyn?

verses.name: Luke 5:23
verses.text: Quoi sassey dy ghra, Ta dty pheccagh yn er nyn leih dhyt, ny dy ghra, Irree seose as shooill?

verses.name: Luke 5:24
verses.text: Agh dy vod fys y ve eu, dy vel pooar ec Mac y dooinney er y thalloo dy leih peccaghyn (dooyrt eh rishyn va ching jeh'n chingys craa-ee.) Ta mee gra rhtt, Irree, as trog seose dty lhiabbee, as gow royd gys dty hie.

verses.name: Luke 5:25
verses.text: As chelleeragh dirree eh seose kiongoyrt roo, as hrog eh shen v'eh ny lhie er, as jimmee eh gys e hie, cur moylley da Jee.

verses.name: Luke 5:26
verses.text: As ghow ad ooilley lane yindys, as ren ad Jee y ghloyraghey, as v'ad lhieent lesh aggle, gra, Ta shin er vakin reddyn yindyssagh jiu.

verses.name: Luke 5:27
verses.text: As ny lurg shoh hie eh magh, as honnick eh publican va enmyssit Levi, ny hoie ec boayrd y cheesh: as dooyrt eh rish, Eiyr orrym's.

verses.name: Luke 5:28
verses.text: As daag eh ooilley as dirree eh seose, as deiyr eh er.

verses.name: Luke 5:29
verses.text: As ren Levi aarlaghey mooar er e hon ayns e hie hene: as va sheshaght vooar dy phublicanee as dy eallagh elley nyn soie ec y voayrd mâroo.

verses.name: Luke 5:30
verses.text: Agh va ny scrudeyryn oc as ny Phariseeyn jymmoosagh rish e ynseydee, gra, Cre'n-fa ta shiu gee as giu marish publicanee as peccee?

verses.name: Luke 5:31
verses.text: As dreggyr Yeesey as dooyrt eh roo, Cha vel feme ocsyn ta slane er yn er-lhee: agh ec sleih chingey.

verses.name: Luke 5:32
verses.text: Cha daink mish dy eamagh er yn vooinjer chairagh, agh er peccee gys arrys.

verses.name: Luke 5:33
verses.text: As dooyrt ad roo, Cre'n-fa ta ynseydee Ean trostey dy mennick, as jannoo padjeryn, as myrgeddin ynseydee ny Phariseeyn; agh ta'n vooinjer ayd's gee as giu?

verses.name: Luke 5:34
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Bailliu mooinjer y chamyr-phoosee dy hrostey, choud as ta dooinney yn phoosee mâroo?

verses.name: Luke 5:35
verses.text: Agh hig ny laghyn, tra vees dooinney yn phoosee er ny ghoaill ersooyl voue, as eisht nee ad trostey ayns ny laghyn shen.

verses.name: Luke 5:36
verses.text: As loayr eh myrgeddin coraa-dorraghey roo, Cha vel dooinney erbee cur peesh dy eaddagh noa er shenn gharmad: er-nonney, ta chammah yn noa raipey yn laane lesh, as cha vel yn pheesh va goit ass yn noa coardail rish y chenn

verses.name: Luke 5:37
verses.text: As cha vel dooinney erbee cur feeyn noa ayns shenn voteilyn er-nonney scoltee yn feeyn noa ny boteilyn, as bee eh deayrit, as bee ny boteilyn dy choayl er.

verses.name: Luke 5:38
verses.text: Agh shegin da feeyn noa v'er ny chur ayns boteilyn noa; as t'ad ny-neesht sauchey.

verses.name: Luke 5:39
verses.text: Chamoo ta dooinney erbee, erreish da v'er n'iu shenn feeyn, chelleeragh shirrey feeyn noa: son t'eh gra, Ta'n shenn ny share.

verses.name: Luke 6:1
verses.text: AS haink eh gy-kione er y chied doonaght lurg yn nah laa jeh'n chaisht, myr v'eh goll trooid ny magheryn-arrooo dy ren e ynseydee ny jeeassyn y phluckey, as rubbey yn arroo assdoo ayns nyn laueyn ren ad gee jeh.

verses.name: Luke 6:2
verses.text: As dooyrt shiartanse jeh ny Phariseeyn roo, Cre'n-fa ta shiu jannoo shen nagh vel lowal dy ve jeant er laghyn y doonaght?

verses.name: Luke 6:3
verses.text: As dreggyr Yeesey ad, gra, Nagh vel shiu er lhaih wheesh shoh, cre ren David tra v'eh hene as e heshaght accryssagh:

verses.name: Luke 6:4
verses.text: Kys hie eh stiagh ayns thie Yee, as ghow eh as d'ee eh yn arran casherick, as hug eh eh myrgeddin dauesyn va marish, ga nagh row eh lowit dy ve eeit, agh liorish ny sag gyrtyn ny-lomarcan?

verses.name: Luke 6:5
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Dy row yn Mac dooinney ny Hiarn myrgeddin er y doonaght.

verses.name: Luke 6:6
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione er doonaght elley, dy jagh eh stiagh ayns y synagogne, as dy dynsee eh: as va dooinney ayns shen va'n laue yesh echey er shyrgaghey.

verses.name: Luke 6:7
verses.text: As va sooill gheyre ec ny scruderyn as ny Phariseeyn er, dy yeeaghyn jinnag eh eh y lheihys er laa yn doonaght: dy voddagh cooish chassid 've oc n'oi.

verses.name: Luke 6:8
verses.text: Agh va fys echeysyn er ny smooinaghtyn oc, as dooyrt eh rish y dooinney lesh y laue shyrgit, Irree seose as shass magh er y laare. As dirree eh, as hass eh magh.

verses.name: Luke 6:9
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt Yeesey roo, Fênyms un red jiuish, Vel eh lowal er laghyn y doonaght dy yannoo mie, ny dy yannoo olk? dy hauail bioys, ny dy stroie eh?

verses.name: Luke 6:10
verses.text: As yeeagh eh mygeayrt orroo ooilley, as dooyrt eh rish y dooinney, Sheeyn magh dty laue. As ren eh shen; as va'n laue echey er ny lheihys myr y laue elley.

verses.name: Luke 6:11
verses.text: As v'adsyn myr deiney baanrit; as hug ad nyn goyrle dy cheilley, cre dy yannoo rish Yeesey.

verses.name: Luke 6:12
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione ayns ny laghyn shen, dy jagh eh seose er slieau dy ghoaill padjer, as dy ren eh tannaghtyn fud ny hoie ayns padjer gys Jee.

verses.name: Luke 6:13
verses.text: As tra va'n laa er hoilshagh, deïe eh er e ynseydee huggey: as jeusyn reih eh ghhaa-yeig, denmys eh myrgeddin nyn os tyllyn:

verses.name: Luke 6:14
verses.text: Simon (denmys eh myrgeddin Peddyr) as Andreays e vraar, Jamys as Ean, Philip as Parlane,

verses.name: Luke 6:15
verses.text: Mian as Thomase, Jamys mac Alpheus, as Simon va enmyssit Zelotes

verses.name: Luke 6:16
verses.text: As Judas braar Yamys, as Yuaase Iscariot, va myrgeddin yn traitoor.

verses.name: Luke 6:17
verses.text: As haink eh neose maroo gys y cheer-rea, as haggil huggey sheshaght e eiyrtee, as earroo mooar dy leih veih ooilley Judea as Jerusalem, as veih ardjyn ny marrey Tyre as Sidon, haink dy eaishtagh rish, as dy ve er nyn lheihys jeh nyn ghoghanyn;

verses.name: Luke 6:18
verses.text: As adsyn va seaghnit lesh spyrrydyn neu-ghlen; as v'ad er nyn lheihys.

verses.name: Luke 6:19
verses.text: As va'n slane chaglym shirrey bentyn rish: son va bree goll magh ass, va dyn lheihys ad ooilley.

verses.name: Luke 6:20
verses.text: As hrog eh seose e hooillyn er e eiyrtee, as dooyrt eh, Bannit ta shiuish voghtyn: son lhieuish reeriaght Yee.

verses.name: Luke 6:21
verses.text: Bannit ta shiuish ta accryssagh nish: son bee shiu er nyn yannoo magh. Bannit ta shiuish ta nish dobberan: son nee shiu garaghtee.

verses.name: Luke 6:22
verses.text: Bannit ta shiuish, tra ta deiney cur feoh diu, as tra nee ad nyn scarrey shiu voue, as nyn oltooaney shiu, as nyn ennym y ghiarey magh myr olk, er coontey Mac y dooinney.

verses.name: Luke 6:23
verses.text: Bee-jee dy ghien mie ayns y laa shen, as lheim-jee son boggey son cur-my-ner, s'mooar ta nyn leagh ayns niau: son er yn aght cheddin ren ny shenn-ayryn oc rish ny phadeyryn.

verses.name: Luke 6:24
verses.text: Agh smerg diuish verchee: son ta shiu er gheddyn nyn gherjagh.

verses.name: Luke 6:25
verses.text: Smerg diuish ta lane: son bee shiu accryssagh. Smerg diuish ta garaghtee nish: son nee shiu dobberan as keayney.

verses.name: Luke 6:26
verses.text: Smerg diuish tra nee dy chooilley ghooinney loayrt dy mie jiu: son shen myr ren ny ayraghyn oc jeh ny phadeyryn foalsey.

verses.name: Luke 6:27
verses.text: Agh ta mish gra riuish ta clashtyn, Bee-jee graihagh er nyn noidyn, bee-jee dooie roosyn ta cur feoh diu:

verses.name: Luke 6:28
verses.text: Bannee-jee adsyn ta gwee mollaght diu, as gow-jee padjer er nyn son ocsyn ta cur seaghyn erriu.

verses.name: Luke 6:29
verses.text: As huggeysyn woaillys oo er y derrey lieckan, chyndaa myrgeddin yn lieckan elley: as eshyn ghoys ersooyl dty chloagey, ny bee noi dty chooat y lhiggey lesh myrgeddin.

verses.name: Luke 6:30
verses.text: Cur da dy chooilley ghooinney ta jannoo aghin hood; as jehsyn ta goaill ersooyl dty chooid voïd, ny shir ad reesht.

verses.name: Luke 6:31
verses.text: As myr bailliuish deiney dy yannoo riuish, jean-jee shiuish myrgeddin roosyn.

verses.name: Luke 6:32
verses.text: Son my ta shiu dooie dauesyn ta dooie riu, s'beg ta nyn mooise; son ta eer drogh-yantee dooie dauesyn ta dooie roo.

verses.name: Luke 6:33
verses.text: As my ta shiu jannoo mie dauesyn ta jannoo mie diuish, cre'n booise ta nyn gour? son ta ny eer drogh-yantee jannoo yn lheid cheddin.

verses.name: Luke 6:34
verses.text: As my ta shiu geeasaght dauesyn voue ta shiu jeeaghyn son cooilleeney, cre ta nyn mooise? son ta eer drogh-sleih geeasaght da drogh-sleih; dy gheddyn wheesh cheddin reesht.

verses.name: Luke 6:35
verses.text: Agh cur-jee graih da nyn noidyn, as jean-jee mie, as eeasee-jee, fegooish jerkal rish veg y gheddyn reesht: as s'mooar vees nyn leagh! as bee shiu cloan yn Er-syrjey: son t'eh dooie da'n vooinjer neu-wooisal as ny mee-chrauee.

verses.name: Luke 6:36
verses.text: Bee-jee er-y-fa shen myghinagh, myr ta'n Ayr eu myrgeddin myghinagh.

verses.name: Luke 6:37
verses.text: Ny jean-jee briwnys, as cha bee shiu er nyn mriwnys: ny jean-jee deyrey, as cha bee shiu er nyn gheyrey: leih-jee, as yiow shiu leih:

verses.name: Luke 6:38
verses.text: Jean-jee coyrt, as bee eh er ny choyrt diu; towse mie, jingit sheese, as criht cooidjagh, as roie harrish, ver deiney diu ayns nyn oghrish. Son lesh y towse cheddin ta shiu towse, bee eh er ny howse diu reesht.

verses.name: Luke 6:39
verses.text: As loayr eh coraa-dorraghey roo, Vod y doal shooyll kione y doal? as nagh duitt ad ny-neesht ayns y jeeg?

verses.name: Luke 6:40
verses.text: Cha vel y schoillar erskyn e vainshter: agh bee dy chooilley unnane ta slane-ynsit, corrym rish e vainshter.

verses.name: Luke 6:41
verses.text: As cre'n-fa t'ou cronnaghey yn brenneein t'ayns sooill dty vraarey, agh cha vel oo gennaghtyn yn darrag t'ayns dty hooill hene?

verses.name: Luke 6:42
verses.text: Ny kys oddys oo gra rish dty vraar, Vraar, lhig dou yn brenneein y ghoaill ass dty hooill's, tra nagh vel oo goaill tastey dy vel darrag ayns dty hooill hene? Er-crauee-oalsey, tilg hoshiaght yn darrag ass dty hooill hene, eisht bee soilshey ayd dy ghoaill yn brenneein ass sooill dty vraarey.

verses.name: Luke 6:43
verses.text: Son cha vel billey mie tilgey drogh vess: ny drogh villey tilgey mess mie.

verses.name: Luke 6:44
verses.text: Son ta dy chooilley villey er ny chronnaghey liorish e vess: son cha vel mess y villey figgagh er ny heiy jeh drineyn, ny mess y villey-feeyney jeh thammag-ghress.

verses.name: Luke 6:45
verses.text: Ta dooinney mie ass stoyr mie e chree, cur magh shen ny ta mie: as drogh-ghooinney ass drogh stoyr e chree, gymmyrkey shen ny ta olk: son magh ass stoyr y chree ta'n beeal loayrt.

verses.name: Luke 6:46
verses.text: As cre'n-fa ta shiu dy my enmys Hiarn, Hiarn, fegooish jannoo ny reddyn ta mee dy ghra?

verses.name: Luke 6:47
verses.text: Quoi-erbee ta cheet hym's, as clashtyn my ghoan, as jannoo ymmyd mie jeu, jeeaghym's diu quoi rish t'eh er ny hoylaghey.

verses.name: Luke 6:48
verses.text: T'eh er ny hoylaghey rish dooinney ren thie y hroggal, as chleiy dy dowin, as hoie yn undin er creg: as tra dhatt yn ushtey, vrish yn thooilley stiagh dy trome er y thie shen, agh cha yiarg eh er y chraa eh; er-yn-oyr dy row yn undin echey er creg.

verses.name: Luke 6:49
verses.text: Agh eshyn ta clashtyn as nagh vel jannoo ymmyd mie jeh, t'eh goll-rish dooinney, ren fegooish undin thie y hroggal er yn ooir, as ren y thooilley brishey stiagh dy trome, as chelleeragh huitt eh, as s'mooar va toyrt-mow yn thie shen.

verses.name: Luke 7:1
verses.text: NISH tra v'eh erreish ooilley ny goan shoh y loayrt ayns clashtyn y phobble, hie eh stiagh ayns Calpernaum.

verses.name: Luke 7:2
verses.text: As va centurion dy row va fer-mooinjerey echey, v'eh dy mooar soiaghey jeh, as v'eh ching, as raad y vaaish.

verses.name: Luke 7:3
verses.text: As tra cheayll eh jeh Yeesey, hug eh shanstyr ny Hewnyn huggey, guee er eh dy heet dy laanaghey e er-mooinjerey.

verses.name: Luke 7:4
verses.text: As tra v'ad er jeet gys Yeesey, ren ad aghin huggey dy jeean, gra, Dy row eshyn feeu v'eh dy yannoo shoh er y hon:

verses.name: Luke 7:5
verses.text: Son t'eh ny charrey da'n ashoon ain, as t'eh er hroggal synagogue dooin.

verses.name: Luke 7:6
verses.text: Eisht hie Yeesey mâroo. As tra v'eh er jeet er-gerrey da'n thie, hug y centurion caarjyn huggey, gra rish, Hiarn, ny boir oo hene, son cha vel mish feeu oo dy heet stiagh fo my chlea.

verses.name: Luke 7:7
verses.text: As er-yn-oyr shen cha yeeagh mee orrym pene dy ve feeu dy heet hood: agh loayr y fockle, as nee my er-mooinjerey coural.

verses.name: Luke 7:8
verses.text: Son ta mish mee hene my ghooinney ayns pooar, as ta sidooryn aym foym, as ta mee gra rish shoh, Immee, as t'eh goll: as rish fer elley, Tar, as t'eh cheet: as rish my harvaant, Jean shoh, as t'eh dy yannoo eh.

verses.name: Luke 7:9
verses.text: Tra cheayll Yeesey shoh, ghow eh yindys, as hyndaa eh mygeayrt, as dooyrt eh rish y pobble va geiyrt er, Ta mee gra riu, Lheid y credjue lajer shoh, cha vel mee er gheddyn ayns Israel hene.

verses.name: Luke 7:10
verses.text: As tra haink ny chaghteryn reesht gys y thie, hooar ad dy row yn fer-mooinjerey va ching dy slane er choural.

verses.name: Luke 7:11
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione yn laa er-giyn dy jagh eh gys ard-valley va enmyssit Nain, as hie ymmodee jeh e ynseydee marish, as mooarrane sleih.

verses.name: Luke 7:12
verses.text: Nish tra haink eh er-gerrey da giat yn ard-valley, cur-my-ner, va sleih cur lhieu magh dooinney marroo, va ny ynrycan mac da e voir, as v'eeish ny ben-treoghe: as va ymmodee jeh sleih yn ard-valley mâree.

verses.name: Luke 7:13
verses.text: As tra honnick y Chiarn ee, va chymmey echey urree, as dooyrt eh r'ee, Ny jean keayney.

verses.name: Luke 7:14
verses.text: As haink eh, as venn eh rish y carbyd (as hass adsyn va fo) as dooyrt eh, Ghooinney aeg, ta mee gra rhyt, Irree.

verses.name: Luke 7:15
verses.text: As hoie yn dooinney marroo seose, as ren eh toshiaght dy loayrt: as livrey eh eh gys e vo1r.

verses.name: Luke 7:16
verses.text: As haink aggle orroo ooilley: as hug ad moylley da Jee, gra, Ta phadeyr mooar er n'irree seose ny mast' ain; as, Ta Jee er yeeaghyn er e phobble.

verses.name: Luke 7:17
verses.text: As hie yn goo shoh magh my-e-chione trooid ooilley Judea, as trooid ooilley yn cheer mygeayrt.

verses.name: Luke 7:18
verses.text: As hug ynseydee Ean coontey da jeh ooilley ny reddyn shoh.

verses.name: Luke 7:19
verses.text: As deie Ean er jees jeh e ynseydee as hug eh ad er chaghteraght gys Yeesey, gra, Nee uss Eh va ry-hoi cheet, ny vel shin dy yeeaghyn son fer elley?

verses.name: Luke 7:20
verses.text: Tra va ny deiney er jeet huggey, dooyrt ad, Ta Ean Bastey er nyn goyrt shin dy ênaght jeed, Nee uss Eh va ry-hoi cheet, ny vel shin dy yeeaghyn son fer elley?

verses.name: Luke 7:21
verses.text: As ayns yn oor cheddin v'eh lheihys ymmodee jeh ny aslayntyn as ny doghanyn, as ny drogh-spyrrydyn oc, as da ymmodee va doal v'eh coyrt soilshey.

verses.name: Luke 7:22
verses.text: Eisht dregyr Yeesey as dooyrt eh roo, Immee-jee reue, as insh-jee da Ean cre y reddyn ta shiu er vakin as er chlashtyn kys dy vel ny doail geddyn nyn soilshey, ny croobee shooyll, ny louraanee er nyn ghlenney, ny beuyr clashtyn, ny merriu er nyn mioghey, as y sushtal er ny phreacheil da ny boghtyn.

verses.name: Luke 7:23
verses.text: As bannit ta eshyn nagh jean beg y hoiaghey jeem's.

verses.name: Luke 7:24
verses.text: As tra va chaghteryn Ean er n'immeeaght, ren eh toshiaght dy ghra rish y pobble mychione Ean, Cre hie shiu magh gys yn aasagh dy akin? Nee cuirtliagh criht lesh y gheay.

verses.name: Luke 7:25
verses.text: Agh cre hie shiu magh dy akin? Dooinney soit magh ayns coamrey moyrnagh! Cur-my-ner t'adsyn ta ceau coamrey costal, as farrail dy seyr, ayns plaaseyn reeoil.

verses.name: Luke 7:26
verses.text: Agh cre hie shiu magh dy akin? Phadeyr? dy jarroo, ta mee gra riu, as fer s'ooasle na phadeyr.

verses.name: Luke 7:27
verses.text: Shoh eh jeh te scruit, Cur-my-ner, ta mee cur my haghter magh royd, dy chiartaghey yn raad kiongoyrt rhyt.

verses.name: Luke 7:28
verses.text: Son ta mee gra riu, Ny mast' oc syn t'er nyn ruggey jeh mraane, cha vel phadeyr syrjey na Ean Bashtey: agh ta'n fer sloo t'ayns reeriaght Yee ny syrjey na eshyn.

verses.name: Luke 7:29
verses.text: As ren ooilley yn pobble cheayll eh as ny publicanee Jee y heyrey, as v'ad er nyn mashtey lesh bashtey Ean.

verses.name: Luke 7:30
verses.text: Agh ren ny Phariseeyn as fir-ynsee yn leigh soiaghey beg jeh coyrle Yee nyn 'oï oc hene, as cha row ad er nyn mashtey liorish.

verses.name: Luke 7:31
verses.text: As dooyrt y Chiarn, Cre gys nee'm deiney yn cheeloghe shoh y hoylaghey? as cre rish t'ad goll?

verses.name: Luke 7:32
verses.text: T'ad goll-rish cloan, ta nyn soie ayns ny margaghyn, geamagh yn derrey yeh gys y jeh elley, as gra, Ta shin er n'yannoo bingys diu, as cha vel shiu er ghaunsin: ta shin er hroggal bardoon diu, as cha vel shiu er ghobberan.

verses.name: Luke 7:33
verses.text: Son cha daink Ean Bashtey gee arran, ny giu feeyn; as ta shiu gra, Ta drogh spyrryd echey.

verses.name: Luke 7:34
verses.text: Ta'n Mac dooinney er jeet gee as giu; as ta shiu gra, Cur-my-ner dooinney jollyssagh, as iuder-feeyney, carrey dy phublicanee as dy pheccee.

verses.name: Luke 7:35
verses.text: Agh ta creenaght er ny heyrey liorish ooilley e cloan.

verses.name: Luke 7:36
verses.text: As chuir fer jeh ny Phariseeyn eh gys bee marish. As hie eh stiagh ayns thie yn Pharisee, as hoie eh sheese gys bee.

verses.name: Luke 7:37
verses.text: As cur-my-ner va ben ayns yn ard-valley, va ny drogh yantagh, tra va fys eck dy row Yeesey ny hoie ec bee ayns thie yn Pharisee, hug ee lh'ee box alabaster dy ooil chostal.

verses.name: Luke 7:38
verses.text: As hass ee ec e chassyn cheu e chooylloo keayney, as ren ee toshiaght dy niee e chassyn lesh jeir, as rub ee ad lesh folt e king, as phaag ee e chassyn, as ren ee ad y ooillaghey lesh yn ooil.

verses.name: Luke 7:39
verses.text: Nish yn Pharisee ren y chuirrey eh, tra honnick eh shoh, loayr eh cheu-sthie jeh hene, gra, Veagh fys er ve ec y dooinney shoh, dy beagh eh ny adeyr, quoi, as cre'n monney dy ven ee shoh, ta bentyn rish: son t'ee ny ben pheccoil.

verses.name: Luke 7:40
verses.text: As dreggyr Yeesey, as dooyrt eh rish, Simon, ta red aym's dy ghra rhyt, As dooyrt eh, Abbyr eh, vainshter.

verses.name: Luke 7:41
verses.text: Va dooinney dy row, as jees ayns lhiastynys da: va'n derrey yeh lhiastyn queig cheead ping, as y jeh elley jeih pingyn as da-eed.

verses.name: Luke 7:42
verses.text: As tra nagh row oc dy eeck, leih eh daue ny-neesht dy arryltagh. Insh dou eisht, quoi jeu s'booisal vees da?

verses.name: Luke 7:43
verses.text: Dreggyr Simon as dooyrt eh, Er-lhiam dy nee eshyn, da smoo ren eh leih. As dooyrt eh rish, T'ou er vriwnys dy cairagh.

verses.name: Luke 7:44
verses.text: As hyndaa eh gys y ven, as dooyrt eh rish Simon, Vel oo cur-my-ner yn ven shoh? Haink mee stiagh ayns dty hie's, as cha dug oo dou ushtey son my chassyn: agh t'eeish er niee my chassyn lesh jeir, as er jyrmagh ad lesh folt e king.

verses.name: Luke 7:45
verses.text: Cha dug uss paag dou: agh ta'n ven shoh, er-dyn traa haink mee stiagh, er ve kinjagh paagey my chassyn.

verses.name: Luke 7:46
verses.text: My chione lesh ooil cha ren oo y ooillaghey: agh ta'n ven shoh er n'ooillaghey my chassyn lesh ooil.

verses.name: Luke 7:47
verses.text: Shen-y-fa ta mee gra rhyt, Ta ny peccaghyn eck ta ymmodee, er nyn leih jee: shen-y-fa wheesh shen smoo ta yn ghraih eck: agh dasyn ta beggan er ny leih, cha vel e ghraih agh beggan.

verses.name: Luke 7:48
verses.text: As dooyrt eh r'ee, Ta dty pheccaghyn er nyn leih dhyt.

verses.name: Luke 7:49
verses.text: As ren y vooinjer va nyn soie ec bee mârish, toshiaght dy ghra cheu-sthie jeu hene, Quoi eh shoh ta myrgeddin leih peccaghyn?

verses.name: Luke 7:50
verses.text: As dooyrt eh rish y ven, Ta dty chredjue er dty hauail; immee ayns shee.

verses.name: Luke 8:1
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione ny lurg shen, dy jagh eh trooid dy chooilley valley, mooar as beg preacheil as soilshaghey sushtal gerjoilagh reeriaght Yee: as va'n daa ostyl yeig marish:

verses.name: Luke 8:2
verses.text: As shiartanse dy vraane, v'er nyn lheihys jeh drogh-spyrrydyn, as aslayntyn, Moirrey va enmyssit Malaine, ass-jee hie shiaght drogh-spyrrydyn,

verses.name: Luke 8:3
verses.text: As Joanna ben Chusa stiurt Herod, as Susanna, as ymmodee elley, v'er hirveish er Jeh nyn gooid.

verses.name: Luke 8:4
verses.text: As tra va earroo mooar dy leih er nyn jaglym cooidjagh, as er jeet huggey ass dy chooilley ard-valley; loayr eh liorish coraa dorraghey:

verses.name: Luke 8:5
verses.text: Hie correyder magh dy chuir e rass: as myr v'eh cuir, huitt paart rish oirr y raad, as ve stampit sheese, as d'ee eeanlee yn aer eh.

verses.name: Luke 8:6
verses.text: As huitt paart er creg, as cha leah as ve er n'aase seose, hie eh naardey, er-yn-oyr dy row eh laccal soo.

verses.name: Luke 8:7
verses.text: As huitt paart mastey drineyn, as daase ny drineyn seose mârish, as phloogh ad eh.

verses.name: Luke 8:8
verses.text: As huitt cooid elley jeh ayns thalloo mie, as daase eh seose, as dymmyrk eh mess keead-filley. As tra v'eh er ghra shoh, deïe eh, Eshyn ta cleayshyn echey dy chlashtyn, lhig da clashtyn.

verses.name: Luke 8:9
verses.text: As dênee e ostyllyn jeh, gra, Cre ta er ny hoiggal liorish y coraa-dorraghey shoh?

verses.name: Luke 8:10
verses.text: As dooyrt eh, Diuish te er ny choyrt dy hoiggal folliaghtyn reeriaght Yee; agh da feallagh elley ayns coraaghyn-dorraghey: ga t'ad fakin cha vel ad cur-my-ner, as clashtyn cha vel ad toiggal.

verses.name: Luke 8:11
verses.text: Nish shoh bun y choraa-dorraghey: Yn rass goo Yee.

verses.name: Luke 8:12
verses.text: Shen rish oirr y raad, yn vooinjer ta clashtyn: eisht ta'n drogh-spyrryd cheet, as goaill ersooyl yn goo ass ny creeaghyn oc, er-aggle dy jinnagh ad credjal, as dy beagh ad er nyn sauail.

verses.name: Luke 8:13
verses.text: Adsyn er y chreg, yn vooinjer, tra t'ad er chlashtyn, ta goaill y goo dy arryltagh; as cha vel fraue oc shoh, son tammylt t'ad credjal, agh ayns earish miolagh ta nyn gredjue failleil.

verses.name: Luke 8:14
verses.text: As shen huitt mastey drineyn, yn vooinjer, tra t'ad er chlashtyn, ta goll magh as ta plooghit lesh kiarail as berchys, as eunyssyn y vea shoh, as cha vel ad gymmyrkey magh mess gys lhieeney vie.

verses.name: Luke 8:15
verses.text: Agh shen er y thalloo mie, yn vooinjer ta lesh creeaghyn onneragh as mie, er chlashtyn yn goo, as ta dy reayll oc eh, as cur magh mess lesh meenid.

verses.name: Luke 8:16
verses.text: Cha vel doooinney erbee, tra t'eh er voaddey cainle, dy choodaghey ee lesh saagh ny dy choyrt ee fo lhiabbee: agh soiaghey ee ayns cainleyr, dy vod adsyn ta cheet stiagh yn soilshey y akin.

verses.name: Luke 8:17
verses.text: Son cha vel nhee erbee follit, nagh jig gys soilshey: ny nhee erbee kiellit, nagh bee fys er, as nagh jig magh.

verses.name: Luke 8:18
verses.text: Cur-jee twoaee er-y-fa shen kys ta shiu clashtyn: son quoi-erbee ta echey, dasyn vees er ny choyrt; as quoi-erbee nagh vel echey, veihsyn vees er ny ghoaill eer shen hene er-lesh dy vel echey.

verses.name: Luke 8:19
verses.text: Eisht haink huggey e voir as e vraaraghyn, as cha voddagh ad cheet n'aare, kyndagh rish y chennid.

verses.name: Luke 8:20
verses.text: As va shoh er ny insh da, lioroosyn dooyrt, Ta dty voir as dty vraaraghyn nyn shassoo mooie, geearee dy dty akin.

verses.name: Luke 8:21
verses.text: Agh dreggyr eh, as dooyrt eh roo, My voir as my vraaraghyn ad shoh ta clashtyn goo Yee, as ta dy yannoo eh.

verses.name: Luke 8:22
verses.text: Nish haink eh gy-kione, er laa dy row, dy jagh eh er-board lhong marish e ostyllyn: as dooyrt eh roo, Lhig dooin goll harrish gys y cheu elley jeh'n logh. As hie ad magh son y cheayn.

verses.name: Luke 8:23
verses.text: Agh myr v'ad shiaulley, huitt eh ny chadley: as dirree sterrym mooar dy gheay er y cheayn, as lhieen yn ushtey stiagh orroo, dy row ad ayns gaue.

verses.name: Luke 8:24
verses.text: As haink ad huggey as ghooisht ad eh, gra, Vainshter, vainshter, bee mayd caillit. Eisht dirree eh, as smaghtee eh yn gheay as freaney ny tonnyn: as ghow ad fea, as va kiuney ayn.

verses.name: Luke 8:25
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Cre vel y credjue eu? As va aggle orroo, goaill yindys as gra ry-cheilley, Cre'n monney dy ghooinney eh shoh? son t'eh cur ny eer geayghyn as yn ushtey fo harey, as t'ad ayns biallys da.

verses.name: Luke 8:26
verses.text: As haink ad gys cheer ny Gadarenee ta harrish noi Galilee.

verses.name: Luke 8:27
verses.text: As tra v'eh er n'gholl er thalloo, haink ny whail ass yn ard-valley, dooinney dy row va ry-foddey seaghnit lesh drogh-spyrrydyn, as cha row eh ceau eaddagh, chamoo duirree eh ayns thie erbee, agh mastey ny hoaiaghyn.

verses.name: Luke 8:28
verses.text: Tra honnick eh Yeesey, dyllee eh, as huitt eh sheese kiongoyrt rish, as dooyrt eh lesh ard-choraa, Cre'n eie t'ayd orrym Yeesey, Vac yn Jee smoo ard? Guee-ym ort nagh jean oo my horchaghey.

verses.name: Luke 8:29
verses.text: (Son v'eh er harey yn spyrryd neu ghlen dy heet magh ass y dooinney. Son v'eh dy mennick er hoiaghey er: as v'eh freilt kianlt lesh geulaghyn, as ayns yiarnyn; as vrish eh ny geulaghyn, as v'eh er ny ve eiyrit liorish y drogh-spyrryd gys yn aasagh.)

verses.name: Luke 8:30
verses.text: As dênee Yeesey jeh, gra, Cre'n ennym t'ort? As dooyrt eh, Legion: er-yn oyr dy row ymmodee drogh-spyrrydyn er n'gholl stiagh ayn.

verses.name: Luke 8:31
verses.text: As ghuee ad er gyn eh dy oardaghey daue goll sheese gys y diunid.

verses.name: Luke 8:32
verses.text: As va griagh mooar dy vuckyn fo bochillyn er y clieau: as ghuee ad er, eh dy chur kied daue goll stiagh ayndoo. As hug eh kied daue.

verses.name: Luke 8:33
verses.text: Eisht hie ny drogh-spyrrydyn ass y dooinney, as hie ad stiagh ayns ny muckyn: as roie yn ghriagh gour nyn mullee lesh yn eaynee gys y cheayn, as v'ad plooghit.

verses.name: Luke 8:34
verses.text: Tra honnick ny bochillyn cre va jeant, roie ad roue, as hie ad as dinsh ad eh ayns yn ard-valley, as trooid y cheer.

verses.name: Luke 8:35
verses.text: Eisht hie ad magh dy yeeaghyn cre va jeant; as haink ad gys Yeesey, as hooar ad y dooinney, ass va ny drogh spyrrydyn er n'gholl, ny hoie ec cassyn Yeesey, as e eaddagh er, as v'eh dy mie ayns e cheeayl: as ghow ad aggle.

verses.name: Luke 8:36
verses.text: Dinsh myrgeddin yn vooinjer honnick eh daue, kys va fer ny drogh-spyrrydyn er ny lheihys.

verses.name: Luke 8:37
verses.text: Eisht ren y slane chaglym jeh cheer y Gadalenee mygeayrt, guee er eh dy gholl roish: son va aggle mooar er duittym orroo: as hie eh er-board yn lhong, as hyndaa eh back reesht.

verses.name: Luke 8:38
verses.text: Nish va'n dooinney ass va ny drogh spyrrydyn er n'immeeaght geearree dy ve marish: agh hug Yeesey ersooyl eh, gra,

verses.name: Luke 8:39
verses.text: Gow royd gys dty hie hene, as soilshee cre ny reddyn mooarey ta Jee er n'yannoo er dty hon. As hie eh roish, as dinsh eh magh trooid ooilley yn ard-valley, cre ny reddyn mooarey va Yeesey er n'yannoo er e hon.

verses.name: Luke 8:40
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione, tra va Yeesey er jeet back, dy ghow yn pobble lane boggey jeh: son v'ad ooilley fieau er.

verses.name: Luke 8:41
verses.text: As cur-my-ner, haink dooinney va enmyssit Jairus, as v'eh fer jeh reiltee yn synagogue: as huitt eh sheese ec cassyn Yeesey, as ghuee eh er, eh dy heet stiagh ayns e hie:

verses.name: Luke 8:42
verses.text: Son va un ynrycan inneen echey, va mysh daa vlein jeig dy eash, as v'ee raad y vaaish. (Agh myr v'eh goll, va'n pobble chionney er.

verses.name: Luke 8:43
verses.text: As va ben va roie foalley er ve eck rish daa vlein jeig, v'er vaarail ooilley e cooid-seihlt er fir-lhee, as cha daink eh lesh veg jeu ee y lheihys,

verses.name: Luke 8:44
verses.text: Haink ee shoh cheu e chooylloo, as venn ee rish oirr e gharmad: as chelleeragh hyrmee yn roie-foalley eck.

verses.name: Luke 8:45
verses.text: As dooyrt Yeesey, Quoi venn rhym? Tra ren ooilley gobbal, dooyrt Peddyr, as adsyn va marish, Vainshter, ta'n pohble chionney ort, as dy dty yingey, as t'ou uss gra, Quoi venn rhym?

verses.name: Luke 8:46
verses.text: As dooyrt Yeesey, Ta peccagh ennagh er ventyn rhym: son ta mee gennaghtyn dy vel bree er n'gholl ass-ym.

verses.name: Luke 8:47
verses.text: As tra honnick yn ven dy row ee cronnit, haink ee er-creau, as huitt ee sheese ec e chassyn, as hoilshee ee da kiongoyrt rish ooilley yn pobble, cre'n oyr v'eck dy ventyn rish, as er-y-chooyl kys v'ee er ny lheihys

verses.name: Luke 8:48
verses.text: As dooyrt eh r'ee, Inneen, bee dy ghien mie; ta dty chredjue er dty laanaghey: immee ayns shee.)

verses.name: Luke 8:49
verses.text: Choud as v'eh foast loayrt, haink fer veih thie fer-reill yn synagogue, gra rish, Ta dty inneen marroo; ny cur trubbyl sodjey da'n Vainshter.

verses.name: Luke 8:50
verses.text: Agh tra cheayll Yeesey shoh, dreggyr eh eh, gra, Ny bee aggle ort: cha vel ort agh dy chredjal, as bee ee er ny lheihys.

verses.name: Luke 8:51
verses.text: As tra v'eh er jeet stiagh 'sy thie, cha lhig eh da dooinney erbee goll stiagh marish, agh Peddyr, as Jamys, as Ean, as ayr as moir y ven-aeg.

verses.name: Luke 8:52
verses.text: As v'ad ooilley keayney, as jannoo dobberan er e son: agh dooyrt eshyn, Ny jean-jee keayney; cha vel ee marroo, agh ny cadley.

verses.name: Luke 8:53
verses.text: Agh s'beg hoie ad jeh e raa, as fys oc son shickyrys dy row ee marroo.

verses.name: Luke 8:54
verses.text: As hug eh ad ooilley magh, as ghow eh ee er laue, as deie eh, gra, Ven-aeg, irree seose.

verses.name: Luke 8:55
verses.text: As haink y spyrryd eck reesht, as dirree ee jeeragh: as doardee eh bee y chur jee.

verses.name: Luke 8:56
verses.text: As ghow yn ayr as y voir eck yindys mooar: agh hug eh currym daue gyn ad dy insh da dooinney erbee cre va jeant.

verses.name: Luke 9:1
verses.text: Eisht deie eh er y daa ostyl yeig cooidjagh, as hug eh daue pooar as eaghtyrys harrish dy chooilley ghrogh-spyrryd, as dy lheihys doghanyn.

verses.name: Luke 9:2
verses.text: As hug eh ad magh dy phreacheil reeriaght Yee, as dy laanaghey sleih chingey.

verses.name: Luke 9:3
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Ny cur-jee lhieu nhee erbee son nyn yurnah, chamoo luirg, ny spagey, ny arran, ny argid; as ny lhig da daa chooat y pheesh y ve eu.

verses.name: Luke 9:4
verses.text: As thie erbee dy jed shiu stiagh ayn, gow-jee aaght ayns shen, derrey hed shiu reue.

verses.name: Luke 9:5
verses.text: As quoi-erbee nagh jean goaill riu, tra aagys shiu yn ard-valley shen, crie-jee yn eer joan jeh ny cassyn eu, son feanish nyn 'oi

verses.name: Luke 9:6
verses.text: As hie ad magh, as jimmee ad trooid ny baljyn, preacheil yn sushtal, as lheihys dy chooilley raad.

verses.name: Luke 9:7
verses.text: Nish va Herod yn tetrarch er chlasht yn jeh ooilley e yannoo: as v'eh seaghnit, er-y-fa dy row paart gra, dy row Ean er n'irree veih ny merriu:

verses.name: Luke 9:8
verses.text: As paart, dy row Elias er jeet kionfenish: as feallagh elley, dy row fer jeh ny sbenn adeyryn er n'irree reesht.

verses.name: Luke 9:9
verses.text: As dooyrt Herod, Jeh Ean ren mish yn kione y ghoaill; agh quoi eh shoh jeh ta mee clashtyn lheid ny reddyn? As v'eh aggindagh dy akin eh.

verses.name: Luke 9:10
verses.text: As tra va ny ostyllyn er jeet reesht, dinsh ad da [Yeesey] ooilley ny v'ad er n'yannoo. As ghow eh ad, as hie eh dy lhiattee gys boayl er-lheh ayns yn aasagh, bentyn gys ard-valley enmyssit Bethsaida

verses.name: Luke 9:11
verses.text: As tra hooar y pobble fys er, deiyr ad er: as hug eh oltaghey daue, as loayr eh roo jeh reeriaght Yee, as laanee eh adsyn va feme slaanaghey.

verses.name: Luke 9:12
verses.text: As tra va'n laa faggys ceaut, haink yn daa ostyl yeig as dooyrt ad rish, Lhig y raad da'n pobble, dy vod ad goll roue gys ny baljyn as er y cheer mygeayrt, dy gheddyn aaght as beaghey: son ta shin ayns shoh ayns boayl faasagh.

verses.name: Luke 9:13
verses.text: Agh dooyrt eh roo, Cur-jee shiuish bee daue. As dooyrt ad, Cha vel ain agh queig bwilleenyn as daa eeast; mannagh jem mayd dy chionnaghey bee son ooilley yn pobble shoh.

verses.name: Luke 9:14
verses.text: Son v'ad mysh queig thousane dooinney. As dooyrt eh rish e ostyllyn, Cur-jee orroo soie sheese, jeih as da-eed ayns sheshaght.

verses.name: Luke 9:15
verses.text: As ren ad shen, as hug ad orroo ooilley soie sheese.

verses.name: Luke 9:16
verses.text: Eisht ghow eh ny queig bwilleenyn as y daa eeast, as yeeagh eh seose gys niau, as vannee eh, as vrish eh, as hug eh ad da e ostyllyn dy hoiaghey roish y pobble.

verses.name: Luke 9:17
verses.text: As ren ad ooilley gee, as v'ad er nyn yannoo magh: as hrog ad jeh'n fooilliagh daag ad, lane daa vaskad jeig.

verses.name: Luke 9:18
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione, myr v'eh ec padjer ayns ynnyd er-lheh, as e ostyllyn marish: dy denee eh jeu, gra, Cre ta'n pobble dy ghra my-mychione's, quoi mee?

verses.name: Luke 9:19
verses.text: Dreggyr adsyn, as dooyrt ad, Ean Bashtey: agh ta paart gra, Elias: as paart elley, dy vel fer jeh ny shenn adeyryn er n'irree reesht.

verses.name: Luke 9:20
verses.text: Dooyrt eshyn roo, Agh quoi ta shiuish gra dy vel mee? Dreggyr Peddyr as dooyrt eh, Yn Creest dy Yee.

verses.name: Luke 9:21
verses.text: As hug eh currym gyere orroo, gyn ad dy insh shen da dooinney erbee,

verses.name: Luke 9:22
verses.text: Gra, Shegin da Mac y dooinney ymmodee reddyn y hurranse, as ve beg soit jeh liorish y chanstyr, as ny ard-saggyrtyn, as ny scrudeyryn, as ve er ny varroo, as girree reesht yn trass laa.

verses.name: Luke 9:23
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo ooilley, My ta dooinney erbee aggindagh geiyrt orrym's lhig da eh-hene y obbal, as e chrosh y hroggal gagh laa, as geiyrt orrym.

verses.name: Luke 9:24
verses.text: Son quoi-erbee baillish e vioys y hauail, caillee eh eh: agh quoi-erbee chaillys e vioys er my ghraih's, sauee eh shoh eh.

verses.name: Luke 9:25
verses.text: Son cre'n vondeish t'ec dooinney, my chosnys eh yn seihll ooilley, as eh-hene dy ve caillit, ny ceaut ersooyl?

verses.name: Luke 9:26
verses.text: Son quoi-erbee ghoys nearey jeem's as jeh my ghoan, jehsyn ghoys yn Mac dooinney nearey, tra hig eh ayns e ghloyr hene, as gloyr e Ayrey, as ny ainleyn casherick.

verses.name: Luke 9:27
verses.text: Agh ta mee ginsh diu ayns firrinys, dy vel paart nyn shassoo ayns shoh nagh jean blashtyn er y baase, derrey hee ad reeriaght

verses.name: Luke 9:28
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione mygeayrt hoght laa lurg ny raaghyn shoh, dy ghow eh marish, Peddyr as Ean as Jamys, as dy jagh eh seose er slieau dy ghoaill padjer.

verses.name: Luke 9:29
verses.text: As myr v'eh ayns padjer, va cummey yn eddin echey er ny chaghlaa, as va'n coamrey echey gial as follys.

verses.name: Luke 9:30
verses.text: As cur-my-ner va daa ghooinney taggloo rish, ta shen dy ghra Moses as Elias:

verses.name: Luke 9:31
verses.text: Haink kionfenish ayns gloyr, as loayr ad heh e vaase, v'eh dy hurranse ec Jerusalem.

verses.name: Luke 9:32
verses.text: Agh haink cadley trome er Peddyr as orroosyn va marish: as tra v'ad er ghoostey, honnick ad yn ghloyr echey, as y daa ghooinney va nyn shassoo marish.

verses.name: Luke 9:33
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione myr v'ad goll dy aagail eh, dy dooyrt Peddyr rish Yeesey, Vainshter, s'mie dooin dy ve ayns shoh; as lhig dooin three cabbaneyn y yannoo, cabbane er dty hon's, as cabbane son Moses, as cabbane son Elias: s'coan toiggal cre v'eh dy ghra.

verses.name: Luke 9:34
verses.text: Choud as v'eh loayrt shoh, haink bodjal lesh scadoo harrystoo: as ghow ad aggle myr va'n bodjal cheet moo.

verses.name: Luke 9:35
verses.text: As haink coraa ass y vodjal, gra, Shoh my vac graihagh; eaisht-jee rishyn.

verses.name: Luke 9:36
verses.text: As lurg y choraa, hooar ad Yeesey ny lomarcan: as dreill ad shoh oc hene, as cha dinsh ad da dooinney erbee ayns ny laghyn shen, veg jeh ny reddyn v'ad er vakin.

verses.name: Luke 9:37
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione yn nah laa tra v'ad er jeet neose jeh'n clieau, dy daink ymmodee ny whail.

verses.name: Luke 9:38
verses.text: As cur-my-ner, deie dooinney jeh'n cheshaght, gra, Vainshter, ta mee guee ort jeeagh er my vac, son she my ynrycan lhiannoo eh.

verses.name: Luke 9:39
verses.text: As cur-my-ner, ta spyrryd dy ghoaill eh, as doaltattym t'eh gyllagh; as tuittym neeal, t'eh keshal, as s'coan t'eh cheet huggey hene, erreish da ve dy mooar broojit.

verses.name: Luke 9:40
verses.text: As ghuee mee er dty ostyllyn ad dy hilgey magh eh, agh cha daink eh lhieu.

verses.name: Luke 9:41
verses.text: As dreggyr Yeesey, gra, 0 heeloghe vee-chredjuagh as roonagh, caid ta mish dy ve meriu, as dy hurranse diu? Cur lhiat dty vac ayns shoh.

verses.name: Luke 9:42
verses.text: As myr v'eh foast cheet, cheau yn drogh-spyrryd sheese eh ayns strepyn: agh vaggyr Yeesey er y spyrryd neu-ghlen, as laanee eh yn lhiannoo, as livrey eh eh reesht gys e ayr.

verses.name: Luke 9:43
verses.text: As v'ad ooilley ayns ard-yindys jeh pooar niartal Yee: Agh choud as va dy chooilley unnane ayns ard-imnea mychione dagh nhee va Yeesey er n'yannoo, dooyrt eh rish e ostyllyn,

verses.name: Luke 9:44
verses.text: Lhig da ny raaghyn shoh goll dowin ayns nyn glashtyn: son bee yn Mac dooinney er ny livrey gys laueyn deiney.

verses.name: Luke 9:45
verses.text: Agh cha hoig ad y raa shoh, as ve gyn yss daue, nagh row toiggal oc jeh: as va aggle orroo fenaght jeh mychione y raa cheddin.

verses.name: Luke 9:46
verses.text: Eisht hie ad son argane ry-cheilley, quoi jeu syrjey veagh.

verses.name: Luke 9:47
verses.text: As Yeesey toiggal smooinaghtyn y chree oc, ghow eh lhiannoo, as hoie eh eh liorish,

verses.name: Luke 9:48
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Quoi-erbee nee soiaghey jeh'n lhiannoo shoh ayns m'ennynn's, t'eh jannoo soiaghey jeem's: as quoi-erbee nee soiaghey jeem's, t'eh soiaghey jehsyn t'er my choyrt: son eshyn sloo ta nyn mast' eu ooilley, eshyn syrjey vees.

verses.name: Luke 9:49
verses.text: As dreggyr Ean as dooyrt eh, Vainshter, honnick shin fer castey drogh spyrrydyn ayns dty ennym's; as liett shin eh, er-yn-oyr nagh vel eh geiyrt ort's marinyn.

verses.name: Luke 9:50
verses.text: As dooyrt Yeesey rish, Ny jean-jee eh y lhiettal: son, eshyn nagh vel nyn 'oi, t'eh lhien.

verses.name: Luke 9:51
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione, myr va'n traa tayrn er-gerrey dasyn dy ve goit seose, dy row eh dy shickyr kiarit er soiaghey e eddin dy gholl gys Jerusalem.

verses.name: Luke 9:52
verses.text: As hug eh chaghteryn roish: as jimmee ad, as haink ad gys balley jeh ny Samaritanee dy aarlaghey er e hon.

verses.name: Luke 9:53
verses.text: Agh cha dug adsyn oltaghey-bea da, er-yn-oyr dy dug ad my-ner dy row eh goll gys Jerusalem.

verses.name: Luke 9:54
verses.text: As tra honnick e ostyllyn Jamys as Ean shoh, dooyrt ad, Hiarn, nailt shin dy harey aile orroo veih niau, dy stroie ad, eer myr ren Elias?

verses.name: Luke 9:55
verses.text: Agh hyndaa eh, as hug eh oghsan daue, gra, Cha s'eu cre'n monney dy spyrryd ta shiu jeh.

verses.name: Luke 9:56
verses.text: Son cha vel Mac yn dooinney er jeet dy stroie bioys deiney, agh dy nyn sauail. As hie ad roue gys balley elley.

verses.name: Luke 9:57
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione, myr v'ad goll er y raad, dy dooyrt dooinney dy row rish, Hiarn, eiyr-yms ort raad erbee dy jed oo.

verses.name: Luke 9:58
verses.text: As dooyrt Yeesey rish, Ta tuill ec ny shynnee, as idd ec eeanlee yn aer, agh ec Mac yn dooimley cha vel boayl, ayn dy chur e chione fo.

verses.name: Luke 9:59
verses.text: As dooyrt eh rish fer elley, Eiyr orrym: Agh dooyrt eshyn, Hiarn, cur kied dou hoshiaeht goll thie dy oanluckey my ayr.

verses.name: Luke 9:60
verses.text: Dooyrt Yeesey rish, Lhig da ny me riu nyn merriu y oanluckey; agh gow uss royd as jean reeriaght Yee y phreacheil.

verses.name: Luke 9:61
verses.text: As dooyrt fer elley myrgeddin rish Hiarn, eiyr-yms ort-agh lhig dou hoshiaght bannaght y aagail ec y vooinjer t'ec my hie.

verses.name: Luke 9:62
verses.text: As dooyrt Yeesey rish, Dooinney erbee t'er chur e laue gys y cheeaght, as ta jeeaghyn back, t'eh an-chooid son reeriaght Yee.

verses.name: Luke 10:1
verses.text: Ny lurg shoh, doardee yn Chiarn three-feed as jeih elley, as hug eh ad magh jees as jees roish hene, gys dy chooilley ard valley as ynnyd, raad v'eh hene ry-hoi cheet.

verses.name: Luke 10:2
verses.text: Shen-y-fa dooyrt eh roo, Ta'n fouyr dy jarroo mooar, agh ta ny labreeyn beggan: guee-jee shiuish er-y-fa shen er Chiarn y fouyr, eh dy chur magh labreeyn gys y fouyr echey.

verses.name: Luke 10:3
verses.text: Immee-jee eisht: cur-jee my-ner, ta mish dyn goyrt shiu magh myr eayin mastey moddee-oaldey.

verses.name: Luke 10:4
verses.text: Ny cur-jee lhieu sporran, ny spagey, ny braagyn: as ny jean-jee cumrail ayns goltaghey dooinney erbee er y raad.

verses.name: Luke 10:5
verses.text: As thie erbee dy jed shiu stiagh ayn, abbyr-jee hoshiaght, Shee dy row gys y thie shoh.

verses.name: Luke 10:6
verses.text: As my vees mac ny shee ayns shen, nee yn chee eu tannaghtyn er: mannagh vel, chyndaa-ee eh hiu hene reesht.

verses.name: Luke 10:7
verses.text: As ayns y thie cheddin fuirree-jee, gee as giu lheid as ver ad reue: son ta'n labree toilliu e aill. Ny gow-jee veih thie dy thie.

verses.name: Luke 10:8
verses.text: As ard-valley erbee dy jed shiu stiagh ayn, as ad dy oltaghey nyn mea, ee-jee lheid as vees soit reue.

verses.name: Luke 10:9
verses.text: As slaanee-jee yn sleih chingey t'ayn, as abbyr-jee roo, Ta reeriaght Yee er jeet er-gerrey diu.

verses.name: Luke 10:10
verses.text: Agh ard-valley erbee dy jed shiu stiagh ayn, as nagh jean goaill riu, gow-jee reue magh ayns ny straidyn oc, as abbyr-jee,

verses.name: Luke 10:11
verses.text: Eer joan yn ard-valley eu, ta lhiantyn hooin, ta shin dy chraa j'in nyn 'oi eu: ny yeih, bee-jee shickyr jeh shoh, dy vel reeriaght Yee er jeet er-gerrey diu.

verses.name: Luke 10:12
verses.text: Agh ta mish gra riu, dy bee eh ny sassey da Sodom ec y laa shen, na da'n ard valley shen.

verses.name: Luke 10:13
verses.text: Smerg dhyt's Chorazin, smerg dhyt's Vethsaida: son dy beagh ny obbraghyn yindyssagh er ve jeant ayns Tyre as Sidon, t'er ny ve jeant ayndiuish, veagh ad er ghoaill arrys foddey er dy henney ayns aanrit-sack as leoie.

verses.name: Luke 10:14
verses.text: Agh bee kerraghey s'eddrym er ny choyrt er Tyre as Sidon ec y vriwnys, na vees er ny choyrt erriuish.

verses.name: Luke 10:15
verses.text: As uss Chapernaum, ta dty ooash]ey roshtyn gys niau, bee oo er dty hilgey sheese eys niurin.

verses.name: Luke 10:16
verses.text: Eshyn eaishtys riuish, t'eh geaishtagh rhym's: as eshyn ta soiaghey beg jiuish, t'eh soiaghey beg jeem's: as eshyn ta soiaghey beg jeem's, t'eh soiaghey beg jehsyn ta er mychoyrt.

verses.name: Luke 10:17
verses.text: As haink y three-feed as jeih huggey reesht lesh boggey, gra, Hiarn, ta ny eer drogh-spyrrydyn biallagh dooin, trooid dty ennym's.

verses.name: Luke 10:18
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Honnick mee Noid ny hanmey, myr tendreil, tuittym veih niau.

verses.name: Luke 10:19
verses.text: Cur-my-ner, ta mish coyrt diu pooar dy chur fo-chosh ard-nieughyn as scorpionee, as ooilley pooar y noid; as cha jean nhee 'sy theihll, er aght erbee, skielley diu.

verses.name: Luke 10:20
verses.text: Ny-yeih ayns shoh ny gow-jee boggey, dy vel ny spyrrydyn biallagh diu: agh gow-jee boggey smoo, dy vel ny enmyn eu scruit ayns niau.

verses.name: Luke 10:21
verses.text: Ayns yn oor cheddin ghow Yeesey boggey ayns e spyrryd, as dooyrt eh, Ta mee cur booise dhyt, O Ayr Hiarn niau as thalloo, dy vel oo er cheiltyn ny reddyn shoh vouesyn ta creeney as tushtagh, as dy vel oo er hoilshaghey ad da oikanyn: shen dy jarroo myr te, Ayr, sonshen myr ve mie ayns dty hilley's.

verses.name: Luke 10:22
verses.text: Ta dy chooilley nhee er ny livrey dooys liorish my Ayr: as cha vel fys ec unnane erbee quoi yn Mac, agh yn Ayr; ny quoi yn Ayr, agh yn Mac, as eshyn da nee yn Mac eh y hoilshaghey.

verses.name: Luke 10:23
verses.text: As hyndaa eh gys e ostyllyn, as dooyrt eh er-lheh, Bannit ta ny sooillyn ta fakin ny reddyn ta shiuish dy akin.

verses.name: Luke 10:24
verses.text: Son ta mee ginsh diu, dy vel ymmodee phadeyryn as reeaghyn er ve aignagh dy akin ny reddyn shen ta shiuish er vakin, as cha vel ad er vakin ad; as dy chlashtyn ny reddyn ta shiuish dy chlashtyn, as cha vel ad er chlashtyn ad.

verses.name: Luke 10:25
verses.text: As cur-my-ner, hass fer-ynsee dy row jeh'n leigh seose, erchee y phrowal eh, gra, Vainshter, cre t'orrym's dy yannoo dy vod eiraght y ve aym ayns y vea veayn?

verses.name: Luke 10:26
verses.text: Dooyrt eshyn rish, Cre ta scruit ayns y leigh? kys t'ou lhaih?

verses.name: Luke 10:27
verses.text: As dreggyr eshyn as dooyrt eh, Ver oo graih da'n Chiarn dty Yee lesh ooilley dty chree, as lesh ooilley dty annym, as lesh ooilley dty niart, as lesh ooilley dty aigney as da dty naboo myr dhyt hene.

verses.name: Luke 10:28
verses.text: As dooyrt eh rish, T'ou er n'ansoor dy mie: jean shoh, as yiow yn vea.

verses.name: Luke 10:29
verses.text: Agh v'eshyn booiagh eh-hene y heyrey, as dooyrt eh rish Yeesey, As quoi my naboo?

verses.name: Luke 10:30
verses.text: As dreggyr Yeesey, gra, Hie dooinney dy row sheese veih Jerusalem gys Jericho, as huitt eh mastey maarlee, rooisht eh jeh e choamrey, as lhott ad eh, as hie ad rhymboo, erreish daue y er vaagail eh lieh-varroo.

verses.name: Luke 10:31
verses.text: As haghyr eh da saggyrt dy row goll sheese y raad shen; as tra honnick eh eh, hie eh shaghey er y derrey heu jeh.

verses.name: Luke 10:32
verses.text: As myrgeddin Levite, tra v'eh ec yn ynnyd, haink eh as yeeagh eh er, as hie eh shaghey er y cheu elley.

verses.name: Luke 10:33
verses.text: Agh haink Samaritan dy row, myr v'eh er e yurnah, raad v'eh: as tra honnick eh eh, va chymmey echey er.

verses.name: Luke 10:34
verses.text: As hie eh huggey, as chiangle eh seose ny lhottyn echey, niee ad lesh ooil as feeyn, as hoie eh eh er e vaagh hene, as hug eh lesh eh gys thie-oast, as ghow eh kiarail jeh.

verses.name: Luke 10:35
verses.text: As laa ny vairagh tra v'eh goll roish ghow eh daa pheesh dy argid as hug eh ad da mainshter y thie-oast as dooyrt eh rish, Gow kiarail jeh; as cre-erbee smoo vaarys oo er, eeck-ym dhyt eh, tra hig-ym reesht.

verses.name: Luke 10:36
verses.text: Quoi nish jeu shoh nyn droor, t'ou uss dy smooinaghtyn, va ny naboo dasyn huitt mastey ny maarlee?

verses.name: Luke 10:37
verses.text: As dooyrt eh rish, Eshyn ren myghin y hoilshaghey er, Eisht dooyrt Yeesey rish, Immee, as jean uss er yn aght cheddin.

verses.name: Luke 10:38
verses.text: Nish haink eh gy-kione, myr vad goll, dy jagh ad stiagh ayns balley beg dy row: as ren ben v'ayns shen enmyssit Martha, eh y chuirrey gys y thie eck.

verses.name: Luke 10:39
verses.text: As va shuyr eck enmyssit Moirrey hoie myrgeddin ec cassyn Yeesey, clashtyn e ghoo.

verses.name: Luke 10:40
verses.text: Agh va Martha tooillit lesh y phreish vooar vurree, as haink ee huggey, as dooyrt ee, Hiarn, nee dty aighey's eh dy vel my huyr er n'aagail y currym orryms my lomarcan dy hirveish er y cheshaght? abbyr r'ee er-y-fa shen, ee dy chooney lhiam.

verses.name: Luke 10:41
verses.text: As dreggyr Yeesey, as dooyrt eh ree, Martha, Martha, t'ou ro-imneagh as seaghnit mysh ymmodee nheeghyn:

verses.name: Luke 10:42
verses.text: Agh un red ta ymmyrchagh. As ta Moirrey er reih yn ayrn vie shen, nagh bee er ny ghoaill ersooyl vo'ee.

verses.name: Luke 11:1
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione, myr v'eh ec padjer ayns ynnyd dy row, tra daag eh jeh, dy dooyrt fer jeh e ostyllyn rish, Hiarn ynsee dooinyn dy ghoaill padjer, myr dynsee Ean myrgeddin da ny ynseydee echeysyn.

verses.name: Luke 11:2
verses.text: As dooyrt eh, Tra ghoys shiu padjer, abbyr-jee, Ayr ain t'ayns niau, Casherick dy row dty ennym. Dy jig dty reeriaght. Dty aigney dy row jeant er y thalloo, myr te ayns niau.

verses.name: Luke 11:3
verses.text: Cur dooin laa Iurg laa nyn arran gagh laa.

verses.name: Luke 11:4
verses.text: As leih dooin nyn beccaghyn; son ta shinyn myrgeddin leih da dy chooilley unnane ta ayns lhiastynys dooin. As ny leeid shin ayns miolagh, agh livrey shin veih olk.

verses.name: Luke 11:5
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Quoi jiuish vees carrey echey, as hed huggey ec main-oie, as jir rish, Charrey, eeasee dou three bwilleenyn;

verses.name: Luke 11:6
verses.text: Son ta dooinney-mooinjerey dou, va er e yurnah, er jeet hym, as cha vel monney aym dy hoiaghey roish:

verses.name: Luke 11:7
verses.text: As freggyr-ee eshyn veih cheu-sthie gra, Ny boir mee: ta'n dorrys nish jeight, as ta my chloan 'sy lhiabbee marym; cha voddym girree dy chur dhyt.

verses.name: Luke 11:8
verses.text: Ta mee gra riu, Ga nagh n'irree eh dy chur da, er-coontey dy nee e charrey eh: ny-yeih kyndagh rish yn jeeanid echey, irree eh, as ver eh da whilleen as vees eh ny eme.

verses.name: Luke 11:9
verses.text: As ta mish gra riuish, Yeearree-jee, as yiow shiu: shir-jee, as nee shiu feddyn: bee-jee aignagh fosley y gheddyn, as bee eh er ny osley diu.

verses.name: Luke 11:10
verses.text: Son ta dy chooilley unnane ta geearree, geddyn: as y fer ta shirrey, feddyn: as eshyn ta aignagh fosley y gheddyn, bee eh er ny osley da.

verses.name: Luke 11:11
verses.text: My nee mac arran y hirrey er fer jiuish ta ny ayr, nee clagh ver eh da? ny my hirrys eh eeast, jean eh ayns ynnyd eeast ard-nieu y chur da?

verses.name: Luke 11:12
verses.text: Ny my hirrys eh ooh, jeb eh scorpion da?

verses.name: Luke 11:13
verses.text: My ta toiggal er-y-fa shen euish, ta olk, kys dy choyrt giootyn mie da nyn gloan; cre-woad smoo nee yn Ayr flaunyssagh eu yn Spyrryd Noo y choyrt dauesyn ta jannoo aghin huggey?

verses.name: Luke 11:14
verses.text: As v'eh tilgey magh drogh-spyrryd, as v'eh balloo. As haink eh gy-kione, tra va'n drogh-spyrryd er gholl ass dy loayr y balloo: as ghow yn pobble yindys.

verses.name: Luke 11:15
verses.text: Agh dooyrt paart jeu, She liorish Beelzebub, yn ard drogh-spyrryd, t'eh castey drogh-spyrrydyn.

verses.name: Luke 11:16
verses.text: As va feallagh elley er-chee prowal eh shirrey er cowrey veih niau.

verses.name: Luke 11:17
verses.text: Agh eshyn toiggal ny smooinaghtyn oc dooyrt roo, Ta dy chooilley reeriaght ta girree-magh n'oi hene, er ny choyrt mow: as thie ta n'oi hene goll naardey.

verses.name: Luke 11:18
verses.text: As my ta'n jouyl girree-magh n'oi hene, kys nee yn reeriaght echey shassoo? er-y-fa dy vel shiu gra, dy nee liorish Beelzebub ta mish castey drogh-spyrrydyn.

verses.name: Luke 11:19
verses.text: As my ta mish liorish Beelzebub castey drogh-spyrrydyn, quoi liorish ta ny mec eu hene dy chastey ad? bee adsyn er-y-fa shen ny briwnyn eu.

verses.name: Luke 11:20
verses.text: Agh my ta mish liorish mair Yee tilgey magh drogh-spyrrydyn, fegooish dooyt ta reeriaght Yee er jeet erriuish.

verses.name: Luke 11:21
verses.text: Tra ta dooinney-caggee eillit freayll arrey er e hie, ta e chooid sauchey.

verses.name: Luke 11:22
verses.text: Agh tra ta fer stroshey na eh soiaghey er, as geddyn yn varriaght, t'eh goaill veih ooilley e eilley, huggey v'eh treishteil, as t'eh rheynn e chooid.

verses.name: Luke 11:23
verses.text: Eshyn nagh vel lhiam, t'eh m'oi; as eshyn nagh vel chymsaghey marym, t'eh skeayley.

verses.name: Luke 11:24
verses.text: Tra ta'n spyrryd neu-ghlen er gholl ass dooinney, t'eh shooyll trooid faasaghyn fadaneagh, chee aash, agh ayns fardail, eisht t'eh gra, Hem reesht gys my hie, veih haink mee.

verses.name: Luke 11:25
verses.text: As tra t'eh cheet, t'eh dy gheddyn eh sceabit as soit magh dy stooamey.

verses.name: Luke 11:26
verses.text: Eisht t'eh goll as goaill marish shiaght spyrrydyn elley, ny smessey na eh-hene, as t'ad goll stiagh as cummal ayns shen: as ta stayd yerrinagh yn dooinney shen ny s'doogh na'n toshiaght.

verses.name: Luke 11:27
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione, myr v'eh loayrt ny goan shoh, dy hrog ben dy row jeh'n cheshaght seose e coraa, as dooyrt ee rish, Bannit ta'n vrein ren oo y ymmyrkey, as ny keeaghyn t'ou er yiole.

verses.name: Luke 11:28
verses.text: Agh dooyrt eshyn, Dy jarroo foddey s'bannee t'adsyn ta clashtyn goo Yee, as freayll eh.

verses.name: Luke 11:29
verses.text: As tra va'n pobble er nyn jaglym chion dy cheilley, ghow eh toshiaght dy ghra, s'drogh y cheeloghe shoh: t'ad shirrey cowrey, as cha bee cowrey er ny choyrt daue, agh cowrey yn phadeyr Jonas.

verses.name: Luke 11:30
verses.text: Son myr va Jonas ny chowrey da ny Nineviteyn, er yn aght cheddin neesht vees Mac y dooinney da'n cheeloghe shoh.

verses.name: Luke 11:31
verses.text: Nee ben-rein y jiass girree seose ayns briwnys noi deiney yn cheeloghe shoh, as ad y gheyrey: son haink ish veih ardjyn sodjey magh y thallooin dy chlashtyn creenaght Solomon; as cur-my-ner, ta fer syrjey na Solomon ayns shoh.

verses.name: Luke 11:32
verses.text: Nee deiney Nineveh girree seose ayns briwnys, as y cheeloghe shoh y gheyrey: son ghow adsyn arrys ec preacheil Yonas; as cur-my-ner, ta fer syrjey na Jonas ayns shoh.

verses.name: Luke 11:33
verses.text: Cha vel dooinney erbee, tra t'eh er voaddey cainle, dy choyrt ee ayns ynnyd follit, ny fo saagh; agh ayns cainleyr, dy vod adsyn ta cheet stiagh yn soilshey y akin.

verses.name: Luke 11:34
verses.text: Yn tooill ta cur soilshey da'n chorp: shen-y-fa tra ta dty hooill glen, bee dty chorp ooilley ayns slane soilshey: agh tra ta lheamys er dty hooill, bee dty chorp myrgeddin ayns slane dorraghys.

verses.name: Luke 11:35
verses.text: Cur twoaie er-y-fa shen nagh bee yn soilshey ta aynyd ny ghorraghys.

verses.name: Luke 11:36
verses.text: My ta ooilley dty chorp er-y-fa shen ayns slane soilshey, gyn dorraghys ayns ayrn erbee, bee yn clane sollys, myr t'ou, tra ta soilshey sollys ayd veih cainle,

verses.name: Luke 11:37
verses.text: As myr v'eh loayrt, chuir Pharisee dy row eh gys jinnair marish: as hie eh stiagh, as hoie eh sheese gys bee.

verses.name: Luke 11:38
verses.text: As tra honnick yn Pharisee shoh, ghow eh yindys nagh niee eh (e laueyn) roish jinnair.

verses.name: Luke 11:39
verses.text: As dooyrt y Chiarn rish, Nish ta shiuish Phariseeyn glenney yn cappan as y claare er cheu-mooie: agh ta'n cheu-sthie eu lane dy hranlaase as dy olkys.

verses.name: Luke 11:40
verses.text: Gheiney vee-cheaylagh, nagh nee eshyn ren y cheu-mooie, ren y cheu-sthie myrgeddin?

verses.name: Luke 11:41
verses.text: Agh cur-jee lheid as t'eu da ny boghtyn: as cur-my-ner, bee dy chooilley nhee glen diu.

verses.name: Luke 11:42
verses.text: Agh smerg diuish Phariseeyn: son ta shiu jagheenys mynthey, rue, as dy chooilley horch dy lossreeyn, agh s'beg ta shiu soiaghey jeh briwnys as graih Yee: ad shoh lhisagh shiu v'er n'yannoo, gyn faagail y chooid elley gyn jannoo.

verses.name: Luke 11:43
verses.text: Smerg diuish Phariseeyn: son shynney lhieu ny ard-stuill ayns ny kialteenyn, as sleih dy vannaghey diu ayns ny margaghyn.

verses.name: Luke 11:44
verses.text: Smerg diuish scrudeyryn as Phariseeyn, chrauee-oalsey: son ta shiu myr oaiaghyn nagh vel ry-akin, as ny deiney ta shooyl harrystoo, cha vel fys oc dy vel ad ayn.

verses.name: Luke 11:45
verses.text: Eisht dreggyr fer jeh fir-ynsee yn leigh, as dooyrt eh rish, Vainshter, liorish shen y ghra, t'ou dy oltooan shinyn myrgeddin.

verses.name: Luke 11:46
verses.text: As dooyrt eh, Smerg diuish neesht fir-ynsee yn leigh son ta shiu laadey deiney lesh erraghyn doillee dy ve er nyn ymmyrkey, as cha vel shiu hene bentyn rish ny er raghyn lesh unnane jeh nyn meir.

verses.name: Luke 11:47
verses.text: Smerg diuish: son ta shiu troggal lhiaghtyn ny phadeyryn, as ny ayraghyn eu ren y varroo ad.

verses.name: Luke 11:48
verses.text: Dy firrinagh ta shiu gymmyrkey feanish dy vel shiu lowal jeh jannoo ny ayraghyn eu: son ren adsyn dy jarroo y varroo ad, as ta shiuish coamrey ny lhiaghtyn oc.

verses.name: Luke 11:49
verses.text: As shoh yn oyr ta creenaght Yee er ghra, Ver-ym huc phadeyryn, as ostyllyn, as paart jeu nee ad y varroo, as tranlaase y yannoo orroo:

verses.name: Luke 11:50
verses.text: Dy vod fuill ooilley ny phadeyryn v'er ny gheayrtey er-dy hoshiaght y theihll v'er ny chooilleeney er y cheeloghe shoh

verses.name: Luke 11:51
verses.text: Veih fuill Abel gys fuill Zacharias ren cherraghtyn eddyr yn altar as y chiamble: dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, dy bee eh er ny chooilleeney er y cheeloghe shoh.

verses.name: Luke 11:52
verses.text: Smerg diu fir-ynsee yn leigh: son ta shiu er ghoaill ersooyl ogher yn ysseree: cha jagh shiu stiagh shiu hene, as adsyn va goll stiagh, ren shiu y lhiettal.

verses.name: Luke 11:53
verses.text: As tra v'eh er ghra ny reddyn shoh roo, ren ny scrudeyryn as ny Phariseeyn toshiaght dy eginaghey, as dy ghreinnaghey eh dy loayrt jeh ymmodee reddyn:

verses.name: Luke 11:54
verses.text: Lhie ayns farkiaght er e hon, as shegin er tayrtyn red ennagh ass e veeal son oyr plaiynt n'oi.

verses.name: Luke 12:1
verses.text: Nish mysh y traa shen va ymmodee erskyn-earroo dy leih er nyn jaglym cooidjagh, ayns wheesh as dy row ad stampey yn derrey yeh er yn jeh elley, ghow eh toshiaght dy ghra rish e ostyllyn, Erskyn ooilley bee-jee twoaiagh jeh soorid ny Phariseeyn, ta shen dy ghra, craueeaght oalsey.

verses.name: Luke 12:2
verses.text: Son cha vel nhee erbee follit nagh jig gys soilshey; ny kiellit, nagh jig er-ash.

verses.name: Luke 12:3
verses.text: Shen-y-fa cre-erbee ta shiuish er loayrt ayns y dorraghys, bee eh er ny chlashtyn ayns y toilshey: as shen ta shiu er ghra myr hannish, ayns shamyryn, bee eh er ny ockley magh er mullagh ny dhieyn.

verses.name: Luke 12:4
verses.text: As ta mee gra riuish, my chaarjyn, Ny gow-jee aggle rouesyn varrys y corp, as ny lurg shen nagh vel arragh oc oddys ad y vannoo.

verses.name: Luke 12:5
verses.text: Agh ver-yms raaue diu quoi roish ghoys shiu aggle: Gow-jee aggle roishyn, echey ta pooar, erreish da v'er varroo dy hilgey ayns niurin; dy jarroo ta mee dy ghra riu, Gow jee aggle roishyn.

verses.name: Luke 12:6
verses.text: Nagh vel queig sperriu er nyn greck son daa farling, as cha vel unnane oc jarroodit kiongoyrt rish Jee?

verses.name: Luke 12:7
verses.text: Agh ta eer renaigyn nyn ghing ooilley er nyn earroo. Ny gow-jee aggle er-y-fa shen: ta ny smoo dy ve soit jiuish, na jeh ymmodee sperriu.

verses.name: Luke 12:8
verses.text: Myrgeddin ta mee gra riu, Quoi-erbee ghoys rhyms kiongoyrt rish deiney, nee yn Mac dooinney myrgeddin goaill rishyn kiongoyrt rish ainleyn Yee.

verses.name: Luke 12:9
verses.text: Agh bee eshyn obbys mie fenish deiney, er ny obbal fenish ainleyn Yee.

verses.name: Luke 12:10
verses.text: As quoi-erbee loayrys fockle noi Mac y dooinney, bee eh er ny leih da: agh dasyn ta loayrt goan-mollaghtagh noi yn Spyrryd Noo, cha bee eh er ny leih.

verses.name: Luke 12:11
verses.text: As tra ver ad lhieu shiu gys ny quaiylyn, as gys fir-reill as pooaraghyn, ny bee-jee imneagh kys ny cre nee shiu y reggyrt, ny cre nee shiu y ghra:

verses.name: Luke 12:12
verses.text: Son ynsee yn Spyrryd Noo diu, ayns yn oor cheddin cre lhisagh shiu y ghra.

verses.name: Luke 12:13
verses.text: As dooyrt fer jeh'n cheshaght rish Vainshter, loayr rish my vraar eh dy rheynn yn eiraght rhym.

verses.name: Luke 12:14
verses.text: As dooyrt eh rish, Ghooinney, quoi t'er my hoiaghey's seose son briw ny rheynneyder harrishdiu?

verses.name: Luke 12:15
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Gow-jee tastey, as cur-jee twoaie jeh saynt: son cha vel maynrys bea yn dooinney lhie ayns mooarane e chooid-seihlt.

verses.name: Luke 12:16
verses.text: As loayr eh coraa-dorraghey roo, gra, Ren thalloo dooinney berchagh dy row mess y chur magh dy palchey.

verses.name: Luke 12:17
verses.text: As smooinee eh rish hene, gra, Cre share dou jannoo, tra nagh vel boayl tashtee aym dy ghoaill my hroar?

verses.name: Luke 12:18
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt eh, Shoh nee'm y yannoo: Lhieg-ym my hoaltyn, as trog-ym soaltyn smoo; as shen y raad nee'm ooilley my vess as my chooid y hashtey.

verses.name: Luke 12:19
verses.text: As jir-ym rish my annym, O my annym, ta mooarane cooid ayd tashtit seose cour ymmodee bleeantyn: gow dty aash, ee, iu, as bee gennal.

verses.name: Luke 12:20
verses.text: Agh dooyrt Jee rish, Uss ommydan yn oie noght vees dty annym er ny ghoaill void: quoi lesh eisht vees yn chooid shen t'ou uss er jaglym?

verses.name: Luke 12:21
verses.text: Myr shoh ta eshyn ta tashtey seose berchys ny chour hene, as nagh vel berchagh ass lieh Yee.

verses.name: Luke 12:22
verses.text: As dooyrt eh rish e ostyllyn, Shen y fa ta mish gra riuish, Ny bee-jee imneagh son nyn mea, cre nee shiu y ee: ny son nyn girp, cre ver shiu miu.

verses.name: Luke 12:23
verses.text: Ta'n vea ny smoo dy ve soit jeh na beaghey, as y corp na coamrey.

verses.name: Luke 12:24
verses.text: Smooinee-jee er ny fee: son cha vel ad cuirr, ny buinn: cha vel thie stoyr ny soalt oc, as ta Jee dyn meaghey ad: As nagh vel shiuish foddey share na ny eeanlee?

verses.name: Luke 12:25
verses.text: Quoi jiuish liorish smooinaghtyn dy imneagh oddys un chubit y chur gys e yrjid hene?

verses.name: Luke 12:26
verses.text: Mannagh vod shiuish wheesh shen hene y yannoo, cre'n-fa ta shiu imneagh son y chooid elley?

verses.name: Luke 12:27
verses.text: Gow-jee tastey jeh lileeyn ny magher agh kys t'ad gaase, cha vel ad tooilleil, chamoo t'ad sneeu: as foast ta mee gra riu, nagh row Solomon ayns ooilley e ghloyr er ny choamrey myr unnane jeu shoh.

verses.name: Luke 12:28
verses.text: My ta Jee eisht myr shoh coamrey blaa ny magheragh, ta jiu 'sy vagher, as mairagh ceaut ayns yn oghe: nagh jean eh foddey smoo er nyn son euish, O gheiney faase-chredjuagh?

verses.name: Luke 12:29
verses.text: As ny bee-jee seaghnit mysh cre ee-ys, ny cre iu-ys shiu, chamoo bee-jee jeh aigney imneagh nagh bee eh twoaiagh jeh, as giaree eh eh veih my-cheilley, as pointee eh e chronney marish y vooinjer vee-chredjuagh.

verses.name: Luke 12:30
verses.text: Son er ooilley ny reddyn shoh ta ashoonyn y theihll dy jeean aggindagh: agh ta fys ec yn Ayr eu dy vel shiu feme ny reddyn shoh.

verses.name: Luke 12:31
verses.text: Agh shir-jee hoshiaght reeriaght Yee, as bee shiu jeant magh lesh ooilley ny reddyn shoh.

verses.name: Luke 12:32
verses.text: Ny gow-jee aggle my hioltane veg; son she aigney-mie nyn Ayr eh; dy chur diuish yn reeriaght.

verses.name: Luke 12:33
verses.text: Creck-jee ny t'eu, as cur-jee da ny boghtyn: kiare-jee diu hene sporranyn nagh naase shenn, berchys ayns ny niaughyn nagh vel failleil, raad nagh vel y maarliagh cheet er-gerrey, ny'n lhemeen cur mow.

verses.name: Luke 12:34
verses.text: Son raad ta nyn merchys, shen y raad vees y cree eu myrgeddin.

verses.name: Luke 12:35
verses.text: Lhig da ny meeghyn eu ve cryssit, as ny cainleyn eu foaddit;

verses.name: Luke 12:36
verses.text: As shiu hene goll-rish deiney ta farkiaght son cheet-thie nyn Jiarn veih'n vannish, ec y cheet echey tra nee eh cronkal dy vod ad fosley da chelleeragh.

verses.name: Luke 12:37
verses.text: Bannit ta ny sharvaantyn shen yiow yn Chiarn er nyn arrey, tra hig eh: dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, dy gryss eh e gharmad mysh, as dy der eh orroo soie sheese gys bee, as dy jig eh magh dy hirveish orroo.

verses.name: Luke 12:38
verses.text: As my hig eh ayns yn nah arrey, ny my hig eh ayns y trass arrey, as ad y gheddyn myr shen, bannit ta'n vooinjer cheddin.

verses.name: Luke 12:39
verses.text: As shoh toig-jee, dy beagh fys er ve ec mainshter y thie cre'n oor veagh y maarliagh er jeet, veagh eh er ve er e arrey, as cha lhiggagh eh da e hie v'er ny vrishey stiagh.

verses.name: Luke 12:40
verses.text: Bee-jee shiuish myrgeddin er-y-fa shen er nyn arrey: son hig Mac y dooinney ec oor nagh vel shiu smooinaghtyn er.

verses.name: Luke 12:41
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt Peddyr rish, Hiarn nee orrinyn t'ou cheet 'sy choraa-dorraghey shoh, ny myrgeddin er ooilley?

verses.name: Luke 12:42
verses.text: As dooyrt y Chiarn, Quoi eisht yn stiurt firrinagh as creeney shen nee e hiarn y yannoo ny er-reill er lught e hie, dy hirveish orroo nyn meaghey ayns traa cooie?

verses.name: Luke 12:43
