verses.text: S'maynrey yn charvaant cheddin, yiow e hiarn tra hig eh jannoo myr shen.

verses.name: Luke 12:44
verses.text: Ayns firrinys ta mee gra riu, dy der eh da yn stiurtys er ooilley e chooid.

verses.name: Luke 12:45
verses.text: Agh my jir y charvaant shen ayns e chree, Ta my hiarn lhiggey shaghey dy heet; as goaill er dy woalley ny fir-vooinjerey, as ny inneenyn, as dy ee, as dy iu, as dy ve er meshtey.

verses.name: Luke 12:46
verses.text: Hig chiarn y charvaant shen ec laa nagh bee eh jeeaghyn er e hon, as ayns oor nagh bee eh twoaiagh jeh, as giaree ehe eh veih my-cheilley, as pointee eh e chronney marish y vooinjer vee-chredjuagh.

verses.name: Luke 12:47
verses.text: As y charvaant shen va toiggal aigney e hiarn, as nagh dooar eh-hene aarloo, as nagh ren cordail rish e aigney, s'mooar vees y kerraghey echey.

verses.name: Luke 12:48
verses.text: Agh eshyn nagh row toiggal, as ren foiljyn va toilliu kerraghey, cha bee yn kerraghey echey cha trome. Son da quoi erbee ta mooarane er ny choyrt, ersyn vees mooarane er ny hirrey: as da quoi-erbee ta lane currit er e churrym, veihsyn nee sleih jeeaghyn son ny smoo

verses.name: Luke 12:49
verses.text: Haink mish dy chur aile er y thalloo, as cre ta my yeearree, agh dy bee eh hannah er ny oaddey?

verses.name: Luke 12:50
verses.text: Agh ta bashtey ayms dy ve er my vashtey lesh, as kys ta mee eginit, derrey vees eh er ny chooilleeney?

verses.name: Luke 12:51
verses.text: Vel shiu smooinaghtyn dy daink mish dy chur shee er y thalloo? Cha nee, ta mee gra riu, agh anvea.

verses.name: Luke 12:52
verses.text: Son veih shoh magh bee queig ayns un thie noi-ry-hoi, three noi jees, as jees noi three.

verses.name: Luke 12:53
verses.text: Bee yn ayr noi yn mac, as y mac noi yn ayr; yn voir noi yn inneen, as yn inneen noi yn voir yn voir-'sy-leigh noi e ben chleuin, as y ven-chleuin noi e moir-'sy-leigh.

verses.name: Luke 12:54
verses.text: As dooyrt eh myrgeddin rish y pobble, Tra heeys shiu bodjal troggal ass y sheear; chelleeragh ta shiu gra, Ta frass cheet; as shen myr te.

verses.name: Luke 12:55
verses.text: As tra ta'n gheay-jiass sheidey, ta shiu gra, Bee chiass ayn, as te cheet gy-kione.

verses.name: Luke 12:56
verses.text: Chrauee-oalsey, ta shiu son baght y ghoaill jeh neeal yn aer as y thalloo: agh kys te nagh vel shiu goaill baght jeh'n earish shoh?

verses.name: Luke 12:57
verses.text: As cre'n-fa myrgeddin nagh vel shiu eer j'iu hene briwnys shen ny ta cairagh?

verses.name: Luke 12:58
verses.text: Tra t'ou goll fenish yn er-reill marishyn ta ec streeu rhyt, jean ny oddys oo er y raad dy gheddyn rea rish; er-aggle dy dayrn eh lesh oo gys y vriw, as dy livrey yn briw oo da'n tidoor, as dy dilg eh shen oo ayns pryssoon.

verses.name: Luke 12:59
verses.text: Ta mee ginsh dhyt, nagh jig oo magh ass shen derrey t'ou er n'eeck yn farling s'jerree.

verses.name: Luke 13:1
verses.text: Va kionfenish ec y traa shen paart dinsh y da mychione ny Galileanee, yn uill oc va Pilate er gheayrtey maStey (filill) ny ourallyn oc.

verses.name: Luke 13:2
verses.text: As dreggyr Yeesey as dooyrt eh roo, Vel shiuish sheiltyn dy row ny Galileanee shoh nyn beccee erskyn ooilley ny Galileanee, er-y-fa dy duillee ad lheid y baase?

verses.name: Luke 13:3
verses.text: Ta mee ginsh diu, Nagh row: agh mannagh gow shiuish arrys, nee shiu ooilley myrgeddin cherraghtyn.

verses.name: Luke 13:4
verses.text: Ny yn hoght-jeig shen, orroo ren y toor nyns Siloam tuittym, as ad y varroo, vel shiu smooinaghtyn dy row ad nyn beccee erskyn ooilley cummaltee Yerusalem?

verses.name: Luke 13:5
verses.text: Ta mee ginsh diu, Nagh row: agh mannagh gow shiuish arrys, nee shiu ooilley myrgeddin cherraghtyn.

verses.name: Luke 13:6
verses.text: Loayr eh myrgeddin yn coraa-dorraghey shoh: va dooinoey dy row va billey-figgagh echey soit ayns e gharey-feeyney, as haink eh dy yeeaghyn row mess er, as cha dooar eh veg.

verses.name: Luke 13:7
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt eh rish y ghareyder, Cur-my-ner, ny three bleeaney shoh ta mee er jeet dy yeeaghyn voin mess er y villey-figgagh shoh, as cha vel mee geddyn veg: giare sheese eh, cha vel eh agh goaill seose room hallooin.

verses.name: Luke 13:8
verses.text: As dreggyr eshyn as dooyrt eh rish, Hiarn, lhig da shassoo blein elley, derrey neem's reurey mygeayrt y mysh as lhiassaghey eh.

verses.name: Luke 13:9
verses.text: As my nee eh mess y ymmyrkey, s'mie shen: as mannagh jean, foddee oo ny lurg shen y ghiarey sheese eh.

verses.name: Luke 13:10
verses.text: As v'eh gynsaghey ayns unnane jeh ny synagogueyn er y doonaght.

verses.name: Luke 13:11
verses.text: As cur-my-ner va ben ayns shen seaghnit lesh spyrryd doghanagh rish hoght bleeaney jeig, as v'ee crybbit dy cheilley, as cha dod ee er aght erbee ec hene y yeeraghey.

verses.name: Luke 13:12
verses.text: As tra honnick Yeesey ee, deie eh urree huggey, as dooyrt eh r'ee, Ven, t'ou er dty eaysley veih dty ghoghan.

verses.name: Luke 13:13
verses.text: As hug eh e laueyn urree; as er-y chooyl v'ee er ny yannoo jeeragh, as ren ee Jee y ghloyraghey.

verses.name: Luke 13:14
verses.text: As dreggyr fer-reill yn synagogue lesh jymmoose, er-yn-oyr dy row Yeesey er lheihys er laa yn doonaght, as dooyrt eh rish y pobble, Ta shey laa ayn ry-hoi gobbraghey: er ny laghyn shen er-y-fa shen tar-jee dy ve er nyn lheihys, as cha nee er laa yn doonaght.

verses.name: Luke 13:15
verses.text: Eisht dreggyr y Chiarn eh, gra, Er crauee-oalsey, nagh vel dagh fer jiuish er y doonaght feaysley e ghow ny e assyl veih'n staik, as dy chur lesh magh dy ushtaghey eh?

verses.name: Luke 13:16
verses.text: As nagh lhisagh y ven shoh ta ny hinneen da Abraham, ee ta satan er chiangley, cur-my-ner ny hoght bleeaney jeig shoh, ve er ny eaysley veih yn vondiaght shoh er laa yn doonaght?

verses.name: Luke 13:17
verses.text: As tra v'eh er loayrt ny goan shoh, ghow ooilley e noidyn nearey: agh va ooilley yn pobble ayns ard-voggey son ooilley ny reddyn gloyroil va jeant liorishyn.

verses.name: Luke 13:18
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt eh, Cre ta reeriaght Yee goll-rish? as cre gys nee'm y hoylaghey eh?

verses.name: Luke 13:19
verses.text: Te goll-rish grine dy rass mustard, ren dooinney y ghoaill, as y hilgey ayns e gharey, as daase eh, as haink eh dy ve ny villey vooar: as ren eeanlee yn aer fastee y ghoaill ayns ny banglaneyn echey.

verses.name: Luke 13:20
verses.text: As reesht dooyrt eh, Cre gys nee'm reeriaght Yee y hoylaghey?

verses.name: Luke 13:21
verses.text: Te goll-rish soorid, ren ben y ghoaill as follaghey ayns three towseyn dy veinn, derrey va'n clane soorit.

verses.name: Luke 13:22
verses.text: As hie eh magh trooid ny ard-valjyn as ny baljyn-cheerey, gynsaghey as goll er e hoshiaght gys Jerusalem.

verses.name: Luke 13:23
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt fer rish, Hiarn, nee beggan ta er nyn sauail? As dooyrt eh roo.

verses.name: Luke 13:24
verses.text: Streeu-jee shiuush dy gholl stiagh er y ghiat coon: son nee ymmodee, ta mee gra riu, shirrey goll stiagh, agh cha jig eh lhieu.

verses.name: Luke 13:25
verses.text: Keayrt dy vel mainshter y thie er n'irree, as y dorrys dooint, as dy jean shiuish toshiaght dy hassoo er cheu-mooie, as dy chronkal ec y dorrys, gra, Hiarn, Hiarn, foshil dooin; as freggyree eshyn as jir eh riu, Cha nione dou shiu, cre veih ta shiu:

verses.name: Luke 13:26
verses.text: Eisht gowee shiuish toshiaght dy ghra, Ta shin er n'ee as er n'iu ayns dty enish, as t'ou er n'ynsaghey ayns ny straidyn ain.

verses.name: Luke 13:27
verses.text: Agh jir eshyn, Ta mee ginsh diu, nagh nione dou shiu, cre veih ta shiu: ersooyl-jee voym ooilley shiuish ghrogh-yantee.

verses.name: Luke 13:28
verses.text: Shen-y-raad vees keayney as snaggeraght feeacklyn, tra hee shiu Abraham, aa Isaac as Jacob as ooilley ny phadeyryn ayns reeriaght Yee, as shiu hene er nyn yioolaey magh.

verses.name: Luke 13:29
verses.text: As hig ad veih'n niar, as veih'n neear, as veih'n twoaie as veih'n jiass, as soie-ee ad sheese ayns reeriaght-Yee.

verses.name: Luke 13:30
verses.text: As cur-my-ner, ta er-jerrey vees hoshiaght, as ta hoshiaght vees er-jerrey.

verses.name: Luke 13:31
verses.text: Yn laa cheddin, haink shiartanse jeh ny Phariseeyn, as dooyrt ad rish, Fow ersooyl, as immee royd veih shoh; son ta Herod sleeuit er dty rioys y ghoaill.

verses.name: Luke 13:32
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Immee-jee shiuish as insh-jee da'n shynnagh shen, Cur-my-ner, ta mee castey drogh-spyrrydyn, as lheihys doghanyn jiu as mairagh, as y trass laa bee'm er my ghloyraghey.

verses.name: Luke 13:33
verses.text: Ny yeih, Shegin dou shooyl jiu as mairagh, as y laa er-giyn: son s'coan oddys phadeyr cherraghtyn agh ayns Jerusalem.

verses.name: Luke 13:34
verses.text: O Yerusalem, Yerusalem, ta cur dy baase ny phadeyryn, as dyn glaghey adsyn t'er nyn goyrt er chaghteraght hood: cre cha mennick as va mish aggindagh v'er hagIym dty chloan cooidjagh, myr ta kiark clussaghey e aalagh fo my skianyn, agh cha bailliu shen!

verses.name: Luke 13:35
verses.text: Cur-my-ner, ta'n thie eu faagit diu follym-faase: as dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, nagh vaik shiu mish maghey shoh, derrey hig yn traa dy jir shiu, Bannit ta eshyn ta cheet ayns ennym y Chiarn.

verses.name: Luke 14:1
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione, tra v'eh er gholl stiagh ayns thie fer jeh ny ard Phariseeyn dy ee arran er y doonaght, dy row sooill oc er.

verses.name: Luke 14:2
verses.text: As cur-my-ner, va dooinney kionfenish, va'n dropsee er.

verses.name: Luke 14:3
verses.text: As dreggyr Yeesey, as loayr eh rish fir-ynsee yn leigh as rish ny Phariseeyn, gra, Vel eh lowal dy lheihys er laayn doonaght?

verses.name: Luke 14:4
verses.text: As v'ad nyn-dhost. As ghow eh as laanee eh eh, as lhig eh yn raad da:

verses.name: Luke 14:5
verses.text: As dreggyr eh ad, gra, Quoi j'iu vees dow ny assyl echey er huittym ayns jeeg, nagh jean jeeragh y hayrn ass eh er y doonaght?

verses.name: Luke 14:6
verses.text: As cha row ansoor erbee oc dy choyrt gys ny goan shoh.

verses.name: Luke 14:7
verses.text: As loayr eh coraa-dorraghey rish ny goaldee, tra hug eh tastey kys v'ad reih ny stuill byrjey; gra roo,

verses.name: Luke 14:8
verses.text: Tra t'ou cuirt liorish dooinney erbee gys bannish, ny soie sheese er y stoyl syrjey; er-aggle dy bee dooinney s'ooasle na uss er ny chuirrey liorish;

verses.name: Luke 14:9
verses.text: As dy jig eshyn ren shiu nyn neesht y chuirrey, as dy jir eh rhyt, Cur raad da'n dooinney shoh; as dy jean oo toshiaght lesh nearey dy ghoaill y stoyl s'inshley.

verses.name: Luke 14:10
verses.text: Agh tra vees oo cuirt, immee, as soie sheese er y stoyl s'inshley; tra hig eshyn ren dty chuirrey, dy vod eh gra rhyt, Charrey, gow seose ny syrjey: eisht bee ooashley ayd ayns yn enish ocsyn ta nyn soie ec bee mayrt:

verses.name: Luke 14:11
verses.text: Son quoi-erbee ta dy hoiaghey eh-hene seose, bee eh er ny injillaghey; as eshyn ta dy injillaghey eh-hene, bee eh er ny hoiaghey seose.

verses.name: Luke 14:12
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt eh rishyn ren y chuirrey eh, Tra t'ou jannoo jinnair ny shibber, ny cuir dty chaarjyn, ny dty vraaraghyn, ny dty gheiney-mooinjerey, ny dty naboonyn berchagh; er-aggle dy jean adsyn oo y chuirrey reesht, as dy bee lhiassaghey er ny yannoo dhyt.

verses.name: Luke 14:13
verses.text: Agh tra t'ou jannoo cuirraghyn, eie er ny boghtyn, ny baccee, ny croobee, as ny doail:

verses.name: Luke 14:14
verses.text: As bee oo bannit; son cha vod adsyn cooilleeney 'chur dhyt: son bee oo cooilleenit ec irree-reesht y chloan chairagh.

verses.name: Luke 14:15
verses.text: As tra cheayll fer jeusyn va nyn soie ec bee marish ny goan shoh, dooyrt eh rish, Bannit ta eshyn ee-ys arran ayns reeriaght Yee.

verses.name: Luke 14:16
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt eh rish, Ren dooinney dy row shibber vooar, as chuir eh ymmodee:

verses.name: Luke 14:17
verses.text: As hug eh magh e harvaant ec traa shibberagh dy ghra rish ny goaldee, Tar-jee, son ta dy chooilley nhee nish aarloo.

verses.name: Luke 14:18
verses.text: As ren ad ooilley toshiaght lesh un aigney dy yannoo leshtalyn. Dooyrt y chied er, Ta mee er chionnaghey peesh dy halloo, as shegin dou goll dy yeeaghyn er: guee-ym ort, jean my leshtal.

verses.name: Luke 14:19
verses.text: As dooyrt fer elley, Ta mee er chionnaghey queig chubbil dy ghew, as ta mee goll dy phowal ad: ta mee guee ort jean my leshtal.

verses.name: Luke 14:20
verses.text: As dooyrt fer elley, Ta mee er phoosey ben, as er-y-fa shen cha voddym cheet.

verses.name: Luke 14:21
verses.text: Myr shen haink y charvaant cheddin, as hoilshee eh da e hiarn ny reddyn shoh. Eisht va mainshter y thie jymmoosagh, as dooyrt eh rish e harvaant, Gow magh dy tappee gys straidyn as raaidyn yn ard-valley, as cur lhiat stiagh ayns shoh ny boghtyn, as ny baccee, as ny croobee, as ny doail:

verses.name: Luke 14:22
verses.text: As dooyrt y charvaant, Hiarn, te jeant myr t'ou er harey, as foast ta room.

verses.name: Luke 14:23
verses.text: As dooyrt y chiarn rish y charvaant, Gow magh gys ny raaidyn mooarey as ny cleigh, as guee orroo dy heet stiagh, dy vod my hie ve er ny lhieeney.

verses.name: Luke 14:24
verses.text: Son ta mee gra riu, nagh jean fer jeh ny deiney va cuirt, blashtyn jeh my hibber,

verses.name: Luke 14:25
verses.text: As hie earrooyn mooarey dy leih marish: as hyndaa eh, as dooyrt eh roo,

verses.name: Luke 14:26
verses.text: My hig dooinney erbee hym's, as nagh vel graih sloo echey er e ayr as e voir, as e ven, as e chloan, as e vraaraghyn, as e hayraghyn, dy jarroo, as er e vioys hene (na orrym's) cha vod eh dy firrinagh gynsaghey voym's.

verses.name: Luke 14:27
verses.text: As quoi-erbee nagh vel gymmyrkey e chrosh, as cheet geiyrt orrym's, cha vod eh ve ny eiyrtyssagh dooys.

verses.name: Luke 14:28
verses.text: Quoi jiuish ta kiarail toor y hroggal, nagh vel soie sheese hoshiaght, as coontey yn cost, vel wheesh echey as ver mullagh er?

verses.name: Luke 14:29
verses.text: Er-aggle erreish da yn undin y boiaghey, as nagh vel yn fort echey dy chur kione er, dy jean ooilley nee fakin eh toshiaght dy chraidey mysh,

verses.name: Luke 14:30
verses.text: Gra, Ren y dooinney shoh toshiaght dy vuildal, as cha row fort echey kione y cur er e obbyr.

verses.name: Luke 14:31
verses.text: Ny cre'n ree ragh dy yannoo caggey noi ree elley, nagh soiagh sheese hoshiaght dy ghoaill coyrle, vel eh son goll magh lesh jeih thousaneyn ny whail echeysyn ta cheet n'oi lesh feed thousane?

verses.name: Luke 14:32
verses.text: Er-nonney, choud as ta'n ree elley foddey veih, t'eh cur chaghteraght huggey, as chebbal conaantyn shee.

verses.name: Luke 14:33
verses.text: Myr shen myrgeddin quoi-erbee jiuish, nagh vel treigeil ooilley ny t'echey, cha vod eh ve ny eiyrtyssagh dooys.

verses.name: Luke 14:34
verses.text: Ta sollan mie: agh my ta'n sollan er choayl e vlass, kys hig e vree ayn reesht?

verses.name: Luke 14:35
verses.text: Cha vel ymmyd ayn son y thalloo, ny foast son y torran; agh ta deiney dy cheau magh eh. Eshyn ta cleayshyn echey dy chlashtyn, lhig da clashtyn.

verses.name: Luke 15:1
verses.text: Eisht haink er-gerrey da ooilley ny publicanee as ny peccee dy eaishtagh; rish.

verses.name: Luke 15:2
verses.text: As ren ny Phariseeyn as ny scrudeyryn tallagh, gra, Ta'n dooinney shoh goaill rish peccee, as gee maroo.

verses.name: Luke 15:3
verses.text: as loayr eh yn coraa-dorraghey shoh roo, gra,

verses.name: Luke 15:4
verses.text: Quoi yn dooinney ny mast' euish ta keead keyrrey echey, as coayl unnane jeu nagh vel eh faagail yn chiare-feed as yn nuy jeig ayns yn aasagh, as goll dy hirrey yn cheyrrey chailjey, derrey t'eh dy gheddyn ee?

verses.name: Luke 15:5
verses.text: As tra t'eh er gheddyn ee, t'eh dy choyrt ee er e gheayltyn, goaill boggey.

verses.name: Luke 15:6
verses.text: As tra t'eh cheet thie, t'eh geamagh er e chaarjyn as e naboonyn cooidjagh, as gra roo, Gow-Jee boggey marym, son ta mee er gheddyn my cheyrrey va caillit.

verses.name: Luke 15:7
verses.text: Ta mee gra riu, dy bee boggey myrgeddin ayns niau, jeh un pheccagh ta goaill arrys, ny smoo na jeh kiare-feed as nuy persoonyn jeig cairagh, nagh vel feme arrys.

verses.name: Luke 15:8
verses.text: Ny cre'n ven ta jeih peeshyn dy argid eck, as ee dy choayl un pheesh, nagh vel ee foaddey cainle, as sceabey yn thie, as shirrey dy kiaralagh, derrey t'ee dy gheddyn eh?

verses.name: Luke 15:9
verses.text: As tra t'ee er gheddyn eh, t'ee geamagh er e caarjyn as e naboonyn cooidjagh, gra, Gow-jee boggey marym, son ta mee er gheddyn yn pheesh ren mee y choayl.

verses.name: Luke 15:10
verses.text: Myrgeddin ta mee gra riu, dy vel boggey ayns fenish ainleyn Yee jeh un pheccagh ta goaill arrys.

verses.name: Luke 15:11
verses.text: As dooyrt eh, Va daa vac ec dooinney dy row:

verses.name: Luke 15:12
verses.text: A s dooyrt y fer saa rish e ayr, Ayr, cur dooys yn ayrn dy chooid ta my chour. As rheynn eh e eh chooid orroo.

verses.name: Luke 15:13
verses.text: As laghyn ny lurg shen, hymsee yn mac saa ooilley cooidjagh as ghow eh jurnah gys cheer foddey, as ayns shen hug eh jummal er e chooid liorish baghey rouanagh.

verses.name: Luke 15:14
verses.text: As tra va ooilley baarit echey, dirree genney vooar ayns y cheer shen; as ren eh toshiaght dy ve ayns feme.

verses.name: Luke 15:15
verses.text: As hie eh as daill eh eh-hene rish cummaltagh jeh'n cheer shen; as hug eshyn eh magh gys ny magheryn echey dy ve son bochilley muickey.

verses.name: Luke 15:16
verses.text: As by-vian lesh e volg y lhieeney lesh ny bleaystyn va ny muckyn dy ee: as cha row dooinney erbee hug cooney da.

verses.name: Luke 15:17
verses.text: As tra v'eh er jeet huggey hene, dooyrt eh, Nagh nhimmey sharvaant failt t'ec my ayr ta nyn saie arran oc, as fooilliagh, as ta mish goll mow laccal beaghey!

verses.name: Luke 15:18
verses.text: Trog-ym orrym, as hem roym gys my ayr, as jir-ym rish, Ayr, ta mee er n'yannoo peccah noi niau, as kiongoyrt rhyt's,

verses.name: Luke 15:19
verses.text: rish fer jeh dty harvaantyn sailt.

verses.name: Luke 15:20
verses.text: As hrog eh er, as haink eh gys e ayr. Agh tra v'eh foast foddey veih, honnick e ayr eh, as va chymmey echey er, as roie eh, as ghow eh eh ayns e roihaghyn as phaag eh eh.

verses.name: Luke 15:21
verses.text: As dooyrt y mac rish, Ayr, ta mee er n'yannoo peccah noi niau, as ayns dty hilley's, as cha vel mee ny-sodjey feeu dy ve enmyssit dty vac.

verses.name: Luke 15:22
verses.text: Agh dooyrt yn ayr rish e harvaantyn, Cur-jee lhieu magh yn coamrey share, as cur-jee er eh, as cur-jee fainey er e laue, as braagyn er e chassyn.

verses.name: Luke 15:23
verses.text: As cur-jee lhieu ayns shoh yn lheiy beiyht, as marr-jee eh; as lhig dooin gee as ve gennal.

verses.name: Luke 15:24
verses.text: Son v'eh shoh my vac marroo, as t'eh bio reesht; v'eh caillit, as t'eh er ny gheddyn reesht. As ren ad toshiaght dy yannoo gien mie.

verses.name: Luke 15:25
verses.text: Nish va'n mac shinney mooie 'sy vagher: as tra haink eh er-gerrey da'n thie, cheayll eh kiaulleeaght as daunsin.

verses.name: Luke 15:26
verses.text: As deie eh er fer jeh'n vooinjer, as denee eh cre son va shoh.

verses.name: Luke 15:27
verses.text: As dooyrt eh rish, Ta dty vraar er jeet thie; as ta dty ayr er varroo yn lheiy beiyht, er-yn-oyr dy vel eh er jeet thie huggey slane follan.

verses.name: Luke 15:28
verses.text: As v'eh feer chorree, as cha baillish goll stiagh: shen-y-fa haink e ayr magh, as vreag eh eh.

verses.name: Luke 15:29
verses.text: As dreggyr eshyn, as dooyrt eh rish e ayr, Cur-my-ner, ta mish rish whilleen blein shen ayns dty hirveish, chamoo ren mee rieau noi dty aigney, as foast cha dug oo dou rieau wheesh mannan, dy yannoo gien marish my gheiney-mooinjerey:

verses.name: Luke 15:30
verses.text: Agh cha leah as v'eh shoh dty vac er jeet, ta er vaarail dty chooid er streebeeyn t'ou er varroo er e hon yn lheiy beiyht.

verses.name: Luke 15:31
verses.text: As dooyrt eh rish, Vac, t'ou er ny ve kinjagh marym, as lhiat's ooilley ny t'aym.

verses.name: Luke 15:32
verses.text: Ve cooie dooin ve gennal, as boggey y ghoaill: son v'eh shoh dty vraar marroo as t'eh bio reesht: v'eh caillit, as t'eh er ny gheddyn.

verses.name: Luke 16:1
verses.text: AS dooyrt eh myrgeddin rish e ostyllyn, Va dooinney berchagh dy row as stiurt echey, va er ny chassid huggey son jummal e chooid.

verses.name: Luke 16:2
verses.text: As deie eh er, as dooyrt eh rish, Kys dy vel mee clashtyn shoh jeed? cur coontey jeh dty stiurtys: son cha vod oo ve ny sodjey dty stiurt,

verses.name: Luke 16:3
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt y stiurt rish hene, Cre nee'm? son ta my hiarn goaill y stiurtys voym: cha voddym reurey, as dy huill ny dhieyn ta nearey orrym.

verses.name: Luke 16:4
verses.text: Shoh ta mee kiarail dy yannoo tra chaill-ym y stiurtys, dy vod paart jeu goaill mee stiagh ayns ny thieyn oc.

verses.name: Luke 16:5
verses.text: Er shoh deie eh orroosyn ooilley v'ayns lhiastynys da e hiarn, as dooyrt eh rish y chied er, Cre-woad t'ou uss dy lhiastyn dy my hiarn?

verses.name: Luke 16:6
verses.text: As dooyrt eh, Keead towse dy ooil As dooyrt eh rish, Gow dty lioar, as soie sheese-dy tappee, as scrieu jeih as da-eed.

verses.name: Luke 16:7
verses.text: As doogrt eh rish fer elley, As cre-woad t'ou uss dy lhiastyn? As dooyrt eh, Keead owse dy churnaght. As dooyrt eh rish,Gow dty lioar as scrieu kiare-feed.

verses.name: Luke 16:8
verses.text: As voyll y chiarn y stiurt neu-chairagh, er-y-fa dy row eh er n'yannoo dy creeney: son ta cloan y theihll shoh ayns nyn sheeloghe ny s'creeney na cloan y toilshey.

verses.name: Luke 16:9
verses.text: As ta mee gra riu, Jean-jee diu hene caarjyn liorish y mammon molteyragh; tra nee shiu failleil dy vod ad shiu y ghoaill stiagh gys ny ynnydyn vaghee dy bragh farraghtyn.

verses.name: Luke 16:10
verses.text: Eshyn ta ynrick ayns yn nhee s'fardalee, t'eh ynrick myrgeddin ayns mooarane: as eshyn ta neu-charragh ayns y nhee s'fadalee, t'eh neu-chairagh myrgeddin ayns mooarane.

verses.name: Luke 16:11
verses.text: Mannagh vel shiu er-y-fa shen er ve ynrick ayns y mammon molteyragh, quoi ver yn verchys firrinagh fo nyn gurrym?

verses.name: Luke 16:12
verses.text: As mannagh vel shiu er ve firrinagh ayns ny ta lesh dooinney elley, quoi ver diu ny vees lhieu hene?

verses.name: Luke 16:13
verses.text: Cha vod sharvaant erbee daa vainshter y hirveish: son eddyr ver eh feoh da'n derrey yeh as graih da'n jeh elley; er nonney cummee eh gys y derrey yeh, as soie-ee eh beg jeh'n jeh elley. Cha vod shiu Jee as mammon y hirveish.

verses.name: Luke 16:14
verses.text: As cheayll ny Phariseeyn myrgeddin va sayntoilagh, ooilley ny reddyn shoh: as ren ad gannidys er.

verses.name: Luke 16:15
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Shiuish yn vooinjer ta dy heyrey shiu hene kiongoyrt rish deiney: agh ta fys ec Jee er ny creeaghyn eu: son ta shen ta dy mooar soit jeh mastey deiney, feohdoil ayns shilley Yee.

verses.name: Luke 16:16
verses.text: Va'n leigh as ny phadeyryn derrey Ean: er-dyn traa shen, ta reeriaght Yee er ny phreacheil, as ta dy chooilley ghooinney chionney stiagh huggey.

verses.name: Luke 16:17
verses.text: Agh te ny sassey da'n aer as da'n thalloo dy herraghtyn, na da un floag jeh'n leigh dy ailleil.

verses.name: Luke 16:18
verses.text: Quoi-erbee scarrys rish e ven, as phoosys ben elley, t'eh brishey poosey: as quoi-erbee phoosys ish ta scarrit veih e sheshey, t'eh brishey poosey.

verses.name: Luke 16:19
verses.text: Va dooinney berchagh dy row va coamrit ayns gorrym-jiarg, as sheeidey, as farrail dy soaillagh dy chooilley laa.

verses.name: Luke 16:20
verses.text: As va boght dy row va enmyssit Lazarus, va ny lhie ec y ghiat echey lane dy hingyn,

verses.name: Luke 16:21
verses.text: As geearree dy ve jeant magh lesh y vrooillagh va tuittym jeh boayrd y dooinney berchagh: agh haink ny eer moddee as sliee ad ny chingyn echey.

verses.name: Luke 16:22
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione, dy dooar y dooinney boght baase, as dy dug dy ainleyn lhieu eh gys oghrish Abraham: hooar y dooinney berchagh myrgeddin baase, as v'eh er ny oanluckey.

verses.name: Luke 16:23
verses.text: As ayns niurin, raad v'eh er ny horchaghey, hrog eh seose e hooillyn, as honnick eh Abraham foddey veih, as Lazarus ayns e oghrish.

verses.name: Luke 16:24
verses.text: As deie eh as dooyrt eh, Ayr Abraham, jean myghin orrym, as cur Lazarus, dy vod eh baare e vair y hummey ayns ushtey, as my hengey y eayraghey; son ta mee er my horchaghey ayns y lossey shoh.

verses.name: Luke 16:25
verses.text: Agh dooyrt Abrabam, Vac, cooinee uss ayns earish dty vea dy row ayd's dy chooilley nhee mie, as myrgeddin ec Lazarus cha row monney agh seaghyn: agh nish t'eshyn er ny gherjaghey, as t'ou uss er dty horchaghey,

verses.name: Luke 16:26
verses.text: As marish shoh ooilley, ta eddyr shinyn as shiuish diunid vooar soit: myr shen adsyn ta aignagh dy gholl yeih shoh hiuish, cha vod ad; chamoo oddys adsyn cheet hooinyn bailliu cheet veih shen.

verses.name: Luke 16:27
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt eh, Ta mee guee ort er-y-fa shen, ayr, dy choyrt eh gys thie my ayrey:

verses.name: Luke 16:28
verses.text: Son ta queig braaraghyn aym; dy vod eh feanish y ymmyrkey daue, nagh jig adsyn myrgeddin gys y boayl shoh dy horchagh.

verses.name: Luke 16:29
verses.text: Dooyrt Abraham rish, Ta Moses as ny phadeyryn oc; lhig daue clashtyn adsyn.

verses.name: Luke 16:30
verses.text: As dooyrt eh, Cha nee, O ayr Abraham: agh dy ragh chaghter huc veih ny merriu, ghoghe ad arrys.

verses.name: Luke 16:31
verses.text: As dooyrt eh rish, Mannagh der ad geill da Moses as ny phadeyryn, cha greidjagh ad, ga dy n'irragh fer veih ny merriu.

verses.name: Luke 17:1
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt eh rish e ostyllyn, Cha vod eh ve, agh dy bee oyryn peccah ayn: agh smerg dasyn liorish hig ad.

verses.name: Luke 17:2
verses.text: Veagh eh ny bare dasyn clagh-wyllin ve croghit mysh e wannal, as eh dy ve baiht ayns y cheayn, na eh dy hayrn gys peccah unnane jeh'n vooinjer veggey shoh.

verses.name: Luke 17:3
verses.text: Cur-jee twoaie diu hene: My nee dty vraar aggair dhyt, cur oghsan da; us my ghoys eh arrys, leih da.

verses.name: Luke 17:4
verses.text: As my nee eh peccah dt'oi shiaght keayrtyn 'sy laa, as shiaght keayrtyn 'sy laa chyndaa reesht hood as gra, Ta mee goaill arrys; te ort leih da.

verses.name: Luke 17:5
verses.text: As dooyrt ny ostyllyn rish y Chiarn, Bishee yn credjue ainyn.

verses.name: Luke 17:6
verses.text: As dooyrt y Chiarn, Dy beagh credjue eu myr grine dy rass mustard, oddagh shiu gra rish y billey-sycamine shoh, Bee er dty hayrn ass ny fraueyn, as bee er dty hoiaghey ayns y cheayn; as yinnagh eh biallys diu.

verses.name: Luke 17:7
verses.text: Agh quoi eu ta sharvaant echey traaue, ny bochillagh ollagh, jirrys rish chelleeragh, tra vees eh er jeet veih'n vagher, Immee as soie gys y voayrd?

verses.name: Luke 17:8
verses.text: As nagh jir hoshiaght rish, Fow aarloo my hibber, as kiartee oo hene dy hirveish orrym's, derrey vee'm erreish gee as giu, us ny lurg shen nee uss gee as giu?

verses.name: Luke 17:9
verses.text: Vel booise er da'n charvaant shen, Son jannoo myr v'eh oardit? Er-lhiam nagh vel.

verses.name: Luke 17:10
verses.text: Myr shen neesht shiuish tra vees shiu er n'yannoo ooilley ny t'er ny harey diu, abbyr jee. She sharvaantyn neu-frioosagh shin: ta shin er n'yannoo ynrycan ny va orrin dy yannoo.

verses.name: Luke 17:11
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione, myr v'eh er e vurnah gys Jerusalem, dy jimmee eh trooid mean Samaria as Galilee.

verses.name: Luke 17:12
verses.text: As myr v'eh goll stiagh ayns balley dy row, haink ny whail jeih deiney va nyn louranee, as hass ad foddey veih:

verses.name: Luke 17:13
verses.text: As hrog ad seose nyn goraa, as dooyrt ad, Yeesey, Vainshter, jean myghin orrin.

verses.name: Luke 17:14
verses.text: As tra v'eh er jeeaghyn orroo, dooyrt eh roo, Immee-jee as jeeagh-jee shiu hene da ny saggyrtyn. As haink eh gy-kione, myr v'ad goll, dy row ad er nyn ghlenney.

verses.name: Luke 17:15
verses.text: As hyndaa fer jeu back, tra honnick eh dy row eh er ny laanaghey, as lesh ard choraa hug eh moylley da Jee,

verses.name: Luke 17:16
verses.text: As huitt eh sheese er e eddin ec ny cassyn echey, cur booise da: as v'eh ny Samaritan.

verses.name: Luke 17:17
verses.text: As dreggyr Yeesey, gra, Nagh row jeih er ny ghlenney? agh cre vel yn nuy?

verses.name: Luke 17:18
verses.text: Cha vel er nyn gheddyn t'er jyndaa dy chur gloyr da Jee, agh yn ynrycan joarree shoh.

verses.name: Luke 17:19
verses.text: As dooyrt eh rish, Irree, immee royd; ta dty chredjue er dty laanaghey.

verses.name: Luke 17:20
verses.text: As tra denee ny Phariseeyn jeh, cre'n traa harragh reeriaght Yee? dreggyt eh ad, gra, Cha jig reeriaght Yee lesh stayd chronnal.

verses.name: Luke 17:21
verses.text: Chamoo jir ad, Jeeagh shoh, ny jeeagh shid: son cur-my-ner, ta reeriaght Yee cheu-sthie jeu.

verses.name: Luke 17:22
verses.text: As dooyrt eh rish e ostyllyn, Hig y traa dy bee shiu aignagh dy akin unnane jeh laghyn Mac y dooinney, as cha vaik shiu eh.

verses.name: Luke 17:23
verses.text: As jir ad riu, jeeagh-jee ayns shoh, as jeeagh-jee ayns shid: ny roie-jee geiyrt orroo, as ny lhian-jee roo.

verses.name: Luke 17:24
verses.text: Son myr ta'n tendreil soilshean veih ard dy ard fo yn aer: myr shen myrgeddin vees Mac y dooinney ayns y laa echeysyn.

verses.name: Luke 17:25
verses.text: Agh hoshiaght shegin da ymmodee seaghyn y hurranse, as ve beg soit jeh liorish y sheeloghe shoh.

verses.name: Luke 17:26
verses.text: As myr ve rish lhing Noe, shen myr vees eh neesht ayns laghyn Mac y dooinney.

verses.name: Luke 17:27
verses.text: V'ad gee, v'ad giu, v'ad poosey, v'ad er nyn goyrt ayns poosey, derrey'n laa hie Noe stiagh ayns yn arg: as haink y thooilley as vaih eh ad ooilley.

verses.name: Luke 17:28
verses.text: As er yn aght cheddin myr ve ayns laghyn Lot, v'ad gee, v'ad giu v'ad kionnaghey, v'ad creck, v'ad soiaghey biljyn, v'ad troggal thieyn:

verses.name: Luke 17:29
verses.text: Agh er yn eer laa hie Lot magh ass Sodom, gheayrt neose orroo aile as brimstone veih niau, as ren eh ad ooilley y stroie:

verses.name: Luke 17:30
verses.text: Eer er yn aght cheddin vees eh er y laa vees yn Mac dooinney er ny hoilshaghey.

verses.name: Luke 17:31
verses.text: Ayns y laa shen, eshyn vees er mullagh y thie, as e chooid sthie, ny lhig da cheet neose dy chur lesh eh: as eshyn ta ayns y vagher, ny lhig dasyn myrgeddin chyndaa back

verses.name: Luke 17:32
verses.text: Cooinee-jee er ben Lot.

verses.name: Luke 17:33
verses.text: Quoi-erbee ta shirrey e vioys y hauail caillee eh eh: as quoi-erbee nee e vioys y choayl, saue-ee eh eh.

verses.name: Luke 17:34
verses.text: Ta mee ginsh diu, ayns yn oie shen dy bee daa ghooinney ayns un lhiabbee: as bee yn derrey yeh goit, as y jeh elley faagit.

verses.name: Luke 17:35
verses.text: Bee daa ven blieh cooidjagh, bee yn derrey yeh goit, as y jeh elley faagit.

verses.name: Luke 17:36
verses.text: Bee daa ghooinney ayns y vagher; bee yn derrey yeh goit, as y jeh elley faagit.

verses.name: Luke 17:37
verses.text: As dreggyr ad, as dooyrt ad rish, C'raad, Hiarn? As dooyrt eshyn roo, Raad erbee dy vel yn convayrt, shen-y-raad vees ny urlee er nyn jaglym cooidjagh.

verses.name: Luke 18:1
verses.text: Aa loayr eh coraa-dorraghey roo, dy lhisagh deiney kinjagh padjer y ghoaill, as gyn ad y ve lhiastey;

verses.name: Luke 18:2
verses.text: Gra, Va ayns ard-valley dy row briw nagh row ayns aggle roish Jee, ny soiaghey jeh deiney.

verses.name: Luke 18:3
verses.text: As va ben-treoghe ayns yn ard-valley cheddin, haink huggey, gra, Jean cairys dou er my noid.

verses.name: Luke 18:4
verses.text: As son tammylt cha dug eh geill jee: agh ny lurg shen dooyrt eh rish hene, Ga nagh vel mee goaill aggle roish Jee, ny jannoo soiaghey jeh dooinney:

verses.name: Luke 18:5
verses.text: Ny-yeih er-y-fa dy vel y ven-treoghe shoh dy my voirey, ver-ym cairys jee, er-aggle liorish cheet cha kinjagh dy jean ee skee jee'm.

verses.name: Luke 18:6
verses.text: As dooyrt y Chiarn, Clasht-jee cre ta'n briw neu-chairagh dy ghra.

verses.name: Luke 18:7
verses.text: As nagh jean Jee cooilleeney ass lieh e chloan reiht hene, ta geamagh huggey oie as laa, ga dy vel eh foddey lhiggey shaghey?

verses.name: Luke 18:8
verses.text: Ta mee ginsh diu dy jean eh dy tappee goaill cooilleeney er nyn son. Ny-yeih tra hig Mac y dooinney, vow eh credjue er y thalloo?

verses.name: Luke 18:9
verses.text: As loayr eh yn coraa-dorraghey shoh rish shiartanse va treishteil ayndoo hene dy row ad cairagh, agh soiaghey beg jeh feallagh elley:

verses.name: Luke 18:10
verses.text: Hie daa ghooinney seose gys y chiamble dy ghoaill padjer; va'n derrey yeh ny Pharisee, as y jeh elley ny Phublican.

verses.name: Luke 18:11
verses.text: Hass y Pharisee as ghow eh padjer myr shoh rish hene, Yee, ta mee cur booise dhyt, nagh vel mish myr deiney elley, tranlaasee, neu-chairagh, brishey-poosey, ny foast myr y publican shoh.

verses.name: Luke 18:12
verses.text: Ta mee trostey daa cheayrt 'sy chiaghtin, ta mee cur jaghee jeh ooilley ny t'ayns my chummal.

verses.name: Luke 18:13
verses.text: As hass y publican foddey veih, as cha b'lhoys da wheesh as e hooillyn y hroggal seose gys niau, agh woaill eh er e chleeau, gra, Dy row Jee myghinagh dooys ta my ghooinney peccoil.

verses.name: Luke 18:14
verses.text: Ta mee ginsh diu, dy jagh y dooinney shoh sheese gys e hie er ny heyrey roish y jeh elley: son bee dy chooilley er ta dy hoiaghey eh-hene seose er ny injillaghey as bee eshyn ta dy injillaghey eh-hene, er ny hoiaghey seose.

verses.name: Luke 18:15
verses.text: As hug ad lhieu huggey myrgeddin cloan aegey, dy ventyn roo: agh tra honnick e ostyllyn shoh, hooar ad foill.

verses.name: Luke 18:16
verses.text: Agh deie Yeesey orroo huggey, as dooyrt eh, Lhig-jee da ny paitchyn cheet hym's, as ny jean-jee ad y lhiettal: son jeh nyn lheid ta reeriaght Yee.

verses.name: Luke 18:17
verses.text: Dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, Quoi-erbee nagh jean goaill-rish reeriaght Yee myr lhiannoo beg, cha jed eh er aght erbee stiagh ayn.

verses.name: Luke 18:18
verses.text: As denee fer-reill dy row jeh, gra, Vainshter vie, cre t'orrym dy yannoo dy vod eiraght y ve aym ayns y vea veayn?

verses.name: Luke 18:19
verses.text: As dooyrt Yeesey rish, Cre'n-fa t'ou genmys mish mie? cha vel ayn ny ta mie, agh unnane, ynrycan Jee.

verses.name: Luke 18:20
verses.text: Shione dhyt ny annaghyn, Ny jean poosey y vrishey, Ny jean dunverys, Ny jean geid, Ny jean feanish foalsey y ymmyrkey, Cur arrym da dty ayr as da dty voir.

verses.name: Luke 18:21
verses.text: As dooyrt eh, Ooilley shoh ta mee er vreayll veih my aegid.

verses.name: Luke 18:22
verses.text: Nish tra cheayll Yeesey shoh, dooyrt eh rish, Ta foast ort un red y yannoo: creck as rheynn ooilley ny t'ayd er ny boghtyn, as bee berchys ayd ayns niau: as tar, as eiyr orrym's.

verses.name: Luke 18:23
verses.text: As tra cheayll eh shoh, daase eh feer trimshagh, son v'eh feer verchagh.

verses.name: Luke 18:24
verses.text: As tra honnick Yeesey dy row eh feer trimshagh, dooyrt eh, Cre cha doillee as te dauesyn ta berchys oc, goll stiagh ayns reeriaght Yee!

verses.name: Luke 18:25
verses.text: Son te ny sassey da camel goll trooid croae snaidey, na da dooinney berchagh dy gholl stiagh ayns reeriaght Yee.

verses.name: Luke 18:26
verses.text: As dooyrt adsyn cheayll eh, Quoi eisht oddys v'er ny hauail?

verses.name: Luke 18:27
verses.text: As dooyrt eh, Ta ny reddyn shoh neu phossible da deiney, agh t'ad possible da Jee.

verses.name: Luke 18:28
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt Peddyr, Cur-my-ner, ta shinyn er dreigeil ooilley, as er n'eiyrt ort's.

verses.name: Luke 18:29
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, Nagh vel dooinney erbee t'er dreigeil thie, ny ayr ny moir, ny braaraghyn, ny ben, ny cloan, er graih reeriaght Yee,

verses.name: Luke 18:30
verses.text: Nagh vow ymmodee fillee smoo 'sy traa t'ayn nish, as ayns y theihll ta ry-heet yn vea dy bragh farraghtyn.

verses.name: Luke 18:31
verses.text: Eisht ghow eh huggey yn daa ostyl yeig, as dooyrt eh roo, Cur-my-ner ta shin goll seose gys Jerusalem, as bee dy chooilley nhee ta scruit liorish ny phadeyryn, my chione yn Mac dooinney, er ny chooilleeney.

verses.name: Luke 18:32
verses.text: Son bee eh er ny vrah gys ny Ashoonee, as nee ad craidey mysh, as dellal dy roonagh rish, as ceau shellaghyn er;

verses.name: Luke 18:33
verses.text: As scuitchee ad eh, as ver ad eh gy baase; as y trass laa nee eh girree reesht.

verses.name: Luke 18:34
verses.text: As cha hoig ad veg jeh ny reddyn va fys oc er ny reddyn va loayrit.

verses.name: Luke 18:35
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione, tra v'eh er jeet er gerrey da Jericho, dy row dooinney doal dy row ny hoie rish lhiattee yn raad, shirrey jeirk.

verses.name: Luke 18:36
verses.text: As tra cheayll eh yn pobble goll shaghey, denee eh cre v'ayn.

verses.name: Luke 18:37
verses.text: As dinsh ad da, dy row Yeesey dy Nazateth goll shaghey.

verses.name: Luke 18:38
verses.text: As dyllee eh, gra, Yeesey, vac Ghavid, jean myghin orrym.

verses.name: Luke 18:39
verses.text: As hug y vooinjer hie roish oghsan da dy ve ny-host: agh dyllee eshyn wheesh shen smoo, Vac Ghavid, jean myghin orrym.

verses.name: Luke 18:40
verses.text: As hass Yeesey, as doardee eh yn dooinney dy ve er ny choyrt lesh huggey: as tra v'eh er jeet er-gerrey, denee eh jeh,

verses.name: Luke 18:41
verses.text: Gra, Cre bailt mee dy yannoo er dy hon? As dooyrt eh, Hiarn, dy voddym my hoilshey y gheddyn.

verses.name: Luke 18:42
verses.text: As doogrt Yeesey rish, Dty hoilshey dy row ayd: ta dty chredjue er dty hauail.

verses.name: Luke 18:43
verses.text: As chelleeragh hooar eh e hoilshey, as deiyr eh er, cur gloyr da Jee: ooilley yn pobble, tra honnick ad eh, hug ad moylley da Jee.

verses.name: Luke 19:1
verses.text: As hie Yeesey stiagh, as jimmee eh trooid Jericho.

verses.name: Luke 19:2
verses.text: As cur-my-ner, va dooinney va enmyssit Zaccheus, va ny ard-ghooinney mastey ny publicanee, as v'eh berchagh.

verses.name: Luke 19:3
verses.text: As v'eh shirrey Yeesey y akin quoi v'eh, as cha dod eh kyndagh rish y pobble, son v'eh ny ghooinney giare.

verses.name: Luke 19:4
verses.text: As roie eh roish, as hie eh seose er billey-sycamore dy gheddyn shilley jeh; son v'eh dy gholl shaghey yn raad shen.

verses.name: Luke 19:5
verses.text: As tra va Yeesey er jeet gys yn ynnyd, yeeagh eh seose, as honnick eh eh, as dooyrt eh rish, Zaccheus, jean siyr, as tar neose; son jiu ta mish dy ghoaill aght ec dty hie.

verses.name: Luke 19:6
verses.text: As ren eh siyr, as haink eh neose, as hug eh oltaghey-bea gennal da.

verses.name: Luke 19:7
verses.text: As tra honnick ad shoh, v'ad ooilley jymmoosagh, gra, Dy row eh er gholl stiagh dy ee as dy iu marish dooinney dy ghrogh vea.

verses.name: Luke 19:8
verses.text: As hass Zaccheus magh, as dooyrt eh rish y Chiarn, Cur-my-ner, Hiarn, yn derrey lieh jeh my chooid ta mee dy choyrt da ny boghtyn: as my ta mee er ghoaill red erbee dy molteyragh veih dooinney erbee, ta mee jannoo lhiassaghey kiare-filley da.

verses.name: Luke 19:9
verses.text: As dooyrt Yeesey rish, Jiu ta saualtys er jeet gys y thie shoh, ayns wheesh as dy vel eshyn myrgeddin ny vac da Abraham.

verses.name: Luke 19:10
verses.text: Son ta Mac y dooinney er jeet dy hirrey as dy hauail shen ny va caillit.

verses.name: Luke 19:11
verses.text: As erreish daue shoh y chlahtyn, hie eh ny sodjey er e hoshiaght, as loayr eh coraa-dorraghey er-y-fa dy row eh er-gerrey da Jerusalem, as liorish dy row ad smooinaghtyn dy beagh reeriaght Yee dy gerrit er ny hoilshaghey:

verses.name: Luke 19:12
verses.text: Dooyrt eh er-y-fa shen, Hie dooinney ooasle dy row gys cheer foddey, dy gheddyn da hene reeriaght, as dy heet back reesht.

verses.name: Luke 19:13
verses.text: As deie eh er ny jeih sharvaantyn echey, as livrey eh daue jeih puint, as dooyrt eh roo, Jean-jee dellal derrey hig-ym.

verses.name: Luke 19:14
verses.text: Agh dirree yn theay shen magh n'oi as hug ad chaghteraght geiyrt er, gra, Cha naill-lhieu yn dooinney shoh dy reill harrin.

verses.name: Luke 19:15
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione, tra v'eh er jeet reesht, erreish da yn reeriaght y gheddyn, dy doardee eh ny sharvaantyn shen dy ve eit huggey, daue v'eh er choyrt yn argid, dy gheddyn fys cre-woad va dy chooilley ghooinney er chosney liorish e ghellal.

verses.name: Luke 19:16
verses.text: Eisht haink y chied er, gra, Hiarn, ta dty phunt er chosney jeih puint.

verses.name: Luke 19:17
verses.text: As dooyrt eh rish, S'mie shen, harvaant vie: er-yn-oyr dy vel oo er ve firrinagh ayns red feer fardalagh, gow uss yn reill er jeih ard-valjyn.

verses.name: Luke 19:18
verses.text: As haink yn nah er, gra, Hiarn, ta dty phunt er chosney queig puint.

verses.name: Luke 19:19
verses.text: As dooyrt eh myrgeddin rishyn, Gow uss yn reill neesht er queig ard-valjyn.

verses.name: Luke 19:20
verses.text: As haink fer elley, gra, Hiarn, cur-my ner, shoh dty phunt, t'er ny ve aym's tashtit ayns naptin:

verses.name: Luke 19:21
verses.text: Son va mee ayns aggle royd, er-y-fa dy nee dooinney creoi oo: t'ou troggal shen nagh dug oo sheese, as buinn shen nagh ren oo cuirr.

verses.name: Luke 19:22
verses.text: As dooyrt eh rish, Ass dty veeal hene nee'm oo y vriwnys, uss ghrogh harvaant, Va fys ayd dy row mee my ghooinney creoi, troggal shen nagh dug mee sheese, as buinn shen nagh chuirr mee:

verses.name: Luke 19:23
verses.text: Cre'n-fa nagh dug oo my argid magh er use, tra harrin thie, dy voddin v'er droggal my chooid hene lesh bishaghey.

verses.name: Luke 19:24
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roosyn,va kionfenish Gow-jee yn punt voishyn as cur-jee eh da fer ny jeih puint.

verses.name: Luke 19:25
verses.text: (As dooyrt ad rish, Hiarn, ta jeih puint echey shen.)

verses.name: Luke 19:26
verses.text: Son ta mee gra riu, Da dy chooilley unnane ta echey, vees er ny choyrt, as eshyn nagh vel echey, bee shen hene ny ta echey er ny ghoaill veih.

verses.name: Luke 19:27
verses.text: Agh ad shen my noidyn nagh bailliu mish dy reill harrystoo, cur-jee lhieu ad ayns shoh, as cur-jee ad gy-baase kiongoyrt rhym.

verses.name: Luke 19:28
verses.text: As tra v'eh er ghra shoh, hie eh rhymboo, myr v'ad goll seose gys Jerusalem,

verses.name: Luke 19:29
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione, tra v'ad er jeet er-gerrey da Bethphage as Bethany, ec y chronk va enmyssit cronk ny oliveyn, dy dug eh jees jeh e ostyllyn er chaghteraght,

verses.name: Luke 19:30
verses.text: Gra, Gow-jee gys y balley-beg ta rhymbiu; as tra hig shiu gys shen, yiow shiu lhiy er-eistyr, er nagh ren rieau dooinney markiagh: feayshil-jee as cur-jee lhieu eh gys shoh.

verses.name: Luke 19:31
verses.text: As my enys dooinney erbee j'iu, Cre'n fa ta shiu dy eaysley eh? Shoh myr nee shiu gra rish, Er-y-fa dy ve feme ec y Chiarn er.

verses.name: Luke 19:32
verses.text: As hie ny chaghteryn rhymboo, as hooar ad eh myr v'eh er ghra roo.

verses.name: Luke 19:33
verses.text: As myr v'ad feaysley yn lhiy, dooyrt y vooinjer by-liesh eh roo, Cre'n-fa ta shiu feaysley yn lhiy?

verses.name: Luke 19:34
verses.text: As dooyrt adsyn, Ta feme ec y Chiarn er.

verses.name: Luke 19:35
verses.text: As hug ad lhieu eh gys Yeesey: as hilg ad nyn gharmadyn er y lhiy, as hug ad Yeesey ny hoie orroo.

verses.name: Luke 19:36
verses.text: As myr v'eh goll, skeayll ad nyn eaddagh er y raad.

verses.name: Luke 19:37
verses.text: As tra v'eh er jeet er-gerrey, eer ec goll-sheese cronk ny oliveyn, ghow yn slane sheshaght jeh e eiyrtyssee toshiaght dy ghoaill boggey, as dy chur moylley da Jee lesh ard-choraa, son ooilley ny obbraghyn mirrillagh v'ad er n'akin,

verses.name: Luke 19:38
verses.text: Gra, Bannit dy row yn Ree ta cheet ayns ennym y Chiarn: shee ayns niau, as gloyr ayns yn yrjid.

verses.name: Luke 19:39
verses.text: As dooyrt paart jeh ny Phariseeyn rish veih mastey yn pobble, Vainshter, cur oghsan da dty eiyrtyssee.

verses.name: Luke 19:40
verses.text: As dreggyr eshyn, as dooyrt eh roo, Ta mee ginsh diu, my chummagh ad shoh nyn jengey, dy jinnagh ny eer claghyn troggal seose nyn goraa.

verses.name: Luke 19:41
verses.text: As tra v'eh er jeet er-gerrey, yeeagh eh er yn ard-valley, as cheayn eh harrish.

verses.name: Luke 19:42
verses.text: Gra, Dy beagh toiggal er ve ayd's, dy jarroo ayd's, ayns dty laa shoh hene, jeh ny reddyn ta bentyn rish dty hee! agh nish t'ad follit veih dty hooillyn.

verses.name: Luke 19:43
verses.text: Son hig ny laghyn ort, tra nee dty noidyn jeeg y yannoo mood, as soie-ee ad ad-hene mygeayrt, as cruinnee ad oo stiagh er dy chooilley heu.

verses.name: Luke 19:44
verses.text: As lhieggee ad oo kiart rish y thalloo, as dty chloan cheu-sthie jeed; as cha vaag ad aynyd un chlagh er clagh elley: er-yn-oyr nagh dug oo tastey da'n earish haink mish dy dty yeeaghyn.

verses.name: Luke 19:45
verses.text: As hie eh stiagh ayns y chiamble, as ren eh toshiaght dy eiyrt magh yn vooinjer va creck as kionnaghey ayn

verses.name: Luke 19:46
verses.text: Gra roo, Te scruit, Ta my hie's thie yn phadjer: agh ta shiuish er n'yannoo eh ny ooig dy vaarlee.

verses.name: Luke 19:47
verses.text: As v'eh gynsagh ad gagh laa ayns y chiamble. Agh va ny ard-saggyrtyn, as ny scrudeyryn, as leeideilee yn phobble shirrey eh y stroie,

verses.name: Luke 19:48
verses.text: As cha row fys oc kys dy heet my geayrt-y-mysh; son va ooilley yn pobble feer aggindagh er clashtyn eh.

verses.name: Luke 20:1
verses.text: AS haink eh gy-kione er unnane jeh ny laghyn shen, myr v'eh gynsaghey yn pobble ayns y chiamble as preacheil y sushtal, dy ren ny ard-saggrtyn as ny scrudeyryn soiaghey er, marish y chanstyr,

verses.name: Luke 20:2
verses.text: As loayr ad rish, gra, Insh dooin, Cre'n phooar t'ayd dy yannoo ny reddyn shoh? ny quoi eh hug y phooar shoh dhyt?

verses.name: Luke 20:3
verses.text: As dreggyr eshyn as dooyrt eh roo, Fenyms jiuish myrgeddin un red; as freggyr-jee mee:

verses.name: Luke 20:4
verses.text: Bashtey Ean, nee veih niau ve, ny veih deiney?

verses.name: Luke 20:5
verses.text: As loayr ad nyn mast' oc hene, gra, My jir mayd, Veih niau; jir eshyn, Cre'n-fa eisht nagh chred shiu eh?

verses.name: Luke 20:6
verses.text: Agh my jir mayd, Veih deiney; nee ooilley yn pobble nyn glaghey shin; son t'ad dy shickyr credjal Ean dy ve ny adeyr.

verses.name: Luke 20:7
verses.text: As dreggyr ad, nagh voddagh ad ginsh cre voish v'eh.

verses.name: Luke 20:8
verses.text: As dooyrt Yeesey roo, Chamoo insh yms diuish cre'n phooar t'aym dy yannoo ny reddyn shoh.

verses.name: Luke 20:9
verses.text: Eisht hie eh er e hoshiaght dy loayrt rish y pobble yn coraa-dorraghey shoh: Va dooinney dy row ren garey-feeyney y hoiaghey, as hoie eh eh rish, eirinnee, as hie eh gys cheer foddey son choud shen dy hraa.

verses.name: Luke 20:10
verses.text: As ec yn imbagh, hug eh fer-mooinjerey gys ny eirinnee, dy choyrt da jeh mess y gharey-feeyney: agh woaill ny eirinnee eh, as hug ad eh ersooyl follym.

verses.name: Luke 20:11
verses.text: As reesht hug eh fer-mooinjerey elley; as woaill ad eshyn myrgeddin, as ghell ad dy scammyltagh rish, as hug ad eh ersooyl follym.

verses.name: Luke 20:12
verses.text: As reesht hug eh yn trass; as vroo ad eshyn myrgeddin, as deiyr ad eh ersooyl.

verses.name: Luke 20:13
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt chiarn y gharey-feeyney Cre nee'm? Ver-ym huc my vac graihagh foddee dy der ad arrym da tra hee-ys ad eh.

verses.name: Luke 20:14
verses.text: Agh tra honnick ny eirinnee eh, loayr ad eddyr ad-hene, gra, Shoh yn eirey: tar-jee, lhig dooin eh y varroo, dy vod yn eiraght ve lhien hene.

verses.name: Luke 20:15
verses.text: Myr shen cheau ad eh magh ass y gharey-feeyney, as varr ad eh. Cre nee Chiarn y gharey-feeyney er-y-fa shen roo?

verses.name: Luke 20:16
verses.text: Hig eh as stroie-ee eh ny eirinnee shoh, as ver eh yn garey-feeyney da feallagh elley. As tra cheayll ad shen, dooyrt ad, Nar lhig eh Jee.

verses.name: Luke 20:17
verses.text: As yeeagh eh orroo, as dooyrt eh, Cre shoh eisht ta scruit, Ta'n chlagh ren ny masoonee y vee-lowal, er jeet dy ve yn ard-chlagh chorneilagh?

verses.name: Luke 20:18
verses.text: Quoi-erbee huittys er y chlagh shen, hee eh er ny vroo: agh er quoi-erbee huittys y chlagh shen, nee ee cha meen as joan jeh.

verses.name: Luke 20:19
verses.text: As va ny ard-saggyrtyn as ny scrudeyryn ayns yn oor cheddin shirrey eh y ghoaill; agh ghow ad aggle roish y pobble: son dennee ad dy row eh er loayrt yn coraa-dorraghey shoh nyn noisyn.

verses.name: Luke 20:20
verses.text: As va sooill oc er, as hug ad magh peeikearyn va dy lhiggey orroo dy ve deiney cairagh, er-chee tayrtyn eh nyns e ghlare, as myr shen dy livrey eh gys pooar as reill y chiannoort.

verses.name: Luke 20:21
verses.text: As denee ad jeh, gra, Vainshter, ta fys ain dy vel oo loayrt as gynsaghey cairagh; chamoo t'ou soiaghey jeh persoon erbee, agh gynsaghey raad Yee dy firrinagh

verses.name: Luke 20:22
verses.text: Vel eh lowal dooin keesh y eeck da Cesar, mannagh vel?

verses.name: Luke 20:23
verses.text: Agh dennee eh yn foalsaght oc, as dooyrt eh roo, Cre'n-fa ta shiu shirrey da my ghoaill ayns ribbey?

verses.name: Luke 20:24
verses.text: Jeeagh-jee dou ping: quoi ta'n jalloo as y scrieu t'er cowraghey? Dreggyr ad as dooyrt ad, Cesar.

verses.name: Luke 20:25
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Eeck-jee er-y-fa shen da Cesar shen ny ta bentyn gys Cesar; as da Jee shen ny ta bentyn gys Jee.

verses.name: Luke 20:26
verses.text: As cha voddagh ad greme y ghoaill er e ghoan kiongoyrt rish y pobble: as ghow ad yindys jeh'n ansoor echey, as chum ad nyn jengey.

verses.name: Luke 20:27
verses.text: Eisht haink huggey shiartanse jeh ny Sadduceeyn (ta gobbal yn irree-seose-reesht veih ny merriu) as denee ad jeh,

verses.name: Luke 20:28
verses.text: Gra, Vainshter, ta Moses er scrieu dooin, My ta braar dooinney erbee geddyn baase, as ben echey, as eh dy gheddyn baase gyn chloan, dy vel e vraar dy phoosey yn ven echey, as dy hroggal seose sluight gys e vraar.

verses.name: Luke 20:29
verses.text: Va er-y-fa shen shiaght braaraghyn: as hooar y braar shinney, tra v'eh er phoosey ben, baase gyn chloan.

verses.name: Luke 20:30
verses.text: As ghow yn nah vraar ee son ben, as hooar eshyn baase dyn chloan.

verses.name: Luke 20:31
verses.text: As ghow yn trass ee: as er yn aght cheddin yn chiaght. As cha daag ad cloan, as hooar ad baase.

verses.name: Luke 20:32
verses.text: Er-jerrey ooilley hooar y ven ee hene baase myrgeddin.

verses.name: Luke 20:33
verses.text: Ec yn irree-reesht er-y-fa shen, quoi jeu vees ee echey son ben? son v'ee ny ben da'n chiaght.

verses.name: Luke 20:34
verses.text: As dreggyr Yeesey as dooyrt eh roo, Ta cloan y theihll shoh poosey, as er nyn goyrt ayns poosey:

verses.name: Luke 20:35
verses.text: Agh adsyn vees coontit feeu jeh'n theihll shen, as jeh yn irree-reesht veih ny merriu, cha vel ad poosey, ny er nyn goyrt ayns poosey.

verses.name: Luke 20:36
verses.text: Chamoo oddys ad baase y gheddyn arragh; son t'ad corrym rish ny ainleyn, as nyn gloan dy Yee, liorish dy vel ad cloan yn irree-seose reesht.

verses.name: Luke 20:37
verses.text: Nish dy n'irree ny merriu, hoilshee Moses hene ec y thammag, tra t'eh genmys y Chiarn, Jee Abraham, as Jee Isaac, as Jee Yacob.

verses.name: Luke 20:38
verses.text: Son cha nee Jee ny merriu eh, agh Jee ny bioee: son ta ooilley bio huggeysyn.

verses.name: Luke 20:39
verses.text: Eisht dreggyr shiartanse jeh ny scrudeyryn as doo~yt ad, Vainshter, t'ou er ghra dy mie.

verses.name: Luke 20:40
verses.text: As ny lurg shen cha by-lhoys daue question erbee sodjey y chur huggey.

verses.name: Luke 20:41
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Kys t'ad gra dy nee Creest mac Ghavid?

verses.name: Luke 20:42
verses.text: As dy vel David eh hene ayns lioar ny psalmyn gra, Dooyrt y Chiarn rish my Hiarn's, Soie uss er my laue yesh,

verses.name: Luke 20:43
verses.text: Derrey ver-ym dty noidyn son stoyl dty choshey.

verses.name: Luke 20:44
verses.text: Ta David er-y-fa shen genmys eh ny Hiarn, kys t'eh eisht yn mac echey?

verses.name: Luke 20:45
verses.text: Eisht ayns clashtyn ooilley yn pobble, dooyrt eh rish e ostyllyn,

verses.name: Luke 20:46
verses.text: Bee-jee er nyn dwoaie jeh ny scrudeyryn, ta geearree shooyll ayns coamraghyn liauyrey, as shynney lhieu dy vannaghey daue ayns ny margaghyn, as ny stuill syrjey y ve oc ayns kialteenyn, as ny ard ynnydn-soie ec cuirraghyn.

verses.name: Luke 20:47
verses.text: T'ad cur-mow thieyn mraane-treoghe, as son scaa dy chraueeaght lhiggey orroo dy ve mennick ayns padjer: ta briwnys strimmey nyn gour oc shoh.

verses.name: Luke 21:1
verses.text: As yeeagh eh seose, as honnick eh ny berchee tilgey ny giootyn oc ayns kishtey yn stoyr.

verses.name: Luke 21:2
verses.text: As honnick eh myrgeddin ben voght treoghe dy row, tilgey ayn daa vite.

verses.name: Luke 21:3
verses.text: As dooyrt eh, Ayns firrinys ta mee gra riu, dy vel y ven voght treoghe shoh er hilgey ayn ny smoo na ad ooilley.

verses.name: Luke 21:4
verses.text: Son t'ad shoh ooilley ayns nyn balchey er chur gys ourallyn Yee: agh t'eeish myr s'boght ee, er choyrt ayn ooilley ny v'eck dy veaghey er.

verses.name: Luke 21:5
verses.text: As myr va paart loayrt jeh'n chiamble, kys ve er ny hoiaghey magh lesh clagh yn aalin, as giootyn, dooyrt eh,

verses.name: Luke 21:6
verses.text: Son ny reddyn shoh ta shiu dy akin hig ny laghyn, tra nagh bee faagit un chlagh er clagh elley nagh bee er ny lhieggal.

verses.name: Luke 21:7
verses.text: As denee ad jeh, gra, Vainshter, agh cuin vees ny reddyn shoh? as cre vees yn cowrey tra hig ny reddyn shoh gy-kione?

verses.name: Luke 21:8
verses.text: As dooyrt eh, Cur-jee twoaie nagh bee shiu er nyn molley: son hig ymmodee ayns m'ennym's, gra, Mish Creest; as ta'n traa tayrn er-gerrey: ny gow-jee shiuish er-y-fa shen geiyrt orroo.

verses.name: Luke 21:9
verses.text: Agh tra chlinnys shiu jeh caggaghyn as irree-magh, ny bee aggle erriu: son shegin da ny reddyn shoh hoshiaght cheet gy-kione, agh cha bee yn jerrey foast.

verses.name: Luke 21:10
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt eh roo, Nee ashoon girree-magh noi ashoon, as reeriaght noi reeriaght.

verses.name: Luke 21:11
verses.text: As bee craaghyn-thallooin mooar ayns ymmodee ynnydyn, as gennaghyn, as crampyn, as shillaghyn agglagh, as bee cowraghyn mooarey veih niau.

verses.name: Luke 21:12
verses.text: Agh roish ooilley shoh gowee ad shiu, ss nee ad tranlaase erriu, as livrey ee ad shiu seose gys quaiylyn, as gys pryssoonyn, as bee shiu er nyn goyrt fenish reeaghyn as fir-reill er coontey yn ennym aym's

verses.name: Luke 21:13
verses.text: As myr shoh hig shiuish dy ve son feanishyn dooys.

verses.name: Luke 21:14
verses.text: Kiare-jee eh- er-y-fa shen ayns nyn gree, gyn shiu dy smooinaghtyn ro-laue cre nee shiu y reggyrt.

verses.name: Luke 21:15
verses.text: Son ver-yms diu beeal as creenaght, nagh bee ooilley nyn noidyn son loayrt ny shassoo magh n'oi.

verses.name: Luke 21:16
verses.text: As bee shiu er nyn mrah chammah liorish ayraghyn as moiraghyn, as braaragh yn as deiney mooinjerey, as caarjyn; as ver ad er paart eu ve er nyn goyrt gy-baase.

verses.name: Luke 21:17
verses.text: As ver yn ymmodee feoh diu er coontey yn ennym aym's.

verses.name: Luke 21:18
verses.text: Agh cha jed wheesh reuaig jeh nyn ghing naardey.

verses.name: Luke 21:19
verses.text: Fo ooilley nyn seaghyn cum-jee seose nyn gree.

verses.name: Luke 21:20
verses.text: As tra hee shiu sheshaghtyn-caggee mygeayrt Jerusalem, eisht toig-jee dy vel y traartys eck er-gerrey.

verses.name: Luke 21:21
verses.text: Eisht lhig dauesyn ta ayns Judea, chea gys ny sleityn; as lhig dauesyn ta cheu-sthie jee, cosney ass-jee; as ny lhig dauesyn ta mooie er y cheer cheet stiagh aynjee.

verses.name: Luke 21:22
verses.text: Son t'ad shoh laghyn y chooilleeney, son jannoo mie dy chooilley nhee ta scruit.

verses.name: Luke 21:23
verses.text: Agh smerg dauesyn ta torragh, as dauesyn ta cur keeagh ayns ny laghyn shen: son bee trimshey mooar ayns y cheer, as corree noi yn pobble shoh.

verses.name: Luke 21:24
verses.text: As tuittee ad er foyr y chliwe, as bee ad er nyn ghoaill ersooyl nyn gappeeyn gys dy chooilley ashoon: as bee Jerusalem er ny stampey sheese liorish ny Ashoonee, derrey vees traa ny Ashoonee er ny chooilleeney.

verses.name: Luke 21:25
verses.text: As bee cowraghyn ayns y ghrian, as ayns ny rollageyn: as er y thalloo seaghyn er ashoonyn, as angaish; yn faarkey, as ny tonnyn freaney;

verses.name: Luke 21:26
verses.text: Creeaghyn deiney gannooinaghey lesh aggle, as lesh jeeaghyn jei ny reddyn ta ry heet er y thalloo: son bee pooaraghyn yn aer er nyn graa.

verses.name: Luke 21:27
verses.text: As eisht hee ad Mac y dooinney cheet ayns bodjal lesh pooar as ard-ghloyr.

verses.name: Luke 21:28
verses.text: As tra ghoys ny reddyn shoh toshiaght dy heet gy-kione, eisht jeeagh-jee shiuish seose, as trog-jee nyn ghing; son ta'n livrey-ys eu tayrn er-gerrey.

verses.name: Luke 21:29
verses.text: As loayr eh roo coraa-dorraghey. Cur-jee my-ner yn billey-figgagh as ooilley ny billjn;

verses.name: Luke 21:30
verses.text: Tra t'ad nish cur magh duillagyn, ta shiu fakin as toiggal jiu hene, dy vel y sourey er-gerrey.

verses.name: Luke 21:31
verses.text: Myr shen shiuish neesht, tra hee shiu ny reddyn shoh cheet gy-kione, toig-jee dy vel reeriaght Yee er-gerrey.

verses.name: Luke 21:32
verses.text: Dy firrinagh ta mee gra riu, Nagh bee yn cheeloghe shoh ec kione, derrey vees ooilley shoh er ny chooilleeney.

verses.name: Luke 21:33
verses.text: Nee yn aer as yn ooir cherraghtyn, agh my ghoan's cha jean cherraghtyn.

verses.name: Luke 21:34
verses.text: As cur-jee twoaie diu hene, er-aggle ec traa erbee dy bee ny creeaghyn eu rouyr laadit lesh jooid as meshtyrys, as kiarailyn y vea shoh, as myr shoh yn laa shen dy heet erriu doaltattym.

verses.name: Luke 21:35
verses.text: Son myr ribbey hig eh er ooilley cummaltee ny hooirey.

verses.name: Luke 21:36
verses.text: Bee-jee er nyn dwoaie er-y-fa shen, as bee-jee kinjagh ayns padjer, dy vod shiu ve coontit feeu dy scapail ooilley ny reddyn shoh hig gy-kione, as dy hassoo kiongoyrt rish Mac y dooinney.

verses.name: Luke 21:37
verses.text: As ayns y laa v'eh gynsagh 'sy chiamble, as ec yn oie goll magh as goaill aaght ec y chronk ta enmyssit cronk ny Oliveyn.

verses.name: Luke 21:38
verses.text: As va ooilley yn pobble cheet huggey dy moghey gys y chiamble, dy eaishtagh rish.

verses.name: Luke 22:1
verses.text: ISH va feuilley yn arran-millish tayrn er-gerrey, ta enmyssit y Chaisht.

verses.name: Luke 22:2
verses.text: As va ny ard-saggyrtyn as ny scrudeyryn shirrey kys oddagh ad eh y choyrt gy-bause; son v'adayns sggle roish y pobble.

verses.name: Luke 22:3
verses.text: Eisht hie yn drogh-spyrryd stiagh ayns Yuaase va slennooit Iscariot, va jeh earroo yn daa ostyl yeig.

verses.name: Luke 22:4
verses.text: As hie eh roish, as loayr eh rish ny ard saggyrtyn as ny captanyn mychione eh y vrah daue.

verses.name: Luke 22:5
verses.text: As ghow adsyn boggey jeh, as ren ad conaant dy chur argid da.

verses.name: Luke 22:6
verses.text: As hug eh gialdyn, as v'eh shirrey caa dy vrah eh tra nagh beagh y pobble marish.

verses.name: Luke 22:7
verses.text: Eisht haink laa yn arran-millish, tra va'n Eayn-caisht dy ve er ny varroo.

verses.name: Luke 22:8
verses.text: As hug eh magh Peddyr as Ean, gra, Immee-jee, as aarlee-jee yn Eayn-caisht dy vod mayd gee.

verses.name: Luke 22:9
verses.text: As dooyrt ad rish, C'raad sailt shin dy yannoo aarloo?

verses.name: Luke 22:10
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Cur-my-ner, tra vees shiu er gholl stiagh ayns yn ard valley hig dooinney nyn guail lesh saagh-craie dy ushtey; eiyr-jee er gys y thie hed eh stiagh ayn.

verses.name: Luke 22:11
verses.text: As abbyr-jee tish y fer-thie, Ta'n mainshter gra rhyt, Cre vel shamyr ny goaldee, raad nee'm yn Eayn-caisht y ee marish my ostyllyn?

verses.name: Luke 22:12
verses.text: As jeeaghee eh diu ard-room mooar vees soit magh: ayns shen jean-jee aarloo.

verses.name: Luke 22:13
verses.text: As hie ad as hooar ad myr v'eh er ghra roo: as daarlee ad yn Eayn-caisht.

verses.name: Luke 22:14
verses.text: As tra va'n oor er jeet, hoie eh sheese as y daa ostyl yeig marish.

verses.name: Luke 22:15
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Lesh yeearree jeean ta mee er ve aignagh yn Eayn-caisht shoh y ee meriu roish my jean-ym surranse.

verses.name: Luke 22:16
verses.text: Son ta mee gra riu, Nagh n'ee-ym maghey shoh jeh, derrey vees eh cooilleenit ayns reeriaght Yee.

verses.name: Luke 22:17
verses.text: As ghow eh yn cappan, as hug eh booise, as dooyrt eh, Gow-jee shoh, as rheynn-jee eh ny mast' eu hene.

verses.name: Luke 22:18
verses.text: Son ta mee gra riu, Nagh n'iu-ym jeh mess y villey-feeyney, derrey hig reeriaght Yee.

verses.name: Luke 22:19
verses.text: As ghow eh arran, as hug eh booise, as vrish eh eh, as hug eh eh daue, gra, Shoh my chorp t'er ny choyrt er nyn son eu shoh jean-jee ayns cooinaghtyn jeem's.

verses.name: Luke 22:20
verses.text: As er yn aght cheddin yn cappan lurg shibber, gra, Yn cappan shoh yn conaant noa ayns my uill's, t'er ny gheayrtey er ny son eu.

verses.name: Luke 22:21
verses.text: Agh cur-my-ner, ta'n laue echeysyn ta dy my vrah, marym er y voayrd.

verses.name: Luke 22:22
verses.text: As dy firrinagh ta'n Mac dooinney goll myr ve kiarit: agh smerg da'n dooinney shen liorish t'eh er ny vrah.

verses.name: Luke 22:23
verses.text: As ren ad toshiaght dy vriaght nyn mast' oc hene, quoi jeu yinnagh shoh.

verses.name: Luke 22:24
verses.text: Nish va streeu myrgeddin nyn mast' oc, quoi jeu syrjey veagh coontit.

verses.name: Luke 22:25
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Ta reeaghyn ny Ashoonee gymmyrkey reill harrystoo: as as t'adsyn t'ayns pooar nyn mastey, enmyssit deiney ooasle.

verses.name: Luke 22:26
verses.text: Agh cha bee shiuish myr shen: agh quoi-erbee shinney ta nyn mast eu, lhig da ve myr y fer saa; as eshyn syrjey ta, myr y fer ta shirveish.

verses.name: Luke 22:27
verses.text: Son quoi syrjey, eshyn ta ny hoie ec bee, ny'n fer ta shirveish? nagh nee eshyn ta ny hoie ec bee? agh ta mish nyn mast' eu myr y fer ta shirveish.

verses.name: Luke 22:28
verses.text: She shiuish t'er hannaghtyn marym ayns my heaghyn.

verses.name: Luke 22:29
verses.text: As ta mee pointeil diu reeriaght, myr ta my Ayr er phointeil dooys.

verses.name: Luke 22:30
verses.text: Dy vod shiu gee as giu ec my voayrd ayns my reeriaght, as soie er stuill-reeoil, briwnys daa heeloghe yeig Israel.

verses.name: Luke 22:31
verses.text: As dooyrt y Chiarn, Simon, Simon, cur-my-ner, ta Satan er yeearree shiuish y ghoaill, dy chreearey shiu myr curnaght:

verses.name: Luke 22:32
verses.text: Agh ta mish er ghuee er dty hon's, nagh jean dty chredjue failleil; as tra vees oo er jyndaa, niartee dty vraaraghyn.

verses.name: Luke 22:33
verses.text: As dooyrt eh rish, Hiarn, ta mish aarloo dy gholl mayrt chammah gys pryssoon, as gys baase.

verses.name: Luke 22:34
verses.text: As dooyrt eh, Ta mee ginsh dhyt, Pheddyr roish gerrym y chellee jiu dy jean uss gobbal three keayrtyn dy nhione dhyt mee.

verses.name: Luke 22:35
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Tra hug mee shiu magh fegooish sporran, as spagey, as braagyn, row nhee erbee dy laccal erriu? As dooyrt ad, Cha row nhee erbee.

verses.name: Luke 22:36
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt eh roo, Agh nish eshyn ta sporran echey, lhig da y ghoaill eh, as myrgeddin e spaagey: as eshyn nagh vel cliwe echey, lhig da creck e gharmad, as cliwe y chionnaghey.

verses.name: Luke 22:37
verses.text: Son ta mee gra riu, Dy nhegin da shoh ny ta scruit, ve foast cooilleenit aynym's, As v'eh er ny earroo marish ny drogh yantee: son ta jerrey er ny reddyn ta my mychione's.

verses.name: Luke 22:38
verses.text: As dooyrt ad, Hiarn, cur-my-ner ta daa chliwe ayns shoh. As dooyrt eh roo, Te dy liooar.

verses.name: Luke 22:39
verses.text: As haink eh magh, as hie eh myr v'eh cliaghtey, gys cronk ny Oliveyn; as deiyr ny ostyllyn myrgeddin er.

verses.name: Luke 22:40
verses.text: As tra v'eh ec yn ynnyd, dooyrt eh roo, Gow-jee padjer, nagh duitt shiu ayns miolagh.

verses.name: Luke 22:41
verses.text: As hie eh voue, mysh choud as hilgagh fer clagh, as huitt eh er e ghlioonyn, as ghow eh padjer

verses.name: Luke 22:42
verses.text: Gra, Ayr, my she dty aigney eh, scugh yn cappan shoh voym: ny-yeih cha nee my aigney's, agh dt'aigney's dy row jeant.

verses.name: Luke 22:43
verses.text: As haink huggey ainle veih niau, dy niartaghey eh,

verses.name: Luke 22:44
verses.text: As v'eh ayns angaish vooar, as ghow eh padjer ny s'jeeaney: as va'n ollish echey myr bineyn mooarey folley tuittym gys y thalloo.

verses.name: Luke 22:45
verses.text: As tra v'eh er n'irree veih padjer, as er jeet gys e ostyllyn, hooar eh ad nyn gadley lesh trimshey,

verses.name: Luke 22:46
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Cre'n-fa ta shiu cadley? irree-jee as gow-jee padjer, nagh duitt shiu ayns miolagh.

verses.name: Luke 22:47
verses.text: As choud as v'eh foast loayrt, cur-my-ner haink sheshaght vooar, as eshyn va enmyssit Yuaase, fer jeh'n daa ostyl yeig, nyn leeideilagh, as hayrn eh er-gerrey da Yeesey dy chur paag da.

verses.name: Luke 22:48
verses.text: Agh dooyrt Yeesey rish, Yuaase, vel oo brah Mac y dooinney lesh paag?

verses.name: Luke 22:49
verses.text: Tra honnick adsyn va mygeayrt-y-mysh cre va ry-heet, dooyrt ad rish, Hiarn, bwoaill mayd lesh y chliwe?

verses.name: Luke 22:50
verses.text: As woaill fer jeu fer-mooinjerey yn ard-saggyrt, as ghiare eh yn chleaysh yesh jeh.

verses.name: Luke 22:51
verses.text: As dreggyr Yeesey, as dooyrt eh, Slioar shoh hene. As venn eh rish e chleaysh, as laanee eh eh.

verses.name: Luke 22:52
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt Yeesey rish ny ard saggyrtyn as captanyn y chiamble, as y chanstyr v'er jeet magh huggey, Vel shiu er jeet magh, myr noi maarliagh, lesh cliwenyn as luirg?

verses.name: Luke 22:53
verses.text: Tra va mee meriu gagh laa ayns y chiamble, cha heeyn shiu magh laue m'oi: agh shoh yn oor eu, as pooar y dorraghys.

verses.name: Luke 22:54
verses.text: Eisht ghow ad eh, as leeid ad ersooyl eh, as hug ad lhieu eh gys thie yn ard-saggyrt. As deiyr Peddyr er foddey ny yei.

verses.name: Luke 22:55
verses.text: As tra v'ad er voaddey aile ayns mean ny halley, as er hoie sheese cooidjagh, hoie Peddyr sheese ny mast' oc.

verses.name: Luke 22:56
verses.text: Agh hug ben-aeg dy row tastey da, myr v'eh ny hoie ec yn aile, as yeeagh ee dy gyere er, as dooyrt ee, v'eh shoh myrgeddin marish.

verses.name: Luke 22:57
verses.text: As dob eh, gra, Ven, cha vel enney aym er.

verses.name: Luke 22:58
verses.text: As tammylt ny lurg shen, honnick fer elley eh, as dooyrt eh, She fer jeu myrgeddin uss. As dooyrt Peddyr, Ghooinney, cha nee.

verses.name: Luke 22:59
verses.text: As mysh oor ny lurg shen, hass fer elley er dy creoi, gra, Ayns firrinys v'eh shoh myrgeddin marish; son she Galilean eh,

verses.name: Luke 22:60
verses.text: As dooyrt Peddyr, Ghooinney, cha s'aym cre t'ou dy ghra. As chelleeragh, choud as v'eh foast loayrt, gherr y kellagh.

verses.name: Luke 22:61
verses.text: As hyndaa yn Chiarn, as yeeagh eh er Peddyr; as chooinee Peddyr er yn ockle va'n Chiarn er ghra rish, Roish gerrym y chellee, nee uss mish y obbal three keayrtyn.

verses.name: Luke 22:62
verses.text: As hie Peddyr magh, as cheayn eh dy sharroo.

verses.name: Luke 22:63
verses.text: As ren ny deiney v'er ghoaill Yeesey gannidys er, as y woalley eh.

verses.name: Luke 22:64
verses.text: As tra v'ad er choodaghey ny sooillyn echey, woaill ad eh er yn eddin, as denee ad jeh, gra, Jean phadeyrys, quoi ta dy dty woalley?

verses.name: Luke 22:65
verses.text: As ymmodee reddyn elley loayr ad dy mollaghtagh n'oi.

verses.name: Luke 22:66
verses.text: As cha leah as va'n laa rish, haink shanstyr yn phobble, as ny ard-saggyrtyn as ny scrudeyryn cooidjagh, as hug ad lhieu eh gys y choonceil oc,

verses.name: Luke 22:67
verses.text: Gra, Nee oo yn Creest? insh dooin. As dooyrt eh roo, My inshym diu, cha jean shiu credjal.

verses.name: Luke 22:68
verses.text: As my neem's myrgeddin shiuish y qhuestional, cha jean shiu my reggyrt, ny lhiggey yn raad dou.

verses.name: Luke 22:69
verses.text: Ny lurg shoh nee Mac y dooinney soie er laue yesh pooar Yee.

verses.name: Luke 22:70
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt ad ooilley, Nee oo eisht Mac Yee? As dooyrt eh roo, Ta shiuish gra ny ta mee.

verses.name: Luke 22:71
verses.text: As dooyrt ad, Cre'n feme sodjey t'ain er feanishyn? son ta shin hene er chlashtyn veih'n veeal echey hene.

verses.name: Luke 23:1
verses.text: As dirree yn slane sheshaght jea, as hug ad lhieu eh gys Pilate.

verses.name: Luke 23:2
verses.text: As ren ad toshiaght dy loayrt n'oi, gra, Hooar shin eh shoh cur yn ashoon ain er shaghryn, as lhiettal sleih veih geeck keesh da Cesar, gra, Dy nee eh-hene Creest yn ree.

verses.name: Luke 23:3
verses.text: As denee Pilate jeh, ghra, Nee ree ny Hewnyn oo? As dreggyr eh, as dooyrt eh, T'ou uss dy ghra eh.

verses.name: Luke 23:4
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt Pilate rish ny ard-saggyrt yn as rish y pobble, Cha vel mish er gheddyn foill erbee ayns y dooinney shoh.

verses.name: Luke 23:5
verses.text: As v'ad wheesh shen s'chenney er, gra, T'eh boirey yn pobble, gynsaghey trooid ooilley Judea, goaill toshiaght veih Galilee derrey shoh.

verses.name: Luke 23:6
verses.text: Tra cheayll Pilate jeh Galilee, denee eh nee Galilean va'n dooinney.

verses.name: Luke 23:7
verses.text: As cha leah as hooar eh fys dy nee gys reill Herod v'eh bentyn, hug eh eh gys Herod, va myrgeddin eh-hene ec Jerusalem ec y traa shen.

verses.name: Luke 23:8
verses.text: As tra honnick Herod Yeesey, v'eh feer wooiagh: son v'eh aignagh ry-foadey dy akin eh, er-yn-oyr dy row eh er chlashtyn ymmodee reddyn jeh; as dy row eh jerkal dy akin mirril ennagh jeant liorish.

verses.name: Luke 23:9
verses.text: Eisht denee en ymmodee questionyn jeh; agh cha dug eh ansoor erbee da.

verses.name: Luke 23:10
verses.text: As hass ny ard-sagggrtyn as ny scrudeyryn as loayr ad dy elgyssagh-n'oi.

verses.name: Luke 23:11
verses.text: As ren Herod as e gheiney-caggee beg y hoiaghey jeh, as chraid ad mysh, as choamree ad eh lesh coamrey moyrnagh, as hug ad eh reesht gys Pilate.

verses.name: Luke 23:12
verses.text: As y laa cheddin va coardail er ny yannoo eddyr Pilate as Herod; son roie v'ad ayns noidys ry-cheilley.

verses.name: Luke 23:13
verses.text: As dele Pilate er ny ard-saggyrtyn cooidjagh, as er ny fir-reill as y pobble.

verses.name: Luke 23:14
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Ta shiu er chur lhieu yn dooinney shoh hym's, myr fer ta cur shaghrynys er y pobble: as cur-my-ner ta mish er veysht eh kiongoyrt riu, as cha vel mee er gheddyn foill erbee ayns y dooinney shoh, mychione ny reddyn ta shiuish cur ny lieh;

verses.name: Luke 23:15
verses.text: Chamoo ta Herod: son hug mee shiu huggeysyn, as cur-my-ner, cha vel nhee erbee ta toilchin baase er ny cherraghey er.

verses.name: Luke 23:16
verses.text: Smaghtee-ym eh er-y-fa shen, as lhiggym y raad da.

verses.name: Luke 23:17
verses.text: Son beign da fer y eaysley daue ec y feailley.

verses.name: Luke 23:18
verses.text: As deie ooilley yn cheshaght, gra, Ersooyl lesh y dooinney shoh, as feayshil dooin Barabbas:

verses.name: Luke 23:19
verses.text: (Va son irree-magh dy row, va jeant ayns yn ard-valley, as son dunverys tilgit ayns pryssoon).

verses.name: Luke 23:20
verses.text: Va Pilate er-y-fa shen aggindagh dy choyrt feaysley da Yeesey, as loayr eh reesht roo.

verses.name: Luke 23:21
verses.text: Agh dyllee adsyn, gra, Jean y chrossey eh, jean y chrossey eh.

verses.name: Luke 23:22
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo yn trass cheayrt Cammah, cre'n olk t'eh er n'yannoo? cha vel mish er gheddyn oyr baaish erbee ayn: smaghtee-ym eh er-y-fa shen, as lhiggym y raad da

verses.name: Luke 23:23
verses.text: As loayr ad ny s'jeeaney lesh ard choraaghyn, guee dy beagh eh er ny chrossey: as ren y coraa ocsyn as coraa ny ard-saggyrtyn raad y ghoaill.

verses.name: Luke 23:24
verses.text: As hug Pilate briwnys cordail rish nyn aigney.

verses.name: Luke 23:25
verses.text: As deayshil eh daue, eshyn va son irree-magh as dunverys tilgit ayns pryssoon eh v'ad hene er n'yeearree; agh livrey eh Yeesey gys nyn aigney.

verses.name: Luke 23:26
verses.text: As myr v'ad dy chur lhieu eh, haare ad greme er Simon Cyrenian dy row, myr v'eh cheet jeh'n cheer, as ersyn hug ad y chrosh, dy ymmyrkey eh geiyrt er Yeesey.

verses.name: Luke 23:27
verses.text: As deiyr er earroo mooar dy leih as dy vraane, va myrgeddin-keayney as jannoo dobberan er e hon.

verses.name: Luke 23:28
verses.text: Agh hyndaa Yeesey huc, as dooyrt eh Inneenyn Yerusalem, ny keayn-jee er my hon's, agh keayn-jee er nyn son hene, as son nyn gloan.

verses.name: Luke 23:29
verses.text: Son cur-my-ner, ta ny laghyn cheet, tra jir ad, Bannit ta ny mraane gennish, as ny breinyn nagh ren gymmyrkey, as ny keeaghyn nagh dug bainney.

verses.name: Luke 23:30
verses.text: Eisht nee ad toshiaght dy ghra rish ny sleityn, Tuitt-jee orrin; as rish ny cruink, Coodee-jee shin.

verses.name: Luke 23:31
verses.text: Son my t'ad jannoo ny reddyn shoh rish y billey oor, cre vees er ny yannoo rish y billey creen?

verses.name: Luke 23:32
verses.text: As va myrgeddin daa chimmagh elley er nyn leeideil magh marish, dy ve er nyn goyrt gy-baase.

verses.name: Luke 23:33
verses.text: As tra v'ad er jeet gys yn ynnyd ta enmyssit Calvary, ayns shen ren ad eshyn y chrossey, as ny kimmee; yn derrey yeh er y laue yesh, as y jeh elley er y laue chiare.

verses.name: Luke 23:34
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt Yeesey, Ayr jean leih daue; son cha vel fys oc cre t'ad dy yannoo. As rheynn ad e choamrey, as hilg ad lottyn.

verses.name: Luke 23:35
verses.text: As va'n pobble nyn shassoo cur-my-ner: as maroo ren ny fir-reill myrgeddin gannidys er, as gra, Haue eh feallagh elley; lhig da eh-hene y hauail my she Creest fer reiht Yee eh.

verses.name: Luke 23:36
verses.text: As va ny sidooryn myrgeddin jannoo faghid er, cheet huggey, as chebbal da vinegar,

verses.name: Luke 23:37
verses.text: As gra, My she ree ny Hewnyn oo, saue oo hene.

verses.name: Luke 23:38
verses.text: As va'n scrieu shoh myrgeddin soit erskyn e chione, ayns letteryn dy Ghreek as dy Latin, as dy Hebrew, SHOH REE NY HEWNYN.

verses.name: Luke 23:39
verses.text: As ren fer jeh ny kimmee v'er nyn groghey loayrt dy lunagh n'oi, gra, My she oo yn Creest, saue oo hene as shinyn.

verses.name: Luke 23:40
verses.text: Agh dreggyr y jeh elley, cur oghsan da, as gra, Nagh vel aggle ort roish Jee, fakin dy vel uss fo yn vriwnys cheddin?

verses.name: Luke 23:41
verses.text: As shinyn dy jarroo dy cairagh; son ta shin er gheddyn toilchinys cooie yn jannoo ain: agh cha vel y dooinney shoh er n'yannoo aggair erbee.

verses.name: Luke 23:42
verses.text: As dooyrt eh rish Yeesey, Hiarn, cooinee orryms tra hig oo gys dty reeriaght.

verses.name: Luke 23:43
verses.text: As dooyrt Yeesey rish, Dy firrinagh ta mee gra rhyt, Dy bee uss marym's jiu ayns Paradise.

verses.name: Luke 23:44
verses.text: As ve mysh y cheyoo oor, as va dorraghys harrish ooilley yn cheer gys yn nuyoo oor.

verses.name: Luke 23:45
verses.text: As va'n ghrian dorraghey, as va curtan scarree yn chiamble raipit veih-my cheilley.

verses.name: Luke 23:46
verses.text: As tra va Yeesey er n'eamagh lesh ard-choraa, dooyrt eh, Ayr, gys dty laueyn ta mish chymney my spyrryd: as tra v'eh er ghra shoh, phaart eh.

verses.name: Luke 23:47
verses.text: Nish tra honnick y centurion cre va er jeet gy-kione, hug eh moylley da Jee, gra, Ayns firrinys v'eh shoh ny ghooinney cairagh.

verses.name: Luke 23:48
verses.text: As ooilley yn pobble v'er jeet cooidjagh gys y shilley shen, hug ad my-ner ny reddyn va jeant, as goaill ad nyn gleeau, haink ad rhymboo.

verses.name: Luke 23:49
verses.text: As ooilley e ainjyssee, as ny mraane deiyr er veih Galilee, hass ad foddey jeh cur-my-ner ny reddyn shoh.

verses.name: Luke 23:50
verses.text: As cur-my-ner va dooinney va enmyssit Joseph, va ny er-coyrlee, as ny ghooinney mie as cairagh:

verses.name: Luke 23:51
verses.text: (Cha row ayrt ny paart echey shoh ayns y choyrle ny yn jannoo oc) v'eh veih Arimathea, ard-valley jeh ny Hewnyn, (va myrgeddin eh-hene farkiaght son reeriaght Yee.)

verses.name: Luke 23:52
verses.text: Hie yn dooinney shoh gys Pilate, as yeearree eh corp Yeesey,

verses.name: Luke 23:53
verses.text: As ghow eh neose eh, as hoiII eh eh ayns aanrit, as doanluck eh eh ayns oaie va cleight ayns creg, raad nagh row rieau dooinney oanluckit roie.

verses.name: Luke 23:54
verses.text: As va shen laa yn aarlaghey, as va yn doonaght tayrn er-gerrey.

verses.name: Luke 23:55
verses.text: As hie ny mraane myrgeddin haink marish veih Galilee geiyrt er y corp, as hug ad my-ner yn oaie, as kys va'n corp er ny oanluckey.

verses.name: Luke 23:56
verses.text: As haink ad rhymboo, as hooar ad aarloo spisyn as ooilyn; as ghow ad fea er laa yn doonaght cordail rish yn anney.

verses.name: Luke 24:1
verses.text: Nish er y chied laa jeh'n chiaghtin, eer sy vadran, haink ad gys yn oaie, cur lhieu ny spisyn v'ad er gheddyn aarloo, as mraane elley maroo.

verses.name: Luke 24:2
verses.text: As hooar ad y chlagh rowlit ersooyl jeh'n oaie.

verses.name: Luke 24:3
verses.text: As hie ad stiagh, as cha dooar ad corp y Chiarn Yeesey.

verses.name: Luke 24:4
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione, myr v'ad ayns imnea mooar son shoh, cur-my-ner hass daa ghooinney lioroo ayns coamrey sollys.

verses.name: Luke 24:5
verses.text: As myr v'ad ayns aggle, as croymmey sheese lesh nyn eddin gys y thalloo, dooyrt ad roo, Cre'n-fa ta shiu shirrey yn vio mastey ny merriu?

verses.name: Luke 24:6
verses.text: Cha vel eh ayns shoh, agh t'eh er n'irree: cooinee-jee cre dooyrt eh-hene riu choud's v'eh foast ayns Galilee,

verses.name: Luke 24:7
verses.text: Gra, Shegin da'n Mac dooinney v'er ny lirrey gys laueyn deiney peccoil, as ve er ny chrossey, as girree reesht er y trsss laa.

verses.name: Luke 24:8
verses.text: As chooinee ad er e ghoan,

verses.name: Luke 24:9
verses.text: As haink ad back veih yn oaie, as dinsh ad ooilley shoh da'n un ostyl yeig, as da ooilley yn vooinjer elley.

verses.name: Luke 24:10
verses.text: She Moirrey Malaine, as Joanna as Moirrey moir Yamys, as mraane elley va maroo, dinsh ny reddyn shoh da ny ostjllyn,

verses.name: Luke 24:11
verses.text: As ghow ad y ghlare oc myr skeeal branlaadee, a cha dug ad geill daue.

verses.name: Luke 24:12
verses.text: Eisht dirree Peddyr as roie eh gys yn oaie, as chroym eh sheese, as honnick eh ny aanrityn nyn lhie er-lheh, as jimmee eh roish, goaill yindys ec ny va er daghyrt.

verses.name: Luke 24:13
verses.text: As cur-my-ner hie Jees jeu yn laa cheddin gys balley va enmyssit Emmaus, va mysh shiaght veeilley veih Jerusalem.

verses.name: Luke 24:14
verses.text: As v'ad taggloo ry-cheilley mychione dy chooilley nhee v'er daghyrt.

verses.name: Luke 24:15
verses.text: As haink eh gy-kione, choud as v'ad taggloo as resooney ry-cheilley, dy daink Yeesey hene er-gerrey, as dy jagh eh maroo.

verses.name: Luke 24:16
verses.text: As va ny sooillyn oc er ny lhiettal nagh dug ad enney er.

verses.name: Luke 24:17
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Cre ny naightyn shoh ta shiu dy insh yn derrey yeh da'n jeh elley, myr ta shiu shooyll dy trimshagh er y raad?

verses.name: Luke 24:18
verses.text: As dreggyr fer jeu, va'n ennym echey Cleopas, as dooyrt eh rish, Vel uss agh joarree ayns Jerusalem, as gyn fys ayd er ny reddyn t'ayns shen er jeet gy-kione er ny laghyn shoh?

verses.name: Luke 24:19
verses.text: As dooyrt eh, Cre ny reddyn? As dooyrt adsyn rish, Mychione Yeesey dy Nazareth, va ny adeyr, as pooaral ayns jannoo as goo, kiongoyrt rish Jee; as ooilley yn pobble:

verses.name: Luke 24:20
verses.text: As kys ren ny ard-saggyrtyn as ny fir-reill ain y livrey eh dy ve er ny gheyrey gys baase, as t'ad er chrossey eh.

verses.name: Luke 24:21
