verses.name: John 11:18
verses.text: (Nish va Bethany er-gerrey da Jerusalem, mysh daa veeilley jeh).

verses.name: John 11:19
verses.text: As va ymmodee jeh ny Hewnyn er jeet magh gys Martha as Moirrey, dy gherjaghey ad son nyn mraar.

verses.name: John 11:20
verses.text: Eisht cha leah as cheayll Martha dy row Yeesey cheet, hie ee magh ny whail: agh hoie Moirrey ayns y thie.

verses.name: John 11:21
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt Martha rish Yeesey, Hiarn, dy beagh uss er ve ayns shoh, cha beagh my vraar er gheddyn baase.

verses.name: John 11:22
verses.text: Agh ta fys aym, eer foast, cre-erbee nee oo y yeearree er Jee, dy der Jee dhyt eh.

verses.name: John 11:23
verses.text: Dooyrt Yeesey r'ee, Nee dty vraar girree reesht.

verses.name: John 11:24
verses.text: Dooyrt Martha rish, Ta fys aym dy n'irree eh reesht ec yn irree-seose 'sy laa jerrinagh.

verses.name: John 11:25
verses.text: Dooyrt Yeesey r'ee, Mish yn irree seose-reesht veih ny merriu as yn vea: bee eshyn ta credjal aynym's bio, ga dy vow eh baase;

verses.name: John 11:26
verses.text: As quoi-erbee ta bio, as credjal aynym's, cha vow eh yn baase dy bragh farraghtyn. Vel uss credjal shoh?

verses.name: John 11:27
verses.text: Dooyrt ee rish, Ta, Hiarn: ta mee credjal dy nee uss yn Creest Mac Yee va ry-hoi cheet gys y theihll.

verses.name: John 11:28
verses.text: As tra v'ee er ghra shoh, hie ee rhym bee, as deie ee er e shuyr Moirrey er-lheh as dooyrt ee, Ta'n Mainshter er jeet, as t'eh geamagh ort.

verses.name: John 11:29
verses.text: Cha leah as cheayll ee shen, dirree ee dy tappee dy tappee, as haink ee huggey.

verses.name: John 11:30
verses.text: Nish cha row Yeesey foast er jeet stiagh ayns y valley, agh v'eh ayns y voayl raad haink Martha ny whail

verses.name: John 11:31
verses.text: Ny Hewnyn eisht va maree ayns y thie dy gherjaghey ee, tra honnick ad dy dirree Moirrey dy tappee, as dy jagh ee magh, deiyr ad urree, gra, T'ee goll gys yn oaie dy cheayney ayns shen.

verses.name: John 11:32
verses.text: Eisht tra va Moirrey er jeet raad va Yeesey, as jeeaghyn er, huitt ee sheese ec e chassyn, gra rish, Hiarn, dy beagh uss er ve ayns shoh, cha beagh my vraar er gheddyn baase.

verses.name: John 11:33
verses.text: Tra honnick Yeesey ee er-y-fa shen keayney, as ny Hewnyn myrgeddin keayney v'er jeet maree, hayrn eh osney hrome, as v'eh seaghnit;

verses.name: John 11:34
verses.text: As dooyrt eh, C'raad ta shiu er choyrt eh? Dooyrt adsyn rish, Hiarn, tarr as hee oo.

verses.name: John 11:35
verses.text: Ren Yeesey keayney.

verses.name: John 11:36
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt ny Hewnyn, Cur-jee my-ner, cre'n ghraih v'echey er.

verses.name: John 11:37
verses.text: As dooyrt paart jeu, Nagh voddagh yn dooinney shoh, ren fosley sooillyn ny doail, v'er lhiettal baase y dooinney shoh?

verses.name: John 11:38
verses.text: Hayrn Yeesey er-y-fa shen osney hrome reesht veih e chree, as haink eh gys yn oaie. She ooig v'ayn, as va clagh er e beeal.

verses.name: John 11:39
verses.text: Dooyrt Yeesey, Scugh-jee yn chlagh. Dooyrt Martha shuyr y varroo rish, Hiarn, ta nish soar trome jeh: son t'eh er ve kiare laa marroo.

verses.name: John 11:40
verses.text: Dooyrt Yeesey r'ee, Nagh dooyrt mee rhyt, my chredjagh oo, dy vaikagh oo gloyr Yee?

verses.name: John 11:41
verses.text: Eisht scugh ad y chlagh jeh'n boayl raad va'n marroo ny lhie. As hrog Yeesey seose e hooillyn, as dooyrt eh, Ayr, ta mee cur booise dhyt dy vel oo er my chlashtyn.

verses.name: John 11:42
verses.text: As va fys aym dy vel oo rieau dy my chlashtyn: agh er coontey yn phobble ta mygeayrt-y-moom dooyrt mee shoh, dy vod ad credjal dy vel oo er my choyrt.

verses.name: John 11:43
verses.text: As tra v'eh er ghra shoh, deie eh lesh ard-choraa, Lazarus, tar magh.

verses.name: John 11:44
verses.text: As haink eshyn va marroo magh soillit cass as laue ayns aanrityn oanluckee: as bussal mysh e eddin. Dooyrt Yeesey roo, Feayshil-jee eh, as lhig-jee yn raad da.

verses.name: John 11:45
verses.text: Eisht ren ymmodee jeh ny Hewnyn v'er jeet magh gys Moirrey, as v'er vakin ny reddyn ren Yeesey, credjal ayn.

verses.name: John 11:46
verses.text: Agh hie paart jeu rhymboo gys ny Phariseeyn, as dinsh ad daue cre ny reddyn va Yeesey er n'yannoo.

verses.name: John 11:47
verses.text: Eisht deie ny ard-saggyrtyn as ny Phariseeyn er y choonceil cooidjagh, as dooyrt ad, Cre ta shinyn dy yannoo? son ta'n dooinney shoh jannoo ymmodee mirrilyn.

verses.name: John 11:48
verses.text: My lhiggys mayd da, nee dy chooilley ghooinney credjal ayn; as hig ny Romanee as ver ad mow chammah yn ynnyd casherick as yn ashoon ain.

verses.name: John 11:49
verses.text: As va fer jeu va enmyssit Caiaphas, ny ard-saggyrt yn vlein shen, as dooyrt eh roo, Cha vel toiggal eu jeh nhee erbee,

verses.name: John 11:50
verses.text: Chamoo ta shiu goaill eu hene kys dy vel eh ymmyrchagh er ny son ain, un dooinney dy gheddyn baase son y pobble, as gyn y slane ashoon dy herraghtyn.

verses.name: John 11:51
verses.text: As shoh loayr eh, cha nee jeh hene: agh v'eh ny ard-saggyrt yn vlein shen, as ren e phadeyrys dy voghe Yeesey baase son yn ashoon shen:

verses.name: John 11:52
verses.text: As cha nee ynrycan son yn ashoon shen, agh myrgeddin dy jinnagh eh cloan Yee va skeaylt dy lhean, y hayrn gys unnaneys ry-cheilley.

verses.name: John 11:53
verses.text: Eisht veih'n laa shen magh v'ad cur nyn goyrle dy cheilley dy choyrt eh gy baase.

verses.name: John 11:54
verses.text: Cha jimmee Yeesey er-y-fa shen ny smoo dy foshlit mastey ny Hewnyn; agh hie eh veih shen gys cheer va er-gerrey da'n aasagh, gys ard-valley enmyssit Ephraim, as duirree eh ayns shen marish e ostyllyn.

verses.name: John 11:55
verses.text: As va caisht ny Hewnyn tayrn er gerrey: as va ymmodee ass y cheer goll seose gys Jerusalem roish y chaisht dy ghlenney ad hene er y hon.

verses.name: John 11:56
verses.text: As v'ad briaght son Yeesey, as loayrt nyn mast' oc hene, myr v'ad nyn shassoo ayns y chiamble, Cre ta shiu dy smooinaghtyn, nagh jig eh seose gys y feailley?

verses.name: John 11:57
verses.text: Nish va chammah ny ard-saggyrtyn as ny Phariseeyn er chur sarey, my va fys ec dooinney erbee c'raad v'eh, dy row ad dy choyrt briaght er cour y ghoaill eh.

verses.name: John 12:1
verses.text: EISHT shey laa roish y Chaisht, haink Yeesey gys Bethany, raad va Lazarus v'er ny ve marroo, yn fer cheddin v'eh er hroggal veih ny merriu.

verses.name: John 12:2
verses.text: Ayns shen ren ad shibber er e hon, as va Martha shirveish orroo: agh va Lazarus fer jeusyn va nyn soie ec y voayrd marish.

verses.name: John 12:3
verses.text: Eisht ghow Moirrey punt dy ooil dy spikenard feer chostal, as ren ee cassyn Yeesey y ooilaghey, as rub ee e chassyn lesh e folt: as va'n thie er ny lhieeney lesh soar yn ooil.

verses.name: John 12:4
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt fer jeh ny ostyllyn echey, Yuaase Iscariot mac Simon, va ry-hoi y vrah eh.

verses.name: John 12:5
verses.text: Cre'n-fa nagh row yn ooil shoh creckit son three cheead ping, as er ny choyrt da ny boghtyn?

verses.name: John 12:6
verses.text: Shoh dooyrt eh, cha nee ayns kiarail erbee son ny boghtyn, agh dy row eh ny vaarliagh, er va currym y sporran, as eshyn va gymmyrkey ny v'ayn.

verses.name: John 12:7
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt Yeesey, Faag-jee veue ee: cour laa my oanluckey t'ee er reayll shoh.

verses.name: John 12:8
verses.text: Son ny boghtyn t'ad eu kinjagh meriu; agh mish cha vel eu kinjagh.

verses.name: John 12:9
verses.text: Va fys er-y-fa shen ec ymmodee jeh ny Hewnyn dy row eh ayns shen: as haink ad, cha nee er coontey Yeesey ny-lomarcan, agh dy voddagh ad Lazarus y akin myrgeddin, eh v'eshyn er hroggal veih ny merriu.

verses.name: John 12:10
verses.text: Agh hug ny ard-saggyrtyn nyn goyrle dy cheilley, mychione Lazarus myrgeddin y choyrt gy-baase;

verses.name: John 12:11
verses.text: Son dy row ymmodee jeh ny Hewnyn kyndagh rishyn er hreigeil adsyn, as er chredjal ayns Yeesey.

verses.name: John 12:12
verses.text: Laa-ny-vairagh hie shiartanse mooar dy leih, v'er jeet gys y feailley, tra cheayll ad dy row Yeesey er y raad gys Jerusalem.

verses.name: John 12:13
verses.text: As ghow ad banglaneyn dy viljyn palm, as hie ad magh ny whail, as deie ad, Hosanna; bannit ta ree Israel ta cheet ayns ennym y Chiarn.

verses.name: John 12:14
verses.text: As tra va Yeesey er gheddyn assyl aeg, varkee eh er: myr te scruit,

verses.name: John 12:15
verses.text: Ny gow aggle, inneen Sion: cur-my-ner ta dty ree cheet, markiagh er lhiy assyl.

verses.name: John 12:16
verses.text: Ny reddyn shoh cha hoig e ostyllyn ec y toshiaght: agh tra va Yeesey er ny ghloyraghey, eisht chooinee ad dy row ny reddyn shoh scruit jeh, as dy row ad er n'yannoo ny reddyn shoh rish.

verses.name: John 12:17
verses.text: Ren y pobble er-y-fa shen va marish, tra deie eh er Lazarus ass yn oaie, as tra hrog eh eh veih ny merriu feanish y ymmyrkey.

verses.name: John 12:18
verses.text: Er-yn-oyr shoh va'n pobble myrgeddin er gholl magh ny whail, son dy geayll ad dy row eh er n'yannoo yn mirril shoh.

verses.name: John 12:19
verses.text: Dooyrt ny Phariseeyn er-y-fa shen nyn mast' oc hene, Nagh vaik shiu, nagh vaardee shiu monney? cur-my-ner ta'n seihll er gholl geiyrt er.

verses.name: John 12:20
verses.text: As va shiartanse dy Ghreekyn nyn mast' oc, v'er jeet seose dy chur ooashley ec y feailley:

verses.name: John 12:21
verses.text: Haink ad shoh er-y-fa shen gys Philip, va veih Bethsaida ayns Galilee, as ghuee ad er, gra, Vainshter, veagh shin booiagh dy akin Yeesey.

verses.name: John 12:22
verses.text: Haink Philip as dinsh eh da Andreays, as reesht dinsh Andreays as Philip shoh da Yeesey.

verses.name: John 12:23
verses.text: Eshyn shynney lesh e vioys, caillee eh eh: agh eshyn nagh vel soiaghey jeh e vioys 'sy theihll shoh, freillee eh eh gys y vea veayn.

verses.name: John 12:24
verses.text: Dy firrinagh firrinagh ta mee gra riu, Mannagh vel y grine curnaght tuittym ayns y thalloo, as goll eig, te cummal ny un ghrine kinjagh: agh my te goll eig: te gymmyrkey magh mooarane mess.

verses.name: John 12:26
verses.text: My nee dooinney erbee mish y hirveish, lhig da geiyrt orrym; as y raad ta mish, shen y raad myrgeddin vees my harvaant: my nee dooinney erbee mish y hirveish, dasyn ver my Ayr onnor.

verses.name: John 12:27
verses.text: Nish ta my annym seaghnit; as cre jir-ym? Ayr, saue mee veih'n oor shoh: agh er yn oyr shoh haink mee gys yn oor shoh.

verses.name: John 12:28
verses.text: Ayr, cur gloyr da dty ennym hene. Eisht haink coraa veih niau, gra, Ta mee hannah er ghloyraghey eh, as nee'm eh y ghloyraghey reesht.

verses.name: John 12:29
verses.text: Dooyrt y pobble er-y-fa shen va kionfenish, as cheayll yn coraa, dy nee taarnagh v'ayn- dooyrt feallagh elley, dy nee ainle ren loayrt rish.

verses.name: John 12:30
verses.text: Dreggyr Yeesey ad, as dooyrt eh, Cha daink y coraa shoh er y choontey aym's, agh er y choontey euish.

verses.name: John 12:31
verses.text: Nish ta briwnys y theihll shoh: nish vees prince y theihll shoh er ny hilgey magh.

verses.name: John 12:32
verses.text: As my veem's er my hroggal seose jeh'n thalloo, tayrn-ym dy chooilley ghooinney hym.

verses.name: John 12:33
verses.text: (Shoh loayr eh, cowraghey liorish shen cre'n monney dy vaase v'eh dy hurranse)

verses.name: John 12:34
verses.text: Dreggyr y pobble eh, Ta shin er chlashtyn ass y leigh, dy vel Creest tannaghtyn son dy bragh: as kys t'ou uss gra, dy vel y Mac dooinney dy ve troggit seose? quoi yn Mac dooinney shoh?

verses.name: John 12:35
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt Yeesey roo, Foast tammylt beg ta'n soilshey meriu: shooill-jee choud as ta'n soilshey eu, er-aggle dy jig y dorraghys erriu: son cha vel fys echeysyn ta shooyll ayns y dorraghys c'raad t'eh goll.

verses.name: John 12:36
verses.text: Choud as ta soilshey eu, cred-jee ayns y toilshey, dy vod shiu ve nyn gloan jeh'n toilshey. Ny goan shoh loayr Yeesey, as jimmee eh roish, as dollee eh eh-hene voue.

verses.name: John 12:37
verses.text: Agh ga dy ren eh whilleen mirril kiongoyrt roo, foast cha chred ad ayn:

verses.name: John 12:38
verses.text: As shen myr va goan Esaias y phadeyr cooilleenit, Hiarn, quoi ta er chredjal yn goo ain? as quoi gys ta roih yn Chiarn er ve soilshit?

verses.name: John 12:39
verses.text: Shen-y-fa cha voddagh ad credjal, rere myr dooyrt Esaias ayns ynnyd elley.

verses.name: John 12:40
verses.text: T'eh er lhiggey lhieu dolley ny sooillyn oc, as creoghey nyn gree; nagh vaikagh ad lesh nyn sooillyn, as nagh doigagh ad lesh nyn gree, dy beagh ad er nyn jyndaa, as dy jinnin ad y lheihys.

verses.name: John 12:41
verses.text: Ny reddyn shoh loayr Esaias, tra honnick eh e ghloyr as loayr eh jeh.

verses.name: John 12:42
verses.text: Ny-yeih mastey ny eer ard-reiltee ren ymmodee credjal ayn; agh kyndagh rish ny Phariseeyn cha ghow ad rish, er-aggle, dy beagh ad er ny ghiarey-magh veih yn agglish.

verses.name: John 12:43
verses.text: Son v'ad ny s'aggindee er moylley gheiney, ny moylley Yee.

verses.name: John 12:44
verses.text: Hrog Yeesey seose e choraa as dooyrt eh, Eshyn ta credjal aynym's, cha nee aynym's t'eh credjal, agh aynsyn t'er my choyrt.

verses.name: John 12:45
verses.text: As eshyn ta dy my akin, t'eh fakin eshyn t'er my choyrt.

verses.name: John 12:46
verses.text: Ta mish er jeet my hoilshey gys y theihll, quoi-erbee nee credjal aynym's nagh jean eh tannaghtyn ayns y dorraghys

verses.name: John 12:47
verses.text: As my ta dooinney erbee ta clashtyn, as nagh vel freayll my ghoan, cha vel mish dy vriwnys eh: son cha daink mee dy vriwnys y seihll, agh dy hauail y seihll.

verses.name: John 12:48
verses.text: Eshyn ta soiaghey beg jeem's, as nagh vel goaill rish my ghoan, ta shen echey ta dy vriwnys eh: eer yn goo ta mish er loayrt, nee shen y vriwnys eh ec y laa jerrinagh.

verses.name: John 12:49
verses.text: Son cha vel mish er loayrt jee'm pene; agh yn Ayr t'er my choyrt, eshyn hug sarey dou, cre v'orrym dy ghra, as cre lhisin loayrt.

verses.name: John 12:50
verses.text: As ta fys aym dy vel yn sarey echeysyn yn vea dy bragh beayn: cre-erbee er-y-fa shen ta mee dy loayrt, she myr ta'n Ayr er ghra rhym, eer myr shen ta mee loayrt.

verses.name: John 13:1
verses.text: NISH, roish feailley ny Caisht, as fys ec Yeesey, dy row yn oor echey er jeet, tra v'eh dy gholl ass y theihll shoh gys yn Ayr, myr v'eh graihagh er e vooinjer hene, va ayns y theihll, hug eh graih daue gys y jerrey.

verses.name: John 13:2
verses.text: As myr v'ad gee nyn shibber (va'n drogh-spyrryd nish er choyrt eh ayns cree Yuaase Iscariot mac Simon, dy vrah eh)

verses.name: John 13:3
verses.text: Va fys ec Yeesey dy row yn Ayr er chur dy chooilley nhee ayns ny laueyn echey, as dy nee veih Jee haink eh, as dy nee gys Jee v'eh goll,

verses.name: John 13:4
verses.text: Dirree eh veih shibber, as hug eh jeh e gharmadyn, as ghow eh aanrit, as chryss eh eh mysh hene.

verses.name: John 13:5
verses.text: Eisht hug eh ushtey ayns saagh, as ren eh toshiaght dy niee cassyn e ostyllyn, as dy rubbey ad lesh yn aanrit va ec e chryss.

verses.name: John 13:6
verses.text: Eisht haink eh gys Simon Peddyr: as dooyrt eshyn rish, Hiarn, vel uss son niee my chassyn's?

verses.name: John 13:7
verses.text: Dreggyr Yeesey as dooyrt eh rish, Cre ta mee dy yannoo cha vel oo toiggal nish; agh bee toiggal ayd jeh ny-yei shoh.

verses.name: John 13:8
verses.text: Dooyrt Peddyr rish, My chassyn's cha niee oo dy bragh. Dreggyr Yeesey eh, mannagh nieeyms oo, cha vod ayrn erbee ve ayd marym.

verses.name: John 13:9
verses.text: Dooyrt Simon Peddyr rish, Hiarn, cha nee ynrycan eisht my chassyn, agh myrgeddin my laueyn, as my chione.

verses.name: John 13:10
verses.text: Dooyrt Yeesey rish, Eshyn ta nieet, cha vel feme echey agh dy niee e chassyn, as t'eh glen ooilley harrish: as ta shiuish glen, agh cha vel shiu ooilley myr shen.

verses.name: John 13:11
verses.text: Son va fys echey quoi va ry-hoi y vrah eh: shen-y-fa dooyrt eh, Cha vel shiu ooilley glen.

verses.name: John 13:12
verses.text: Myr shen erreish da v' er niee ny cassyn oc, as tra v'eh er ghoaill e gharmadyn, as er hoie sheese reesht, dooyrt eh roo, Vel fys eu cre ta mee er n'yannoo riu?

verses.name: John 13:13
verses.text: Ta shiu genmys mish nyn Mainshter, as Chiarn: as ta shiu gra dy mie; son she shen mee.

verses.name: John 13:14
verses.text: My ta mish eisht yn Chiarn as y Mainshter eu er niee nyn gassyn, lhisagh shiuish myrgeddin yn derrey yeh eu cassyn y jeh elley y niee.

verses.name: John 13:15
verses.text: Son ta mish er chur diu sampleyr; shiuish dy yannoo myr ta mish er n'yannoo riu.

verses.name: John 13:16
verses.text: Dy firrinagh firrinagh ta mee gra riu, Cha vel y charvaant ny syrjey na e hiarn, ny eshyn t'er ny choyrt, ny syrjey na eshyn ren y choyrt eh.

verses.name: John 13:17
verses.text: My ta fys eu er ny reddyn shoh, s'maynrey vees shiu my nee shiu ad y yannoo.

verses.name: John 13:18
verses.text: Cha vel mee loayrt j'iu ooilley; ta fys aym quoi ta mee er reih: agh dy vod y scriptyr ve cooilleenit, T'eshyn ta gee arran marym, er hroggal e voyn m'oi.

verses.name: John 13:19
verses.text: Nish ta mee ginsh diu ro-laue, tra hig eh gy-kione, dy vod shiu credjal dy nee mish eh.

verses.name: John 13:20
verses.text: Dy firrinagh firrinagh ta mee gra riu Eshyn ta jannoo soiagh jeh quoi-erbee ta mee dy choyrt, t'eh jannoo soiagh jeem's: as eshyn ta soiaghey jeem's, t'eh soiaghey jehsyn t'er my choyrt.

verses.name: John 13:21
verses.text: Tra va Yeesey er ghra shoh, v'eh seaghnit ayns e spyrryd, as dymmyrk eh feanish, as dooyrt eh, Dy firrinagh firrinagh ta mee gra riu, dy jean fer jiuish mish y vrah.

verses.name: John 13:22
verses.text: Eisht yeeagh ny ostyllyn er y cheilley ayns ourys quoi er v'eh cheet.

verses.name: John 13:23
verses.text: Nish va ny lhie er oghrish Yeesey, fer jeh e ostyllyn bynney lesh.

verses.name: John 13:24
verses.text: Chrie Simon Peddyr er-y-fa shen er, eh dy enaght quoi er v'eh cheet.

verses.name: John 13:25
verses.text: Myr v'eh eisht ny lhie rish oghrish Yeesey, dooyrt eh rish, Hiarn, quoi eh?

verses.name: John 13:26
verses.text: Dreggyr Yeesey, She eshyn eh da verym greme dy arran, tra vee'm er hummey eh. As tra v'eh er hummey yn greme, hug eh eh da Yuaase Iscariot mac Simon.

verses.name: John 13:27
verses.text: As lurg y greme, hie yn drogh-spyrryd stiagh ayn. Eisht dooyrt Yeesey rish, Shen t'ou dy yannoo, jean eh dy tappee.

verses.name: John 13:28
verses.text: Nish cha row fys ec dooinney jeu ec y voayrd cre'n-fa loayr eh shoh rish.

verses.name: John 13:29
verses.text: Son heill paart, er-yn-oyr dy nee ec Yuaase va'n sporran, dy row Yeesey er ghra rish Kionnee ny vees mayd feme cour y feailley: ny eh dy chur jeirk da ny boghtyn.

verses.name: John 13:30
verses.text: Erreish da eisht v'er n'ghoaill y greme dy arran, hie eh chelleeragh magh: as va'n oie ayn.

verses.name: John 13:31
verses.text: Shen-y-fa erreish da v'er n'gholl magh, dooyrt Yeesey, Nish ta'n Mac dooinney er ny ghloyraghey, as ta Jee er ny ghloyraghey ayn.

verses.name: John 13:32
verses.text: My ta Jee er ny ghloyraghey ayn, nee Jee myrgeddin eshyn y ghloyraghey ayn hene, as nee eh dy gerrit eh y ghloyraghey.

verses.name: John 13:33
verses.text: Chloan veggey, foast tammylt beg ta mish meriu. Nee shiu my hirrey: as myr dooyrt mee rish ny Hewnyn, Raad ta mish goll, cha vod shiuish cheet; myr shen ta mec nish gra riuish.

verses.name: John 13:34
verses.text: Sarey noa ta mee dy choyrt diu, Shiu dy ve graihagh yn derrey yeh er y jeh elley; myr ta mish er ve graihagh erriuish dy der shiuish myrgeddin graih yn derrey yeh da'n jeh elley.

verses.name: John 13:35
verses.text: Liorish shoh vees fys ec dy chooilley ghooinney dy vel shiu gynsaghey voym's, my vees shiu graihagh yn derrey yeh er y jeh elley.

verses.name: John 13:36
verses.text: Dooyrt Simon Peddyr rish, Hiarn, c'raad t'ou goll? Dreggyr Yeesey eh, Raad ta mee goll, cha vod oo geiyrt orrym nish; agh eiyree oo orrym ny lurg shoh.

verses.name: John 13:37
verses.text: Dooyrt Peddyr rish, Hiarn, cre'n-fa nagh voddym geiyrt ort nish? scarrym rish my vioys er dty ghraih.

verses.name: John 13:38
verses.text: Dreggyr Yeesey eh, Jean oo scarrey rish dty vioys er my ghraih's? Dy firrinagh firrinagh ta mee gra rhyt, Nagh jean y kellagh gerrym, derrey obbys oo mish three keayrtyn.

verses.name: John 14:1
verses.text: NY lhig da'n cree eu ve seaghnit:. ta shiu credjal ayns Jee, cred-jee myrgeddin aynym's.

verses.name: John 14:2
verses.text: Ayns thie my Ayrey ta ymmodee ynnydyn-vaghee; dy beagh eh er aght elley, veign er n'insh diu: ta mee goll dy yannoo aarloo ynnyd er nyn son.

verses.name: John 14:3
verses.text: As my hem's dy yannoo aarloo ynnyd er nyn son, hig-ym reesht, as goym shiu hym pene, raad ta mish dy vod shiuish ve myrgeddin.

verses.name: John 14:4
verses.text: As ta fys eu cre'n raad ta mee goll, as shione diu yn raad.

verses.name: John 14:5
verses.text: Dooyrt Thomase rish, Hiarn, cha s'ain cre'n raad t'ou goll, as kys oddys enney y ve ain er y raad?

verses.name: John 14:6
verses.text: Dooyrt Yeesey rish, Mish y raad, yn irriney, as y vea: cha vel dooinney erbee cheet gys yn Ayr, agh lioryms.

verses.name: John 14:7
verses.text: Dy beagh enney er ve eu orrym's, veagh enney eu er my Ayr myrgeddin: as nish ta enney eu er, as ta shiu er vakin eh.

verses.name: John 14:8
verses.text: Dooyrt Philip rish, Hiarn, jeeagh dooin yn Ayr, as s'lioar dooin eh.

verses.name: John 14:9
verses.text: Dooyrt Yeesey rish, Vel mish er ve choud shen meriu, as nagh nione dhyt's mee foast, Philip? eshyn t'er n'akin mish, t'eh er vakin yn Ayr; as kys t'ou uss gra eisht, Jeeagh dooin yn Ayr? l

verses.name: John 14:11
verses.text: Cred-jee mish, dy vel mee ayns yn Ayr, as yn Ayr aynym's: er-nonney cred-jee mee er graih ny eer obbraghyn.

verses.name: John 14:12
verses.text: Dy firrinagh firrinagh ta mee gra riu, Eshyn ta credjal aynym's, ny obbraghyn ta mish dy yannoo nee eshyn myrgeddin, as obbraghyn smoo na ad shoh nee eh; er-y-fa dy vel mish goll roym gys my Ayr.

verses.name: John 14:13
verses.text: As cre-erbee nee shiu y hirrey ayns yn ennym aym's, shen neem's y yannoo, dy vod yn Ayr v'er ny ghloyraghey ayns y Mac.

verses.name: John 14:14
verses.text: My hirrys shiu nhee erbee ayns yn ennym aym's, nee'm eh y yannoo.

verses.name: John 14:15
verses.text: My ta shiu graihagh orrym's, freill jee my annaghyn.

verses.name: John 14:16
verses.text: As guee-yms gys yn Ayr, as ver eh hiu Fer-gerjagh elley dy hannaghtyn meriu son dy bragh.

verses.name: John 14:17
verses.text: Eer Spyrryd ny firriney, nagh vod y seihll goaill-rish, er-y-fa nagh vel ad dy akin eh, as nagh nione daue eh: agh shione diuish eh, son t'eh tannaghtyn meriu, as bee eh ayndiu.

verses.name: John 14:18
verses.text: Cha vaag-ym shiu gyn gerjagh; higyms hiu.

verses.name: John 14:19
verses.text: Foast tammylt beg, as cha vel y seihll dy my akin ny smoo; agh ta shiuish dy my akin: er-yn-oyr dy vel mish bio, bee shiuish bio myrgeddin.

verses.name: John 14:20
verses.text: Ayns y laa shen vees fys eu dy vel mish ayns my Ayr, as shiuish aynym's, as mish ayndiuish.

verses.name: John 14:21
verses.text: Eshyn ta my annaghyn's echey, as ta freayll ad, eshyn eh ta graihagh orrym's: as eshyn ta graihagh orrym, ver my Ayr graih da, as ver-yms graih da, as soilshee-ym mee hene da.

verses.name: John 14:22
verses.text: Dooyrt Yuaase rish, cha nee Iscariot, Hiarn, kys te dy jean oo oo-hene y hoilshaghey dooinyn, as cha nee da'n seihll?

verses.name: John 14:23
verses.text: Dreggyr Yeesey as dooyrt eh rish, My ta dooinney graihagh orrym, freillee eh my ghoan: as ver my Ayr graih da, as hig mayd huggey, as nee mayd tannaghtyn marish.

verses.name: John 14:24
verses.text: Eshyn nagh vel graihagh orrym's, cha vel eh freayll my ghoan: as y goo ta shiu dy chlashtyn, cha nee lhiam's eh, agh goo yn Ayr t'er my choyrt.

verses.name: John 14:25
verses.text: Ny reddyn shoh ta mee er loayrt riu, choud's ta mee foast meriu.

verses.name: John 14:26
verses.text: Agh nee Fer-ny-gherjagh, ta shen, yn Spyrryd Noo, eh nee yn Ayr y choyrt ayns yn ennym aym's, gynsaghey diu dy chooilley nhee, as tayrnee eh dy chooilley nhee gys nyn gooinaghtyn, cre-erbee ta mish er ghra riu.

verses.name: John 14:27
verses.text: Shee ta mee dy aagail meriu, my hee ta mee dy choyrt diu: cha nee myr ta'n seihll coyrt, ta mish dy choyrt eh diu. Ny lhig da'n cree eu ve seaghnit, chamoo lhig da aggle y ve er.

verses.name: John 14:28
verses.text: Ta shiu er chlashtyn kys dooyrt mee riu, Ta mee goll roym, as cheet reesht hiu. Dy beagh shiu graihagh orrym, ghoghe shiu boggey, er-y-fa dy dooyrt mee, Ta mee goll roym gys my Ayr: son ta my Ayr ny syrjey na mish.

verses.name: John 14:29
verses.text: As nish ta mee er n'insh diu ro-laue, tra hig eh gy-kione, dy vod shiu credjal

verses.name: John 14:30
verses.text: Veih shoh magh cha loayr-ym cooidvooar riu: son ta prince y theihll shoh cheet, as cha vel nhee erbee echey aynym's.

verses.name: John 14:31
verses.text: Agh dy vod fys y ve ec y theihll dy vel mish graihagh er yn Ayr; as myr hug yn Ayr sarey dou, myr shen ta mee jannoo. Trog-jee erriu, lhig dooin goll roin.

verses.name: John 15:1
verses.text: NISH y billey-feeyney firrinagh, as my Ayr yn eirinnagh.

verses.name: John 15:2
verses.text: Dy chooilley vanglane aynym's nagh vel gymmyrkey mess, t'eh dy ghoaill ersooyl: as dy chooilley vanglane ta gymmyrkey mess, t'eh dy phollal, dy vod eh ve ny s'messoil.

verses.name: John 15:3
verses.text: Nish ta shiuish glen trooid y goo ta mish er loayrt riu.

verses.name: John 15:4
verses.text: Jean-jee tannaghtyn aynym's, as mish ayndiuish. Myr nagh vod y banglane mess y ymmyrkey jeh hene, mannagh vel eh tannaghtyn ayns y villey-feeyney: chamoo oddys shiuish, mannagh jean shiu tannaghtyn aynym's.

verses.name: John 15:5
verses.text: Mish y billey-feeyney, shiuish ny banglaneyn: eshyn ta tannaghtyn aynym's, as mish aynsyn, t'eh shoh cur magh mooarane mess: son scarrit voym's cha vod shiu jannoo monney dy vie.

verses.name: John 15:6
verses.text: Mannagh vel dooinney tannaghtyn aynym's t'eh tilgit magh myr banglane, as t'eh fioghey; as t'ad dyn deiy as dyn dilgey ad ayns yn aile, as t'ad er nyn lostey.

verses.name: John 15:7
verses.text: My nee shiu tannaghtyn aynym's, as my ghoan's tannaghtyn ayndiuish, shirree shiu cre sailliu, as bee eh jeant er nyn son.

verses.name: John 15:8
verses.text: Liorish shoh ta my Ayr er ny ghloyraghey, shiu dy chur magh lane mess, as shoh myr vees shiu ny ynseydee aym's.

verses.name: John 15:9
verses.text: Myr ta'n Ayr graihagh orrym's, myr shen ta mish er ve graihagh erriuish: jean-jee tannaghtyn ayns y ghraih aym's.

verses.name: John 15:10
verses.text: My nee shiu my annaghyn y reayll, nee shiu tannaghtyn ayns my ghraih: eer myr ta mish er vreayll annaghyn my Ayrey, as tannaghtyn ayns y ghraih echeysyn.

verses.name: John 15:11
verses.text: Ny goan shoh ta mee er loayrt riu, dy vod y boggey aym's ve er-mayrn ayndiu, as dy vod y boggey euish v'er ny yannoo magh.

verses.name: John 15:12
verses.text: Shoh my harey, Shiu dy chur graih yn derrey yeh da'n jeh elley, myr ta mish er ve graihagh erriuish.

verses.name: John 15:13
verses.text: Graih smoo na shoh cha vel ec dooinney erbee, na dooinney dy scarrey rish e vioys son e chaarjyn.

verses.name: John 15:14
verses.text: She my chaarjyn shiuish, my nee shiu ny ta mish dy harey diu.

verses.name: John 15:15
verses.text: Veih shoh magh cha vel mee dy enmys shiu sharvaantyn; son cha vel fys ec y charvaant, cre ta e hiarn dy yannoo: agh ta mee er n'enmys shiu caarjyn; son dy chooilley nhee ta mee er chlashtyn veih my Ayr, ta mee er hoilshaghey diuish.

verses.name: John 15:16
verses.text: Cha vel shiuish er my reih, agh ta mish er reih shiuish, as er chur shiu ayns pooar, dy vod shiu goll magh as mess y ymmyrkey, as dy vod y mess eu ve beayn: cre erbee nee shiu y hirrey er yn Ayr ayns yn ennym aym's, dy vod eh y chur diu eh.

verses.name: John 15:17
verses.text: Ny reddyn shoh ta mish dy harey diu, dy vod shiu ve graihagh yn derrey yeh er y jeh elley.

verses.name: John 15:18
verses.text: My ta dwoaie ec y seihll erriu, ta fys eu dy dug eh dwoaie dooys hoshiaght.

verses.name: John 15:19
verses.text: Dy beagh shiuish jeh'n theihll, veagh y seihll graihagh er e vooinjer hene: agh son nagh vel shiu jeh'n theihll, agh dy vel mish er reih shiu ass y theihll, shen-y-fa ta dwoaie ec y theihll erriu.

verses.name: John 15:20
verses.text: Cooinee-jee er y raa loayr mish riu, Cha vel y charvaant ny syrjey na e hiarn. My t'ad er n'yannoo tranlaase orrym's, nee ad myrgeddin tranlaase erriuish: my t'ad er vreayll my ghoan's, freillee ad ny goan euish myrgeddin.

verses.name: John 15:21
verses.text: Agh dy chooilley nhee jeu shoh nee ad riu kyndagh rish yn ennym aym's, er-y-fa nagh vel enney oc ersyn t'er my choyrt.

verses.name: John 15:22
verses.text: Mannagh beign's er jeet as er loayrt roo, cha beagh peccah er ve oc: agh nish cha vel leshtal oc son nyn beccah.

verses.name: John 15:23
verses.text: Eshyn ta dwoaie echey orrym's, ta dwoaie echey er my Ayr myrgeddin.

verses.name: John 15:24
verses.text: Mannagh beign's er n'yannoo nyn mast' oc lheid ny obbraghyn as nagh ren rieau dooinney erbee elley, cha beagh peccah er ve oc: agh nish t'ad er vakin, as er chur dwoaie chammah dooys as da my Ayr.

verses.name: John 15:25
verses.text: Agh ta shoh, dy vod y raa ve cooilleenit ta scruit ayns y leigh oc, Hug ad dwoaie dou gyn oyr.

verses.name: John 15:26
verses.text: Agh tra vees Fer-ny-gherjagh er jeet, eh ver-yms hiu veih yn Ayr, ta shen, Spyrryd ny firriney, ta cheet magh veih yn Ayr, nee eh feanish y ymmyrkey jeem's.

verses.name: John 15:27
verses.text: As nee shiuish myrgeddin feanish y ymmyrkey, er-y-fa dy vel shiu er ve marym er-dyn toshiaght.

verses.name: John 16:1
verses.text: NY goan shoh ta mee er loayrt riu, son nagh bee nyn gredjue er ny lhaggaghey.

verses.name: John 16:2
verses.text: Ver ad shiu magh ass ny kialteenyn: as ta'n oor cheet, quoi-erbee varrys shiu, dy smooinee eh dy bee eh shirveish Jee.

verses.name: John 16:3
verses.text: As ny reddyn shoh nee ad riu, er-yn-oyr nagh vel enney oc er yn Ayr, ny orrym's.

verses.name: John 16:4
verses.text: Agh ny reddyn shoh ta mish er n'insh diu, tra hig yn earish, dy vod shiu cooinaghtyn dy dinsh mee diu jeu. As ny goan shoh cha loayr mee riu ec y toshiaght, er-y-fa dy row mee meriu.

verses.name: John 16:5
verses.text: Agh nish ta mee goll roym huggeysyn t'er my choyrt, as cha vel fer j'iu fenaght jee'm c'raad t'ou goll?

verses.name: John 16:6
verses.text: Agh er-yn-oyr dy vel mee er ghra ny reddyn shoh riu, ta trimshey er lhieeney ny creeaghyn eu.

verses.name: John 16:7
verses.text: Ny-yeih ta mish ginsh diu yn irriney; Te ymmyrchagh er nyn son mish dy gholl roym: son mannagh jem roym, cha jig Fer ny-gherjagh hiu; agh my hem's roym, verym hiu eh.

verses.name: John 16:8
verses.text: As tra vees eh er jeet, nee eh yn seihll y gheyrey mychione peccah, as cairys, as briwnys:

verses.name: John 16:9
verses.text: Mychione peccah, son nagh vel ad credjal aynym's;

verses.name: John 16:10
verses.text: Mychione cairys, son dy vel mee goll roym gys yn Ayr, as nagh vaik shiu mee arragh;

verses.name: John 16:11
verses.text: Mychione briwnys, son dy vel prince y theihll shoh er ny vriwnys.

verses.name: John 16:12
verses.text: Shimmey red ta aym's foast dy ghra riu, agh cha vod shiu ad y ymmyrkey nish.

verses.name: John 16:13
verses.text: Agh tra hig eshyn, Spyrryd ny firriney, leeidee eh shiu gys dy chooilley irrinys: son cha loayr eh jeh hene, agh cre-erbee nee eh y chlashtyn, shen loayrys eh; as soilshee eh diu reddyn ta ry-heet.

verses.name: John 16:14
verses.text: Nee eh mish y ghloyraghey: son yiow eh jeh ny ta lhiam's as soilshee eh diuish eh.

verses.name: John 16:15
verses.text: Ta dy chooilley nhee t'ec yn Ayr lhiam's: shen-y-fa dooyrt mee, dy gow eh jeh ny ta lhiam's, as dy soilshee eh diuish eh.

verses.name: John 16:16
verses.text: Tammylt beg as cha vaik shiu mee: as reesht, tammylt beg, as hee shiu mee, er-y-fa dy vel mee goll roym gys yn Ayr.

verses.name: John 16:17
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt paart jeh e ostyllyn eddyr ad-hene, Cre shoh t'eh dy ghra rooin, Tammylt beg as cha vaik shiu mee: as reesht, tammylt beg, as hee shiu mee: as, Er-yn-oyr dy vel mee goll roym gys yn Ayr?

verses.name: John 16:18
verses.text: Dooyrt ad er-y-fa shen, Cre shoh t'eh dy ghra, Tammylt beg? cha s'ain cre t'eh dy ghra.

verses.name: John 16:19
verses.text: Nish va fys ec Yeesey dy row ad aignagh dy enaght jeh, as dooyrt eh roo, Vel shiu briaght nyn mast' eu hene, er-y-fa dy dooyrt mee, Tammylt beg, as cha vaik shiu mee: as reesht, tammylt beg as hee shiu mee?

verses.name: John 16:20
verses.text: Dy firrinagh firrinagh ta mee gra riu, Dy jean shiuish keayney as dobberan, agh nee yn seihll boggey y ghoaill: as bee shiuish trimshagh, agh bee yn trimshey eu er ny hyndaa gys boggey.

verses.name: John 16:21
verses.text: Ta ben, tra t'ee er-troailt, as trimshey eck, er-yn-oyr dy vel yn oor eck er jeet: agh cha leah as t'ee er ny livrey jeh'n lhiannoo, cha vel ee ny sodjey cooinaghtyn er yn angaish, son boggey dy vel dooinney er ny ruggey gys y theihll.

verses.name: John 16:22
verses.text: As ta nish er-y-fa shen trimshey euish: agh hee-yms shiu reesht, as gowee yn cree eu boggey, as y boggey eu cha gow dooinney erbee veue.

verses.name: John 16:23
verses.text: As ayns y laa shen cha jean shiu nhee erbee y enaght jeem's: Dy firrinagh firrinagh ta mee gra riu, Cre-erbee hirrys shiu er yn Ayr ayns yn ennym aym's, ver eh diu eh.

verses.name: John 16:24
verses.text: Cha vel shiu foast er hirrey nhee erbee ayns yn ennym aym's shir-jee as yiow shiu, dy vod y boggey eu v'er ny yannoo magh.

verses.name: John 16:25
verses.text: Ny reddyn shoh ta mee er loayrt riu ayns coraaghyn-dorraghey: agh ta'n traa cheet tra nagh loayrym riu ny smoo ayns coraaghyn-dorraghey, agh soilshee-ym diu dy foshlit jeh'n Ayr.

verses.name: John 16:26
verses.text: Ayns y laa shen nee shiu geearree ayns y ennym aym's: as cha vel mee gra riu, dy guee-ym gys yn Ayr er nyn son:

verses.name: John 16:27
verses.text: Son ta'n Ayr hene graihagh erriu, er-y-fa dy vel shiuish er ve graihagh orrym's, as dy chred shiu dy daink mee magh veih Jee.

verses.name: John 16:28
verses.text: Haink mee magh veih'n Ayr, as ta mee er jeet gys y theihll: reesht, ta mee faagail y seihll, as goll roym gys yn Ayr.

verses.name: John 16:29
verses.text: Dooyrt e ostyllyn rish, Cur-my-ner, nish t'ou loayrt dy foshlit, as cha vel oo loayrt coraa-dorraghey erbee.

verses.name: John 16:30
verses.text: Nish ta shin shickyr dy vel fys ayd er dy chooilley nhee, as nagh vel feme ayd dooinney erbee dy enaght jeed: liorish shoh ta shin credjal dy daink oo magh veih Jee.

verses.name: John 16:31
verses.text: Dreggyr Yeesey ad, Vel shiu nish credjal?

verses.name: John 16:32
verses.text: Cur-my-ner ta'n oor cheet, as eer nish er jeet, dy bee shiu er nyn skeayley dy chooilley ghooinney gys e ynnyd hene, as dy vaag shiu mish my lomarcan: as foast cha vel mee my lomarcan, er-y-fa dy vel yn Ayr marym.

verses.name: John 16:33
verses.text: Ny reddyn shoh ta mee er loayrt riu, aynym's dy vod shee y ve eu. Ayns y theihll vees seaghyn eu: agh bee-jee dy yien mie, ta mish er gheddyn barriaght er y theihll.

verses.name: John 17:1
verses.text: NY goan shoh loayr Yeesey; as hrog eh seose e hooillyn gys niau, as dooyrt eh, Ayr, ta'n oor er jeet; jean dty Vac y ghloyraghey, dy vod dty Vac myrgeddin uss y ghloyraghey.

verses.name: John 17:2
verses.text: Myr t'ou er chur da pooar harrish ooilley sheelnaue, dy vod eh yn vea veayn y choyrt da whilleen as t'ou er chur da.

verses.name: John 17:3
verses.text: As shoh yn vea veayn, tushtey y ve oc jeed's yn ynrycan Jee firrinagh, as jeh Yeesey Creest t'ou uss er choyrt.

verses.name: John 17:4
verses.text: Ta mee er ghloyraghey oo er y thalloo: ta mee er chooilleeney yn obbyr hug oo dou dy yannoo.

verses.name: John 17:5
verses.text: As nish, O Ayr, jean mish y ghloyraghey mayrt hene, lesh y ghloyr v'aym mayrt roish my row seihll ayn.

verses.name: John 17:6
verses.text: Ta mee er hoilshaghey dty ennym gys ny deiney hug oo dou ass y theihll: lhiat's ad, as hug oo ad dooys; as t'ad er vreayll dty ghoo.

verses.name: John 17:7
verses.text: Nish t'ad er hoiggal dy nee void's ta dy chooilley nhee t'ou er choyrt dou.

verses.name: John 17:8
verses.text: Son hug mish dauesyn ny goan hug uss dooys; as t'ad er ghoaill huc hene ad, as er hoiggal ayns shickyrys dy daink mee magh voids, as t'ad er chredjal dy ren oo my choyrt.

verses.name: John 17:9
verses.text: Ta mee guee ort er nyn son: cha vel mee guee son theihll, agh er ny son ocsyn t'ou er choyrt dou, son she lhiat hene ad.

verses.name: John 17:10
verses.text: As ta ooilley ny ta lhiam's lhiat's, as ny ta lhiat's lhiam's, as ta mee er my ghloyraghey ayndoo.

verses.name: John 17:11
verses.text: As nish cha vel mish dy ve ny sodjey ayns y theihll, agh t'ad shoh ayns y theihll, as ta mish cheet hood's. Ayr chasherick, freill trooid dty ennym hene adsyn t'ou er chur dou, dy vod adsyn ve unnane, myr ta shinyn unnane.

verses.name: John 17:12
verses.text: Choud as va mee maroo ayns y theihll, dreill mee ad ayns dty ennym's: adsyn hug oo dou dreill mee, as cha vel unnane oc caillit, mannagh vel mac y toyrt-mow: dy voddagh yn scriptyr ve cooilleenit.

verses.name: John 17:13
verses.text: As nish ta mee cheet hood's, as ny reddyn shoh ta mee dy loayrt ayns y theihll, dy vod y boggey aym's y ve oc jeant magh ayndoo hene.

verses.name: John 17:14
verses.text: Ta mee er chur daue dty ghoo; as ta'n seihll er chur dwoaie daue, er-y-fa nagh vel ad jeh'n theihll, myr nagh vel mish jeh'n theihll.

verses.name: John 17:15
verses.text: Cha vel mee guee ort dy ghoaill ad ass y theihll, agh oo dy reayll ad veih'n olk.

verses.name: John 17:16
verses.text: Cha vel adsyn jeh'n theihll, myr nagh vel mish jeh'n theihll.

verses.name: John 17:17
verses.text: Jean ad y chasherickey son dty irriney: dty ghoo she firrinys eh.

verses.name: John 17:18
verses.text: Myr t'ou uss er my choyrt gys y theihll, myr shen ta mish myrgeddin er chur adsyn gys y theihll.

verses.name: John 17:19
verses.text: As er y ghraih ocsyn ta mish dy chasherickey mee hene, dy vod adsyn myrgeddin v'er nyn gasherickey gys yn irriney.

verses.name: John 17:20
verses.text: Chamoo ta mee guee er ny son oc shoh nyn lomarcan, agh myrgeddin er ny son ocsyn nee credjal aynym's trooid y goo oc.

verses.name: John 17:21
verses.text: Dy vod ad ooilley ve unnane, myr t'ou uss ayr aynym's, as mish aynyd's; dy vod adsyn myrgeddin ve unnane ayninyn: dy vod y seihll credjal dy ren oo my choyrt.

verses.name: John 17:22
verses.text: As y ghloyr hug uss dooys, ta mish er chur dauesyn: dy vod ad ve unnane, eer myr ta shinyn unnane.

verses.name: John 17:23
verses.text: Mish ayndoosyn, as uss aynym's, dy vod ad ve jeant slane firrinagh ayns unnaneys, as dy vod fys ve ec y seihll dy vel oo er my choyrt, as dy vel oo er ve graihagh orroosyn, myr t'ou er ve graihagh orrym's

verses.name: John 17:24
verses.text: Ayr, ta mee geearree adsyn t'ou er chur dou dy ve marym raad ta mee; dy vod ad fakin my ghloyr t'ou er chur dou: son t'ou er ve graihagh orrym's roish my row yn seihll er ny chroo.

verses.name: John 17:25
verses.text: Ayr chairagh, cha ghow yn seihll tushtey jeed; agh ta tushtey er ve aym's jeed, as t'ad shoh er hoiggal dy vel oo er my choyrt.

verses.name: John 17:26
verses.text: As ta mee er hoilshaghey daue dt'ennym's, as nee'm y hoilshaghey eh: dy vod y graih, liorish t'ou er ve graihagh orrym's, ve ayndoo, as mish ayndoosyn.

verses.name: John 18:1
verses.text: TRA va Yeesey er loayrt ny goan shoh, hie eh magh marish e ostyllyn harrish y strooan Cedron, raad va garey, as hie eshyn as e ostyllyn stiagh ayn.

verses.name: John 18:2
verses.text: As bione da Yuaase neesht va dy vrah eh, yn ynnyd: son boallagh Yeesey dy mennick taaghey yn voayl shen marish e ostyllyn.

verses.name: John 18:3
verses.text: Hooar Yuaase eisht sheshaght dy gheiney, as sidooryn veih ny ard-saggyrtyn as ny Phariseeyn, as haink eh ayns shen lesh lonteyryn, as torchyn, as armyn.

verses.name: John 18:4
verses.text: Va fys ec Yeesey er-y-fa shen er dy chooilley nhee harragh er, as hie eh magh, as dooyrt eh roo, Quoi ta shiu dy hirrey?

verses.name: John 18:5
verses.text: Dreggyr ad eh, Yeesey dy Nazareth. Dooyrt Yeesey roo, Mish eh. As va Yuaase myrgeddin ren y vrah eh ny hassoo maroo.

verses.name: John 18:6
verses.text: Cha leah eisht as v'eh er ghra roo, Mish eh, hie ad gour nyn drommey, as huitt ad gys y thalloo.

verses.name: John 18:7
verses.text: Eisht denee eh jeu reesht, Quoi ta shiu dy hirrey? As dooyrt adsyn, Yeesey dy Nazareth.

verses.name: John 18:8
verses.text: Dreggyr Yeesey, Ta mee er n'insh diu dy nee mish eh. My ta shiu er-y-fa shen dy my hirrey, lhig-jee daue shoh goll roue:

verses.name: John 18:9
verses.text: Shoh myr va'n raa shen loayr eh cooilleenit, Jeusyn hug oo dou, cha vel mee er choayll unnane.

verses.name: John 18:10
verses.text: Eisht va cliwe ec Simon Peddyr, as hayrn eh eh, as woaill eh fer-mooinjerey yn ard-saggyrt, as ghiare eh yn chleaysh jeh. Va ennym yn er-mooinjerey shen Malchus.

verses.name: John 18:11
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt Yeesey rish Peddyr, Cur seose dty chliwe ayns y fine: yn cappan ta my Ayr er chur dou, nagh niu-ym eh?

verses.name: John 18:12
verses.text: Eisht ghow yn cheshaght, as y captan, as fir-oik ny Hewnyn Yeesey, as chiangle ad eh.

verses.name: John 18:13
verses.text: As hug ad lhieu ersooyl eh gys Annas hoshiaght (son v'eh shen ny ayr-'sy-leigh da Caiaphas, va ny ard-saggyrt yn vlein shen).

verses.name: John 18:14
verses.text: Nish she Caiaphas v'er choyrlaghey ny Hewnyn, dy row eh ymmyrchagh un dooinney dy ve er ny choyrt gy-baase son y pobble.

verses.name: John 18:15
verses.text: As deiyr Simon Peddyr as ostyl elley er Yeesey. Yn ostyl shen va ainjys ec yn ard-saggyrt er, as hie eh stiagh marish Yeesey gys thie yn ard-saggyrt,

verses.name: John 18:16
verses.text: Agh hass Peddyr ec y dorrys er cheu mooie. Eisht hie magh yn ostyl elley shen va ainjys ec yn ard-saggyrt er, as loayr eh reeish va currym y dorrys urree, as hug eh lesh stiagh Peddyr.

verses.name: John 18:17
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt y ven-aeg va currym y dorrys urree rish Peddyr, Nagh nee fer jeh eiyrtyssee yn dooinney shoh uss neesht? Dooyrt eshyn, Cha nee.

verses.name: John 18:18
verses.text: As va ny sharvaantyn as ny fir-oik nyn shassoo ayns shen, ec aile geayil v'ad er n'yannoo (son ve feayr) as v'ad dyn jiow ad-hene.

verses.name: John 18:19
verses.text: Denee yn ard-saggyrt eisht jeh Yeesey mychione e eiyrtyssee, as mychione yn ynsagh echey.

verses.name: John 18:20
verses.text: Dreggyr Yeesey eh, Loayr mee dy foshlit rish y theihll: dynsee mee kinjagh ayns y cheeill, as ayns y chiamble, raad ta ny Hewnyn kinjagh taaghey, as dy follit cha vel mee er ghra nhee erbee

verses.name: John 18:21
verses.text: Cre'n-fa t'ou fenaght jeem's? fenee jeusyn t'er my chlashtyn, cre ta mee er ghra roo: cur-my-ner ta fys ocsyn cre ta mee er ghra.

verses.name: John 18:22
verses.text: As tra v'eh erreish ny goan shoh y loayrt woaill fer jeh ny fir-oik va ny hassoo ayns shen Yeesey lesh bass e laue, gra, Nee shen myr t'ou freggyrt yn ard-saggyrt?

verses.name: John 18:23
verses.text: Dansoor Yeesey eh, My ta mee er loayrt dy olk, ymmyrk feanish jeh'n olk: agh my loayr mee dy mie, cre'n-fa woaill uss mee?

verses.name: John 18:24
verses.text: (Nish va Annas er choyrt eh kianlt gys Caiaphas yn ard-saggyrt)

verses.name: John 18:25
verses.text: As va Simon Peddyr ny hassoo as dy hiow eh-hene: dooyrt ad er-y-fa shen rish, Nagh nee fer jeh e eiyrtyssee uss neesht? Dob eh, as dooyrt eh, Cha nee.

verses.name: John 18:26
verses.text: Dooyrt fer jeh sharvaantyn yn ard saggyrt (va mooinjerys dasyn va Peddyr er ghiarey yn chleaysh jeh) Nagh vaik mish oo marish ayns y gharey?

verses.name: John 18:27
verses.text: Eisht dob Peddyr reesht, as chelleeragh gherr y kellagh.

verses.name: John 18:28
verses.text: Eisht hug ad lhieu Yeesey veih Caiaphas gys halley ny briwnys: as ve moghey, as cha jagh ad-hene stiagh ayns halley ny briwnys, er-aggle dy beagh ad anchasherick; as nagh voddagh ad yn Eayncaisht y ee.

verses.name: John 18:29
verses.text: Hie Pilate eisht magh huc, as dooyrt eh, Cre ta shiu dy chur gys lieh yn dooinney shoh?

verses.name: John 18:30
verses.text: Dreggyr adsyn as dooyrt ad, Er-be dy nee drogh-yantagh eh, cha beagh shin er livrey hood's eh.

verses.name: John 18:31
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt Pilate roo Gow-jee shiuish eh, as jean-jee eh y vriwnys cordail rish y leigh eu hene. Dooyrt ny Hewnyn er-y-fa shen rish, Cha vel eh lowal dooinyn dooinney erbee y chur gy-baase:

verses.name: John 18:32
verses.text: Shoh myr va cooilleenit yn raa loayr Yeesey, cowraghey cre'n baase v'eh dy hurranse.

verses.name: John 18:33
verses.text: Eisht hie Pilate stiagh reesht ayns halley ny briwnys, as deie eh er Yeesey, as dooyrt eh rish, Nee ree ny Hewnyn oo?

verses.name: John 18:34
verses.text: Dreggyr Yeesey eh, Vel uss dy ghra shoh jeed hene, ny nee feallagh elley dinsh dhyt eh my-mychione's?

verses.name: John 18:35
verses.text: Dreggyr Pilate, Vel mish my Hew? she dty ashoon hene as ny ard-saggyrtyn t'er livrey oo seose hym's: Cre t'ou er n'yannoo?

verses.name: John 18:36
verses.text: Dreggyr Yeesey, Cha vel my reeriaght's jeh'n theihll shoh: dy beagh my reeriaght jeh'n theihll shoh; eisht veagh my harvaantyn er chaggey, nagh beign er my livrey gys ny Hewnyn, agh nish cha nee veih shoh ta my reeriaght.

verses.name: John 18:37
verses.text: Dooyrt Pilate er-y-fa shen rish, Vel oo dty ree eisht? Dreggyr Yeesey, T'ou uss er ghra eh, ta mee my ree. Er son shoh ruggyr mee, as er-yn-oyr shoh haink mee gys y theihll, dy ymmyrkey feanish gys yn irriney, Ta dy chooilley unnane ta jeh'n irriney clashtyn my choraa.

verses.name: John 18:38
verses.text: Dooyrt Pilate rish, Cre ta'n irriney shen? as tra v'eh er ghra shoh, hie eh magh reesht gys ny Hewnyn, as dooyrt eh roo, Cha vel mish er gheddyn foill erbee ayn.

verses.name: John 18:39
verses.text: Agh ta cliaghtey eu mee dy eaysley diu fer ec y Chaisht: nailliu er-y-fa shen mee dy eaysley diu ree ny Hewnyn?

verses.name: John 18:40
verses.text: Eisht deie ad ooilley reesht, gra, Cha nee eh shoh, agh Barabbas. Nish va Barabbas ny roosteyr.

verses.name: John 19:1
verses.text: EISHT ghow Pilate er-y-fa shen Yeesey, as doardee eh eh dy ve scuitchit.

verses.name: John 19:2
verses.text: As fee ny sidooryn attey dy ghrineyn, as hug ad eh er e chione, as hug ad er coamrey purple.

verses.name: John 19:3
verses.text: As dooyrt ad, Dy vannee dhyt's, Ree ny Hewnyn: as woaill ad eh lesh nyn laueyn.

verses.name: John 19:4
verses.text: Haink Pilate er-y-fa shen magh reesht, as dooyrt eh roo, Cur-my-ner, ta mish dy choyrt lhiam magh hiu eh, dy vod fys y ve eu nagh vel mish er gheddyn foill erbee ayn.

verses.name: John 19:5
verses.text: Eisht haink Yeesey magh, ceau yn attey dy ghrineyn as y coamrey purple. As dooyrt Pilate roo, Cur-jee my-ner yn dooinney.

verses.name: John 19:6
verses.text: Shen-y-fa tra honnick ny ard-saggyrtyn as ny fir-oik eh, deie ad, gra, Jean y chrossey eh, jean y chrossey eh. Dooyrt Pilate roo, Gow-jee shiuish eh, as Jean-jee eh y chrossey: son cha vel mish er gheddyn foill er bee ayn.

verses.name: John 19:7
verses.text: Dreggyr ny Hewnyn eh, Ta leigh ainyn, as liorish y leigh ain lhisagh eh v'er ny choyrt gy-baase, er-y-fa dy ghow eh er dy nee Mac Yee v'eh.

verses.name: John 19:8
verses.text: Tra cheayll Pilate er-y-fa shen yn raa shoh, v'eh ny s'agglee;

verses.name: John 19:9
verses.text: As hie Pilate reesht gys halley ny briwnys, as dooyrt eh rish Yeesey, Cre voish t'ou? Agh cha dug Yeesey ansoor da.

verses.name: John 19:10
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt Pilate rish, Nagh loayr oo rhym's? nagh vel fys ayd dy vel pooar aym's dy dty chrossey, as pooar dy dty eaysley?

verses.name: John 19:11
verses.text: Dreggyr Yeesey, Cha voddagh pooar erbee y ve ayd harrym's, mannagh beagh eh er ny choyrt dhyt veih'n yrjid; shen-y-fa ta peccah smoo lhie ersyn ren m'y livrey hood.

verses.name: John 19:12
verses.text: As veih shen magh va Pilate shirrey dy eaysley eh: agh deie ny Hewnyn, gra, My lhiggys oo yn raad da yn dooinney shoh, cha nee carrey da Cesar oo: quoi-erbee ta jannoo eh-hene ny ree, t'eh loayrt noi Cesar.

verses.name: John 19:13
verses.text: Tra cheayll Pilate er-y-fa shen yn raa shoh, hug eh lesh Yeesey magh, as hoie eh sheese er stoyl ny briwnys, ayns ynnyd ta enmyssit yn Pavement, agh ayns Hebrew, Gabbatha.

verses.name: John 19:14
verses.text: As she er laa aarlaghey ny Caisht ve, as mysh y cheyoo oor: as dooyrt eh rish ny Hewnyn, Cur-jee my-ner yn ree eu.

verses.name: John 19:15
verses.text: Agh dyllee ad, Ersooyl lesh, ersooyl lesh, jean y chrossey eh. Dooyrt Pilate roo, Jean-ym yn ree euish y chrossey? Dreggyr ny ard-saggyrtyn, Cha vel ree ainyn agh Cesar.

verses.name: John 19:16
verses.text: Er shoh ren eh eshyn y livrey huc dy ve er ny chrossey. As ghow ad Yeesey as leeid ad eh ersooyl.

verses.name: John 19:17
verses.text: As dymmyrk eh e chrosh, as hie eh magh gys ynnyd yiarragh ad ynnyd y vollag rish, ta enmyssit ayns Hebrew, Golgotha.

verses.name: John 19:18
verses.text: Raad ren ad eshyn y chrossey, as jees elley marish, fer er dagh cheu, as Yeesey ayns y vean.

verses.name: John 19:19
verses.text: As ren Pilate screeuyn, as hug eh er y chrosh eh. As va'n screeu, YEESEY DY NAZARETH REE NY HEWNYN.

verses.name: John 19:20
verses.text: Yn screeu shoh eisht ren ymmodee jeh ny Hewnyn y lhaih, son va'n boayl raad v'eh er ny chrossey er-gerrey da'n ard valley: as ve scruit ayns Hebrew, as Greek, as Latin.

verses.name: John 19:21
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt ard-saggyrtyn ny Hewnyn rish Pilate, Ny scrieu, Ree ny Hewnyn; agh dy dooyrt eh, She ree ny Hewnyn mee.

verses.name: John 19:22
verses.text: Dreggyr Pilate, Ny ta scruit aym, te scruit.

verses.name: John 19:23
verses.text: Eisht ghow ny sidooryn, tra v'ad er chrossey Yeesey, e gharmadyn (as ren ad kiare ayrnyn jeu, ayrn da dy chooilley hidoor) as myrgeddin e chooat: nish va'n cooat ooilley feeit, veih heose dy heese, fegooish seam.

verses.name: John 19:24
verses.text: Dooyrt ad er-y-fa shen nyn mast' oc hene, Ny lhig dooin y raipey eh, agh lhottyn y hilgey er, quoi echey vees eh: dy voddagh y scriptyr ve cooilleenit, ta gra, Reynn ad my gharmad nyn mast' oc, as er my chooat ren ad lottyn y hilgey. Shoh myr ren ny sidooryn.

verses.name: John 19:25
verses.text: Nish va nyn shassoo liorish crosh Yeesey, e voir, as shuyr e vayrey, Moirrey ben Cleopas, as Moirrey Malaine.

verses.name: John 19:26
verses.text: Tra honnick Yeesey er-y-fa shen e voir, as yn ostyl bynney lesh ny hassoo lioree, dooyrt eh rish e voir, Ven, cur-my-ner dty vac.

verses.name: John 19:27
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt eh rish yn ostyl, Cur-my-ner dty voir. As veih'n oor shen ghow yn ostyl ee gys e hie hene.

verses.name: John 19:28
verses.text: Ny lurg shoh, son dy row fys ec Yeesey dy row dy chooilley nhee nish cooilleenit, dy voddagh y scriptyr ve jeant mie, dooyrt eh, Ta mee paagh.

verses.name: John 19:29
verses.text: Nish va saagh er ny hoiaghey lane vinegar: as lhieen ad spunge leih y vinegar, as hug ad eh er hyssop, as heeyn ad eh seose gys e veeal.

verses.name: John 19:30
verses.text: Tra va Yeesey er-y-fa shen er ghoaill y vinegar, dooyrt eh, Te cooilleenit: as chroym eh e chione, as phaart eh.

verses.name: John 19:31
verses.text: Shen-y-fa son dy nee laa yn aarlaghey ve, as nagh beagh ny kirp er y chrosh er laa yn doonaght (son va'n doonaght shen ny ard-laa) ghuee ny Hewnyn er Pilate, ny lurgaghyn oc dy ve brisht, as ad dy ve goit ersooyl.

verses.name: John 19:32
verses.text: Eisht haink ny sidooryn as vrish ad lurgaghyn y chied er, as y jeh elley v'er ny chrossey marish.

verses.name: John 19:33
verses.text: Agh tra haink ad gys Yeesey, as dy vaik ad dy row eh hannah marroo, cha vrish ad ny lurgaghyn echeysyn.

verses.name: John 19:34
verses.text: Agh ren fer jeh ny sidooryn lesh shleiy yn lhiattee echey y hoylley, as chelleeragh haink magh ass fuill as ushtey.

verses.name: John 19:35
verses.text: As dymmyrk eshyn honnick eh feanish, as ta'n eanish echey firrinagh: as ta fys echey dy vel eh gra yn irriney, dy vod shiuish credjal.

verses.name: John 19:36
verses.text: Son liorish jannoo ny reddyn shoh va'n scriptyr cooilleenit, Cha bee craue jeh er ny vrishey.

verses.name: John 19:37
verses.text: As reesht ta scriptyr elley gra, Jeeaghee ad ersyn t'ad er hoylley.

verses.name: John 19:38
verses.text: As ny lurg shoh ren Joseph dy Arimathea (va fer jeh ynseydee Yeesey, agh dy follit, ayns aggle roish ny Hewnyn) guee er-Pilate, eh dy lhiggey da corp Yeesey y ghoaill ersooyl; as hug Pilate kied da: Haink eh er-y-fa shen, as hug eh lesh corp Yeesey.

verses.name: John 19:39
verses.text: As haink myrgeddin Nicodemus (va roie er jeet gys Yeesey ayns yn oie) as hug eh lesh mysh keead punt dy vyrrh as dy aloes kione y cheilley.

verses.name: John 19:40
verses.text: Eisht ghow ad corp Yeesey, as hoill ad eh ayns aanrityn, lesh spiceyn, myr va cliaghtey ny Hewnyn dy oanluckey.

verses.name: John 19:41
verses.text: Nish er-gerrey da'n ynnyd raad v'eh er ny chrossey, va garey; as ayns y gharey oaie noa, ayn nagh jagh rieau dooinney er coyrt.

verses.name: John 19:42
verses.text: Ayns shen ren ad Yeesey er-y-fa shen y oanluckey, son dy nee laa aarlaghey ny Hewnyn ve, as dy row yn oaie er-gerrey daue.

verses.name: John 20:1
verses.text: ER y chied laa jeh'n chiaghtin, haink Moirrey Malaine dy moghey, tra ve foast dorraghey, gys yn oaie, as honnick ee yn chlagh goit ersooyl jeh'n oaie.

verses.name: John 20:2
verses.text: Eisht roie ee, as haink ee gys Simon Peddyr, as gys yn ostyl elley bynney lesh Yeesey, as dooyrt ee roo, T'ad er ghoaill ersooyl y Chiarn ass yn oaie, as cha s'ain c'raad t'ad er choyrt eh.

verses.name: John 20:3
verses.text: Hie Peddyr er-y-fa shen magh, as yn ostyl elley shen, as haink ad gys yn oaie.

verses.name: John 20:4
verses.text: Son v'ad ny-neesht er roie cooidjagh: agh va'n ostyl elley er roie ny s'bieau na Peddyr, as er jeet hoshiaght gys yn oaie.

verses.name: John 20:5
verses.text: As chroym eh sheese, as honnick eh ny aanrityn nyn lhie, ny-yeih cha jagh eh stiagh.

verses.name: John 20:6
verses.text: Eisht haink Simon Peddyr geiyrt er, as hie eh stiagh 'syn oaie, as honnick eh ny aanrityn nyn lhie.

verses.name: John 20:7
verses.text: As y naptin va mysh e chione, cha nee ny lhie marish ny aanrityn elley, agh fillit er-y-cheilley ayns ynnyd er-lheh.

verses.name: John 20:8
verses.text: Eisht hie stiagh myrgeddin yn ostyl elley shen haink hoshiaght gys yn oaie, as honnick eh as ren eh credjal.

verses.name: John 20:9
verses.text: Son cha row foast toiggal oc jeh'n scriptyr, dy beign da girree veih ny merriu.

verses.name: John 20:10
verses.text: Eisht hie ny ostyllyn rhymboo reesht gys nyn dhie hene.

verses.name: John 20:11
verses.text: Agh va Moirrey ny shassoo cheu mooie jeh'n oaie keayney: as myr v'ee keayney, chroym ee sheese as yeeagh ee stiagh ayns yn oaie.

verses.name: John 20:12
verses.text: As honnick ee daa ainle nyn soie ayns coamraghyn sollys, yn derrey yeh ec y chione, as y jeh elley ec ny cassyn raad va corp Yeesey ny lhie.

verses.name: John 20:13
verses.text: As dooyrt ad r'ee, Ven, cre'n-fa t'ou keayney? Dooyrt ish roo, Er-yn-oyr dy vel ad er ghoaill ersooyl my Hiarn, as nagh s'aym c'raad t'ad er choyrt eh.

verses.name: John 20:14
verses.text: As tra v'ee er ghra shoh, hyndaa ee mygeayrt, as honnick ee Yeesey ny hassoo, as cha row fys eck dy nee Yeesey v'ayn.

verses.name: John 20:15
verses.text: Dooyrt Yeesey r'ee, Ven, cre'n-fa t'ou keayney? quoi t'ou dy hirrey? Heill ish dy nee yn gareyder v'ayn, as dooyrt ee rish, Vainshter, my t'ou er chur lhiat ass shoh eh, insh dou c'raad t'ou er choyrt eh, as goym ersooyl eh.

verses.name: John 20:17
verses.text: Dooyrt Yeesey r'ee, Ny benn rhym; son cha vel mee foast er gholl seose gys my Ayr; agh gow gys my vraaraghyn, as abbyr roo, Ta mee goll seose gys my Ayr's as yn Ayr euish, as gys my Yee's as y Jee euish.

verses.name: John 20:18
verses.text: Haink Moirrey Malaine as dinsh ee da ny ostyllyn, dy row ee er vakin y Chiarn, as dy row eh er loayrt ny goan shoh r'ee.

verses.name: John 20:19
verses.text: Eisht er y laa cheddin, yn chied laa jeh'n chiaghtin, ayns yn astyr, tra va ny dorryssyn dooint, raad va ny ostyllyn er nyn jaglym cooidjagh ayns aggle roish ny Hewnyn, haink Yeesey as hass eh kiongoyrt roo, as dooyrt eh roo, Shee dy row hiu.

verses.name: John 20:20
verses.text: As tra v'eh er ghra shoh, yeeagh eh daue e laueyn as e lhiattee. Eisht ghow ny ostyllyn boggey tra honnick ad y Chiarn.

verses.name: John 20:21
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt Yeesey roo reesht, Shee dy row hiu; myr ta my Ayr er my choyrt's, myr shen ta mish coyrt shiuish

verses.name: John 20:22
verses.text: As tra v'eh er ghra shoh, heid eh orroo, as dooyrt eh roo, Gow-jee yn Spyrryd Noo.

verses.name: John 20:23
verses.text: Da quoi-erbee ta shiuish leih peccaghyn, t'ad er nyn leih daue; as da quoi erbee nagh vel shiu cur feaysley, cha vel ad feayshlit.

verses.name: John 20:24
verses.text: Agh cha row Thomase, fer jeh'n daa ostyl yeig va enmyssit Didymus, maroo tra haink Yeesey.

verses.name: John 20:25
verses.text: Dooyrt ny ostyllyn elley er-y-fa shen rish, Ta shin er vakin y Chiarn. Agh dooyrt eshyn roo, Mannagh vaikym ayns ny laueyn echey ynnyd ny treinaghyn, as mannagh derrym my vair ayns ynnyd ny treinaghyn, as my laue y choyrt stiagh ayns e lhiattee, cha greidym.

verses.name: John 20:26
verses.text: As lurg hoght laa reesht va ny ostyllyn echey sthie, as Thomase maroo: eisht haink Yeesey, as ny dorryssyn dooint, as hass eh kiongoyrt roo, as dooyrt eh, Shee dy row hiu.

verses.name: John 20:27
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt eh rish Thomase, Sheeyn ayns shoh dty vair, as loaghtee my laueyn; as sheeyn dty laue, as cur ee stiagh ayns my lhiattee: as ny bee mee-chredjuagh, agh credjuagh.

verses.name: John 20:28
verses.text: As dreggyr Thomase as dooyrt eh rish, My Hiarn, as my Yee.

verses.name: John 20:29
verses.text: Dooyrt Yeesey rishyn, Homase, Er-y fa dy vel oo er my akin, t'ou er chredjal; bannit t'adsyn nagh vel er vakin, as foast ta er chredjal.

verses.name: John 20:30
verses.text: As ymmodee cowraghyn elley dy jarroo ren Yeesey ayns fenish e ostyllyn, nagh vel scruit ayns y lioar shoh.

verses.name: John 20:31
verses.text: Agh t'ad shoh scruit, dy voddagh shiuish credjal dy nee Yeesey yn Creest Mac Yee, as liorish credjal shiu dy chosney bea trooid yn ennym echeysyn. [(John 20:32) Dooyrt Yeesey,Voirrey. Hyndaa ee ee-hene, as dooyrt ee rish, Rabboni, ta shen dy ghra, Vainshter.]

verses.name: John 21:1
verses.text: LURG shoh hoilshee Yeesey eh-hene reesht da ny ostyllyn, ec faarkey Tiberias; as er yn aght shoh hoilshee eh eh-hene.

verses.name: John 21:2
verses.text: Va Simon Peddyr, as Thomase sliennooit Didymus, as Nathanael dy Chana ayns Galilee; as mec Zebedee, as jees elley jeh ny ostyllyn er nyn jaglym dy cheilley.

verses.name: John 21:3
verses.text: Dooyrt Simon Peddyr roo, Ta mish son goll dy eeastagh. Dooyrt adsyn rish, Hem mainyn myrgeddin mayrt. Hie ad magh, as er-y-chooyl ghow ad lhuingys; as yn oie shen cha haare ad monney.

verses.name: John 21:4
verses.text: Agh 'sy vadran, va Yeesey ny hassoo er y traie: agh cha row fys ec ny ostyllyn dy nee Yeesey v'ayn.

verses.name: John 21:5
verses.text: Eisht dooyrt Yeesey roo, Chloan, vel shiu er dayrtyn veg y veaghey? Dooyrt adsyn rish, Cha vel.

verses.name: John 21:6
verses.text: As dooyrt eh roo, Cuir-jee magh yn lieen er y cheu-yesh jeh'n lhong, as bee eh eu. Eisht chuir ad: as nish cha row dy niart oc yn lieen y ghoaill stiagh va lhied y thummyd eeast ayn.

verses.name: John 21:7
verses.text: Shen-y-fa dooyrt yn ostyl shen bynney lesh Yeesey rish Peddyr, She yn Chiarn t'ayn. Nish tra cheayll Simon Peddyr dy nee yn Chiarn v'ayn, hug eh e chooat-eeastee mysh (son v'eh 'sy lheiney) as hilg eh eh-hene ayns y cheayn.

verses.name: John 21:8
verses.text: As haink ny ostyllyn elley ayns lhong veg (son cha row ad foddey veih'n thalloo, agh mysh keead stundayrt) sleodey lhieu yn lieen as yn eeast ayn.

verses.name: John 21:9
verses.text: Cha leah eisht as v'ad er jeet gys y thalloo, honnick ad aile smarageagh, as eeast ny lhie er, as arran liorish.

verses.name: John 21:10
verses.text: Dooyrt Yeesey roo, Cur-jee lhieu jeh'n eeast ta shiu nish er ghoaill.

verses.name: John 21:11
verses.text: Hie Simon Peddyr er-board, as hayrn eh yn lieen gys thalloo lane dy eeastyn mooarey, shiaght-feed as three-jeig: as son ooilley dy row whilleen ayn, ny-yeih cha vrish y lieen.

verses.name: John 21:12
verses.text: Dooyrt Yeesey roo, Tar-jee gys nyn mee. Agh cha by-lhoys da fer jeh ny ostyl nyn fenaght jeh, Quoi oo hene? cur enney er dy nee eh va'n Chiarn.

verses.name: John 21:13
verses.text: Eisht haink Yeesey, as ghow eh arran, as hirveish eh orroo eh, as eeast myrgeddin.

verses.name: John 21:14
verses.text: Shoh nish yn trass cheayrt hoilshee Yeesey eh-hene da e ostyllyn, erreish da v'er n'irree veill ny merriu.

verses.name: John 21:15
verses.text: Myr shen tra v'ad erreish bee, dooyrt Yeesey rish Simon Peddyr, Simon mac Yonas, vel oo ny s'graihlee orrym's na orroo shoh? Dooyrt eh rish, Ta mee, Hiarn; ta fys ayd dy vel graih aym ort. Dooyrt eh rish, Jeeagh dy mie da my eayin.

verses.name: John 21:16
verses.text: Dooyrt eh rish reesht yn nah cheayrt, Simon mac Yonas, vel oo graihagh orrym? Dooyrt eh rish, Ta mee, Hiarn; ta fys ayd hene dy vel graih aym ort. Dooyrt eh rish, Bee dty vochilley mie er my chirree.

verses.name: John 21:17
verses.text: Dooyrt eh rish yn trass cheayrt, Simon mac Yonas, vel oo graihagh orrym? Va Peddyr mooar-seaghnit dy dooyrt eh rish yn trass cheayrt, Vel oo graihagh orrym? As dooyrt eh rish, Hiarn, ta fys ayd's er dy chooilley nhee, as fys ayd hene dy vel mee graihagh ort. Dooyrt Yeesey rish, Jeeagh dy mie da my chirree.

verses.name: John 21:18
verses.text: Dy firrinagh firrinagh ta mee gra rhyt, Tra v'ou aeg ren oo oo-hene y chryssey, as jimmee oo raad erbee dy bailt: agh tra vees oo shenn, sheeynee oo magh dty laueyn, as nee fer elley oo y chryssey, as ver eh lesh oo raad nagh nailt.

verses.name: John 21:19
verses.text: Shoh loayr eh, cowraghey liorish cre'n baase v'eh dy ghloyraghey Jee. As tra v'eh er ghra shoh, dooyrt eh rish, Eiyr orrym.

verses.name: John 21:20
verses.text: Eisht hyndaa Peddyr mygeayrt, as honnick eh cheet geiyrt orroo yn ostyl bynney lesh Yeesey; yn fer cheddin ren lhie rish e oghrish ec shibber, as dooyrt Hiarn, quoi eh ta dy dty vrah?

verses.name: John 21:21
verses.text: Honnick Peddyr eh shoh, as dooyrt eh rish Yeesey, Hiarn, as cre'n erree hig er y dooinney shoh?

verses.name: John 21:22
verses.text: Dooyrt Yeesey rish, My she m'aigney's eh eshyn dy uirriaght derrey hig-ym, cre ta shen dhyt's? Eiyr uss orrym's.

verses.name: John 21:23
verses.text: Eisht hie yn raa shen magh mastey ny braaraghyn, nagh row yn ostyl shen dy gheddyn baase: agh cha dooyrt Yeesey rish, Cha vow eh baase: agh, My she m'aigney's eh eshyn dy uirriaght derrey hig-yms, cre ta shen dhyt's.

verses.name: John 21:24
verses.text: Shoh yn ostyl dymmyrk feanish jeh ny reddyn shoh, as ren ny reddyn shoh y scrieu: as ta fys ain dy vel yn eanish echey firrinagh.

verses.name: John 21:25
verses.text: As ta myrgeddin ymmodee reddyn elley ren Yeesey, dy beagh ad ooilley scruit, ta mee dy heiltyn nagh gummagh y seihll hene ny lioaryn veagh scruit. Amen.
